jobs.title: Warranty Service Manager - East Valley
jobs.description:
David Weekley Homes is seeking a Warranty Service Manager dedicated to delivering an exceptional customer experience for our homeowners in Phoenix.

Our Warranty Service Managers oversee the post-construction phase of our homes to ensure homeowner satisfaction and uphold David Weekley Homes' quality standards. They manage the warranty process, visiting the home to address homeowner concerns, determining warranty eligibility, coordinating repairs, and ensuring all work aligns with our standards and warranty guidelines.

What You'll Do:

• Engage with homeowners in an inviting, friendly, and professional manner to deliver exceptional experiences and nurture lasting relationships
• Respond quickly, professionally, and accurately to homeowner warranty concerns
• Home visits to inspect issues and determine if the concern is eligible under warranty
• Work with homeowners and subcontractors to resolve the issue quickly and correctly
• Conduct research with available resources to satisfy homeowner inquiries
• Say "no" when necessary, hold firm on decisions, and overcome objections in a professional manner
• Coordinate and schedule all warrantable repairs with contractors and homeowners
• Follow up, inspect, and ensure completion of all repairs
• Hold contractors accountable for results
• Maintain records of issues and resolutions in the warranty database for management reviews
• Instruct customers on how to maintain their homes, as well as communicating what items are not warrantable
• Manage a budget
• Achieve high levels of homeowner satisfaction

• Positive attitude with excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills
• Show resilience under pressure, dealing with negativity and confrontational situations in a professional manner
• Self-starter with excellent time management, scheduling and follow-up skills required
• Comfortable holding subcontractors accountable for the quality of their work and making independent decisions
• Previous experience in the home building industry and/or some home repair experience is helpful, but not required
• Experience managing budget/costs is a plus

.

What We Offer:

Come build your future with our winning team, recognized by Fortune Magazine as one of the "100 Best Companies to Work For" 20 times! David Weekley Homes builds in 19 markets across the U.S. and is one of the largest private home builders in America.

We offer an excellent benefits package that includes:

• Health Insurance - Medical, Dental and Vision
• 401k and discretionary 8% match
• Employee Stock Ownership Plan
• Profit Sharing
• Vacation, Paid Holidays, plus PTO
• New Home Discount for Team Member and Family
• College Scholarship Program
• Community Outreach
• Sabbaticals
• And more!

David Weekley Homes is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by state or federal law.

Note to Job Seekers: No telephone calls or walk-ins please. Interviews are by appointment only. Your resume will be reviewed and qualified candidates may be contacted in the event of a potential job match, or if further information is needed.

jobs.title: Digital Project Manager — Industrial AI, Asset Intelligence & Digital Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Sia/LBG is seeking an experienced Digital Project Manager to support a Frederick, Maryland’s manufacturing site as it advances a prioritized portfolio of roughly 40 digital and AI use cases. This is an on-site digital delivery role, not a capital projects role: the focus is on implementing and sustaining digital tools and industrial AI platforms across manufacturing, maintenance, and asset management, rather than physical plant or facility construction.

This person will own the day-to-day backlog of digital initiatives at the site, coordinate onboarding of newly prioritized use cases as they move through the site's Q4 prioritization cycle and serve as the site-based point of contact connecting operations, engineering, quality, and Sia/LBG's broader digital team. The role must be filled by someone able to work on-site, full-time, and in close proximity to the operational teams they support.

The work spans industrial AI and asset intelligence platforms (Cognite, HighByte, Seeq), maintenance scheduling and predictive maintenance planning (including tools such as Vertex), and asset documentation such as P&IDs, equipment availability, and breakdown history. This role is not a hands-on data science or platform-engineering position; the emphasis is on delivery, prioritization, and cross-functional coordination. The site is concurrently running Process Performance Qualifications (PPQs) and preparing for/undergoing FDA and other regulatory inspections, so this person must be able to sequence digital work sensitively around those constraints.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and manage the site's digital/AI use-case backlog (~40 identified use cases), driving prioritization, sequencing, and onboarding of new use cases through the Q4 planning cycle.
• Serve as day-to-day project manager for digital (non-capital) initiatives spanning asset intelligence, process intelligence, and maintenance planning.
• Coordinate deployment, adoption, and ongoing use of industrial AI / asset-intelligence platforms such as Cognite, HighByte, and Seeq across manufacturing and engineering teams.
• Partner with maintenance and reliability teams on maintenance scheduling (e.g., Vertex) and preventive/predictive maintenance planning, including OEE-related initiatives where prioritized.
• Maintain and organize asset intelligence documentation: P&IDs, equipment availability, breakdown/downtime history to support technician checklists and troubleshooting workflows.
• Coordinate with quality, engineering, and site leadership to sequence digital work appropriately around the site's active commercial manufacturing and regulatory inspections.
• Track project status, risks, dependencies, and timelines, and report progress to site and Sia/LBG digital leadership.
• Act as the proximal, site-based digital PM, embedded with the digital lean team rather than remote.

Required

• 3-7 years of experience as a Project Manager supporting digital, technology, or data-enabled initiatives (this is not a capital/construction project management role).
• Comfortable operating in a GxP/regulated manufacturing environment; formal GxP certification is not required.
• Familiarity with industrial AI / asset-intelligence platforms such as Cognite, HighByte, or Seeq, or comparable platforms.
• Ability to manage a multi-workstream backlog and prioritize across a large portfolio of digital use cases.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across engineering, maintenance, quality, and IT/digital functions.
• Willingness and ability to work on-site, full-time, at the Frederick, MD site.

Preferred

• ​​Direct pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing experience.
• Direct experience with industrial AI / asset-intelligence platforms Cognite, HighByte, or Seeq.
• Experience with maintenance scheduling / CMMS platforms such as Vertex.
• Familiarity with OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) and predictive maintenance concepts.
• Experience supporting sites through FDA inspections (PAI) or Process Performance Qualification (PPQ) campaigns.
• Experience with asset documentation such as P&IDs, LOTO procedures, and equipment breakdown/checklist management.

Compensation & Benefits

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

• Base Salary: $75,000-115,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.
• Annual Performance Bonus

Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP
• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options
• College savings and student loan repayment programs
• Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday
• Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Workplace

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

jobs.title: CNC Field Service Technician - (Remote Work)

With over 20 years of experience supporting the metalworking community of Northern Illinois and Indiana, HFO Chicago is the exclusive distributor for Haas CNC machine tools and rotary products. We’re proud to represent America’s largest machine tool builder, offering a complete range of; 5-axis universal machining centers, vertical machining centers, horizontal machining centers, CNC lathes, CNC mills, rotary tables and 5C collet indexers. All Haas machine tools and rotary products are built to deliver high accuracy, repeatability and durability.

We are currently seeking an adventurous and diligent Field Service Technician. This role will provide exciting opportunities to work for a multifaceted company in a fast-paced, growing industry.

• HFO Chicago is a division of Morris Group, Inc., one of the largest machine tool distribution networks in North America.

jobs.title: Product Owner, Supply Chain & Procurement
jobs.location: Englewood Cliffs, NEW JERSEY, United States
jobs.description:
As a Product Owner, Supply Chain & Procurement (Business Solutions – Corporate Core Finance), you will own the vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for SAP S/4HANA capabilities that support procurement, inventory, and related finance processes. You will work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, engineers, QA, data teams, and delivery partners to deliver scalable, user-centered solutions across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash workflows.

This role combines strong product ownership with a working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Materials Management, Sales and Distribution, and Finance/Controlling integrations. You will focus on improving business outcomes such as purchasing compliance, process efficiency, invoice automation, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, financial controls, and user experience.

Drive Product Outcomes

• Own, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for supply chain, procurement, and related finance capabilities.
• Define the customer and business problems to solve, desired outcomes, and success measures—not only the features to deliver.
• Translate business objectives into prioritized epics, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and incremental release plans.
• Balance customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, risk, compliance needs, and delivery timelines.
• Break large initiatives into smaller releases that enable continuous delivery, learning, and measurable improvement.
• Define and monitor key performance indicators for adoption, process efficiency, procurement compliance, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, and user satisfaction.

Lead Discovery and Process Design

• Lead discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with procurement, supply chain, finance, warehouse, sales, customer service, and IT stakeholders.
• Understand current-state workflows, pain points, and control requirements needs across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash processes.
• Facilitate future-state process design, identify gaps and dependencies, document decisions, and build alignment on scope and priorities.
• Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and system insights to validate assumptions before significant investment.
• Identify opportunities to improve workflows through SAP capabilities, process simplification, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
• Maintain a strong understanding of core procurement, inventory, finance, and cross-functional business processes.

Enable Strong Delivery

• Partner with SAP functional consultants, engineers, QA, integration teams, data teams, and business process owners to refine solutions and remove ambiguity.
• Define requirements for integrations among SAP S/4HANA MM, SD, FI/CO, warehouse operations, tax, payment, logistics, customer, supplier, and third-party systems.
• Validate end-to-end business and accounting impacts across requisition-to-payment, inventory, sales-order-to-billing, and financial reporting processes.
• Participate in and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and other Agile delivery ceremonies.
• Prioritize defects, enhancements, and change requests based on business impact, urgency, risk, compliance, and roadmap value.
• Support implementation activities including master-data readiness, data migration, testing, cutover planning, release readiness, hypercare, and post-launch stabilization.
• Coordinate business testing by defining test scenarios, test data, acceptance criteria, and success measures for end-to-end processes.
• Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, defect triage, and business sign-off.

Build Alignment and Trust

• Act as the liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
• Communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, progress, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Maintain organized product documentation, business-process materials, requirements, decisions, and release information in Confluence.
• Use Jira and Slack effectively to manage backlog transparency, delivery workflow, stakeholder communication, and issue resolution.
• Support change management through training materials, process documentation, release communications, stakeholder demonstrations, and adoption feedback.
• Build trusted relationships across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Technology, and external implementation partners.

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Finance, Supply Chain, Business, or equivalent experience.
• 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, SAP functional delivery professional, or similar role in a technology-driven organization.
• Experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog in an Agile delivery environment.

jobs.title: Delivery Driver (5326) - Osceola, AR
jobs.description:
Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

Domino’s is growing and we are looking to add Delivery Experts to our team!

IMMEDIATE HIRE!  Short or Long shifts - YOUR CHOICE!

Drivers typically average over $20/hr (Wage + Tips + Mileage reimbursement- see below for details).

Flexible Scheduling! Part time and Full-time hours available – Work the shifts that work for you!

ABOUT THE JOB:

Drivers typically average over $20/hr (Wage + Tips + Mileage reimbursement). Mileage reimbursement and tips paid daily, hourly wages paid out every other Friday.

Our Delivery Experts use their own vehicles and receive an adjustable mileage reimbursement to cover fuel costs and extra for other auto-related expenses. Delivery Experts must be at least 18 years old with a clean driving record, 1 year minimum verifiable driving history, and a clean driving record. Safe driving at all times is a must!

Delivery Experts can choose their own schedule. Whether you want to work Part time or Full time, we have shifts available to fit your needs! Our drivers have access to cutting edge technology that makes the SAFE Delivery of Domino’s products faster than our competition. More efficient deliveries = more money!

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Must be 18 years of age or older. Must be able to pass a background check and have a valid driver’s license with a safe driving record (subject to review of Motor Vehicle Report). Must have a reliable vehicle and valid insurance. Must possess good navigational skills and be able to read/follow maps and locate addresses within designated delivery area. Must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings in order to deliver products. Must possess the ability to follow directives, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and well with others, work well under stress, meet strict quality control standards, provide excellent customer service, analyze and compile data, make good judgements and decisions.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product or distributing flyers and door hangers

• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside - In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas

• Fumes from food odors, including exposure to cornmeal dust

• Compact work areas including walk-in cooler

• Hot surfaces/tools including oven reaching 500 degrees or higher

• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts

PHYSICAL DUTIES & REQUIREMENTS

Including but not limited to:

Walking/Carrying/Climbing

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location. During delivery, the driver must carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties. During delivery of product, navigation of 5+ flights of stairs may be required.

Driving

Use safe driving practices to deliver products within a designated delivery area. Delivery drivers may make several deliveries per shift.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients. Crouching and bending peformed occasionally to stock shelves and clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward. Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves. Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes. Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day. Frequent activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists. Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter. Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes. Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Sensing

Talking and hearing on telephone. Depth perception as well as Near and mid-range vision required for most in-store tasks. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces. Far and night vision required for driving

What makes driving for Domino's different than our competition?

OPPORTUNITY!

Our Delivery Experts have the opportunity to work a schedule that works with their lives with flexible full-time and part-time shifts. Domino’s also offers a variety of promotional opportunities such as Shift Lead, Assistant Manager, General Manager and beyond! In fact, 90% of Domino's franchise owners started out as delivery drivers for Domino's!

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential

Ready to join our team? Submit your application today!

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor (Seasonal) - Denver Premium Outlets
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $16.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Cheese Prep Cook (Seasonal)
jobs.description:
A Prep Cook prepares a variety of cold food items and all prepared ingredients that will be distributed to the kitchens to be cooked for restaurants. Reports to the Sous Chef Manager.

• Cleans all utensils, preparation equipment and counters required for production

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and exert well-paced mobility

• Ability to work with commercial equipment including stand mixers, ovens, torches, etc.

jobs.title: Profiling Machine Operator - Bracing Line 1st Shift
jobs.description:
The Machine Operator sets up, operates, and maintains specialized machinery to shape metal coils into specific profiles, ensuring production quality and efficiency. Key responsibilities include installing roller dies, adjusting machine settings, monitoring for defects, performing routine preventive maintenance, and interpreting blueprints to meet strict dimensional tolerances.

• Machine Setup & Operation: Install and align roller dies (tooling) on spindles, load steel/metal coils using cranes or forklifts, and adjust settings for thickness, speed, and shear.

• Production Monitoring: Run the roll-forming line, ensuring continuous material feed, proper lubrication, and accurate cut-to-length functionality.

• Quality Control: Perform first-off inspections, using calipers, micrometers, angle gauges, and tape measures to verify that finished products match blueprints and specs.

• Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Perform daily preventive maintenance (cleaning, oiling, greasing) and troubleshoot issues like jamming, roller wear, or misalignment.

• Safety Adherence: Strict adherence to safety protocols, including machine guarding, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and PPE usage.

Experience: 2 years of experience in metal fabrication, manufacturing, or specific roll-forming machine operation.

Technical Skills: Ability to read blueprints,  SAP work orders, navigate MES system, and interpret technical drawings.

Tools: Proficiency in using hand tools (wrenches), measuring instruments (calipers, gauges, tape measure, micrometer), and potentially overhead cranes.

Physical Strength: Capability to lift materials (often up to 50 lbs) and stand for long periods.

Education: High school diploma or equivalent (GED).

What do we offer you?

• PTO, days paid sick leave, 11 US paid holidays
• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
• Company paid Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
• Company Paid Life Insurance
• Company Paid Accidental Death & Dismemberment
• 401K with employer match, currently 4%
• Partial Tuition Reimbursement after 12 months
• Tobacco Free Campus

Quality, Safety, Health, Environment, Compliance

Every employee at stow contributes to a safe and compliant work environment. We set the example and motivate each other to work safely, efficiently, and in a qualitative way. stow’s standards, policies, instructions, and local legislations are there to guide our decisions.

EEO

stow provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. stow prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, age, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: MSL/Senior MSL, Aesthetics Portfolio - TN, MO, KS
jobs.description:
MSL/Senior MSL, Aesthetics Portfolio is:

• A field based scientific expert that strategically supports the research and business objectives of a designated therapeutic area across the product life cycle for a specific geography/territory
• The primary communicator of AbbVie science within a specific geography with healthcare professionals.
• Develops and maintains professional relationships with internal and external customers to provide comprehensive medical and scientific support to AbbVie initiatives in assigned therapeutic areas.
• Viewed as a peer scientific expert in a designated therapeutic area/product.

Combined with strong strategic vision, market therapeutic area awareness, as well as clinical expertise, the MSL/Senior MSL serve as a conduit of information, education, and research activities for physicians and ancillary healthcare professionals regarding current and future therapies in development or commercialized by AbbVie.

The MSL/Senior MSL works closely with other AbbVie personnel to ensure information, education, and research needs of healthcare professionals are met and to ensure scientific and technical training needs of commercial organizations are identified and met.

Responsibilities:

• Identify, develop, and maintain professional relationships with thought leaders, academic centers, and researchers in assigned areas of therapeutic interest to ensure access to current medical and scientific information on the designated therapeutic/product area
• Present scientific information and education relative to disease state, therapeutic landscape, and AbbVie products across the product lifecycle to healthcare professionals including physicians, academic institutions, researchers, and other health care professionals.
• Support research initiatives as requested by AbbVie R&D, Clinical Operations, and Medical Affairs Departments and physician-initiated projects including, but not limited to, site evaluation and identification, recruitment, investigator meetings, external expert identification, and external collaboration management.
• Prepares marketplace in new therapeutic areas of interest, which includes creating awareness and relationships for AbbVie in the Medical community.
• Creates, maintains, and collaborates in relationships with internal cross-functional partnerships, Works with in-field commercial teams, as appropriate, to develop and execute Account plans designed to support and meet shared business objectives. Serves as a scientific resource to commercial partners, as appropriate, to support activities
• Serve as a medical/scientific resource to healthcare providers through answering unsolicited medical questions and addressing other clinically related medical information issues.

jobs.title: Delivery Driver (6177) - McKenzie, TN
jobs.description:
Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

Domino’s is growing and we are looking to add Delivery Experts to our team!

IMMEDIATE HIRE!  Short or Long shifts - YOUR CHOICE!

Drivers typically average over $20/hr (Wage + Tips + Mileage reimbursement- see below for details).

Flexible Scheduling! Part time and Full-time hours available – Work the shifts that work for you!

ABOUT THE JOB:

Drivers typically average over $20/hr (Wage + Tips + Mileage reimbursement). Mileage reimbursement and tips paid daily, hourly wages paid out every other Friday.

Our Delivery Experts use their own vehicles and receive an adjustable mileage reimbursement to cover fuel costs and extra for other auto-related expenses. Delivery Experts must be at least 18 years old with a clean driving record, 1 year minimum verifiable driving history, and a clean driving record. Safe driving at all times is a must!

Delivery Experts can choose their own schedule. Whether you want to work Part time or Full time, we have shifts available to fit your needs! Our drivers have access to cutting edge technology that makes the SAFE Delivery of Domino’s products faster than our competition. More efficient deliveries = more money!

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Must be 18 years of age or older. Must be able to pass a background check and have a valid driver’s license with a safe driving record (subject to review of Motor Vehicle Report). Must have a reliable vehicle and valid insurance. Must possess good navigational skills and be able to read/follow maps and locate addresses within designated delivery area. Must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings in order to deliver products. Must possess the ability to follow directives, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and well with others, work well under stress, meet strict quality control standards, provide excellent customer service, analyze and compile data, make good judgements and decisions.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product or distributing flyers and door hangers

• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside - In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas

• Fumes from food odors, including exposure to cornmeal dust

• Compact work areas including walk-in cooler

• Hot surfaces/tools including oven reaching 500 degrees or higher

• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts

PHYSICAL DUTIES & REQUIREMENTS

Including but not limited to:

Walking/Carrying/Climbing

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location. During delivery, the driver must carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties. During delivery of product, navigation of 5+ flights of stairs may be required.

Driving

Use safe driving practices to deliver products within a designated delivery area. Delivery drivers may make several deliveries per shift.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients. Crouching and bending peformed occasionally to stock shelves and clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward. Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves. Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes. Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day. Frequent activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists. Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter. Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes. Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Sensing

Talking and hearing on telephone. Depth perception as well as Near and mid-range vision required for most in-store tasks. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces. Far and night vision required for driving

What makes driving for Domino's different than our competition?

OPPORTUNITY!

Our Delivery Experts have the opportunity to work a schedule that works with their lives with flexible full-time and part-time shifts. Domino’s also offers a variety of promotional opportunities such as Shift Lead, Assistant Manager, General Manager and beyond! In fact, 90% of Domino's franchise owners started out as delivery drivers for Domino's!

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential

Ready to join our team? Submit your application today!

This job posting is for a position in a store owned and operated by an independent franchisee, not Domino’s Pizza LLC, Domino’s Pizza Franchising LLC, or Domino’s Pizza, Inc. (“Domino’s Corporate”). This means, among other things, that the independent franchisee is alone responsible for and will independently make all decisions concerning employment matters for the store, including those relating to hiring, firing, discipline, supervision, compensation and benefits, staffing, and scheduling. Domino’s will not receive a copy of any application you submit for this job posting and will not have any control over whether you receive an interview and/or are ultimately hired. Further, Domino’s does not control and is not responsible for the employment policies and practices of independent franchisees. If you are hired for this job posting, the independent franchisee will be your only employer, and you will not be an employee of Domino’s.

At Domino's, we are a brand of honesty, transparency and accountability and we want exceptional people like you to join our team! We have continued to prove we “Put our People First” by making sure our work environment is safe and provides stability for you as a team member. The brand continues to deliver the “Power of Possible” to local Domino’s store owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores!

jobs.title: Senior Building Services Project Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Building Services Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex building services projects across commercial real estate, data centers, life sciences, healthcare, industrial, and other capital project sectors.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the delivery of mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), fire protection, and related building systems throughout the project lifecycle. This role will act as a key client interface, ensuring technical excellence, effective stakeholder coordination, and successful project outcomes aligned with schedule, budget, quality, and operational objectives.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with exceptional project management and leadership skills. They will work collaboratively with clients, design consultants, contractors, commissioning teams, and project stakeholders while promoting Turner & Townsend's values, methodologies, and commitment to delivering better outcomes.

What you'll do

• Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of building services projects from design through commissioning and handover.
• Act as the primary point of contact for clients regarding MEP and building systems delivery.
• Manage multidisciplinary design consultants, contractors, suppliers, and technical stakeholders.
• Oversee the coordination and integration of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and specialty building systems.
• Monitor project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk to ensure successful project delivery.
• Review design documentation, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and technical deliverables for compliance with project requirements.
• Facilitate design reviews, technical workshops, constructability assessments, and value engineering initiatives.
• Support procurement processes, contractor evaluations, and technical bid reviews.
• Identify project risks and lead mitigation strategies related to building services systems and infrastructure.
• Coordinate project activities with construction, cost management, scheduling, and commissioning teams.
• Monitor installation progress and provide oversight during construction, testing, commissioning, and startup activities.
• Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, sustainability objectives, and client requirements.
• Prepare and present project status reports, technical updates, and executive summaries to clients and stakeholders.
• Support project governance, change management, issue resolution, and decision-making processes.
• Develop and maintain strong client relationships while identifying opportunities for additional services.
• Mentor junior team members and promote continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
• 5+ years of experience managing MEP, building services, or technical project delivery on large-scale capital construction projects.
• Experience delivering commercial, healthcare, data center, life sciences, industrial, or mission-critical facilities.
• Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and building systems design and construction.
• Experience managing multidisciplinary consultants, contractors, and client stakeholders.
• Knowledge of commissioning, testing, handover, and operational readiness processes.
• Strong understanding of project controls, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and change management.
• Excellent communication, leadership, and client relationship management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
• Professional certifications such as PMP, PE, CEng, LEED, or equivalent are preferred.

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

• May assist with managing vendor quality and may perform move-in/move-out inspections.

• Demonstrates a strong work ethic and thrives in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Process Optimization Manager

Position Purpose:

Lead operational excellence and regulatory strategy across the contract treatment facility portfolio. Combine regulatory expertise with data-driven process operations and management to ensure facilities maintain high standards of compliance and operational effectiveness. Serve as the technical bridge between executive strategy, regulatory requirements, and on-the-ground implementation across multiple projects, driving continuous improvement and empowering operational and water quality compliance teams.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Technical Guidance: Provide technical consultation on process controls, process troubleshooting, water and wastewater treatment optimization, and regulatory interpretation to elevate the on-the-ground understanding. Key processes to oversee and implement efficiency improvements:Coagulation and flocculation.Oxidation and disinfection.Disinfection byproduct formation.Corrosion control.Distribution water quality.TOC Removal.Sludge management and disposal.Nutrient removal efficiency (wastewater).
• Process Optimization: Conduct and oversee data analytics programs to monitor system performance, identify inefficiencies, and drive operational improvements.
• Regulatory Leadership: Develop and implement regional comprehensive compliance frameworks aligned with our Municipal Services Water Quality and Compliance Team goals, the SDWA, state regulations, and industry best practices. Serve as regional liaison with regulatory agencies, facility operations teams, and executive leadership.
• Continuous Improvement Culture: Instill and lead with a culture of operational excellence across decentralized plant portfolios, steering operational teams to achieve elite, voluntary industry standards like the Area Wide Optimization (AWOP) or Partnership for Safe Water program goals.
• Vendor Collaboration: Partner closely with chemical and equipment suppliers and contractors to evaluate and current treatment technologies that may reduce sludge production, lower chemical consumption, and support O&M budgets.
• Communication Bridging: Deliver technical presentations to executive boards, municipal clients, and on-site utility teams, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned on operational strategies and performance goals.
• Team Collaboration: Network and build relationships with other Municipal Services Teams (e.g. Project Leaders, Technical Leaders, Water Quality and Compliance Directors) to identify gaps, and support implementation at the project level.
• Quality Assurance: Lead, train and support project staff in implementation of the laboratory operations plan (QA/QC), validation of monitoring and reporting protocols and accuracy.
• Strategic Planning: Partner with and assists the Municipal Services Water Quality and Compliance Team on compliance audits, identify skills and gap analyses, and recommend remediation and training initiatives across the facility network.

Work Environment:

• Work is primarily performed in an office and at water and wastewater treatment facilities.
• Occasional travel to facility sites, meetings, and client locations may be required.
• Employees may be exposed to outdoor conditions, industrial equipment, chemicals, and wastewater environments and must follow all applicable safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment.

Education/Experience/Background:

• Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field, such as Environmental Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 15 years of experience in water/wastewater compliance, regulatory affairs, and technical process operations.
• Experience with data analytics, QA/QC program management, and laboratory oversight.
• Preferred: Advanced degree, such as an MS or MBA; a technical MS is highly preferred.
• Preferred: Background in process operations, engineering, or treatment optimization.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Deep knowledge of Safe Drinking Water Act requirements and state and federal regulatory frameworks.
• Demonstrated project management and strategic planning skills.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical and regulatory concepts for diverse audiences.
• Ability to provide matrix leadership as a technical lead, mentor, and advisor to field operations teams without direct hierarchical authority.
• Preferred: Deep technical expertise in analytical chemistry, laboratory instrumentation data, process control, and data management systems used to optimize active treatment processes.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with regulatory agencies, executive leaders, municipal clients, vendors, contractors, and decentralized facility teams.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Preferred: Water and wastewater operator licenses, Professional Engineer (PE) license, or other relevant water-industry credentials.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist I, Cell Line Development / Molecular Biology
jobs.description:
The Biologics CMC Development organization at AbbVie has a long and rich history of biologics development, leveraging comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to advance complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, from discovery through human clinical studies and eventual licensure.

The Cell Line Development (CLD) Innovation Group is seeking a Senior Scientist I to join a talented and collaborative team developing next-generation CHO cell line platforms for the production of recombinant antibodies and complex biologics. This is a hands-on, laboratory-focused role for a versatile molecular biologist who will independently drive expression-optimization projects across both the vector and the host cell — from experimental design through execution and data interpretation. The successful candidate will design and test vector constructs, engineer host cells, conduct transfection and clone-generation campaigns in CHO cells, and apply a deep theoretical understanding of recombinant protein expression to improve titer in stable cell lines. This is not a single-technique position: the role spans the full set of levers that govern expression, and the candidate is expected to think, read, and propose, then carry the work out at the bench with a high degree of independence.

Responsibilities:

• Independently conceive ideas and designs to investigate CHO expression technical improvements across both vector and host cell.
• Design and test dozens of vector constructs in recombinant stable CHO cell lines for increased mAb titer. Rapidly execute the associated transfections, screening, and clone-characterization studies to generate decision-quality data.
• Employ a variety of hands-on laboratory techniques, including transfection, aseptic CHO cell culture, DNA gene copy number analysis, RNA expression analysis (ddPCR / RT-qPCR), mAb titer measurement, cell engineering to knock in/out target genes.
• Operate and interpret data from core CLD instrumentation, including Octet (BLI titer), ViCell, CloneSelect Imager, microfluidic clone-screening platforms such as the Beacon, flow cytometry. Share responsibility for equipment maintenance.
• Apply a rigorous theoretical and practical understanding of recombinant protein expression from the genome to the protein — including genomic loci, epigenetics, transcription, mRNA stability, translation, the organelles and secretory machinery involved, and the engineering constraints specific to industrial CHO cell line development.
• Author and co-author cell line development technical reports and present data to the group and to leadership; contribute scientific insight to project teams.
• Collaborate closely with cell culture, analytical, purification, and bioinformatics colleagues to meet project timelines, and adhere to corporate standards for code of conduct, safety, materials handling, and good documentation practices.

Required:

• Senior Scientist I: BS with a minimum of 10 years, or MS with a minimum of 8 years of experience is strongly preferred, or PhD with no minimum years’ experience, in molecular biology, cell biology, biochemistry, or a related discipline.
• Demonstrated ability to read the literature, review external sources, and gather inputs to synthesize technically sound ideas and design proper experimental controls.
• Demonstrated ability to independently analyze experimental data, draw appropriate conclusions, and communicate them to a wide audience.
• Demonstrated proficiency with designing and implementing vector improvements to increase recombinant antibody expression levels in stable CHO cells.
• Proficiency with Geneious Prime or similar software for designing and annotating DNA vectors, primers, and probes, and performing sequence alignments.
• Proficiency with most or all of the following techniques and instrumentation: transfection, aseptic mammalian cell culture, Octet, ViCell, CloneSelect Imager, and microfluidic clone-screening platforms such as the Beacon.
• Demonstrated ability to learn, understand, and master new experimental techniques, and to multi-task and work within timelines.
• Strong scientific communication skills — verbal, written, and data presentation — with detailed daily digital lab notebook record-keeping proficiency.
• A candidate who combines hands-on wet-lab depth with the ability to think alongside the team and then execute independently.

Preferred:

• While we welcome all candidates with a genuine passion for CHO cell line development, we strongly prefer those who bring hands-on, industry cell line development experience in a CMC / drug-substance environment over candidates with purely academic or cell-culture-development-only backgrounds.
• Candidates with substantial experience developing CHO expression platform improvements in an industrial/CMC setting.
• Possess a demonstrated and genuine passion for getting the most mAb titer out of recombinant CHO cells.
• Previous experience performing cellular analyses using flow cytometry.
• Proficiency with cell engineering to knock in / knock out target genes using CRISPR/Cas or other suitable tools.

Quality:

• Assist in interpreting research findings and developing strategies for implementation of results into evidenced based clinical practice guidelines.

• Attend Unit Based Staff Meetings.
• Attend Unit Based Shared Leadership meeting (POC) and Clinical Nurse Leadership Council (CNLC).
• Attend Unit Leadership (LDOC) Meetings.
• Off-unit committee/project team participation as appropriate.

• Make recommendations for improvements in clinical efficiency in partnership with operational manager.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.

• Leads content review/revision for unit based orientation annually.
• Actively Participates in new employee orientation (PCS Orientation and unit based orientation).
• Participates in monitoring new hire goal progress and in touch points/check-ins.

• Provides formal classroom instruction and skills assessments including competency assessment.

• Maintains visibility on all shifts and serves as resource to off-shift staff.
• Communicates efficiently and effectively role modeling using critical-thinking skills and problem-solving skills.

Leadership:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.description:
Mission

IntegriChain is on a mission to help all stakeholders in the life sciences industry drive access. We do this through our relentless focus on unifying all of the critical business functions for therapy commercialization and access contracts and pricing, gross-to-net, channel, and patient services unlocking strategic payer, provider, pharmacy and patient access insights for our life sciences customers.

This role is for a Sr. Product Manager who wants real ownership and real impact. You will own a critical product area end‑to‑end—from problem discovery through delivery and adoption—with clear accountability for outcomes, not just execution. You’ll operate as a decision‑maker at the center of Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and customer‑facing teams, shaping strategy while staying deeply connected to how the product is built and used.

The problems you’ll work on are complex, operationally critical, and deeply embedded in customer workflows. Success requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to translate messy, real‑world processes into clear product direction. You’ll be expected to challenge assumptions, prioritize based on evidence, and make hard tradeoffs when constraints collide.

Roles and Responsibilities

This is not a role for someone who waits for direction or optimizes for consensus. It is a role for a PM who:

• Wants clear ownership of a product area
• Is energized by hard problems with meaningful business impact
• Can balance long‑term strategy with hands‑on execution
• Earns trust by making sound decisions and delivering results

Required Skills

• Own and evolve the multi-quarter product strategy and roadmap (6+ quarters) for assigned product areas, aligned to company objectives and market needs.

• Proactively identify delivery risks, dependencies, and scope changes, and drive resolution.
• Lead release planning and readiness for assigned product areas, ensuring features are usable, valuable, and supportable.
• Facilitate roadmap reviews, prioritization discussions, and decision forums with senior leaders.
• Represent the product in customer conversations, translating feedback into actionable insights and decisions.
• Collaborate with delivery teams to estimate roadmap initiatives and inform quarterly and annual planning.
• Align priorities with capacity constraints and support resource allocation discussions.
• Coach and mentor business analysts on best practices in discovery, prioritization, and execution.

Qualifications

• 7+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of complex products.
• Deep experience in US Pharmaceutical Market Access, including Commercial Contracting, Pricing, Claims Adjudication, Rebates, or Chargebacks.
• Strong understanding of US Healthcare and Life Sciences systems, data, and operational workflows.
• Proven ability to lead within Agile environments (Scrum) and partner effectively with Engineering and QA.
• Experience with system integration, revenue management, or business operations platforms.
• Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate effectively with executive, business, and technical audiences.
• Proficient with Jira, Confluence, and modern product lifecycle management tools.
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field preferred.

What does IntegriChain have to offer?

Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!

• Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Student Loan Reimbursement, Flexible Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave
• 401(k) Plan with a Company Match to prepare for your future

jobs.title: Senior Strategy & Operations Lead, US Tax Operations
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

US Tax Operations is responsible for resolving tax notices that clients receive from the IRS and state agencies, as well as managing the filings, payments, and amendments work that helps prevent those notices. The organization includes notice-resolution specialists, managers, and pillar leads across notices, filings, payments, and amendments.

As the organization has grown, the leadership team has outgrown its current operating structure. This newly created role will build and own the operating cadence, reporting, accountability mechanisms, and planning processes that help US Tax Operations operate effectively at scale.

Today, coordination, reporting, and follow-through often sit with pillar leads and managers who are also responsible for day-to-day execution. In this role, you will take ownership of those operating responsibilities so leaders can focus on running and scaling their teams.

You’ll establish reliable executive reporting, drive accountability for commitments, partner with pillar leads on capacity planning, and lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how the organization runs. This role requires someone who can bring structure to ambiguity, operate independently, and move work forward without needing deep tax or payroll subject-matter expertise.

Over time, this role is expected to help build a dedicated operations function for US Tax Operations, with a path to managing a small team as the function matures.

What you will do

• Own the operating cadence: Establish and maintain the planning, review, and follow-through processes that keep US Tax Operations leadership aligned on priorities, progress, and risks.
• Build executive-ready reporting: Develop and maintain clear reporting that gives leadership an accurate, current view of progress against annual operating plan goals, including risks, delays, and root causes.
• Drive accountability: Track action items, decisions, and commitments from recurring leadership forums, ensuring clear ownership and timely follow-through.
• Lead capacity planning: Partner with pillar leads to translate projected workload and growth into hiring plans, including planning for extended international hiring lead times.
• Solve ambiguous operating problems: Identify operational gaps, create structured solutions, and drive cross-functional initiatives through completion with minimal oversight.
• Build a scalable operating function: Help define and integrate new specialist roles, including a Systems Lead and Quality & Enablement Lead, and establish the management structure needed as the function grows.
• Measure success and operating discipline: Ensure initiatives are tracked accurately, commitments are completed, and risks are surfaced early with clear explanations and corrective actions.

What you will have

• Experience in management consulting, strategy and business operations, program management, or a similar role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
• Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problems or loosely defined mandates and turn them into structured plans, processes, and measurable outcomes.
• Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive initiatives through completion.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex or ambiguous priorities into clear plans, actionable updates, and executive-ready reporting.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate tracking of goals, commitments, decisions, and progress.
• Ability to operate independently with significant autonomy and influence stakeholders without formal authority.
• Sound judgment, a results-oriented mindset, and the ability to identify when work is off track, understand why, and drive corrective action.
• Experience building operating cadences, business reporting, accountability mechanisms, or planning processes for a growing organization.
• Experience with capacity planning, workforce planning, or translating workload forecasts into hiring plans.
• Experience partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to drive operational improvements.
• Experience with Jira or a similar project and initiative-tracking system is a plus.
• People management experience, or a strong interest in developing as a people leader, is a plus.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

jobs.title: HVAC Operating Engineer
jobs.description:
Uncommon Schools is seeking a HVAC Operating Engineer to join the charter network’s New Jersey Facilities team. This position provides an opportunity for an experienced HVAC Operating Engineer with at least seven (7) years' relevant experience to work with a dedicated facilities group, deepen his/her technical skills, and help ensure that Uncommon provides well-maintained, comfortable, and safe educational facilities for our students and staff.

Uncommon’s portfolio in New Jersey comprises buildings constructed from the very early 1900s through the early 2020s, operating HVAC systems dating from 1966 to the recent past few years. As ambient comfort is essential to a productive learning and teaching environment, the impact of this individual’s attentiveness will be felt and deeply appreciated across the region.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Facilities Management Team, the HVAC Operating Engineer will perform all technical work necessary to inspect, maintain, repair, and modify HVAC system in our buildings.

With expertise in HVAC – and to a lesser extent in construction and plumbing – in multi-family, schools, and commercial buildings, the successful candidate will be responsible for conducting minor HVAC projects and managing larger ones and ensuring they are completed on time and within budget. The HVAC Operating Engineer will partner with senior Facilities team members and outside consultants on the planning, coordination, and supervision of mechanical construction and repair activities implemented by outside vendors, will ensure project timelines are met and ensure quality control standards are followed, mentor junior staff, and handle all HVAC-related communication with stakeholders.

Uncommon values candidates who have the drive and ability to work hard, are highly self-motivated, are eager to take on and implement assignments and projects, and have a strong commitment to customer service and satisfaction.

Safe, efficient, healthy, clean, comfortable, and reliable buildings are essential to Uncommon’s mission to deliver an excellent education to our students and a comfortable working environment to our dedicated staff.

As a member of the NJ Facilities Team, the HVAC Operating Engineer will:

• maintain current knowledge of the National Standard HVAC Code and other applicable building codes and perform all facets of the HVAC trade in accordance with those codes and in a safe and effective manner
• diagnose problems with HVAC systems, evaluate solutions to remedy issues, and provide sound recommendations to supervisors
• in emergency situations take immediate steps to contain the problem and restore the system to sound working condition
• in emergency situations maintain clear and consistent communication with stakeholders to apprise them of steps being taken to address the issue
• troubleshoot and repair all HVAC type systems currently available in the market
• maintain records of corrective and preventive work assignments received through an automated work order system (currently SchoolDude, soon ZenDesk)
• assist onsite Facilities Managers and General Maintenance Workers with work projects or special assignments
• respond to campus emergency calls after hours as needed
• perform other duties as assigned

Required Technical Skills:

• Significant journeyman-level HVAC experience along with the trade knowledge to effectively understand and perform all facets of the HVAC trade in accordance with the National Standard Plumbing Code and other applicable codes
• Strong background in commercial heating projects large and small, including hot water boilers and gas furnaces
• Ability to read as-built plans for all buildings in portfolio
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, submittals, cut sheets, layouts, technical manuals, schematic drawings, and other HVAC-related trade documents
• Advanced knowledge of BMS systems and system operations
• Ability to procure replacement parts as needed to make all necessary repairs
• Ability to properly and safely use the tools of the trade and carry out all tasks expected of a Snr. HVAC Technician
• Ability to troubleshoot and repair refrigerant-driven cooling and heating equipment (heat pump systems)
• Ability to troubleshoot and repair water-driven heating and cooling equipment
• Ability to troubleshoot and repair water or glycol pump systems
• Ability to troubleshoot and service chillers and cooling towers
• Ability to change filters and belts and clean coils as needed to ensure proper functioning of units
• Ability to troubleshoot and implement recommended repair/replacement ofgas valves economizer motors and damperscompressors and contactors dampers chilled water and hot water pumpsglycol injection units
• Ability to evacuate and top-off units with refrigerant

General Technical Skills

• Bachelor’s Degree equivalent or seven plus (7+) years of experience in the HVAC field
• Evidence of progressive responsibility and experience in HVAC field, with four plus (4+) years as head technician
• Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
• Familiarity with key building systems (HVAC, electrical, mechanical, plumbing)
• Familiarity with OSHA and other Life Safety codes, etc.
• Computer skills necessary to operate BMS system
• Facility with Microsoft office suite
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through
• Ability to communicate effectively verbally and electronically with facilities staff, school staff, and vendors
• Available to work nights and weekends when necessary
• Extreme flexibility, with a strong work ethic and an entrepreneurial spirit to accommodate high level of responsibility and multiple priorities
• New Jersey low pressure black seal boiler, HVAC or other certificate, training, or licenses a plus
• Carry a current EPA card enabling technician to dispense of refrigerants
• Valid driver’s license and vehicle
• Strong capacity to operate independently

Physical Requirements

• The physical requirements outlined below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.
• Stand or walk for up to two (2) hours at one time, up to eight (8) hours per day
• Sit for fewer than two (2) hours during an eight (8)-hour day
• Lift or carry up to 35 pounds frequently and 100 pounds occasionally
• Lift up to 100 pounds to waist height and up to 35 pounds in a range of motions from floor to overhead

Uncommon Schools is seeking a Senior HVAC Technician (Snr HVAC Tech) to join the charter network’s New Jersey Facilities team. This position provides an opportunity for an experienced HVAC technician with at least seven (7) years' relevant experience to work with a dedicated facilities group, deepen his/her technical skills, and help ensure that Uncommon provides well-maintained, comfortable, and safe educational facilities for our students and staff.

Uncommon’s portfolio in New Jersey comprises buildings constructed from the very early 1900s through the early 2020s, operating HVAC systems dating from 1966 to the recent past few years. As ambient comfort is essential to a productive learning and teaching environment, the impact of this individual’s attentiveness will be felt and deeply appreciated across the region.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Facilities Management Team, the Senior HVAC Technician will perform all technical work necessary to inspect, maintain, repair, and modify HVAC system in our buildings.

With expertise in HVAC – and to a lesser extent in construction and plumbing – in multi-family, schools, and commercial buildings, the successful candidate will be responsible for conducting minor HVAC projects and managing larger ones and ensuring they are completed on time and within budget. Uncommon values candidates who have the drive and ability to work hard, are highly self-motivated, are eager to take on and implement assignments and projects, and have a strong commitment to customer service and satisfaction.
