jobs.title: Associate Director, International Market Access and Pricing, Immunology
jobs.description:
The Associate Director, Pricing is the International pricing lead for RINVOQ. The role sets RINVOQ's International pricing strategy and preserves the integrity of RINVOQ's price across its indications and markets. It turns pricing analysis into clear guidance, robust business cases and accurate financial assumptions, and supports Area and affiliate teams in achieving broad, timely and sustainable patient access that reflects the value of RINVOQ.

Key Responsibilities:

Pricing Strategy and Guidance:

• Develop and maintain International pricing guidance for RINVOQ (price corridors and launch and re-pricing recommendations) in line with brand strategy, the Integrated Access Strategy (IAS) and corporate objectives.
• Apply the Strategic Pricing Framework to define the price potential of new indications and formulations, and recommend indication and country launch sequencing that maximizes International value.
• Develop contracting guidance and access models that address payer objections and affordability concerns while preserving the integrity of RINVOQ's price.
• Monitor International pricing policy and competitor pricing, and flag risks and opportunities for RINVOQ early.

Business Cases and Pricing Governance:

• Lead the development, review and challenge of RINVOQ pricing business cases from affiliates and Areas, ensuring each is analytically sound, compliant with International pricing governance and ready for decision.
• Prepare and present business cases to the Executive Pricing Councils, with a clear recommendation, quantified financial impact, risks and mitigations.

PVTO and IRP Analysis:

• Build and run price-volume trade-off (PVTO) analyses to evaluate price and access scenarios, breakeven volumes and the net revenue impact of pricing decisions at market and International level.
• Assess International Reference Pricing (IRP) implications of every proposed price change, launch price and confidential agreement. Quantify cross-country spill-over and recommend the sequencing and price levels that preserve the integrity of RINVOQ's price across International markets.
• Work with International Pricing analysts to design, run and interpret IRP, PVTO and launch-sequencing models, and turn the outputs into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Plan and LRP:

• Own the RINVOQ pricing assumptions in the annual Plan and Long Range Plan (LRP) process, including price evolution, launch timing, price erosion, IRP impact and risk and opportunity scenarios.
• Collect, challenge and align pricing assumptions with Areas, affiliates and Finance, so that forecasts are consistent and explained.

Cross-Functional Partnership:

• Area and affiliates (primary partners): help key markets turn International pricing guidance into local outcomes, covering price potential, negotiation strategy, scenarios, fallback positions and objection handling for national and sub-national negotiations.
• Therapy Area teams (primary partners): make sure the pricing position is reflected in the RINVOQ IAS and brand strategy, and that indication priorities reflect price potential.
• HTA: align price potential with the expected HTA outcome and value story and assess the price implications of HTA evidence and comparator choices.
• Finance: reconcile pricing inputs with Plan, LRP and business case financials, and agree the net revenue impact of pricing decisions.
• Act as the internal subject matter expert on RINVOQ pricing, IRP and pricing analytics.

Essential

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Health Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Pharmacy or a related field.
• At least 3 years' experience in pharmaceutical pricing, market access, health economics or commercial finance.
• Strong quantitative and modelling skills, with experience building and interpreting pricing, forecasting or scenario models in Excel.
• Working knowledge of International Reference Pricing and its impact on launch sequencing and price setting.
• Ability to condense complex analysis into clear, concise recommendations for senior audiences. Excellent written and spoken English.
• Able to influence without authority in a matrix organization, make sound calls on incomplete data, and challenge affiliate and Area proposals constructively.

Desired

• Hands-on experience with pricing business cases for executive pricing committees, PVTO analysis and Plan/LRP pricing assumptions.
• Knowledge of P&R systems in key markets, including Australia, Canada, China, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Spain and the UK.
• Understanding of HTA and health economic principles from a payer perspective.
• Experience in immunology or another multi-indication specialty brand.

jobs.title: Senior manager, lifecycle & audience marketing
jobs.description:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.

Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Austin, Chicago, Seattle, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.



📐 About the role

WRITER is looking for a senior lifecycle marketing manager to own how we engage, nurture, and grow our audiences across the customer journey.

You'll own our email and lifecycle marketing program end to end, from strategy and audience development through hands-on execution, measurement, and optimization. At the heart of the role is a simple goal: getting the right message to the right person at the right time.

This is both a strategic and highly hands-on role. You'll define our lifecycle strategy and then get into HubSpot to build it: creating emails, audiences, workflows, nurture programs, triggered journeys, tests, and reporting. You'll use behavioral, account, intent, and engagement signals to understand where people are in their journey and create experiences that become more relevant and personalized over time.

You'll also help define what lifecycle marketing looks like in an AI-first world, exploring how AI can change the way we build audiences, personalize communications, and use email to move people throughout their journey with WRITER.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, or Seattle hubs. You will report directly into the Director, lifecycle marketing.



🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do

 - Own our email and lifecycle marketing program end to end, from strategy and audience development through hands-on execution, measurement, and optimization in HubSpot

 - Build and manage emails, audiences, workflows, nurture programs, triggered journeys, A/B tests, and reporting directly in HubSpot without relying on marketing operations

 - Drive audience segmentation strategy, getting into the weeds of how our database is structured to deliver the right message to the right person at the right time across a growing contact base

 - Use behavioral, account, intent, and engagement signals to create experiences that become more relevant and personalized over time, supporting complex enterprise buying journeys and account-based GTM motions

 - Partner cross-functionally with demand generation, ABM, content, product marketing, and sales to align lifecycle programs with broader GTM priorities and ensure nurture supports pipeline from first touch through expansion

 - Explore how AI can transform the way we build audiences, personalize communications, and use email to move people through their journey — experimenting quickly and pushing beyond traditional lifecycle playbooks

 - Establish the reporting and measurement framework that connects lifecycle activity to engagement, pipeline, and revenue outcomes, and translate performance into clear decisions and program improvements



⭐️ What you need

 - 6+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, email, or retention marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.

 - Experience owning an email and lifecycle marketing program end to end, including both strategy and hands-on execution.

 - Experience building lifecycle programs for complex enterprise buying journeys and understanding how email and nurture support account-based GTM motions.

 - Deep hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform. You should be comfortable independently building emails, lists, workflows, nurture programs, automation, and reporting.

 - Experience using person-level and account-level signals to inform segmentation, nurture, personalization, and lifecycle strategy.

 - Strong understanding of segmentation, personalization, behavioral triggers, and audience management.

 - Strong understanding of email fundamentals, including deliverability, experimentation, frequency management, QA, and performance measurement.

 - Strong analytical instincts and the ability to translate performance into clear decisions and program improvements.

 - A builder mentality. You're equally comfortable developing the strategy and getting into the tools to make it happen.

 - Strong ownership and comfort operating in ambiguity, identifying what needs to happen rather than waiting for a fully formed brief.

 - A strong point of view on personalization and curiosity about how AI is changing email, audience strategy, and lifecycle marketing. You don't need to have all the answers, but you should be excited to experiment, learn quickly, and push beyond traditional lifecycle playbooks.


🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees)

 - Generous PTO, plus company holidays

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

 - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

 - Fertility and family planning support

 - Flexible spending account and dependent FSA options

 - Health savings account for eligible plans with company contribution

   - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

jobs.description:
Uncommon Middle School Science teachers work in grade-level teams to prepare all students with the tools and knowledge to critically engage in the field of science. At the heart of all Science courses is a love for the subject and inquiry-based learning, including a robust focus on student discourse and the science practices. Science teachers employ a variety of instructional strategies to develop a passion for scientific questioning and analysis in their students. Our teachers strive for subject mastery and have a keen sense of the socio-emotional changes middle schoolers experience. At the conclusion of eighth grade, students are prepared for the academic autonomy and college preparatory focus of our high schools.

Responsibilities

jobs.description:
Join the 2025 AIA Firm Award Winner https://www.aia.org/about-aia/press/lpa-design-studios-receives-2025-aia-architecture-firm-award shaping a more sustainable future.

LPA is a collective of designers, engineers, and researchers committed to tackling the biggest issues of our time. Our "No Excuses" integrated design approach was recognized by the AIA as “a trailblazer in sustainable, high-performance architecture".  At LPA you’ll be part of the team that is changing the way the industry thinks about design and carbon emissions, built around the belief that we only achieve our goals when everybody has a seat at the table and all input is valued.

LPA is seeking an Electrical Project Manager to join our integrated team of architects, engineers, interior designers, landscape architects and master planners. As a member of our MEP+L Systems Engineering team, you will work on a broad range of projects from office, education and recreation buildings to complex laboratories, health care facilities, and performing arts centers. Our award-winning projects aim to have a positive and enduring environmental, economic and social impact.

Click this link to learn more about our MEP+L Systems Engineering team https://lpadesignstudios.com/playlist/systems.



What You Will Do:

 - Prepare and/or oversee complete electrical drawings for schematic design, design development, and construction documents in close collaboration with internal teams, architects, clients, and consultants.

 - Lead the electrical design effort and coordinate with other disciplines to define requirements for equipment power, lighting, and special systems throughout the project scope.

 - Apply a strong understanding of design standards and code requirements related to medium-voltage and utility systems.

 - Contribute to projects of varying types, sizes, and complexities, including large-scale, technically complex projects and those incorporating emerging industry technologies.

 - Develop creative and effective electrical design solutions using sound engineering judgment; evaluate alternative electrical distribution schemes based on cost, efficiency, space constraints, constructability, and performance.

 - Prepare project labor hour and fee estimates; review construction cost estimates; write, edit, and develop project specifications as needed.

 - Perform feasibility studies for existing facilities and electrical systems, including load analysis, capacity assessments, and future electrical requirements; coordinate metering strategies and field surveys as required.

 - Support construction administration activities, including punch lists, RFIs, and submittal reviews.

 - Design and coordinate special electrical systems such as photovoltaics, emergency and standby power systems, battery energy storage systems, fire pumps, and grounding; maintain a working knowledge of low-voltage and fire alarm systems.

What We Offer:

At LPA, your growth and contributions matter. We foster a collaborative culture where creative ideas are valued, and voices are heard.

 - Mentorship from Managing Directors, Design Directors, and senior team members across disciplines.

 - Career development support, including professional development grants and in-house training.

 - Ongoing education through LPA+U courses and Tech Talks focused on innovative, sustainable practices.

 - 8 paid hours of volunteer time each year.

 - Opportunities to propose and lead projects that impact your local community, including more than $1 million since 2015 in Habitat for Humanity builds, scholarships, and other pro bono community projects.  

 - Access to our Professional Development Grants program, created to encourage professional development and further LPA's collective knowledge as a firm.  Over the life of the grant program, we have invested $1,196,890 and impacted 848 LPA employees.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

 - 10+ years of experience in electrical engineering, with a focus on the design of building power and lighting systems.

 - Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in Electrical Engineering.

 - Strong understanding of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and applicable energy codes, including common design sections and the ability to efficiently locate relevant tables and requirements.

 - Demonstrated ability to perform value engineering, including evaluating design alternatives and developing high-level construction cost estimates to meet client or owner budget objectives.

 - Extensive knowledge of electrical, building, and energy code requirements, as well as key client and owner design standards.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively coordinate with clients, consultants, and internal teams.

Preferred:

 - Working knowledge of AutoCAD and Revit.

Lead the Market. Shape the Future.

Are you a proven sales leader with a passion for developing high-performing teams, driving revenue growth, and making a lasting impact in your community?

Townsquare Media Group is looking for a dynamic Market President to lead our Cedar Rapids/ Waterloo operation. This is more than a sales management role—it's an opportunity to serve as the local leader of one of the most recognized media organizations in the country.

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Cedar Rapids/ Waterloo stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

• Lead market-wide sales initiatives focused on new business development, key account growth, and client retention

• Partner with sales leaders and Account Executives to secure high-value business opportunities and deliver integrated marketing solutions

• Analyze market performance and implement strategies that maximize revenue, profitability, and market share

• Represent the company at community events, industry organizations, and key client meetings

• Build partnerships that strengthen Townsquare's visibility, reputation, and influence within the market

• Foster a culture that supports both business success and community engagement

Drive Operational Excellence

• Oversee market budgeting, forecasting, and overall financial performance

• Ensure compliance with FCC regulations and all federal, state, and local requirements

• Monitor market performance metrics and implement action plans to improve results

• Align market resources, talent, and business strategies to achieve long-term growth objectives

• Proven track record of consistently exceeding revenue goals and delivering profitable growth

• Experience leading teams in both traditional and digital advertising environments

• Strong understanding of digital marketing solutions, including programmatic, social, search, and website strategies

• Demonstrated success recruiting, coaching, and retaining high-performing talent

• Ability to create strategic plans and translate vision into measurable results

• Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, budgeting, and revenue management

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

• Community-minded leadership style with a passion for local business growth

• A hands-on, lead-from-the-front mentality—this is not a sit-behind-the-desk leadership role

We know exceptional leaders create exceptional results. Here's what you can expect:

• Volunteer Time Off

jobs.description:
All Uncommon Schools teachers hold primary responsibility for the implementation of Uncommon’s curriculum and the success of our students. Therefore, Uncommon Schools seeks teachers who are committed to becoming best-in-class educators, who are continuously improving instructional practices through collaboration and targeted development within their school community. We are currently seeking both experienced and apprentice teachers for all grades and all subjects for the 25-26 and 26-27 school years.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

• Implement curricula and activities to meet our high academic standards
• Analyze assessments that measure progress towards these standards and use this assessment data to inform and differentiate instructional practices
• Focus constantly on student learning, thinking critically and strategically to respond to student learning needs
• Create a positive, structured learning environment to ensure that students observe the school’s core values, high expectations, and code of conduct
• Communicate effectively with students, families, and colleagues
• Commit to continual professional growth, participating actively in our annual, three-week staff orientation training in August and instructional training throughout the school year

jobs.title: Store Supervisor (Full-Time)
jobs.description:
Studs is a category-defining ear piercing and earring brand named one of “the 10 most innovative companies in retail for 2023” by Fast Company. Studs connects ear piercing with aftercare and earring shopping to create an end-to-end Earscaping® experience. We offer a better retail and digital experience that prioritizes safety and expertise in a cool, fun and welcoming environment, along with a wide earring assortment—all at an accessible price point.

*Please Note: The official title for this role will be Studio Supervisor*

Location: Madison, WI | Reports to: Studio Manager | Full Time

Hourly Rate: $17

The Studio Supervisor plays a critical support role in the daily operations of the Studio, serving as a trusted keyholder and frontline leader. This role is designed for team members who consistently demonstrate strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to operate independently.

As a Studio Supervisor, you’ll help open and close the Studio, support floor leadership during peak periods, and ensure a consistent customer and brand experience. You’ll also set the tone on the floor — modeling our values, reinforcing service standards, and supporting operational execution. This is a non-managerial role but one that requires maturity, ownership, and leadership by example.

Key Responsibilities:

Operational Execution & Sales Support

• Opens and closes the Studio independently and ensures all opening/closing procedures are completed accurately

• Supports daily execution of visual merchandising, supply restocks, and Studio upkeep

• Reviews daily business and helps implement strategies to drive results

• Acts as a floor leader during assigned shifts, helping structure the team to deliver both sales and service goals

• Upholds compliance with safety and brand standards, including regulations tied to piercing and Studio cleanliness

Customer Experience

• Delivers exceptional service and educates customers on the Studs experience

• Supports service recovery and escalates customer concerns as needed

• Ensures a warm, welcoming, and consistent customer journey aligned with our service expectations

Team Support & Culture

• Sets a strong example for professionalism, inclusion, and accountability

• Provides real-time feedback and support to teammates when appropriate, escalating as needed

• Helps reinforce company values and contributes to a collaborative, feedback-rich environment

Requirements:

• Prior experience in a keyholder or shift lead role that included independent operations and opening/closing responsibilities

• Must be available to work a flexible schedule up to 5 days per week (32+ hours), including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Must maintain consistent availability

• Weekend availability (Friday, Saturday, Sunday) is required, excluding approved PTO

• Schedules may vary based on business needs, and Full-Time employees are expected to prioritize Studs as their primary employment commitment

• Proven track record of professionalism, reliability, and sound judgment in a customer-facing environment

• Comfortable standing for extended periods (up to 8+ hours) and able to lift/move at least 20 lbs

• Able to handle chemicals safely and follow all relevant health, safety, and compliance protocols

• Confident operating solo and taking ownership of floor leadership responsibilities when assigned

• Brings a positive attitude, receives feedback well, and contributes to a collaborative, service-oriented team culture

Benefits & Perks

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (including $0 in-network mental health visits)

• Access to Mental Health and Work/Life Resources including Online Therapy, Gender Affirmation Support Services, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Voluntary Life Insurance

• Health and Commuter Tax-Advantaged Accounts

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Paid Time Off and Paid Safe & Sick Leave Accruals

• Exclusive Employee Discounts on Piercings and Jewelry (we’ve got your friends and family covered too!)

• Access to PerkSpot and additional benefits such as pet insurance, discounted tickets, personal finance coaching, healthy rewards, and more!

jobs.title: High School Science Teacher
jobs.description:
Uncommon High School Science teachers work collaboratively across the network to prepare all students with the tools and knowledge to critically engage in the field of science and develop them into self-directed learners. At the heart of all Science courses is inquiry-based learning, including a robust focus on student discourse and the science practices. Science teachers employ a variety of instructional strategies to develop a passion for scientific questioning and analysis in their students. Our teachers prepare all students such that they have the choice to study and excel in any STEM discipline. We prepare all students to be citizen scientists that have the tools and knowledge to critically engage in the field of science regardless of their university major or professional career. Our teachers become experts in their course content and have a keen sense of how to motivate and inspire high school students.

Responsibilities

1.     Instruction

• You’ll teach a curriculum that includes, but is not limited to, analysis of Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Environmental Sciences that prepares students for Advanced Placement (AP) and collegiate level coursework.
• You'll develop students’ practices skills of questioning, modeling, constructing explanations, data analysis, argumentation, and planning and conducting interactive labs.
• You’ll create an environment where students feel confident using their voice to engage in scientific discourse.
• You will facilitate student-led discourse, during which students use evidence to make sophisticated claims and synthesize and critique arguments.
• You'll facilitate student-led inquiry of various scientific topics and engage students in lab and project-based performance tasks.
• You'll work with the Science department to determine academic and engagement goals for students.

2.     Data Analysis

• You'll meet weekly with your principal and/or instructional coach to analyze and respond to trends in student work samples and assessments.
• You'll learn and implement strategies to differentiate instruction for all learners in your classroom.

3.     School Culture

• You’ll build positive relationships with students to ensure they feel seen, loved, and heard.
• You’ll partner with students’ families to ensure appropriate resources are available to support their child's learning needs.
• You'll engage in practice-based professional development, mentorship, and coaching sessions.
• You'll participate in weekly, school-wide meetings to cultivate community, model our core values, and encourage student achievement.
• You'll partner with your grade level team to develop academic goals and practice instructional strategies.

• A demonstrated commitment to supporting students’ social emotional and academic development
• An enthusiasm for collaborating with internal and external partners in the best interest of students
• A self-directed learner who solicits and implements feedback to improve outcomes and achieve objectives
• Required Experience:A demonstrated interest in impacting K-12 students in urban schools and communities (1-2 years experience preferred).Academic expertise in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or other related fields of study. Prior to the start of employment, you must have a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university. Teacher certification is not a prerequisite for consideration at Uncommon Schools in the state of NJ, but you do need to meet NJ state certification eligibility requirements (a final undergraduate or graduate cumulative GPA of 3.0 for graduates on or after 9/1/16, or 2.75 if you graduated prior to 9/1/16). All instructional staff are required to become certified in the state of New Jersey within a reasonable period after beginning employment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Supplier
jobs.description:
ABOUT REMARCABLE

Remarcable is intelligent procurement and material operations for commercial specialty contractors and the distributors who supply them. We connect the field, the office, and suppliers on one platform, so everyone works from the same information from the first requisition to the last invoice. Every part. Every order. Every team. Finally connected.

We come from the trade. Our team includes manufacturers, distributors, contractors, and construction technologists, with more than 100 years of combined experience. We know the chaos well: scattered orders, re-keyed POs, overcharges caught three weeks too late, and a field and office working from different information. We are pro-distributor and supplier-neutral. Our job is to make the counter easier to run and the contractor relationship stronger.

Today Remarcable connects over 250 MEP contractors to more than 1,300 distributors and over 8,600 integrated branches, with more than $1 billion in material moving through the platform every month.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: Omaha, NE (hybrid)

We're building for distributors, and we're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to be on the core team for this new go-to-market. This is not a role that inherits a launch calendar. You'll help decide who we build for, what problem we lead with, and how we talk about.

You'll work side by side with product, engineering, sales,  supplier success, and our distributor customers. The products, the positioning, and the go-to-market programs are all still being written, and you'll write a good part of them. Distributors run a different business than contractors, with branches, counter staff, outside sales, and margins measured in points. You'll learn that business well enough to talk shop at the counter and in the boardroom.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Get out to the branches and the main office. Run customer discovery with distributor owners, operations leaders, inside and outside sales, and counter staff, and bring what you hear back to Product.

 - Define the ideal customer and the buyer. Sort which distributors we serve first, by size, trade, and how they sell today.

 - Write the positioning and messaging for new distributor products from a blank page, in partner language. We make their counter easier and their contractor relationships stronger.

 - Shape pricing and packaging with leadership. Test it with early customers and refine it as the market answers.

 - Plan and run the first launches: beta and early-access programs, launch plans, and the story for each release.

 - Partner with sales on the first sales playbook, including the pitch, demo flow, objection handling, and discovery questions. Then enable the reps who carry it.

 - Turn early customers into proof. That means pilots with clear success measures, case studies, and the numbers distributors care about: orders handled, disputes avoided, and hours back at the counter.

 - Map the competitive field for distributor technology, including ERPs, ecommerce platforms, and homegrown tools, and show where we fit.

 - Work with our partnerships team and industry groups such as NAED to build presence in distribution.

 - Travel at least 25% of the time for distributor visits, trade shows, and internal events.
   
   
   WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in product marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or a technical product.

 - At least one product you helped take from zero to one: the early discovery, the first positioning, and the first paying customers. You should be able to say what you'd do differently.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. When the answer isn't written down yet, you go find it, make a call, and adjust.

 - Strong writing and speaking. You can take a complex workflow and explain it in plain words that a specific audience cares about.

 - A head for the business side. You can talk pricing, margin, and ROI with an owner or CFO.

 - Cross-functional instincts. You've worked closely with Product, Sales, and leadership to agree on a plan and ship it.

 - A self-starter's drive, solid project management, and a bias for action.

 - Experience in wholesale distribution, electrical or plumbing supply, or construction is a strong plus.


WHY REMARCABLE

 - Build product marketing at Remarcable from the ground up.

 - Shape go-to-market for a company doubling revenue year over year.

 - Join a team that values creativity and accountability, and does work that matters to the people who build the communities we live, work, and play.

 

Please be aware of potential phishing scams. Remarcable will never advance job applicants money or ask them to send money (via Venmo, Zelle, Paypal etc.) to preferred vendors. If you are concerned about the application process, please contact Remarcable directly at (216)770-3322.

Remarcable is not associated with info-remarcable.com http://info-remarcable.com. For information about applying for a position with Remarcable, please reference remarcable.com http://remarcable.com.

Teachers use a variety of instructional strategies to prioritize discussion, ignite a passion for literature, and promote strong voice and agency within students. At the conclusion of each high school year students are more prepared for the academic rigor and independence of college coursework, as well as for a long term love of literacy.

Scott Fitzgerald, William Shakespeare, and Yaa Gyasi; books that ignite a passion for literature, sharpen a critical eye for examining the world, and deepen students’ intellectual identity.

jobs.title: Special Education Coordinator

They also provide crucial academic, emotional, and physical support to students with disabilities and believe they are capable of high academic achievement.

• You'll participate in weekly, school-wide meetings to cultivate community, model our core values, and encourage student achievement.
• You'll partner with your grade level team to develop academic goals and practice instructional strategies.

• A demonstrated commitment to supporting students’ social emotional and academic development
• An enthusiasm for collaborating with internal and external partners in the best interest of students
• A self-directed learner who solicits and implements feedback to improve outcomes and achieve objectives

jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Architect
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Principal AI Platform Architect to define and build the next generation of our AI platform and cloud-native application ecosystem. This is a senior technical leadership role responsible for designing scalable, secure, and resilient platforms that enable AI-powered products, intelligent automation, and modern software development across the organization.

The ideal candidate is hands on technologist with extensive experience designing cloud-native applications and AI-enabled platforms. They understand how modern APIs, event-driven systems, orchestration frameworks, and agentic AI capabilities come together to create enterprise-scale solutions that are secure, observable, and operationally efficient.

This role partners closely with product leadership, engineering teams, and executive stakeholders to establish architectural direction, define platform standards, and guide the implementation of next-generation AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and build a scalable AI platform supporting LLMs, agentic workflows, and federated development across multiple teams
• Establish architectural standards for AI governance, security, evaluation strategies, and operational excellence
• Architect cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform supporting enterprise-scale workloads
• Define platform patterns for microservices, event-driven architectures, and API-first design
• Build CICD pipelines that deploy automatically to the cloud while interfacing with legacy systems
• Provide architecture guidance and governance across engineering teams through reviews and standards
• Balance strategic platform vision with hands-on implementation to earn respect from engineering teams
• Enable teams to add new components, agents, and functionalities within the overarching platform

Required Qualifications & Technical Experience

• 10+ years designing and delivering enterprise software platforms with proven success at scale
• Strong GCP expertise - deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform services, semantics, and AI capabilities (Vertex AI preferred)
• AI platform experience building production systems that support product use cases, including agentic frameworks, LLMs, and orchestration
• Evaluation strategy experience - particularly building eval loops in production for monitoring and tuning AI systems (highly preferred)
• Event-driven architecture and distributed systems expertise with understanding of microservices and APIs
• Platform security and governance knowledge, including responsible AI practices
• Python proficiency (primary language for AI development), plus experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native tools
• Exceptional communication skills with ability to influence technical direction across multiple engineering organizations

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

• Establish the architectural vision for our enterprise AI platform.
• Define reusable cloud-native platform patterns supporting AI-enabled applications.
• Enable engineering teams through standardized platform capabilities and architectural guidance.
• Improve platform scalability, security, observability, and operational efficiency.
• Accelerate the adoption of AI capabilities while ensuring strong governance, reliability, and engineering quality.

Additional Information

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at an Informa event – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

jobs.title: Publicist
jobs.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on.

About this role

Reporting to the Global Head of Communications, this role will be responsible for helping to manage the day-to-day operations of Semafor’s communications efforts. Embedded deep within the fabric of the newsroom, you’ll be working with our journalists and editors each day on amplifying our journalism across outlets that align with our brand and goals, as well as supporting and promoting other core areas of our business.

As Publicist, you will:

• Work closely with the Global Head of Communications to develop and execute a robust day-to-day communications strategy that supports the newsroom.

• Develop and implement communications / PR strategies that amplify Semafor’s high-impact reporting, editorial projects, and newsroom initiatives.

• Proactively identify editorial moments, trends, or news cycles where our reporting and talent should be part of the media conversation

• Maintain an always-on awareness of the competitive media landscape to spot gaps and opportunities for coverage.

• Cultivate strong relationships with national TV and radio/podcast bookers, and maintain segmented, up-to-date media lists.

• Pitch booking producers across major broadcast networks and platforms (including TV, radio, and podcasts/YouTube) daily, working closely with newsroom leaders and journalists to promote scoops and impactful journalism

• Draft talking points, briefings, and internal messaging for internal and external communications, including writing and editing media alerts on deadline.

• Secure daily press coverage across television, radio, print, and digital outlets for a wide range of coverage areas.

• Support development and implementation of a creative and consistent internal communications strategy.

• Lead and manage a global calendar of awards submissions, media lists, and speaking opportunities.

• Oversee media monitoring, including compiling timely press recaps and reports using a range of PR tools.

• Proactively recommend and implement new workflows and processes to improve the effectiveness and speed of the communications function.

Requirements:

• 3+ years of experience in communications, preferably at a news organization, in media/entertainment/politics or other similar work environments.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent is preferred.

• Deep passion for news and current affairs with broad understanding of the current global / U.S. news/media environment is a must.

• Proven ability to garner media attention, craft stories, and drive daily results.

• Previous experience booking network appearances for individuals/brands, and interacting with reporters on daily inquiries and media requests.

• A team player with the ability to work with others in a fast-paced news environment on deadline.

• A strong sense of what makes a good feature or news angle, and a varied contact list across the media landscape, including broadcast, print and online, with contacts in news in the US and globally

• Impeccable writing skills with the ability to write and produce clear and concise communications materials under time constraints.

• Previous experience with using PR & social media tools (e.g., Critical Mention, Muck Rack, Mailchimp, Twitter) is a plus

• Experience with handling set-up and logistics for speaking engagements and events.

• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

• Proactivity and resourceful problem-solving skills.

Additional Job Details

This position is based in New York, NY. Candidates must be willing to work flexible hours and travel domestically and internationally on an as-needed basis.

Salary Range: $90k-$110K base annual salary.  Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, etc.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.description:
Join the 2025 AIA Firm Award Winner https://www.aia.org/about-aia/press/lpa-design-studios-receives-2025-aia-architecture-firm-award shaping a more sustainable future.

LPA is a collective of designers, engineers, and researchers committed to tackling the biggest issues of our time. Our "No Excuses" integrated design approach was recognized by the AIA as “a trailblazer in sustainable, high-performance architecture".  At LPA you’ll be part of the team that is changing the way the industry thinks about design and carbon emissions, built around the belief that we only achieve our goals when everybody has a seat at the table and all input is valued.

We’re currently seeking a Project Architect to join our dynamic Dallas studio. You’ll be part of a culture that values deep collaboration, technical excellence, and continual growth.  Examples of projects completed by our Dallas studio include Sheffield Elementary School https://lpadesignstudios.com/projects/sheffield-elementary-school and Broughton Recreation Center https://lpadesignstudios.com/projects/broughton-recreation-center-2.  Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across our studios in California and Texas—and help bring high-performance, community-first design to life.

 - Direct the technical delivery of projects from concept design through construction, working closely with a multidisciplinary team of designers and engineers.

 - Collaborate with the Project Designer and Project Manager to bring design visions to life with clarity and precision.

 - Oversee the preparation of design documentation, including schematic design, design development, and construction documents.

 - Conduct quality control reviews and research to ensure the use of appropriate products, materials, and construction methods.

 - Lead the construction administration process, ensuring successful implementation and resolution of design intent on-site.

 - Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, regulatory authorities, and internal team members.

 - Mentor junior staff, fostering their growth through knowledge-sharing, training, and ongoing support.

At LPA, your growth and contributions matter. We foster a collaborative culture where creative ideas are valued, and voices are heard.

 - Mentorship from Managing Directors, Design Directors, and senior team members across disciplines.

 - Career development support, including professional development grants and in-house training.

 - Ongoing education through LPA+U courses and Tech Talks focused on innovative, sustainable practices.

 - 8 paid hours of volunteer time each year.

 - Opportunities to propose and lead projects that impact your local community, including more than $1 million since 2015 in Habitat for Humanity builds, scholarships, and other pro bono community projects.  

 - Access to our Professional Development Grants program, created to encourage professional development and further LPA's collective knowledge as a firm.  Over the life of the grant program, we have invested $1,196,890 and impacted 848 LPA employees.

Required:

jobs.title: Senior Scriptwriter / Storyteller, Growth Creative
jobs.description:
About Ruggable:

Ruggable is a leading direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand based in Los Angeles, California with an extraordinary track record of high, profitable growth. We pride ourselves on having an extremely loyal customer base and a talented team made up of genuinely caring people who take action and deliver results. We are venture-backed and own a patented washable rug design that's disrupting the home décor industry. Our mission is to empower our customers to live vibrantly with beautiful products that don't compromise on function. If you're passionate about consumer products, e-commerce, and high-growth start-ups, keep reading!

Job Summary:

Ruggable is building an evergreen creative team that makes entertaining & compelling work across paid advertising, organic social, email, and the website. We’re looking for a Senior Scriptwriter / Storyteller who can turn customer insights, product truths, and everyday life at home into ideas people want to watch, share, and act on.  You’ll partner closely with our Growth Creative Lead, whose roots are in art direction and design. As creative partners, you’ll develop the ideas together, with you leading story, narrative, and scripts. You’ll help build work that can perform as a single ad or grow into a recurring series, creator format, or larger content platform.  This role is for someone who loves both the idea and the making of it. You can write a six-second hook, build a longer story, and give an editor the note that makes the whole piece click. Video storytelling is your craft; you’re also happy to bring that same clarity and voice to headlines, emails, landing pages, and other copy if the work calls for it.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead story and script development for evergreen paid advertising and organic social, from the first concept through the final edit.

• Partner with the Growth Creative Lead and Creative Strategist to turn audience insights, product priorities, and performance learnings into creative territories and repeatable content series.

• Write scripts for creator-led, produced, short-form, and long-form video. Know when to write every word and when to give a creator room to be their authentic selves.

• Find the human story in Ruggable’s products; from the look and feel of a room to the moments of life that happen in it, and make the benefit clear without making every piece feel like a product demo.

• Develop story structures, interview questions, creator prompts, and production briefs that help strong ideas survive the realities of a shoot.

• Build multiple hooks, endings, and versions of an idea across products, audiences, and channels. Use insights to help decide what to expand, refine, or retire.

• Stay close to production and post-production. Help shape interviews and shoots, spot unscripted moments, and give clear feedback on structure, pacing, voiceover, captions, and the opening seconds.

• When needed, write and refine supporting copy for paid ads, social posts, email, and site experiences, working with channel partners to keep the story consistent.

• Collaborate with creators, editors, producers, and agencies, giving direction that makes the work stronger while preserving each creator’s voice.

• Present ideas and the thinking behind them to creative and cross-functional partners.

What You’ll Need to Have:

Required:

• 5-7+ years of experience in the industry

• Significant experience writing scripts and developing concepts for advertising, social video, entertainment, or creator-led content.

• A portfolio of finished video work you originated or co-led, with examples of sharp short-form hooks and stories that have room to develop.

• Experience taking an idea from insight through concept, script, production, edit, and performance review.

• A feel for Meta, TikTok, PInterest, YouTube, and emerging formats, including how a story changes across channels

• The ability to write dialogue, voiceover, prompts, attention grabbing headlines and on-screen language that sound natural and make a product benefit easy to understand.

• Comfort using creative performance results and audience feedback to improve the next round of work.

• Experience building & scaling recurring formats or series, not just one-off videos.

• Confidence collaborating with art directors, strategists, creators, editors, producers, and agencies... and giving feedback that makes the work better.

• Strong copy instincts and the flexibility to write a headline or email when the idea needs to carry into another channel.

• An interest in interiors, design, culture, and the many ways people make a space their own.

Preferred:

• You’re connected to the LA creator or filmmaking community, have experience with episodic or unscripted content, or enjoy making things yourself.

• You notice the story happening around the rug: the first apartment when you got that new job, the dog (or cat) with no respect for boundaries but fills the room with joy, the dinner that ran long, the room someone finally made their own. You can turn those observations into scripts with personality and purpose, then find new ways to tell the story as you learn what connects with people.

• You’re a generous creative partner with a strong point of view. You care about the words, the images, and what happens when they come together.

Compensation & Location Details:

• $130,000-$150,000 per year base salary based on experience

• An annual bonus percentage that varies based on level of role

• Employer matching (up to 3% of base salary) for company sponsored 401K plan

• This role requires a hybrid schedule in our North Torrance, CA location

At Ruggable, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Ruggable is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

jobs.title: 5-Axis CNC Programmer 2nd shift, Site 2
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

This position is based in our satellite production facility in Midland, TX.

AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight.

AST SpaceMobile is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented 5-Axis CNC Programmer to support precision manufacturing operations within our satellite production facility. This role is responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining CNC programs for complex aerospace components using 5-axis machining centers. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with multi-axis CNC programming, machining strategies, tooling selection, blueprint interpretation, and precision manufacturing processes in a fast-paced production environment.

The 5-Axis CNC Programmer will collaborate closely with manufacturing engineers, machinists, quality teams, and production leadership to ensure parts are produced accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with engineering specifications and aerospace quality standards. Responsibilities include creating and modifying CNC programs, supporting machine setup and troubleshooting, optimizing cycle times, validating tooling paths, and assisting with continuous improvement initiatives to maximize machining performance and production efficiency. Strong knowledge of GD&T, CAD/CAM software, tooling, feeds and speeds, and precision measurement practices is highly preferred.

Hourly Pay Rate: $45.00 -$55.00/hr

$10,000 sign on bonus to assist with relocation.

Work Schedule

• Standard: Monday–Thursday (4x10 schedule aligned with AST operations)

• Overtime as required based on production demands

Position Summary

The 5-Axis CNC Programmer is responsible for operating, setting up, and maintaining multi-axis CNC machining centers to produce high-precision aerospace components. This role ensures all parts are manufactured in compliance with engineering specifications, quality standards, and production schedules in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

What you'll do:

Machine Programmer /Operation & Setup

• Program and Operate 5-axis CNC machines to manufacture complex aerospace components with tight tolerances

• Perform machine setup including tooling, fixtures, offsets, and work holding

• Load and verify CNC programs, ensuring correct parameters and material selection

• Monitor machine performance and make adjustments to maintain quality and efficiency

Production & Quality

• Interpret blueprints, GD&T, technical drawings, and work instructions

• Perform first article, in-process, and final inspections using precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges)

• Ensure parts meet strict aerospace tolerances and quality standards

• Document and report non-conforming parts per quality procedures

Process Control & Troubleshooting

• Identify machining issues (tool wear, chatter, offsets) and implement corrective actions

• Optimize feeds, speeds, and tool paths for efficiency and quality

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization

Maintenance & Safety

• Perform routine preventative maintenance (lubrication, coolant checks, cleaning)

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

• Follow all OSHA, company safety, and aerospace compliance standards

Collaboration & Documentation

• Work closely with engineering, quality, and production teams to resolve issues

• Complete job travelers, ERP entries, and production documentation accurately

• Support training of junior programmers when required

What you bring:

• High school diploma or GED (technical certification preferred)

• 2–5+ years of experience Programming and operating 5-axis CNC machines in a manufacturing environment

• Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T

• Experience with precision measuring instruments

• Ability to perform machine setups independently

• Strong attention to detail and quality focus

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in aerospace or defense manufacturing

• Familiarity with CAD/CAM systems, G-code, Mastercam

• Experience machining aluminum, composites, or aerospace alloys

• Post processor development

Skills & Competencies

• Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving ability

• Ability to operate multiple machines simultaneously

• Strong understanding of machining processes, tooling, and materials

• Time management and ability to meet production deadlines

• Team-oriented with strong communication skills

Physical Requirements & Work Environment:

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods (8–10+ hours)

• Ability to use hands and fingers to perform repetitive and precision tasks.

• Ability to climb, balance, bend, stoop, kneel, and reach as required to perform job duties.

• Ability to communicate effectively, including talking and hearing.

• Ability to work in, on, around, and in proximity to large structures, equipment, and tooling.

• Ability to lift, push, and/or carry items up to 50 pounds as required.

• Ability to work near moving mechanical parts and equipment.

• Ability to work in and around tight or confined spaces.

• Ability to work in environments that may include exposure to fumes, airborne particles, and/or hazardous materials (e.g., carbon fiber).

• Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment (heat, noise, machinery)

If you are open to relocating to Midland, this can be a career changing, and life changing, move into the high-tech aerospace world offering a new skill set and job security in a very similar environment that will soon feel like home. We encourage you to apply to learn more about AST SpaceMobile and what Midland has to offer.

jobs.title: Delivery Driver (6310) - Henderson, TN
jobs.description:
Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

Domino’s is growing and we are looking to add Delivery Experts to our team!

IMMEDIATE HIRE!  Short or Long shifts - YOUR CHOICE!

Drivers typically average over $20/hr (Wage + Tips + Mileage reimbursement- see below for details).

Flexible Scheduling! Part time and Full-time hours available – Work the shifts that work for you!

ABOUT THE JOB:

Drivers typically average over $20/hr (Wage + Tips + Mileage reimbursement). Mileage reimbursement and tips paid daily, hourly wages paid out every other Friday.

Delivery experts have the option to use their own car and receive an adjustable mileage reimbursement to cover fuel costs and extra for other auto expenses - OR – use one of our company provided vehicles to complete deliveries (must be at least 21, clean driving record, minimum 2 years of driving history. and clean driving record to use the company car). Safe driving record is a must!

Our drivers have access to cutting edge technology that makes the SAFE Delivery of Domino’s products faster than our competition. More efficient deliveries = more money!

Delivery Experts can choose their own schedule. Whether you want to work Part time or Full time, we have shifts available to fit your needs!

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Must be 18 years of age or older. Must be able to pass a background check and have a valid driver’s license with a safe driving record (subject to review of Motor Vehicle Report). Must have a reliable vehicle and valid insurance. Must possess good navigational skills and be able to read/follow maps and locate addresses within designated delivery area. Must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings in order to deliver products. Must possess the ability to follow directives, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and well with others, work well under stress, meet strict quality control standards, provide excellent customer service, analyze and compile data, make good judgements and decisions.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product or distributing flyers and door hangers

• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside - In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas

• Fumes from food odors, including exposure to cornmeal dust

• Compact work areas including walk-in cooler

• Hot surfaces/tools including oven reaching 500 degrees or higher

• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts

PHYSICAL DUTIES & REQUIREMENTS

Including but not limited to:

Walking/Carrying/Climbing

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location. During delivery, the driver must carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties. During delivery of product, navigation of 5+ flights of stairs may be required.

Driving

Use safe driving practices to deliver products within a designated delivery area. Delivery drivers may make several deliveries per shift.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients. Crouching and bending peformed occasionally to stock shelves and clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward. Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves. Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes. Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day. Frequent activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists. Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter. Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes. Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Sensing

jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics platform. As we continue to expand our Engineering organization globally, we’re looking for Staff Backend Engineers to build and evolve the large-scale, highly available systems that power DoorDash’s three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and Dashers.

Our engineers solve complex technical and business problems across a global platform that operates 24/7 and supports millions of users.

About the Role

We’re looking for Staff Backend Engineers to join Product and Product Platform teams across DoorDash.

Engineers on Product teams work at the intersection of product and infrastructure, translating complex business problems into scalable technical solutions. Engineers on Product Platform teams build the foundational systems, services, and capabilities that enable product teams to move quickly and reliably.

As a Staff Engineer, you will set technical direction, lead complex initiatives across teams, and shape the architecture and long-term roadmap of critical systems. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Design, and other cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate trade-offs and deliver solutions that maximize customer and business impact.

You will also raise the technical bar across the organization by mentoring engineers, improving engineering practices, and helping teams navigate ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.

This is a hybrid role with some in-office time expected. You will report to an Engineering Manager.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Develop, release and run large-scale web applications

• Develop and define the backend architecture and tech stack for a product area

• Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our backend systems

• Be involved in transitioning our monolithic codebase to a microservice-based architecture

• Completely disrupt logistics by tackling bleeding-edge, technical problems

We're excited about you because you have…

• B.S., M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or equivalent

• 8+ years of industry experience

• Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

• Ability to analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of various system resources

• Experience with service oriented architecture, writing REST API’s, unit testing, and architectural design

• Understanding of modern web stacks and architecture (HTTP, REST)

• Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and other technologies (e.g. Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ)

Compensation

DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
DevOps Engineer

At Minitab, you'll do more than build software, you'll help transform the future of manufacturing. Every day, the world's leading manufacturers rely on Minitab to increase efficiency, improve quality, reduce waste, and make smarter, data-driven decisions that power better factories and better products. Our smart manufacturing platform connects data across the enterprise to uncover hidden capacity, eliminate bottlenecks, optimize machine performance, simulate improvements before implementation, and accelerate innovation through advanced analytics and experimental design. As part of our team, you'll collaborate with passionate, talented colleagues who are solving meaningful, real-world challenges for global industry leaders. With more than 250,000 users, 30,000 organizations, and 90% of the Fortune 100 trusting Minitab, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact while growing your career in a collaborative, innovative, and customer-focused environment where your ideas matter.

Position Overview

Minitab is seeking a skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to play a key role in developing and maintaining our infrastructure and deployment pipelines. This role requires strong technical expertise, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.

As a DevOps Engineer at Minitab, you will have the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to our global technology ecosystem, supporting the tools and platforms that enable data-driven decision making for businesses worldwide. You will help shape the future of Minitab’s software delivery processes, infrastructure reliability, and overall engineering excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Develop & Maintain Infrastructure and Deployment Pipelines

• Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless and efficient software delivery.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.

• Help manage and maintain development and production infrastructure, ensuring environments are stable, scalable, secure, and suitable for continuous testing and delivery.

• Participate in an on-call rotation to address urgent infrastructure issues and support system reliability.

Change Requests & Infrastructure Support

• Manage requests across systems and environments, including updates to settings, permissions, and components.

• Provide timely support for infrastructure-related issues to minimize disruption and improve service quality.

• Maintain documentation and procedures for request handling and issue resolution to ensure consistency and operational efficiency.

Communication & Collaboration

• Communicate progress and status of assigned work in accordance with team and company practices.

• Participate in code reviews, seeking and incorporating feedback from teammates, reviewers, and domain experts.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to meet shared goals and deliverables on schedule.

Continuous Learning & Development

• Stay current with new technologies, trends, and best practices in the DevOps field.

• Actively explore emerging tools and methodologies to drive continuous process improvement.

• Apply new knowledge to enhance infrastructure performance, scalability, security, and efficiency.

Core Competencies (Korn Ferry Framework)

• Tech Savvy: Anticipates and adopts emerging technologies and digital innovations.

• Action Oriented: Tackles challenges with urgency, enthusiasm, and high energy.

• Collaborates: Builds strong partnerships and works effectively with others.

• Manages Complexity: Breaks down complex problems using critical thinking and structured approaches.

• Nimble Learning: Experiments, learns quickly, and uses successes and failures as growth opportunities.

• Communicates Effectively: Adjusts communication style to meet the needs of diverse audiences.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.

• Understanding of infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS).

• Proficiency with scripting languages and configuration management tools.

• Experience with containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration technologies (e.g., Kubernetes).

• Ability to speak, read, write, and comprehend English.

This is an onsite position at our State College, PA headquarters and candidates must be within commutable distance of State College, PA for consideration. Remote work is not an option for this position.

This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship.

To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future.

Our Benefits:

HEALTH INSURANCE:  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance is provided at no cost for full-time employees upon date of hire. Low co-pay pharmacy benefit and affordable family coverage plan is available. Short and Long Term Disability is fully paid by Minitab. Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Provides guidance for personal issue and information on other Work Life Matters.

LIFE INSURANCE:  Group Term Life Insurance is provided at no cost for full-time employees at three times employee base salary. Minitab provides eligible employees the opportunity to purchase Voluntary Life Insurance for themselves and eligible dependents at affordable rates.

RETIREMENT PLANNING:  A 401k Retirement Plan with T. Rowe Price is provided with eligible employee contribution immediately. Minitab will match dollar for dollar up to the first 6% of employee’s contribution. Employees are fully vested in the Minitab, LLC 401(k) Retirement Plan upon date of hire.

PAID TIME OFF:  Paid holidays, as well as 4 weeks of annual paid time off are provided. The annual paid time off increases one week every five years.

HIGHER AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT:  The pursuit of ongoing development is important and valued at Minitab. In support of this value, Minitab offers tuition and related expenses assistance for both higher education and other professional development.

FLEXIBLE SPENDING ACCOUNT:  Medical and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts - Pre-tax Deductions. Parking and Transit - Pre-Tax Deductions.

HYBRID WORK SCHEDULE:  We offer a hybrid work model for eligible positions.

PREMIUM BENEFITS:  At our State College, PA Headquarters, there is an onsite gym, indoor swimming pool, yoga studio, movie theater, outdoor sand volleyball court, game room, arcade room and even a golf simulator. Personal training and nutrition counseling is available upon request.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job application remains open until filled.

jobs.description:

Partnering closely with Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, and Engineering teams, you will help operate and support our environment today while identifying opportunities to improve how we work for the future.

Key Responsibilities

• Proactively identify and address technical debt, single points of failure, and opportunities to improve the reliability, scalability, and resilience of the environment.

• Monitor and analyze system and application performance to proactively identify issues and opportunities for optimization.

• Contribute to infrastructure modernization initiatives across cloud infrastructure, disaster recovery, virtualization, containerization, and platform architecture.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and alternative solutions, bringing forward recommendations that improve performance, reliability, operational efficiency, or cost.

• Contribute to the Infrastructure team’s longer-term technical roadmap and continuous improvement priorities.

What We’re Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in infrastructure, systems, cloud, or site reliability engineering.

• Experience designing, supporting, and troubleshooting enterprise data center infrastructure, with an understanding of modern infrastructure practices across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

• Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Salt, Puppet, or Chef.

• Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, incident response, performance optimization, and capacity planning.
