jobs.title: Chief Engineer, Power Generation
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE ENERGY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Put solar, storage and gas in the ground at an install rate no one in the construction market has hit. We are building generation across multiple gigawatt sites at once, on a schedule traditional EPC delivery cannot meet.

 - Secure supply at a scale and timeline the supply chain cannot meet, and reshore it ourselves. Cells, containers, transformers and turbines are all constrained, so we qualify new suppliers and stand up domestic capacity instead of waiting in line.

 - Make solar, gas and storage combine into power steady enough to run AI workloads. A training run does not tolerate a dip, so the hybrid plant has to behave like firm generation even when the resource behind it does not.

 - Clear balancing authority certification, firm load rights, permits and interconnection against long clocks and a shifting policy environment. These approvals sit on the critical path to every gigawatt, so we work them years ahead of the build.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the production system behind how Fluidstack builds generation, from module fabrication through field install and energization, as one standard set of work instructions repeated across concurrent gigawatt sites.

 - Set takt time and line balance for module and skid manufacturing, then hold the line to it with standard work, andon escalation and first-pass yield targets rather than with expediting.

 - Drive install rate and rework down in the field through kaizen events and value stream mapping run with the crews doing the work, at the site, on the shift.

 - Take quality to the source at suppliers through process audits, error-proofing and joint improvement work on their floor, and fold every fix into the standard design through change control so the next site inherits it.

 - Teach the method across the organization, coaching engineers, site leads and contractors through A3 problem solving so the system holds when you are not in the room.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've run a production system built on the Toyota Production System or a direct derivative of it, and you learned it by doing the work under someone who had already done it.

 - You've set takt time on a real line, balanced it against actual cycle times, and held it through a demand ramp that tempted everyone around you to abandon standard work.

 - You've cut cycle time or defect rate on a process and you can name the before number, the after number, and what you changed to get there.

 - You've stopped a line, or told a site to stop, when the standard was not being met, and you made that call stick with people who outranked you.

 - You've developed a supplier on their own floor, changed how they build a part, and watched incoming quality move as a result.

 - You've taught the method to people who did not want to learn it, and left behind engineers who now run their own A3s and kaizen events without you.

 - You write clearly enough that a fabrication supervisor, a site superintendent and a CEO each get the decision they need out of the same document.

 - Bonus: Practice inside a Toyota group company or a TPS-derived operating system (Toyota, Danaher DBS, Boeing, Tesla). Modular and offsite construction (volumetric modules, skidded MEP, prefabricated power blocks). Lean Six Sigma at black belt level. Manufacturing quality and execution systems (MES, SPC, APQP and PPAP). Professional Engineer license.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute team. This team owns the critical systems that power project provisioning, scaling, and the compute that our users rely on every day.

You’ll work on the core platform that ensures Supabase can seamlessly scale
across multiple regions, handle high-volume workloads, and provide
low-latency, highly available compute services.

You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly
automated — enabling us to provision new projects reliably at scale,
optimize resource utilization, and deliver a seamless experience to the
millions of databases which we manage.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

 - Help build and maintain the Supabase Cloud offering;

 - Design and implement systems to provision, scale, and manage the multi-region compute workloads powering Supabase projects;

 - Own the full lifecycle of compute orchestration: project creation, warm pools, autoscaling, resizing, and resource optimization;

 - Improve automation and observability across the compute stack to ensure high availability and performance;

 - Improve our system architecture to reduce costs while balancing security, reliability, and performance;

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to help leverage compute as a core platform offering;

 - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews;

 - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform.


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required);

 - Experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale;

 - Have 5+ years experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS required, additional experience with GCP and Azure is a plus) - particularly compute, networking, and storage services;

 - Have 3+ years experience working with building custom Kubernetes controllers, and operating large-scale (tens-to-hundreds of thousands of pods) clusters;

 - Are knowledgable about networking and multi-region infrastructure design;

 - Are familiar with Postgres;

 - Have experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Pulumi highly preferred, Terraform/CDK etc acceptable)

 - Have experience working with QEMU, KVM, and NAS is a plus;

 - Have experience with being part of on-call rotations for large production system;


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Facilities Operations Technician - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity’s knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Facilities Operations Technician at SpaceXSI, you'll dive in, operating and maintaining the critical facility systems that power our supercomputing data centers. Working hands-on with MEP systems, you’ll tackle maintenance, operations, and repairs, ensuring peak performance and reliability. Expect to troubleshoot complex issues, streamline processes, and collaborate with teams to keep our infrastructure running smoothly, directly supporting SpaceXSI's mission to accelerate human scientific discovery through AI.

This role includes the following positions, each with increasing responsibility:

• Facilities Operations Technician: Independently operate and maintain critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems in supercomputing data centers, ensuring high reliability and performance through hands-on maintenance, troubleshooting, and process optimization.

• Sr Facilities Operations Technician: Perform advanced maintenance and troubleshooting of critical data center systems like HVAC, power, and environmental controls, while mentoring junior technicians to ensure operational reliability.

• Facilities Operations Lead: Oversee the maintenance and optimization of critical data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, and environmental systems, while leading a team of technicians to ensure operational reliability and efficiency.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Responsible for MEP Infrastructure site safety and environmental compliance, ensuring the sites align with all local and regional health and safety requirements.

• Provide operational expertise for Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems at the datacenter facility. The systems and equipment can include pumps, piping, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH units, wiring, lighting systems, generators, motors, water supply, UPS and switchgear, etc.

• Routinely inspect all areas to ensure performance measures are being maintained and proactively self-report the problems of facilities.

• Experience with writing and executing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs.

• Perform daily inspections of critical systems.

• Identify and maintain spare parts inventory to minimize downtime.

• Coordinate and supervise scheduled system shutdowns.

• Develop and implement energy monitoring metrics.

• Support commissioning efforts by witnessing equipment startup, assisting with functional testing, and monitoring construction progress.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical or 2+ years of hands-on operations/facilities work experience in lieu of degree (data center experience preferred).

• Knowledge of mechanical or electrical engineering principles and systems (both would be a huge plus).

• Experience and knowledge of all critical systems documentation including Plans, Procedures, and Operations Manuals.

• Experience and knowledge of Building and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems and Operations.

• Strong troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with PLC-based control systems and/or with Building Management Systems (Client).

• Excellent written and verbal communication and technical writing skills in English.

• Physical Requirements: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Ability to utilize hand tools and power tools as needed. Work is often performed in tight quarters, and physical dexterity is necessary to perform job functions. Ability to lift up to 35 lbs. unassisted. Comfortable working at elevated heights (up to 100 feet) with appropriate safety gear. Comfortable working in extreme outdoor environments—heat, cold, rain, etc. Comfortable working in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise.

• Available to work flexible shifts providing 24x7 coverage as needed, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.

• Position is subject to pre-employment and annual post-employment background checks.

• Willing to travel as needed (up to 10%).

• Valid driver’s license.

Security, Privacy & Compliance

Required

• Experience automating technical processes using Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.

jobs.description:
Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5

* This is a full-time, in-office position in Trenton that involves working closely and collaboratively with our New Jersey content teams. *

Lead the Next Evolution of Digital News & Audience Growth

Are you a sharp editor, strategic digital thinker, and hands-on content creator who understands how great stories find audiences today? At Townsquare Media – New Jersey, we’re looking for a Director of Digital News & Audience to help lead the digital evolution of New Jersey 101.5, while serving as a digital content resource for our other brands across New Jersey.

This is a digital-first, hands-on content leadership role at the intersection of journalism, content, audience, and growth. You’ll work alongside our journalists, personalities, producers, and content teams to create compelling original content, strengthen the stories we’re already telling, and expand their reach across web, social, video, apps, newsletters, and emerging platforms.

You don’t need to come from radio. Your experience may be in a digital newsroom, social or video team, local media company, creator-led organization, or another digital-first environment. What matters most is that you understand great storytelling, strong journalism, and how audiences discover, consume, and share content across platforms.

And this isn’t a role that manages from the sidelines. You’ll write, edit, publish, produce, package, analyze, and create content yourself, while helping talented people around you make their work even stronger.

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted New Jersey stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital News & Audience, you’ll help shape our digital content strategy while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution. You’ll serve as both a leader and a hands-on editor, helping shape the digital voice of our local brands. Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading digital news and content strategy for New Jersey 101.5, helping identify, develop, and execute compelling original and breaking-news coverage across platforms

• Creating, editing, publishing, and packaging content across websites, apps, social media, video, newsletters, and other digital channels

• Partnering with journalists, on-air personalities, producers, and creators to turn strong ideas and existing content into platform-specific digital experiences

• Elevating our social and video storytelling, including platform-native hooks, headlines, captions, thumbnails, pacing, formats, and creative approaches for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms

• Coaching and collaborating with content teams on digital storytelling, SEO, audience development, social strategy, and evolving best practices

• Using audience and content analytics to understand performance, identify opportunities, test new ideas, and make data-informed editorial decisions

• Expanding content distribution through SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and other audience-growth channels

• Supporting day-to-day news priorities and coordination while balancing breaking news, daily content production, and longer-term audience-growth initiatives

• Serving as a digital content resource across our New Jersey brands, helping teams capitalize on strong stories and audience opportunities

• Exploring new platforms, technologies, and AI-assisted content and workflow tools to improve efficiency and creativity while maintaining strong editorial standards and human judgment

What You’ll Bring:

• 5+ years of experience in digital journalism, digital media, audience development, social/video content, online publishing, or a related content environment

• A proven track record of creating digital content that earns and grows an audience

• Exceptional writing, editing, story-framing, and headline-writing skills

• Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make smart, responsible decisions quickly, particularly during breaking or developing news

• Deep familiarity with Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform-specific formats, audience behavior, discovery, and best practices

• Strong understanding of social and short-form video storytelling, including hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, titles, and vertical video

• Hands-on experience creating, editing, publishing, and packaging digital content—not simply directing others

• Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and turn insights into actionable content decisions

• Strong understanding of SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and digital audience development

• Experience collaborating with and coaching reporters, writers, personalities, producers, or other content creators

• Strong organizational, communication, and project-management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment

• Familiarity with CMS platforms, social publishing tools, analytics platforms, and digital/video production workflows

• Curiosity about emerging platforms, creator trends, changing audience behaviors, and new technologies

• Knowledge of New Jersey—its communities, culture, issues, and personalities—is a major plus

• High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with great instincts, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action. You should be excited to experiment, pay close attention to what audiences are telling us through performance and engagement, and turn those insights into action. Just as importantly, you’ll be a collaborative, positive teammate who makes the people around you better.

What’s In It for You?

We offer a supportive environment where creativity and growth are encouraged:

• Competitive salary + bonus program

• 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays

• Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Plan

• Company-provided laptop

• Casual, high-energy work environment

• Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization

• Company discounts

• Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community

• And much more…

jobs.title: BESS Lead Engineer, Power Generation
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE ENERGY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Put solar, storage and gas in the ground at an install rate no one in the construction market has hit. We are building generation across multiple gigawatt sites at once, on a schedule traditional EPC delivery cannot meet.

 - Secure supply at a scale and timeline the supply chain cannot meet, and reshore it ourselves. Cells, containers, transformers and turbines are all constrained, so we qualify new suppliers and stand up domestic capacity instead of waiting in line.

 - Make solar, gas and storage combine into power steady enough to run AI workloads. A training run does not tolerate a dip, so the hybrid plant has to behave like firm generation even when the resource behind it does not.

 - Clear balancing authority certification, firm load rights, permits and interconnection against long clocks and a shifting policy environment. These approvals sit on the critical path to every gigawatt, so we work them years ahead of the build.
   


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the electrical design and sizing of multi-hundred-megawatt storage plants, from single line, protection and grounding through power and energy ratings and augmentation strategy, across several concurrent gigawatt sites.

 - Qualify and dual-source BESS vendors on technical merit, running factory witness testing, failure mode review and warranty terms alongside supply chain.

 - Define how storage, solar and on-site generation dispatch together so the plant holds a firm load profile through resource swings and generator trips.

 - Drive NFPA 855 compliance, hazard mitigation analysis and large-scale fire test evidence through the AHJ and the insurer before equipment reaches site.

 - Take each plant through commissioning, capacity and round-trip performance testing and controls integration before the first training load connects.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've taken grid-scale battery storage from single line to energized plant, and you can name the sites and the megawatts.

 - You've sized a storage system against a real duty cycle and lived with the result, including the augmentation call and the places the model turned out to be wrong.

 - You've chosen between BESS vendors on technical grounds, sat through factory witness testing, and pushed back on a datasheet that did not survive scrutiny.

 - You've argued NFPA 855 and hazard mitigation analysis in front of an AHJ or an insurer and got to approval.

 - You've integrated storage controls with generation and load so the combined plant behaves as one machine rather than three.

 - You write clearly enough that a procurement lead, a fire marshal and a CEO each get the decision they need out of the same document.

 - Bonus: Hybrid plant and dispatch modelling (PLEXOS, PVsyst, HOMER). Power system studies (PSCAD, ETAP, protection coordination, arc flash). Behind-the-meter and islanded microgrid operation. Interconnection and market processes (FERC, ERCOT, MISO). Professional Engineer license.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Technical Support Specialist

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Technical Support Specialist for our Corporate HQ in Columbia, MO and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. The Technical Support Specialist will be responsible for providing 7x24x365 technical support of EquipmentShare’s heavy equipment and tooling rental fleet. This is an inaugural position and will be instrumental in the creation and launch of the newly formed Technical Support team.

Primary Responsibilities

• Provide remote technical support (via phone, Slack, or other online applications) for EquipmentShare assets on a 24x7x365 basis. On-call duty includes evenings and weekends as needed after the team is fully operational.

• Compile and utilize data gathered from Field Service Technicians, diagnostic tools, schematics, and equipment manuals to resolve complex technical issues and bring assets back to a fully operational state.

• Communicate and partner with EquipmentShare product teams and OEMs on problems/issues found in the field.

• Subject matter expert that works with OEMs to provide root cause analysis on complex technical issues.

• Provide on-site support to Service Technicians and customers as required (minimal).

• Contribute to the EquipmentShare knowledge base.

• Mentor and train newly hired and advancing Technical Support Specialists.

• Directly support the creation of the foundational process and procedure for the team.

• Perform job duties in accordance with EquipmentShare’s vision, mission, and values.

• Establish and maintain professional working relationships with internal departments and rental/retail markets across the organization.

• Contribute to the team KPIs to ensure performance expectations are met.

• Represent the department effectively & professionally as required, both internally as well as to OEM vendors and end customers.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, and food truck nights

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

• A passion for helping others and a willingness to go the extra mile in providing nothing less than exceptional service and a positive customer experience.

• Proven subject matter expert on the operation, maintenance, and diagnostics/repair of heavy equipment to include aerial work platforms, telehandlers, excavators, loaders, bulldozers, tractors, generators, pumps, and HVAC.

• Specialty skills in two or more of the following areas: engine/powertrain, hydraulic/hydrostat, electrical/electronics, and other mechanical/structural aspects of heavy equipment.

• Strong working knowledge of general safety practices and relevant OSHA regulations to be observed while maintaining and repairing mechanical equipment.

• Must be able to read, understand, and leverage equipment manuals and system schematics to remotely troubleshoot and diagnose issues.

• Must be able to clearly communicate and document proposed actions plans to resolve equipment issues.

• Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong time management and communication skills.

• Ability to multi-task and manage multiple priorities.

• Working knowledge of G-Suite, including Gmail, Google Docs, Sheets, and Drive.

• Ability to proofread and edit written content.

• Attention to detail with the ability to quickly identify process break-downs.

• Ability to be flexible and adapt to change in a positive manner.

• Ability to travel on an as-needed basis (minimal).

• Self-starter and highly motivated with a strong, positive work ethic that contributes to the vision of the department and the company as a whole.

• Must possess a professional yet enthusiastic and friendly demeanor.

Education and Experience

• Graduate of a technical trade school or possess a certificate/degree in a related technical field, preferred.

• At least 5-7 years of technical support and/or service technician experience in the heavy equipment, truck, or diesel engine industries.

• Combination of equivalent education, experience, and industry certifications.

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to sit and stand for long periods of time

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an EOE M/F/D/V.

jobs.title: Mission Operations Engineer II - Ground Segment
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Mission Operations Engineer II - Ground Segment, reporting to the Lead Mission Operations Engineer, Mission Systems, to support planning and execution of Vast missions.

At Vast, Mission Operations Engineers are responsible for the planning and successful execution of our spacecraft missions. They work cross functionally with engineers from other disciplines from the very early stages of spacecraft design through on-orbit decommissioning. The Mission Operations Engineer - Ground Segment is responsible for designing systems as well as authoring procedures to operate both the spacecraft as well as supporting ground systems, ensuring harmonious communications & operations between the spacecraft and ground, and ensuring the integrity and validity of commands sent to and telemetry received from the spacecraft.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach location.

Responsibilities:

• Take extreme ownership of large impact initiatives working with engineers across disciplines to support the development of spacecraft operations & ground operations procedures, flight rules, products & processes, culminating in the safe & successful operations of a newly launched spacecraft

• Provide technical and operational leadership as the operations expert in planning for and execution of pre-flight testing and checkouts of ground systems to ensure spacecraft and ground systems are ready for flight

• Assist with performing the operations of Vast’s crewed and uncrewed missions for vehicle commissioning, on-orbit operations, anomaly resolution and final deorbit of the spacecraft

• Perform deep-dive analysis of vehicle & ground system telemetry and deliver informed summaries as well as recommendations to mission stakeholders for further review & analysis

• Formulate and lead the execution of workflows facilitating improvements to processes & systems with a focus on advancing Vast’s Mission Operations while maintaining Vast’s commitment to excellence

• Help strategize plans for and contribute to efforts to iteratively improve the Mission Systems, Mission Operations Software and other ground processes and collaborate with the Mission Systems Engineering & Ground Software Engineering teams to implement them

• Work closely with Mission Management to ensure customer requirements are translated to a Concept of Operations that balances all needs

• Assist and support peer Mission Operations Engineers, offering helpful input or specific items for consideration as informed by anecdotal experiences and operational best practices

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, software engineering, or other engineering discipline

• 3+ years of experience in the operation of complex systems

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with other engineering disciplines

• Demonstrated ability to to critically think in high stress environments and rapidly evolving situations

• Ability to disseminate critical engineering & technical information effectively and clearly

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Willing to support 24/7 operations during operationally intense mission phases

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Experience in human spaceflight mission operations

• Master’s of science degree in a technical field

• 1+ years working in a spacecraft design, build, and test environment

• Technical knowledge in spacecraft systems engineering (avionics, propulsion, attitude control, communications, orbital mechanics, life support systems, thermal and power control systems)

• Technical knowledge in Space-to-Ground Communication Systems (RF, Ground Stations, Modems, Antenna Systems)

• Experience building or designing from scratch a system, process and team to perform complex operations of an aerospace system (launch vehicle, satellite, crew capsule)

• Software Engineering Skills (C++, Golang, Javascript, React, Software Architecture, Databases, Cloud)

• Matlab or Python/Octave Proficiency

• Proficient at using the command line and scripting languages

• Strong Technical Writing skills

• Strong mentorship and leadership skills

Additional Requirements:

• Ability to travel up to 20% of the time

• Willingness to work overtime, or weekends to support critical mission milestones

• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs unassisted

Pay Range: California

$110,000—$195,000 USD

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS

The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. This status includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: VP of Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

• Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.

• Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.

• Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.

• Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.

• Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.

• Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a VP of Strategic Finance to shape the financial strategy of a company operating at the intersection of AI software and large-scale compute infrastructure. You'll be a key thought partner to the CFO and executive team, building the models, plans, and insights that guide how we allocate capital, price our products, and scale the business.

You will be joining the Finance Team and report to our Chief Financial Officer. This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco office with in-office requirements of 2 days per week.

What You’ll Do

• Strategic Planning: Own the annual operating plan and long-range financial model; translate company strategy into clear financial targets and track performance against them

• Capital Allocation: Model and evaluate major investment decisions, including GPU and data center capacity, infrastructure expansion, and build vs. buy vs. lease trade-offs

• Unit Economics & Pricing: Develop a deep understanding of the economics across our software platform and compute business, including utilization, gross margin, and customer profitability; partner with Product and GTM on pricing and packaging

• Executive & Board Partnership: Prepare board materials, investor updates, and executive reporting; deliver clear, data-backed recommendations that inform company-level decisions

• Fundraising & Financing: Support equity fundraising, debt and asset-backed financing, and investor diligence; build the models and narrative that underpin capital raises

• Merger Integration: Lead the financial integration of Lightning AI and Voltage Park, including unifying planning processes, reporting structures, and KPIs across both businesses

• Business Partnership: Act as a strategic partner to Engineering, Infrastructure, Sales, and Marketing leaders, helping them plan headcount, budgets, and investments with financial discipline

• Corporate Development: Evaluate strategic opportunities including partnerships, acquisitions, and large customer or supplier contracts

• Team Leadership: Build, manage, and develop a high-performing FP&A and strategic finance team as the company scales

What You’ll Need

• 12+ years of experience across strategic finance, FP&A, corporate development, investment banking, or management consulting, with at least 5 years in a senior finance leadership role

• Infrastructure economics expertise: Experience with capital-intensive businesses such as cloud infrastructure, data centers, telecom, or hardware; comfortable modeling capex, depreciation, utilization, and asset-backed financing

• Software and usage-based revenue fluency: Understanding of SaaS and consumption-based business models, including revenue forecasting, cohort analysis, and margin drivers

• Exceptional modeling skills: Able to build sophisticated, flexible financial models from scratch and pressure-test assumptions with rigor

• Capital markets experience: Hands-on involvement in equity fundraising, debt financing, or M&A transactions at a venture-backed or growth-stage company

• Executive presence: Credibility with CEOs, boards, and investors; able to distill complex financial analysis into clear recommendations and influence decisions

• Leadership: Track record of building and developing finance teams in a fast-growing environment

• Business acumen: Ability to connect financial outcomes to operational drivers and partner with technical and commercial leaders in their language

• Bias for action: Comfortable operating in ambiguity, prioritizing what matters most, and moving quickly without sacrificing accuracy

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:

$280,000—$310,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

• Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.

• Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).

• Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.

• Company-Wide Winter Break: Two weeks of company closure each winter to disconnect and recharge.

• Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.

• Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.

• Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.

• Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.

• Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.

• In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

At Lightning AI, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and create better products. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to building a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute to their fullest potential.

jobs.title: Manager, Safe and Secure Operations Center
jobs.description:
Shift:

M-F, 8:00am - 5:00pm, with occasional night and weekend support as needed; Onsite in Tempe, AZ

About Carvana

If you like disrupting the norm and are looking to join a company revolutionizing an industry then you will LOVE what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. Buying a car the old fashioned way sucks and we are working hard to make it NOT suck. I mean, have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and every day we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do.  We’ve been changing the game since 2013, and we’re not taking our foot off the gas now.

About the team and position

The Safe & Secure Operations Team (SSOT) helps to keep our 20,000+ associates, who work at our 200+ various locations, Safe and Secure every day. The Safe & Secure Operations Team develops our physical security strategy, technology, remote processes, and ensures each site is prepared to deliver a Safe & Secure environment from day one of operations. Our technology is the foundation upon which we strive to create efficiency. This technology also fuels our Remote Operations Center (ROC). The ROC leverages data to monitor our sites both proactively and reactively to provide risk mitigation and crisis management support.

This position  is responsible for the  success of our Remote Operations Center, as well as the programs and services it provides to the organization.  Candidates must be comfortable working in a highly complex, fast paced, and collaborative culture.  Leveraging their strong knowledge of physical security protocols and technology, the Manager of the ROC will oversee a team of coordinators to ensure the needs of our fast growing business are met.

What you’ll be doing

• Lead and develop ROC staff and other members of the security operations team to meet individual and departmental goals.

• Oversee and ensure the effectiveness and continued improvement of all aspects of ROC operations, emergency coordination and response.

• Work with Safe and Secure Senior Leaders to develop and maintain critical administrative and emergency response/coordination procedures.

• Manage multiple projects to create new services, improve existing procedures, or implement solutions to improve ROC efficiency and company-wide safety initiatives.

• Maintain the ROC’s high level of expectations and key performance indicators, by measuring results against standards; and making necessary adjustments.

• Develop and coordinate training for ROC staff including new hire training, ongoing development, training exercises, and drills.

• Maintain visibility and ownership of all systems monitored by the ROC, and coordinate with internal customers to establish and meet expectations.

• Gather, maintain, and analyze data to identify potential threats/vulnerabilities and improve the ROC’s performance.

What you should have

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university (ideally in business, finance or criminal justice).

• 5+ years of experience working in the security industry, preferably in a ROC/SOC/GSOC environment.

• 2+ years of people leadership experience.

• Global perspective and the ability to build effective networks.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• Ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Self-starter’s mentality.

• Proficiency in MS Office, MS Project, Google Suites, and Tableau.

It would be great if you also had

• Master’s Degree from an accredited graduate school or university (preferably in business, finance, or security).

• Experience performing threat and vulnerability assessments.

• Budgetary experience.

• Experience using Genetec, DataMinr, Everbridge, DNA fusion.

• Experience supporting security functions at remote sites.

• Advanced understanding of security technology.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Salary Position with a competitive salary.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

• 401K with company match.

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.

• Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Analista de Backoffice Cobrança e Despejo Sênior — Afirmativa PcD
jobs.description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

Por que essa vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência?

O Grupo QuintoAndar está comprometido com a promoção da Inclusão Social e um dos pilares é a representatividade em nossos times. Acreditamos que através da geração de mais oportunidades e de ações intencionais, avançaremos na construção e fortalecimento da inclusão social em nosso ambiente.

Vale ressaltar que para essa vaga o nosso processo seletivo não sofreu alterações de etapas ou formas de avaliação. Entendemos que o recrutamento é uma porta de entrada para a diversidade, sempre atentos ao que nos torna plurais.

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

• 100% Remoto: A posição é 100% remota, podendo a pessoa residir em qualquer localidade do Brasil. O time pode realizar encontros presenciais pontuais, previamente comunicados, para momentos de integração, alinhamento ou dinâmicas específicas de time.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

O Backoffice atua em demandas internas de maior complexidade e impacto para a operação, apoiando diferentes áreas e garantindo a execução dos fluxos de Collections (cobrança) e Evictions (despejo). Na posição de Analista de Backoffice (Banda 3), você atuará como referência técnica no time, garantindo a fluidez e qualidade nas operações de média e alta complexidade, cumprimento de SLAs e melhorias contínuas para gerar escala, otimizar processos legados e reduzir o backlog. Buscamos um perfil curioso e analítico, focado em identificar causa-raiz, utilizar Inteligência Artificial/automações e transformar dados em soluções de impacto para o negócio.

Suas Responsabilidades:

• Atuar de forma autônoma e como referência técnica em demandas operacionais de média e alta complexidade no Backoffice, garantindo prazos e SLAs.

• Investigar gargalos e problemas sem procedimento previamente definido, identificando causa-raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais nos processos legados.

• Desenhar, implementar e evoluir projetos de melhoria contínua, automação e agentes de Inteligência Artificial (ex: Gemini) para otimizar rotinas e aumentar a eficiência operacional.

• Analisar métricas e indicadores operacionais, elaborando diagnósticos e apresentando relatórios de performance em rituais/weeklys com a liderança.

• Interagir proativamente com diferentes stakeholders e áreas parceiras (como Processos, Treinamento e Melhoria Contínua) para destrinchar e destravar demandas.

• Apoiar colegas de menor senioridade na resolução de dúvidas operacionais e técnicas do dia a dia.

O que buscamos (Requisitos Obrigatórios):

• Vivência em Backoffice / Suporte: Experiência prévia comprovada atuando em operações de Backoffice, atendimento interno ou suporte operacional.

• Melhoria Contínua e IA / Automação: Vivência em otimização de processos, identificação de causa-raiz e utilização/desenvolvimento de automações ou ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para ganho de eficiência.

• Capacidade Analítica & Visão de Processos: Raciocínio lógico estruturado para interpretar indicadores operacionais, diagnosticar falhas em fluxos e propor soluções sustentáveis.

• Comunicação e Stakeholder Management: Boa articulação para interagir com áreas parceiras, apresentar diagnósticos e reportar resultados em fóruns operacionais com segurança e clareza.

• Domínio de Ferramentas: Conhecimento prático em ferramentas como Salesforce, Zendesk e Google Sheets para gestão e tratativa de demandas.

Diferenciais (Desejável):

• Conhecimento prévio ou atuação nas frentes de Collections (cobrança/faturas/acordos) ou Evictions (despejo/BPOs jurídicos).

• Experiência com construção de dashboards, relatórios e análises de métricas de acompanhamento operacional.

Como é nosso processo seletivo?

Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

• Inscrição e Triagem de Perfil

• Entrevista de Avaliação de Perfil

• Entrevista com Liderança

• Proposta e Oferta Final

Importante: Avaliamos todas as candidaturas individualmente e garantimos retorno para todas as pessoas. Toda a comunicação é feita por e-mail, então certifique-se de liberar o domínio @quintoandar.com.br na sua caixa de entrada.

jobs.title: Senior Facilities Operations Technician - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity’s knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sr. Facilities Operations Technician at SpaceXSI, you'll dive in, operating and maintaining the critical facility systems that power our supercomputing data centers. Working hands-on with MEP systems, you’ll tackle maintenance, operations, and repairs, ensuring peak performance and reliability. Expect to troubleshoot complex issues, streamline processes, and collaborate with teams to keep our infrastructure running smoothly, directly supporting xAI’s mission to accelerate human scientific discovery through AI.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Independently operate and maintain critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems in supercomputing data centers, ensuring high reliability and performance through hands-on maintenance, troubleshooting, and process optimization.

• Perform advanced maintenance and troubleshooting of critical data center systems like HVAC, power, and environmental controls, while mentoring junior technicians to ensure operational reliability.

• Oversee the maintenance and optimization of critical data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, and environmental systems, while leading a team of technicians to ensure operational reliability and efficiency.

• Responsible for MEP Infrastructure site safety and environmental compliance, ensuring the sites align with all local and regional health and safety requirements.

• Provide operational expertise for Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems at the datacenter facility. The systems and equipment can include pumps, piping, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH units, wiring, lighting systems, generators, motors, water supply, UPS and switchgear, etc.

• Routinely inspect all areas to ensure performance measures are being maintained and proactively self-report the problems of facilities.

• Experience with writing and executing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs.

• Perform daily inspections of critical systems.

• Identify and maintain spare parts inventory to minimize downtime.

• Coordinate and supervise scheduled system shutdowns.

• Develop and implement energy monitoring metrics.

• Support commissioning efforts by witnessing equipment startup, assisting with functional testing, and monitoring construction progress.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical or 6+ years of hands-on operations/facilities work experience in lieu of degree (data center experience preferred).

• Knowledge of mechanical or electrical engineering principles and systems (both would be a huge plus).

• Experience and knowledge of all critical systems documentation including Plans, Procedures, and Operations Manuals.

• Experience and knowledge of Building and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems and Operations.

• Strong troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with PLC-based control systems and/or with Building Management Systems (Client).

• Excellent written and verbal communication and technical writing skills in English.

• Physical Requirements: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Ability to utilize hand tools and power tools as needed. Work is often performed in tight quarters, and physical dexterity is necessary to perform job functions. Ability to lift up to 35 lbs. unassisted. Comfortable working at elevated heights (up to 100 feet) with appropriate safety gear. Comfortable working in extreme outdoor environments—heat, cold, rain, etc. Comfortable working in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise.

• Available to work flexible shifts providing 24x7 coverage as needed, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.

• Position is subject to pre-employment and annual post-employment background checks.

• Willing to travel as needed (up to 10%).

• Valid driver’s license.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money. 



In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Sales Development Manager in New York, NY or San Francisco, CA that will recruit, develop, & lead a highly driven and hardworking team of Sales Development Representatives (Inbound) & Business Development Representatives (Outbound). We are looking for someone who is passionate about building a winning team and coaching & elevating the craft of new sellers at Notion. The Sales Development team is the first interaction with prospective Notion customers and is key to the success of our Sales organization!



At Notion the Sales Development team is responsible for driving new business opportunities and expanding market share through qualified pipeline, as well as driving the business forward by developing the next generation of top closers. As the Sales Development Lead you will be responsible for delivering both revenue and talent for our business. You will focus on the Recruitment, Enablement and Execution of your team to assure the continued successful trajectory of this strategically important department.



Our ideal candidate for this role has proven experience in managing, building and encouraging a team to achieve daily, weekly and monthly/quarterly targets in addition to delivering feedback to marketing and sales operations about lead quality and process improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 1. As an AMER Sales Development Manager, you will work directly with Sales Managers, cross functionally with Marketing Leadership, & Revenue Operations Leadership in creating and developing Notion’s Sales Development strategy, process and playbooks

 2. Partnering with regional leaders across Sales Strategy, Marketing, and Sales teams to plan territory mapping and pipeline development programs

 3. Build winning teams through Attracting, Hiring, and Developing the world’s best xDRs

 4. Enable your team to relentlessly prospect, identify and qualify sales pipeline through your coaching and mentoring on topics including courageous qualification, prospecting techniques, phone skills, and strategic engagement with Account Executives

 5. Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to ensure we capitalize on the massive market opportunity ahead of us

 6. Help build the foundations of Sales at Notion: As an early member of our sales org, you'll be instrumental in helping define our sales assisted motions.

 7. Join a fantastic team at a magical time: We've hit profitability and over 100 million users with a small team, which gives us a huge green field to work with. You'll join at the perfect time to shape how we grow from here.

 8. Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better — and work with the product to inform what we do next.

 9. Elevate your skills as we tackle our most impactful challenges: We've achieved more than teams 10x our size in less time — and there's so much more to do and learn.
    
    


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Experience including either
   
   - 1-2 years managing a high-performing Sales Development team
   
   - 1-2 years Account Executive experience (and strong performance) at a SaaS company; after having successfully made the leap from Sales Development to Account Executive 

 - Strong track record of achieving sales targets across team and individual goals

 - Skilled in managing and coaching early-career salespeople

 - You have strong, recognized leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive mindsets, collaboration, and the ability to inspire a team of direct reports

 - You are comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of a high growth startup

 - You have a growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of an early stage team

 - You view setbacks as learning opportunities, not failures

 - You have a high EQ and exceptional interpersonal skills, the ability to manage influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building

 - You have an analytical mindset and enjoy problem-solving as part of a regional leadership team

 - You have strong empathy for customers and a passion for revenue and growth

 - You have a good understanding of value selling

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've built new business sales playbooks or processes

 - You've been a first or early hire at a fast-growing start-up before

 - Experience leading and improving Sales Development critical metrics

 - Experience running successful weekly and monthly team meetings

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About EssenceMediacom: A Leading WPP Media Brand

This role is within EssenceMediacom, a leading brand within WPP Media, where you will be instrumental in driving breakthroughs for the world’s best brands through data-driven media and creative strategies.

Role Summary & Impact

As a Manager of Planning, you will direct the day-to-day account activities of the group and play a key role in translating marketing and advertising objectives into overall media strategies. You will also direct the development of media plans consistent with the approved strategy. You will be responsible for developing the skills and knowledge of assigned Associate(s) and/or Senior Associate(s).

Skills and Experience

• Partner with the Director on all aspects of communication plan development and recommendations.

• Demonstrate a full understanding of the Client’s businesses as a basis for all future work.

• Determine and supervise the best possible implementation of all approved communication plans and projects.

• Direct marketing and media analyses to support recommendations.

• Act as primary planning/buying integration contact for outside agency partners.

• Supervise, guide and counsel Senior Associate(s) and/or Associate(s) on all day-to-day activities.

• Train planning staff in media and marketing disciplines as well as the specifics of the Client’s business and industry.

• Accurately, objectively, and constructively evaluate the performance of Senior Associate(s) and/or Associate(s) via the talent development process.

• Provide insightful updates to media and agency partners on the status of all account projects.

• Assume ultimate media financial accountability with Client Accounting and agency partners.

• Act with high integrity when managing solid relationships across agency and media partners to ensure brand understanding, more effectively sell ideas, and contribute to positive agency evaluations,

• A Bachelor’s Degree in advertising, marketing, business administration or communication; OR equivalent professional work experience.

• 3-4 years experience working within strategy/planning, preferably within a media agency setting.

• Previous experience working across all media channels (digital and traditional).

• Previous experience working with tools including MediaOcean, Prisma is preferred.

• Previous experience working in a data-driven environment is a plus.

• Able to work autonomously in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

• Adaptable to take direction and multi-task.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
