jobs.title: * NOW HIRING* Domino's hourly shift lead - Omak, Washington
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From assistant manager to general manager, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

Additional Information:

• Pay range $17.13 to $22.00 per hour
• Healthcare (after 90 days and must work 40 hours)
• Flexible schedule
• Employee discounts
• Washington paid sick leave

Must be 18 years or older

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.title: Maternal OB Clinical Nursing Instructor
jobs.description:
Chamberlain College of Nursing seeks Part-Time Clinical Nursing Faculty interested in teaching with our BSN Nursing program.

You will be mentoring BSN students in person at an inpatient clinical setting in the Des Moines, Iowa area. You'll be making connections between what our students are learning in the classroom and during simulations, with the real-world applications in patient care they are experiencing on-site. By bridging this gap, we can ensure that our students are not only well-prepared for their roles as healthcare professionals but also confident in their abilities to provide high-quality care to their patients.

No teaching experience is required, nurses with solid clinical experience and a completed MSN are encouraged to apply!

Scheduling:

• Schedule is determined based on the course need and the clinical specialty for each 8-week session
• Typically, clinical instructors are scheduled for 3-4 consecutive 12-hour shifts, which occur over a period of 1-2 weeks each session

Maternal-OB Nursing:

Students will be demonstrating nursing skills and procedures in an inpatient healthcare center. This course focuses on family-centered approaches to maternal/newborn care and incorporates health promotion and wellness issues. The childbearing cycle, including normal experience, high-risk factors, complications, and alterations are studied.

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacist - Care Team
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Clinical Pharmacist, Care Team is a member of the Rightway PBM Clinical Operations team. This role will be key in delivering on the “pharmacist in the family” approach to engaging our members. We are looking for an experienced clinical pharmacist to engage with our members in a caring and empathetic manner. Written and verbal communication skills will be critical when interacting with members on the phone, via email, and via the chat function on the Rightway app. A willingness to go the extra mile to provide outstanding customer service is an essential requirement of this role.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Guide members as if you are the “Pharmacist in the Family” to help members manage their medications and disease states

• Engage with members via phone, chat, and email to provide a white glove/concierge experience for members

• Go above and beyond to answer member questions about all things pharmacy related

• Perform core Pharmacist duties including prospective/retrospective drug utilization reviews, comprehensive medication reviews, and recommending changes to patient's drug regimens

• Partners with Rightway’s Navigation team where needed to provide holistic support to members

• Engages with providers to address medication gaps in therapy for patients, drug therapy recommendations, formulary compliance, and serve as a subject matter expert on medications

• Contributes to the Pharmacy & Therapeutics committee in the research, preparation and presentation of drug monographs, therapeutic category reviews and clinical policy development. Ensures that these processes meet or exceed regulatory and best practice standards

• Supports prior authorization review process as needed regarding drug product selection and formulary compliance to ensure quality of care

• Perform utilization management reviews and support outreach to members and providers to drive clinical and cost-savings outcomes.

• Effectively collaborate with third-parties in the administration of Rightway’s clinical pharmacy strategy

• Responsible for achieving productivity and quality of work metrics for clinical pharmacy interactions

• Contribute to the design and evolution of technology-enabled processes to create a scalable clinical pharmacy operation

• Ensures regulatory standards are consistently met

WHO YOU ARE:

• Pharmacy degree required, PharmD preferred. Managed Care or other pharmacy residency preferred

• 3 years in direct patient care such as PBM clinical operations or Health Plan Pharmacy Department or provision of Medication Therapy Management services

• Pharmacy License: Required: State of residence. Preferred: Multi-state licenses and/or be willing to attain licensure in additional states

• Empathetic, detail-oriented, intellectually and clinically curious, good listener, ability to challenge status quo, values exemplar

• Great clinician, effective & creative problem-solver, ability to prioritize and manage through change. Solid communication skills, ability to lead projects and influence others even without direct reporting line ownership

• Occasional travel may be required

COMPENSATION:  $120,000 - $125,000 annually, in addition to bonus and equity.

Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @rightwayhealthcare.com email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $300mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, Francisco Partners, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, first
Our humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possible
We always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commit
We believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate grit
Changing healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delight
Healthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

Community Public Health Nursing:

jobs.title: Domino's Hourly Delivery Driver Omak, Washington
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our

delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it

because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible

schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be.

You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if

you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so

fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 18 years of age or older.

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

Additional Information:

• Pay- $17.13 (minimum wage) plus mileage and tips
• Health, Dental, and Vision (after 90 days and must work at least 40 hours per week)
• Flexible schedule
• Employee discounts
• Washington paid sick leave

Must be 18 years or older

Held Driver license for two years

Clean driving record

Proof of liability insurance, Vehicle Registration, reliable personal vehicle

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.title: TIG Welder (2nd Shift Weekend, Fri-Mon)
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY
The position of Welder will apply their knowledge and skills in Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (TIG) including fitting, welding, and brazing for the repair and modification of turbine engine components, primarily used in the aerospace industry.  Materials include, but are not limited to, stainless steels, titanium, aluminum and nickel alloys such as hastaloy and inconel. 

Participation in a continuous and proven on-the-job training program (OJT) and adherence to the American Welding Society (AWS D17.1 -aerospace endorsement) structured certification program is expected.

This position will work alongside experienced welders that allows continuous interaction of techniques, skill knowledge, and print reading and interpretation. You will become familiar with various types of welding, equipment, learn about safety and quality standards, and develop your welding technique all under the supervision of a professional team of welders. As your skills increase, so will your responsibilities, giving you hands-on experience, growth, and additional responsibilities.

This position operates from a climate controlled and modern welding department area.
 
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Component Repair Technologies (CRT) is a locally family-owned business, with operations in Mentor, OH since 1985. Our staff of approximately five hundred dedicated team-members, many of whom have been onboard for decades, are the key reason for the success of the company. 

CRT specializes in the repair and overhaul of turbine engine components with our customers being the world’s largest airlines and jet engine manufacturers.  CRT is a global leader in the aerospace and marine turbine engine repair sector with authorizations from the Federal Aviation Administration and other world regulatory bodies.

Our commitment is focused on our valued employees, customers, and community.  Take the next career step and bring your openness to learning new skills to CRT and discover the advantages of working with a privately owned family business.  

Visit www.componentrepair.com for more information.
 
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1.     Follow written and verbal instructions accurately. Clearly understand all instructions prior to proceeding with work. Be able to read and interpret various documents, work instructions and drawings.
2.     Successfully complete all requirements of AWS D17.1 -aerospace endorsement certification and the OJT requirements of the company and the weld department.
3.     Perform welding, weld prep and weld finishing operations (primary TIG application) under the direction and observation of a skilled welder or trainer initially.  When proficiency is demonstrated (via various testing methods) perform the aforementioned tasks independently.
4.     Inspect work for completion and quality. Understand and achieve weld quality requirements.
5.     The welder may perform in the following disciplines:
a.     Perform Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (TIG welding) or parts. 
b.     Perform Torch Brazing of tubes and connectors.
c.      Perform Automated TIG Welding.
d.     Use pneumatic hand grinders, and other powered bench tools to grind metal to prepare parts for welding or to finish after welding.
e.     Use weld fixtures, chill blocks, gas back-ups, pre-heat methods, and other methods and equipment.
f.       Perform local heat treat and local stress relief of weld repair areas.
g.     Assemble and fit parts such as flanges to cases, cut and fit patches, or assemble tubes and fittings. 
h.     Perform non-certified welding for shop maintenance, building installation, or for tooling and fixturing.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
1.     Technical high school, or equivalent trade school completion in a weld curriculum.
2.     Successful completion of skill specific TIG welding courses from an approved technical or welding school and/or a minimum of two years’ TIG specific welding experience.
3.     Previous certification credentials in an AWS welding classification, with AWS D17.1 preference.
4.     The ability to interpret and follow written and verbal instructions accurately, including reading and interpretation of technical drawings.
 
OTHER QUALIFICATIONS
1.     Read, write, speak, and understand the English language.
2.     Basic knowledge of computers and standard software programs.
3.     Demonstrated ability to perform mathematical operations, including working with decimals, fractions, and basic geometry.
4.     Previous experience or familiarity with measuring gages such as calipers and micrometers. 
 
WORK ENVIRONMENT
1. Must be able to pass a vision test and fitness-for-duty test.
2. Follow general shop safety procedures including the occasional use of safety glasses, safety toe shoes, and hearing protection. 
3. Follow general shop safety procedures including the use of safety glasses, safety toe shoes, and hearing protection when required.
4. Work in varying positions from time to time. Stand and/or sit for portions of the shift.  Move parts (>50 pounds) using hoists, slings, carts, or other handling methods. Move less heavy parts (<50 pounds) with or without hoists, slings, or carts. 
5. Occasionally use powered and hand-held tools. 
 
COMPANY BENEFITS
Our employees and families are the number one asset at CRT.  A progressive and innovative benefits package is in place, such as:  
1.      CRT currently offers two excellent health care options, one being a fully funded program (no premiums for employee and family) and the other being a traditional employee premium contribution.  Programs include health, vision, and dental coverages. Additional programs include short- and long-term disability and life insurance.
2.      The company offers a 401k program that will match up to 6% of your contributions and distributes annual cash bonuses based on the performance of the company.
3.      Continuing education is offered via multiple sources and opportunities with tuition reimbursement based on eligibility requirements.
4.      Traditional paid time off (PTO) is offered via vacation days and personal days.
5.      Multiple shift opportunities with hourly premiums for off-shifts are offered.

To review other benefits, visit our website at www.componentrepair.com/join-us/ or Facebook page www.facebook.com/ComponentRepair  to see, “what we are up to.”

Alongside regular hygiene appointments, you will help document clinical observations, track restorative treatment follow-up, and support dental screening for personnel arriving at the installation. Appropriate instrument processing, sharps controls, and supply readiness are part of maintaining a safe patient care environment. When specialty services are unavailable locally, accurate referral records help ensure care continues.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Specialist - Night Shift
jobs.description:
ABOUT NELO

About the Company

Nelo is a leading fintech in Mexico reimagining credit to expand consumer buying power. Founded in 2019 by former Uber international growth team leads Kyle Miller and Stephen Hebson, Nelo offers credit cards, BNPL loans, bill payments, and its own marketplace — all under one app — designed from first principles for a mobile-first, real-time payments world.

With $100M in annual revenue, $1B in annualized GMV, and $140M+ raised in equity and debt, Nelo is one of the most capital-efficient consumer fintech companies in Latin America. The company is profitable — positive operating profit in both 2024 and 2025. It runs lean and technical: 60 employees, 8 engineers, with AI driving underwriting, collections, and operations.

 - HQ: Mexico City, Mexico; commercial and people operations in New York City

 - Founded: 2019

 - Team size: 60 FTEs

 - Website: nelo.mx http://nelo.mx

 - Stage: Post-Series A; $100M credit facility (Victory Park Capital, 2022); profitable

Company values:

 - Be your best selves: ambition, hard work, intellectual curiosity

 - Everyone is an owner: all employees receive equity including customer support; 10-year option expiration; equity refreshers

 - Customer first: product decisions grounded in customer benefit

 - Open and honest communication: quarterly financials and board presentations shared company-wide; low tolerance for bureaucracy or gossip

 - Move fast, learn fast: hundreds of experiments run monthly; rigorous experimentation culture


ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re looking for a Customer Experience Specialist who can operate at a high level of autonomy, judgment, and analytical thinking. This is not an entry-level position. At Nelo, all agents are expected to think like Tier 3 support from day one.

You’ll be part of a lean, high-performance support team trusted to own complex resolutions, analyze user problems across multiple systems, and collaborate with product and engineering when needed. You’ll also contribute to improving our automation flows and support strategy by flagging insights and outliers with clarity.

This is the right role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, adapts fast, and is excited by the challenge of building a world-class, AI-augmented CX operation.




WHY THIS ROLE

At Nelo, we’ve automated more than 60% of inbound tickets, and we’re just getting started. That means the role of the cx agent has evolved: we’re no longer looking for people to follow scripts, we’re looking for people who can think like product analysts.

Night shift at Nelo it's a high-trust, high-autonomy environment where you're often the only person standing between a user and a resolution.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Deliver fast, accurate, and empathetic support via WhatsApp, email, and internal workflows.

 - Handle complex user scenarios, including financial disputes, exception cases, and ambiguous product issues.

 - Analyze tickets to detect root causes, identify patterns, and raise quality tickets to Product or Engineering.

 - Use internal tools and dashboards to query user data, assess trends, or confirm behaviors.

 - Collaborate with the automation team to improve flows by providing structured feedback or tagging errors.

 - Stay constantly up to date on product changes and use that context to drive accurate, trust-building resolutions.

 - Support operational processes, including claims, identity checks, transaction investigations, and escalations.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 2-4 years of experience in customer support or fintech/marketplace environments in high-concurrency channels like WhatsApp.

 - You're reliable and self-directed at night. You don't need someone looking over your shoulder to stay sharp during off-hours.

 - You’re not just reactive, you anticipate problems, ask smart questions, and solve with judgment.

 - You’re highly analytical: you enjoy problem-solving, logic, and going one level deeper.

 - You’re data curious: maybe you don’t write SQL yet, but you’re eager to learn.

 - You write clearly and concisely, and you adapt your tone to the context.

 - You enjoy helping people, but more importantly, helping them fast and well.

 - You’re fluent in Spanish and comfortable reading and writing in English.





COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Base Salary: MXN $24.000

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage.

 - 15 Days of PTO

 - Equity

 - Remote in Mexico City or the Metropolitan Area.

 - Schedule: This is a fixed night shift. You'll work 40 hours a week, 5 days on and 2 days off, from 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Days off rotate weekly, so reliability and consistency are a must.

 - Team offsites twice a year in cool destinations.

 - Opportunity to grow inside a strategic, AI-driven CX team at a fast-growing tech company.


ABOUT THE PROCESS

We move fast, and we respect your time.

 1. Business Case: Skip the intro call and go straight to the challenge. We'll send you a real-world CX scenario to see how you think, write, and solve. No prep needed, just bring your judgment. (72 hours)

 2. Manager Interview: If your case stands out, we'll get on an interview to learn more about you and answer any questions.

 3. On-site Interview: Meet the team you'll be working with.

 4. Background Check. 

 5. Offer: We move quickly

This is a senior, hands-on design role for someone with exceptional craft, strong conceptual thinking, and the ability to take meaningful ownership of projects from early exploration through final delivery.

You'll work across brand identities, websites, campaigns, and launch moments — developing ideas, building visual systems, and pushing the work beyond the obvious. You'll collaborate closely with creative leadership, project managers, strategists, and other designers while owning significant portions of the creative process yourself.

You'll also work directly with clients, presenting concepts, explaining creative decisions, responding thoughtfully to feedback, and helping move projects toward strong outcomes.

We're looking for someone who wants to do career-defining work, move quickly, push creative boundaries, and help raise the standard of what Nen puts into the world.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design & Craft: Create exceptional work across brand identity, visual systems, websites, campaigns, and launch experiences. Bring a high level of taste, detail, and polish to everything you touch.

Concept Development: Develop distinctive creative directions from early exploration through fully realized systems. Push beyond the first idea, challenge conventions, and find solutions that feel ownable and memorable.

Project Ownership: Take meaningful ownership of projects and workstreams from concept through delivery. Manage your own work effectively, anticipate what needs to happen next, and make sure details don't fall through the cracks.

Client Collaboration: Present work clearly and confidently, articulate the thinking behind creative decisions, respond thoughtfully to feedback, and build trust with founders and senior stakeholders.

Creative Collaboration: Work closely with creative leadership, strategists, developers, project managers, and other designers to make the work stronger. Give thoughtful feedback and contribute actively to critiques.

Raise the Bar: Help improve the quality of our work, our creative process, and the way we present ourselves as a studio. Bring new references, ideas, techniques, and perspectives into the team.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–7 years of experience as a designer, ideally within a strong branding, design, or creative agency environment.

 - Exceptional design craft and taste. You have a strong portfolio demonstrating excellent typography, composition, visual systems, identity work, and digital design.

 - Strong conceptual thinking. You can develop ideas, not just execute layouts, and know how to turn a strong concept into a cohesive visual system.

 - High ownership and reliability. You do whatever it takes to get important work over the line, stay calm under pressure, and don't need someone chasing you to make things happen. This is not a role for someone looking for a strictly 9–5 mindset.

 - Strong with clients and presentations. You're comfortable presenting your work, explaining your thinking, receiving feedback, and navigating creative conversations professionally.

 - Able to move fluidly between thinking and making. You can zoom out to understand the bigger creative idea and zoom all the way into the details required to make the final work exceptional.

 - Driven to raise the bar. You're ambitious about your craft, curious about what's happening in design and culture, and constantly looking for ways to make the work more distinctive.
   
    


WHY JOIN NEN CREATIVE

 - Be part of a small, fast-growing studio trusted by world-class startups and investors

 - Work directly with top founders shaping the future of tech

 - Clear growth path as we scale — you’ll help define the design practice itself

 - Remote-friendly, flexible, and entrepreneurial environment

 - Healthcare, PTO, 401K

jobs.title: Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Come join our Strategy & Operations team!

High velocity, high trust, and high impact with a will to win.

If that resonates deeply with you, this could be your next career move. We're seeking someone who leads with humility, pursues audacious goals, and is motivated by meaningful impact on people and the world.

At FutureFit AI, our core mission is to help more people get to better jobs faster and cheaper, with a specific focus on those facing barriers to opportunity. Our work helps resolve the growing issue of economic inequality, ensuring that no one is left behind in the future of work. Our AI-powered platform brings efficiency and insight to workforce development, replacing outdated systems and unlocking human potential at scale.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today.

Important note: Data shows that men typically apply when meeting 3/10 requirements, while women often wait until it's 10/10. We encourage you to apply if you see a strong (not necessarily perfect) fit.




YOUR ROLE

We're seeking a Manager, Strategy & Operations to join our team, reporting to Katya Simpson, VP, Strategy and Ops.

You will be the operating backbone of the leadership team. You will run the rhythm that keeps the company aligned, keep the numbers everyone argues from shared and trusted, and own the contract and risk operations that let us move fast without dropping anything. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a small, nimble company. It blends business judgment with disciplined execution, and you will have wide latitude to decide how the operating system of the company gets built.

A note on what this role is: it is a roll-up-your-sleeves seat. Most of the work is operating cadence, tracking, and administration, and strategy is a real but lighter part of it. If you are looking for a pure strategy role, this is not it. If you want to be the person who makes a leadership team run well and sharpens its judgment, read on.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Management cadence and enablement (about 30%): Run the operating rhythm of the management team, the exec team, and the operating review: agendas, pre-reads, a lightweight decision log, and follow-through on what was decided. Produce board and investor meetings, assembling the decks and investor packages from numbers the Director of Finance owns. Partner with the Director of People to plan company onsites and team gatherings from start to finish.

 - Measurement, tools, and risk (about 25%): Maintain the company's metrics and OKR tracking so performance conversations start from shared numbers. Keep the tools inventory and licensing in order, along with a risk register and a compliance calendar.

 - Legal and contract operations (about 30%): Take the first pass on NDAs and standard agreements against a playbook, and route anything non-standard to outside counsel with a clear brief. Maintain the contract repository and an obligations tracker covering renewals, notice periods, and government reporting deliverables, so nothing slips. Run vendor onboarding and corporate records, including entity and cap table hygiene in Carta.

 - Strategic projects (about 15%): Take on scoped projects for the leadership team: dig into an issue the metrics surface, frame the options and tradeoffs, and recommend a path to a decision. This is real strategy work, but it is the lighter share of the role.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 6-12 MONTHS

 - The weekly management meeting runs on a clear agenda and pre-reads, leaders arrive prepared, and decisions and actions are logged and followed through without anyone chasing.

 - Company OKRs and metrics are tracked on a steady rhythm, and you are surfacing the items that need leadership attention before anyone has to ask. You are supporting the rollout of the company-wide health dashboard as it comes online.

 - NDA intake is yours: every incoming NDA is reviewed, risks are identified, and anything non-standard reaches outside counsel with a clear brief. Nothing we have signed goes untracked.

 - You have taken at least one strategic project from framing to a leadership decision.

 - Leaders across Build, Grow, and Manage see you as the person who keeps things moving and can be trusted with judgment calls.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You roll up your sleeves. You are as comfortable building the agenda and chasing the pre-read as you are framing a recommendation, and you see enablement as high-leverage work.

 - You have business judgment. You know what to fix yourself, what to flag, and what to escalate.

 - You are a generalist at heart who learns fast. You may have come up through business operations, strategy and operations, strategic finance, or consulting, or through legal ops or HR looking to broaden into something new. You are drawn to breadth and want to grow into more strategy, or into the legal work.

 - You earn trust across functions. You work easily with leaders in Build, Grow, and Manage, and with outside counsel.

 - You own it. You turn decisions into owned actions and follow through without being chased.


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years in business operations, strategy and operations, strategic finance, or consulting

 - Comfort with numbers: you can work from financial and operating metrics, spot what needs leadership attention, and flag it clearly

 - Comfort with contracts: you can read an NDA or standard agreement, identify risk, and know what to escalate (legal training is not required)

 - Clear written and verbal communication: you can brief outside counsel, prepare an executive pre-read, and explain a tradeoff to a non-specialist

 - High attention to detail across many moving parts, including trackers, calendars, repositories, and records


BONUS POINTS

 - Exposure to contract or legal operations (a strong plus)

 - Experience supporting board and investor reporting

 - Familiarity with Carta or cap table management

 - Experience building lightweight systems (decision logs, risk registers, compliance calendars) from scratch


LOCATION

Fully remote across the US and Canada. We are open to candidates living anywhere in either country. For candidates living in Toronto, our office is conveniently located at 325 Front St West (a short walk from Union Station), and you are welcome to drop by.




TRAVEL EXPECTATIONS

Although this role is remote, quarterly travel is required for off-sites and team gatherings.




COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is USD $120,000 to $180,000 for candidates based in the United States. Bands are designed for the lifecycle of the role. Where you enter the band reflects your applied experience and other criteria established by the hiring committee, with room to grow through the band as you grow in the role.




HIRING JOURNEY

At FutureFit AI, our hiring process is designed to help you assess whether this role and our culture are the right fit based on your unique skills, mindset, and experiences. We move fast and work with intensity, so we want you to get a real sense of that from the start.

Each journey includes a mix of interviews and a short business exercise. For this role, that might look like:

 - Online Application

 - Initial Screen with our Recruiter

 - Interview with Hiring Manager

 - Short Business Case Exercise

 - Panel Interview

 - Final Conversation

 - Final Decision

Generally, this entire process takes around 6 weeks, although the timing can vary due to specific candidate circumstances.






READY TO SHAPE THE FUTURE OF WORK?

At FutureFit AI, we're not just building a company—we're transforming how talent and opportunity connect. Join our driven team united by a commitment to job seekers and the workforce ecosystems we serve.




COMPANY SNAPSHOT:

 - Team: 30-50 across US and Canada (hubs in NYC and Toronto)

 - Customers: Workforce development agencies and intermediaries, government agencies, employers

 - Industry: SaaS/AI technology

 - Funding: Bootstrapped 0-1, then raised funding led by JP Morgan

 - Structure: Growth, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Data, People & Culture, Finance & Operations




OUR CORE PRINCIPLES

 - Be Curious

 - Drive to Outcomes

 - Raise the Bar

 - Speed Matters

 - Own It

 - We Over Me




USE OF AI IN HIRING

At FutureFit, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and equitable—never to replace human judgment. We use AI in the following ways:

 - Screening support: AI may help us compare applications against the skills and experience required for a specific role. These skills are defined by the hiring team for each position. A human reviews each application, with the AI assessment as just one input. 

 - Interview support: In some interviews, we may use an AI notetaker to summarize the discussion so interviewers can focus on being present in the conversation.

 - Insights, not decisions: AI provides data points to support our team’s evaluation but does not make or recommend final hiring decisions. Every hiring decision is made by people.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.description:
About Reactivate ☀️

Reactivate, an Invenergy company, is a mission-driven organization that develops, owns, and operates renewable energy solutions that are designed to improve quality of life for communities, with a focus on meaningful benefits for working-class people across the country. Focus areas include community solar, commercial & industrial solar, small utility-scale solar, energy storage, and EV charging projects. By delivering economic development and energy resiliency with renewable energy solutions, Reactivate provides energy cost savings, job opportunities, workforce training, and opportunities for businesses, while creating positive social and environmental impact.

Reactivate was founded by Invenergy and Lafayette Square.

To learn more, visit us at www.reactivate.com.

We are thrilled to become ✨Great Place to Work Certified✨! The Great Place to Work Certification is the most definitive "employer-of-choice" recognition that companies aspire to achieve. It is the only recognition based entirely on what employees report about their workplace experience - specifically, how consistently they experience a high-trust workplace. Great Place to Work Certification is recognized worldwide by employees and employers alike and is the global benchmark for identifying and recognizing outstanding employee experience. Every year, more than 10,000 companies across 60 countries apply to get Great Place to Work Certified.

The Senior Analyst, Origination will support and be the analytical and coordination hub of the Origination and Contracting team, owning market fundamentals reporting, price curve management, revenue modeling, and day-to-day management of M&A. This role translates market data, vendor forecasts, and regulatory developments into pricing recommendations, deal economics, and decision-ready analysis that support origination strategy, PPA structuring, and investment approvals across Reactivate’s distributed generation, community solar and storage portfolio.

Responsibilities ⚙️

• Produce recurring market fundamentals reports (monthly/quarterly) covering energy, capacity, REC/SREC, and ancillary service markets across key ISOs/RTOs (e.g., PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO)

• Track and interpret drivers of power prices, load growth (data centers, electrification), supply additions and retirements, transmission constraints, and policy changes

• Monitor forward curves, broker quotes, and market transactions to benchmark PPA pricing and identify shifts in offtake market conditions

• Maintain market intelligence dashboards and summaries for leadership, origination, and finance stakeholders

• Serve as the internal owner of third-party price curves from fundamentals vendors

• Ingest, validate, version, and archive vendor curves; reconcile differences across vendors and releases, and document methodology changes

• Build and maintain revenue models for solar, storage, and solar-plus-storage projects under various offtake structures, including physical and virtual PPAs, fixed-shape and as-generated contracts, tolling agreements, hedges, and merchant tails

• Model revenue stacks including energy, capacity, RECs/SRECs, ancillary services, energy arbitrage, and community solar/DG compensation (e.g., Illinois ABP REC pricing, NY VDER/Value Stack)

• Research utility tariffs and state-specific regulatory frameworks (e.g., net metering rules, community solar program rules, rate case outcomes) to inform origination strategy

• Monitor, screen, and review utility and load-serving entity RFPs for energy, capacity, RECs, storage, and DG/community solar procurement, and summarize eligibility, product definitions, evaluation criteria, credit and security requirements, and key dates for go/no-go decisions

• Prepare market updates, origination materials, pricing memos, and deal summaries for internal approval and external counterparties

• Coordinate with Finance, Product, and Origination teams to align pricing assumptions with the deal pipeline in Salesforce

• Manage internal M&A review process, coordinate with internal departments and be point of contact for communication with Sellers

Requirements 🎓

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus

• 3 - 5+ years of experience in renewable energy origination, community solar program administration, utility regulatory analysis, or a related analytical role

• Strong Excel skills for building pricing forecasts and tracking program economics over time

• Familiarity with community solar and distributed generation program structures (Illinois Adjustable Block Program, NY VDER/Value Stack, or similar state programs) and interconnection processes

• Working knowledge of utility tariff and program adder structures, with ability to read and extract relevant terms from program administrator guidance, PUC/PSC filings, and rate schedules

• Advanced Excel modeling skills, including building integrated revenue models, scenario tools, and sensitivity analyses from scratch

• Solid understanding of wholesale power market fundamentals, including LMP pricing, capacity markets, REC markets, and basis/congestion dynamics

• Experience working with third-party price forecasts and forward curves, and the ability to critically evaluate vendor methodologies and assumptions

• Proficiency in Python,SQL or similar tools for data pipelines, curve processing, and automating recurring analysis, CRM (salesforce) experience

• Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams across different state markets

• Strong written communication skills; ability to translate technical/regulatory detail into clear, decision-ready summaries

• Comfort acting as an external-facing point of contact with sellers, advisors, counsel, and counterparties, with sound judgment on when to escalate

• Experience supporting or managing M&A diligence or project acquisition processes in renewable energy or infrastructure

• Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications 💡

• Experience with storage dispatch or production cost modeling tools (e.g., PLEXOS, Aurora, PowerSimm, or custom optimization models)

• Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)

• Exposure to ISO market data sources and APIs (e.g., PJM Data Miner, NYISO OASIS, Yes Energy)

• Familiarity with tax credit structures (ITC/PTC, transferability, adders) and their interaction with offtake pricing

The annual base salary for this position is $90,000 - $120,000. Reactivate considers several factors when determining base pay offers such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibility of the role, candidate’s work experience and/or education, training and certifications among other key skills at the time of offer.

Why Reactivate ⚡

To support our incredible team and their families beyond the workplace, Reactivate provides an outstanding benefits package effective day one of employment. In addition to medical benefits, 401(k) options, professional development opportunities and a competitive paid time off policy, we allow work flexibility to contribute to a valuable work-life balance.

At Reactivate, we build our teams, cultivate our leaders, and foster an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to be their authentic selves. These values are at the core of our organization, strengthening our team and fueling innovation and progress

We strive to create workplaces that reflect the communities we serve, and we believe that our differences enable us to be a better team. We are not just looking for a culture fit — we are looking for a culture add. If you’re looking for a career where your unique talents are celebrated, your voice is heard, and your contributions make an impact, Reactivate is the place for you.

jobs.location: East Point Plantation, , British Indian Ocean Territory
jobs.description:
As an EMT-B, you will respond to emergencies, stabilize patients within your authorized scope, and support safe ambulance movement and handoff to the next level of care. You will also assist with routine and urgent clinic services, maintain emergency equipment readiness, and participate in planned response exercises. The work calls for practical assessment skills and reliable collaboration with physicians, nurses, and other emergency responders.

Your response duties will include cardiopulmonary resuscitation, automated external defibrillator use, and basic stabilization appropriate to EMT-B practice. During patient transfer, careful monitoring and documentation support continuity of care. You will also help maintain stocked, ready-to-use equipment and participate in response preparation for incidents that may involve multiple patients. Safe documentation of patient disposition and clinical handovers is an important part of the service.

Employment Type: Full-time

Assignment Details: This position requires relocation to Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory, for the duration of the assignment.

Key Responsibilities

• Respond to emergencies, assess patients, and provide authorized first aid, CPR, AED use, wound care, and other Basic Life Support interventions.
• Monitor and document vital signs, condition changes, care delivered, and patient status during emergency treatment and movement.
• Support ambulance operations, patient transfers, referrals, and medical evacuation coordination when higher-level care is required.
• Assist clinicians with authorized patient assessments, urgent care, and health screening activities.
• Check equipment, medical supplies, and ambulance readiness; follow infection prevention, exposure control, and waste management procedures.
• Participate in mass-casualty exercises, emergency drills, incident reporting, and assigned emergency response coverage.

jobs.title: Director of Talent
jobs.description:
ABOUT SYGALDRY

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to superintelligence, and addressing the problem of rising compute costs and energy bottlenecks. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Sygaldry is seeking a highly motivated Director of Talent to help build world-class teams at the intersection of quantum computing and artificial intelligence. This role will focus on identifying, engaging, and closing exceptional technical talent across AI research, quantum computing, software engineering, and systems architecture.

We're looking for an experienced recruiter who thrives in competitive talent markets, knows how to engage hard-to-reach candidates, and can build meaningful relationships with top technical talent. You'll partner closely with hiring managers and company leadership to drive hiring strategies and deliver an exceptional candidate experience.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Own full-cycle recruiting for highly specialized technical roles across quantum computing, AI research, and engineering.

 - Proactively identify, source, and engage passive candidates through creative sourcing strategies, targeted outreach, and industry networks.

 - Develop and execute recruiting strategies to attract top talent from leading AI companies, research institutions, quantum computing organizations, and technology startups.

 - Build strong candidate relationships, effectively communicate Sygaldry's mission and opportunities, and successfully close candidates in competitive hiring situations.

 - Partner closely with hiring managers and technical leadership to understand hiring needs, define candidate profiles, and develop effective search strategies.

 - Manage candidates throughout the recruiting process, including screening, interview coordination, offer development, negotiation, and closing.

 - Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

 - Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation trends, and competitive hiring practices.

 - Continuously improve recruiting processes, sourcing effectiveness, and the overall candidate experience.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - 10+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong emphasis on technical sourcing and candidate closing.

 - Demonstrated success recruiting highly specialized technical talent in quantum computing, AI, machine learning, advanced hardware, or related deep-tech industries.

 - Proven ability to identify and engage passive candidates in highly competitive talent markets.

 - Strong track record of closing senior-level and hard-to-fill technical positions.

 - Experience partnering directly with senior technical leaders, researchers, and hiring managers.

 - Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

 - Resourceful, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously.

 - Experience recruiting AI researchers, quantum physicists, research scientists, or specialized systems engineers.

 - Established networks within AI research, quantum computing, or frontier technology communities.

 - Experience recruiting for an early-stage or high-growth technology startup.

 - Familiarity with academic research communities, technical conferences, and alternative sourcing channels.

 - Experience recruiting talent internationally.


HOW WE’RE DIFFERENT

At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail. We’re looking for scientists, engineers, and operators to forge new paths with us at the intersection of quantum and AI.




CULTURE & BENEFITS

 - Visa Sponsorship - We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We’re open to supporting visas whenever possible.

 - Compensation - We value your contribution and invest in your future with a competitive salary and meaningful equity.

 - Benefits - Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

 - Connection - Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to to contribute to our mission, please reach out at letsbuild@sygaldry.com

jobs.title: TIG Welder (3rd Shift, Mon-Fri)
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY
The position of Welder will apply their knowledge and skills in Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (TIG) including fitting, welding, and brazing for the repair and modification of turbine engine components, primarily used in the aerospace industry.  Materials include, but are not limited to, stainless steels, titanium, aluminum and nickel alloys such as hastaloy and inconel. 
Participation in a continuous and proven on-the-job training program (OJT) and adherence to the American Welding Society (AWS D17.1 -aerospace endorsement) structured certification program is expected.
This position will work alongside experienced welders that allows continuous interaction of techniques, skill knowledge, and print reading and interpretation. You will become familiar with various types of welding, equipment, learn about safety and quality standards, and develop your welding technique all under the supervision of a professional team of welders. As your skills increase, so will your responsibilities, giving you hands-on experience, growth, and additional responsibilities.
This position operates from a climate controlled and modern welding department area.
 
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Component Repair Technologies, Inc. (CRT) began as a locally family-owned business, with operations in Mentor, OH since 1985, and grew into a global leader (500+ employees) in the aerospace MRO sector.  Specializing in the repair and overhaul of turbine engine components, CRT proudly serves the world’s largest airlines and jet engine manufactures. Component Repair Technologies is focused on our valued employees, customers, and community.  
In 2025, CRT became a Safran Aircraft Engines company as a Center of Excellence for the repair of large jet engine parts in the Americas. 
For over 120 years, Safran, through its Aircraft Engines subsidiary, designs, produces, markets and supports, alone or in partnership, aircraft engines offering world-class performance and reliability. Its core purpose is to contribute to a safer, more sustainable world, where air transport is more environmentally friendly, comfortable and accessible. 
Operating through CFM International, its 50/50 joint venture with GE Aerospace, Safran Aircraft Engines is the world’s leading supplier of single-aisle commercial jet engines, the CFM56 and LEAP. Safran Aircraft Engines is fully committed to sustainable aviation through the RISE (Revolutionary Innovation for Sustainable Engines) technology development program. Safran Aircraft Engines also deploys a global network providing a full range of support, maintenance & repair services.  
Visit www.componentrepair.comand www.safran-group.comfor more information. Take-off in your career, learn new skills and become part of a world-class workforce.
 
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Follow established safety protocols and guidelines to ensure full compliance with company safety policies and procedures.
Follow written and verbal instructions accurately. Clearly understand all instructions prior to proceeding with work. Be able to read and interpret various documents, work instructions and drawings.
Successfully complete all requirements of AWS D17.1 -aerospace endorsement certification and the OJT requirements of the company and the weld department.
Perform welding, weld prep and weld finishing operations (primary TIG application) under the direction and observation of a skilled welder or trainer initially.  When proficiency is demonstrated (via various testing methods) perform the aforementioned tasks independently.
Inspect work for completion and quality. Understand and achieve weld quality requirements.
The welder may perform in the following disciplines:
Perform Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (TIG welding) or parts. 
Perform Torch Brazing of tubes and connectors.
Perform Automated TIG Welding.
Use pneumatic hand grinders, and other powered bench tools to grind metal to prepare parts for welding or to finish after welding.
Use weld fixtures, chill blocks, gas back-ups, pre-heat methods, and other methods and equipment.
Perform local heat treat and local stress relief of weld repair areas.
Assemble and fit parts such as flanges to cases, cut and fit patches, or assemble tubes and fittings. 
Perform non-certified welding for shop maintenance, building installation, or for tooling and fixturing.
 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Technical high school, or equivalent trade school completion in a weld curriculum.
Successful completion of skill specific TIG welding courses from an approved technical or welding school and/or a minimum of two years’ TIG specific welding experience.
Previous certification credentials in an AWS welding classification, with AWS D17.1 preference.
The ability to interpret and follow written and verbal instructions accurately, including reading and interpretation of technical drawings.
 
OTHER QUALIFICATIONS
Read, write, speak, and understand the English language.
Basic knowledge of computers and standard software programs.
Demonstrated ability to perform mathematical operations, including working with decimals, fractions, and basic geometry.
Previous experience or familiarity with measuring gages such as calipers and micrometers.
 
 
 WORK ENVIRONMENT
Must be able to pass a vision test and fitness-for-duty test.
Follow general shop safety procedures including the occasional use of safety glasses, safety toe shoes, and hearing protection. 
Follow general shop safety procedures including the use of safety glasses, safety toe shoes, and hearing protection when required.
Work in varying positions from time to time. Stand and/or sit for portions of the shift.  Move parts (>50 pounds) using hoists, slings, carts, or other handling methods. Move less heavy parts (<50 pounds) with or without hoists, slings, or carts. 
Occasionally use powered and hand-held tools.
 
COMPANY BENEFITS
Our employees and families are the number one asset at CRT.  A progressive and innovative benefits package is in place, such as:  
CRT currently offers two excellent health care options, one being a fully funded program (no premiums for employee and family) and the other being a traditional employee premium contribution.  Programs include health, vision, and dental coverages. Additional programs include short- and long-term disability and life insurance.
The company offers a 401k program with company match.
Continuing education is offered via multiple sources and opportunities with tuition reimbursement based on eligibility requirements.
Traditional paid time off (PTO) is offered via vacation days and personal days.
Multiple shift opportunities with hourly premiums for off-shifts are offered.
To review other benefits, visit our website at www.componentrepair.com/careers or Facebook page www.facebook.com/ComponentRepair  to see, “what we are up to.”

As Lead Physician, you will provide direct medical care while guiding clinical personnel, supporting consistent standards, and helping coordinate services across the medical program. Your scope includes preventive and urgent care, medical readiness examinations, occupational health assessments, and clinical decision-making when a patient may need specialist care or medical evacuation. The position is grounded in clinical oversight rather than broad corporate management: you will be a point of coordination between care providers, designated leadership, and authorized medical authorities.

Clinical leadership here is closely tied to real patient care. You will help colleagues evaluate cases, maintain consistent treatment practices, and recognize when the limits of local resources require referral or evacuation. The same practice setting also handles medical screenings, occupational surveillance, and fitness-for-duty assessments, which require careful interpretation of findings and clear documentation of restrictions or qualifications. You will support preventive health education, immunization activities, and the appropriate response to communicable-disease concerns. A key part of the position is coordinating clinical priorities with other healthcare professionals while keeping patient safety at the center of decisions.

You will also work within established clinic hours and emergency coverage arrangements, supporting team readiness for urgent presentations, coordinated transport, and mass-casualty exercises. As an authorized clinical point of coordination, you will communicate with designated leaders, receiving facilities, and relevant medical authorities on matters affecting care. The position involves applying approved medical procedures, supporting clinical quality efforts, and reinforcing appropriate reporting and follow-up. It does not assume unrestricted access to specialty services or resources beyond the island; judgment about safe treatment limits and referral pathways is therefore central to the work.

The clinical oversight element includes consultation and medical guidance to other team members, rather than a separate hospital executive or departmental administration function. You will remain directly involved in patient assessment, management, and treatment while supporting reliable medical services and continuity across the clinic.

Employment Type: Full-time

Assignment Details: This position requires relocation to Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory, for the duration of the assignment.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver routine, preventive, and urgent medical care within clinical privileges, assess complex presentations, and guide the clinical team on treatment and referral decisions.
• Promote evidence-based practice, consistent clinical procedures, patient safety, and continuity across clinic operating hours and emergency coverage.
• Direct clinical coordination of triage, stabilization, specialist referrals, medical evacuation, and handoffs when needs exceed on-island capabilities.
• Support initial, periodic, and annual medical screenings, occupational surveillance, fitness-for-duty assessments, and documentation of medical qualifications or restrictions.
• Collaborate with medical personnel and authorized stakeholders on clinical operations, immunization programs, communicable-disease concerns, emergency planning, and quality processes.

You will combine physician-level care with practical clinical leadership, helping the team make sound decisions within a defined healthcare program.

Requirements

• Current, valid license or professional registration to practice medicine issued by a recognized medical regulatory authority in the candidate's country or jurisdiction of licensure, with authorization for assigned responsibilities and ability to satisfy applicable medical credentialing requirements; qualifications are subject to approval.
• A medical degree (e.g., MD, DO, MBBS, MBChB, or equivalent) awarded by a recognized or accredited medical institution in any country or jurisdiction.

• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

jobs.description:
You will conduct ordered diagnostic X-ray studies, prepare and position patients, and assess image quality before submitting examinations for interpretation by authorized healthcare professionals. The role focuses on X-ray imaging within the available facility capabilities. You will work closely with clinical personnel and support imaging equipment readiness, quality control, and the safe flow of diagnostic information.

The diagnostic service is conventional X-ray imaging rather than a multi-modality post. Each examination calls for appropriate technique selection, image review, attention to unnecessary radiation exposure, and accurate communication with the requesting clinician. You will also participate in established imaging safety and quality processes and report equipment concerns before they compromise service readiness. Patient-centered communication and safe handling of examination information are part of each study.

Employment Type: Full-time

Assignment Details: This position requires relocation to Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory, for the duration of the assignment.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform provider-ordered diagnostic X-ray examinations using appropriate patient positioning and technical settings.
• Explain procedures, maintain patient comfort, apply radiation protection safeguards, and review images for clarity and diagnostic quality.
• Operate imaging equipment, perform routine checks, and coordinate reporting of maintenance, calibration, or serviceability issues.
• Record examination information in the electronic health record while protecting patient privacy and maintaining imaging documentation.
• Apply infection prevention and imaging safety controls; coordinate with clinicians on diagnostic needs and referrals beyond on-island resources.
• Contribute to imaging quality assurance, incident reporting, equipment safety, and applicable preparedness activities.

You will put your general X-ray skills to work in a clinically connected role where image quality, patient safety, and collaboration matter every day.

Requirements

• Minimum of two (2) years of recent experience as a Radiology Technician.
• Current, unrestricted radiologic technology license or professional registration issued by a recognized regulatory authority in the candidate's country or jurisdiction of licensure, and recognized professional certification in radiologic technology; qualifications are subject to approval.
• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.
• Ability to relocate to Navy Support Facility Diego Garcia for the duration of the assignment and meet applicable site access and personnel approval requirements.
• Availability for established clinic hours, assigned on-call arrangements and emergency response requirements; ability to read, write, and speak English for effective communication.
• Ability to work seated or standing for prolonged periods, with bending, stooping, and lifting up to 15 lbs as required.

Preferred

• Associate degree in radiologic technology or a related field from an accredited program, or approved equivalent.
• Experience providing healthcare in international, island-based, or operational healthcare environments.
