jobs.title: Manager of Customer Success, SMB
jobs.description:
LEAD THE FUTURE OF DENTISTRY. 

Overjet is the world-leader in dental AI. Already, thousands of dental providers and insurers rely on our platform to deliver the best possible care. Now, we’re looking for talented people to fulfill our mission: improve oral health for all.

Overjet is where builders become leaders. Everyone here loves to make new things: new products, new partnerships, new content, and a new category of AI technology. And as Overjet grows ridiculously fast, so will you.

Simply put, there’s no better place to accelerate your career. Come join us!




THE ROLE

As a Manager of Customer Success, SMB at Overjet, you will play a crucial role in leading our fastest-growing segment through its next phase of hyper-growth. You’ll drive retention, adoption, and expansion across our SMB customer base (private dental practices), and you’ll hire, coach, and scale a team of SMB Customer Success Managers. Leveraging AI and automation, you’ll build the strategies and playbooks that get new practices live fast, keep them engaged, and turn them into long-term advocates, making sure every practice gets maximum value from Overjet’s AI platform.

We’re not looking for dental expertise. We’re looking for someone smart, hungry, and humble: a rock star who learns fast, loves to build, and gets fired up by turning data into action. If that’s you, this is your seat.

Responsibilities

 - Retention and churn reduction: Own SMB net revenue retention, gross churn, and contraction. Build the churn prevention system, including early risk detection, save motions in email and meetings, ROI objection handling, and a clear escalation pathway. Step into critical saves yourself.

 - Coaching and team leadership: Hire, onboard, and scale a team of SMB CSMs. Build coaching programs grounded in real call and email reviews. Set clear goals, hold the team accountable, and build a culture of curiosity and ownership.

 - Onboarding and time-to-live: Own how quickly new clinics and new locations go live. Streamline and automate onboarding, including self-serve and portal-driven motions, so the team can scale without adding headcount at the same rate.

 - Activation and adoption: Drive early product adoption across Vision, Voice, and RCM. Define activation milestones, identify where clinics stall, and design training, follow-up, and re-engagement programs that move usage. Reduce trial drop-off and opt-outs.

 - Analytics-driven management: Own health scoring, risk signals, and the weekly operating cadence. Use BigQuery, Gong, CRM, and product usage data to find at-risk clinics, root-cause churn and opt-outs, and decide where the team spends its time.

 - AI-first operations: Build automations that replace manual work, such as call and training-session reviews, AI-drafted follow-ups, and risk summaries. Make AI part of every CSM’s daily workflow, and measure the productivity gain.

 - Cross-functional partnership: Work with Sales, Onboarding, Support, Product, Marketing, and Finance. Serve as the voice of the customer, bringing quantified feedback on product gaps, pricing and ROI objections, and competitive pressure.

 - Forecasting and reporting: Deliver accurate retention forecasts and clear reporting on churn drivers, activation trends, and team performance to senior leadership.


QUALIFICATIONS 

 - 5+ years in customer success, account management, or SMB-focused SaaS, including 2+ years managing CSMs.

 - Experience running a high-volume SMB book where retention and adoption are won through process, data, and automation rather than high-touch coverage alone.

 - A track record of reducing churn and improving onboarding or activation metrics, including building save playbooks and coaching reps on objection handling.

 - Strong analytical skills. You can write or review SQL, build and interpret dashboards, and turn usage and health data into decisions.

 - Hands-on AI fluency. You already use LLMs and automation to build workflows, review calls, and scale coaching, and you can show examples.

 - Experience with CRM and CS tools (Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar) and call intelligence or BI tools (Gong, BigQuery, Sigma, or similar).

 - Excellent communication. You are credible with dental practice owners and with executives.

 - Strong ownership and urgency, and comfort with aggressive, metric-bound goals.

 - Dental, healthcare, or practice-management software experience strongly preferred (2+ years with dental practices or DSOs is a plus).



Why Overjet? 

 - Competitive Compensation and Equity

 - Hybrid workplace that provides flexibility, vibrant in-person workspaces, and the ability to build strong connections across all of Overjet - regardless of location

 - 401k plans with a matching program

 - Medical, Dental and Vision coverage: 99% employee premium covered, 75% dependent premium covered

 - Life and AD+D Insurance 

 - 8 weeks Paid Parental Leave 

 - Optional HSA with Employer contribution

 - Flexible Time Off and company paid holidays

 - Annual Learning and Development Stipend

Our Hybrid Workplace

We have a unique hybrid workplace at Overjet — which combines the teamwork of meeting in person, with the flexibility of working from anywhere.

Many of our positions are based in San Mateo, New York City, Boston, and Salt Lake City. The Jetters who live in these “geo-hubs” come to the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, while having the option to work from home the rest of the week.

Our People Team is happy to answer any questions about what hybrid work means for your specific role!

Overjet's Values

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Shift Lead) - Katy, TX
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

Veterinary nursing Shift Leads are the glue that holds each shift together—and the spark that keeps it moving. You own the rhythm and flow of each shift, making sure patients get top-tier care and every VEGgie has what they need to thrive. From team huddles and rounds to break coverage and on-the-floor coaching, you’re the steady presence keeping things smooth, safe, and supported. You don’t need to know every detail, but you do keep a big picture view—anticipating what’s next and jumping in wherever needed. You lead with heart, hustle, and a belief that when your team is empowered, great care follows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Keep a clear pulse on patient status, team bandwidth, and shift-wide needs

• Manage daily workflow and help the team pivot when the unexpected hits

• Ensure shift roles are assigned and adapted as needed, with clarity and care

• Jump in on the floor when help is needed—no task is too small

• Coordinate breaks, assist with conflict resolution, and model calm under pressure

• Lead shift transitions, team huddles, and start/end-of-day wrap-ups

• Communicate clearly, direct questions appropriately, and elevate key issues

• Help the team turn downtime into learning time—or just a moment to breathe

• Flag incidents or notable events with a mindset of transparency and growth

• Work with hospital leadership on coverage, call-outs, and ongoing coaching

WHAT YOU NEED

• Credentialed Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) or enrolled in the VEG Credentialing Support Program preferred

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician or assistant role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred.

• Strong grasp of clinical workflow and team dynamics

• Confidence in navigating floor operations while guiding others with empathy

• Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills

• Flexibility and a willingness to step in wherever needed

• Leadership instincts, an ownership mindset, and a desire to grow professionally

• Basic computer skills, comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

Open Fertility is committed to making exceptional fertility care accessible to more people than ever. From egg freezing to IVF, we simplify and streamline treatments so patients can pursue their reproductive goals with confidence. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who want to make a meaningful impact in people’s lives. As part of our rapidly growing team, you’ll help innovate fertility care and transform the patient experience. Our clinics are currently open in Roseville, CA and Astoria, NY, with Denver, CO coming soon.

Our Core Values:

• Open Possibilities: Helping patients achieve their reproductive goals.

• Open Access: Making high-quality fertility care available to those paying out of pocket.

• Open Arms: Welcoming every patient with compassion and understanding.

Role Summary

Our Medical Assistants engage with our patients day-in and out and they are vital to the patient experience. They are caring, compassionate, and work well together as a team. They work closely with our Physicians to provide exceptional patient care. Our Medical Assistants will also support front desk duties.

Some day-to-day duties include:

• Greeting patients

• Collecting patient payments

• Rooming patients

• Obtaining vitals

• Performing phlebotomy

• Scheduling appointments

• Maintaining a clean clinic

• Assisting physicians during clinic procedures (Saline sonograms, IUI and more!)

Education, Licenses, Certifications

• Bachelor's Degree preferred

• Certified Medical Assistant Certification preferred

• Current BLS Certification

• CPT1 certification required

Employment Type

This is a full-time non-exempt onsite position that requires early hours, rotational weekends and holidays.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $23-27/hr. Salary is based on several factors including job related knowledge and skill set, depth of experience, certifications and/or degrees.

#INDSFT

Benefits

Investing in You Today and Tomorrow

Supporting your well-being

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision plans

• Paid time off to recharge and enjoy personal time

• Access to BetterHelp therapy sessions for mental and emotional wellness

• Commuter benefits and discounted rates on home, auto, and pet insurance

Investing in your future

• 401(k) with up to a 4% company match

• Comprehensive fertility and parental leave benefits

• Career development opportunities in a fast-growing organization

• Employer-paid life and disability insurance

Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role:

The Sanctions Advisor will provide specialized, second-line-of-defense compliance services across the entire SoFi Enterprise, including SoFi Bank, N.A., SoFi Securities, LLC, and the technology platform.

As SoFi continues its expansion into digital assets and cutting-edge financial technology, you will play a critical role in ensuring our sanctions compliance program keeps pace.

Your role will be to support the business in identifying, mitigating, and managing risks related to global sanctions (OFAC, UN, EU, UK), while ensuring the enterprise meets evolving regulatory expectations.

What you’ll do:

• Support the execution and maintenance of SoFi’s sanctions oversight controls framework by producing clear sanctions risk analyses and maintaining an enterprise-wide inventory.
• Serve as a point of escalation for sanctions investigations, including cryptocurrency, providing regulatory guidance for complex scenarios, risk determinations, and actionable mitigating steps.
• Act as sanctions subject matter expert for the SoFi Enterprise, advising Compliance, product managers, engineers, and SoFi’s business units during the entire product lifecycle.
• Support the ongoing tuning, testing, and optimization of payment and name screening, ensuring models are calibrated to minimize risk.
• Draft clear and well-reasoned sanctions risk analyses, reporting, and governance documentation. Assist in preparing materials for regulatory examinations, internal audits, risk assessments, and third-party reviews.
• Collaborate closely with AML leadership to integrate and operationalize sanctions obligations into new product assessments and ensure continuous alignment between Sanctions Advisory and broader financial crime objectives.
• Build and support the development of sanctions policies, procedures, and controls, ensuring that they align with regulatory requirements and business objectives and are properly implemented throughout the product lifecycle.
• Monitor developments and changes in sanctions regulations, industry trends, and best practices, and translate them into actionable guidance.

What you’ll need:

• Bachelor’s Degree from a four-year college or university in a related field.
• 5+ years of sanctions experience in a complex financial institution, including crypto and global sanctions compliance.
• A comprehensive understanding of BaaS products, including payment processing, card issuance, credit and lending, and other traditional banking services.
• Ability to lead the development and continuous enhancement of core sanctions policies, risk appetites, and governance structures to reflect evolving legal, geopolitical, and regulatory landscapes.
• Provide direct advisory support to the Compliance and Risk Leadership team on high-risk transactions, strategic market expansions, mergers, and emerging international sanctions regimes.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization and across different business lines.
• Demonstrated strong leadership and management skills that build solid working relationships within the organization.
• Excellent working knowledge of Sanctions Compliance within various international jurisdictions
• Excellent organizational, verbal, written, and interpersonal skills are required.
• Must be able to multitask, adapt well to changing priorities, and effectively prioritize responsibilities to meet critical deadlines.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, demanding, and changing environment; must work well under pressure.
• Excellent analytical skills required.
• Ability to work collaboratively and independently while managing projects and assignments.

Nice to have:

• CAMS/CGSS certification

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.
Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Within our Teacher Education Ecosystem, including Moreland University, we connect with aspiring and current educators, alumni, and school leaders to support their professional journeys. Social media helps us build authentic relationships with these audiences and connect them with valuable resources and opportunities.
Come Build What’s Next
We’re looking for a Social Media Manager to lead and grow the organic social media presence of Colibri Group’s Teacher Education Ecosystem. This person will shape how our brands show up across social channels, bring educator-focused stories and campaigns to life, build engaged communities, and use performance insights to support awareness, qualified traffic, leads, and applications.
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with meaningful ownership of social strategy, day-to-day content production, community engagement, social measurement, and the management of our existing influencer program. As a general guide, approximately 50% of the role is content creation, 25% is social strategy, and 25% spans analytics, reporting, and influencer-program work. The balance will shift with campaigns and business priorities.
We’re looking for someone who has managed social media on behalf of a company, organization, or agency client and understands what it means to collaborate with a marketing team and be accountable for KPIs. You should be equally comfortable developing a channel plan, filming and editing a short-form video, speaking on camera, tailoring content for different audiences, engaging with followers, and explaining what the performance data says to do next.
Important distinction: This is a professional social media management position, not an influencer, brand ambassador, or personal-content-creator opportunity. You will manage Moreland University -owned social channels and work with external influencers as partners; you will not be hired to promote our brands primarily through your own personal accounts.
What You’ll Do
Own organic social strategy and editorial planning: Build audience-specific strategies and content calendars across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging channels. Prioritize Instagram and TikTok for educator audiences, tailor LinkedIn content for school leaders and alumni, and explore authentic, non-promotional participation in relevant Reddit communities. Translate wider Marketing initiatives into platform-native campaigns
Create content hands-on, with a strong emphasis on short-form video: Personally concept, script, film, edit, caption, and publish videos; appear confidently in talking-head content and social live events. Independently produce graphics, carousels, stories, and copy using tools such as Canva, collaborate with the Graphic Designer on brand consistency, and develop social assets to promote guides, events, and podcasts (without hosting the podcast)
Build and serve engaged communities: Manage organic social accounts day to day, including comments, DMs, tags, audience conversations, and admissions-related questions that need routing to the appropriate team. Proactively identify educator and school-leader stories and opportunities for meaningful engagement, not merely one-way posting
Measure performance and continually improve results: Monitor audience growth, reach, engagement, video performance, website traffic, leads, guide downloads, and applications attributable to organic social. Use reporting, experiments, and audience insights to refine creative decisions and channel priorities; demonstrate how social contributes to integrated marketing goals
Manage influencer partnerships and collaborate across Marketing: Oversee existing external creators, including briefs, content review, approvals, deliverables, renewals, payment coordination, budgets, and ROI. Recommend when to expand, adjust, or pause partnerships. Partner closely with content, design, and paid media colleagues; direct management of paid advertising is not part of this position. Occasionally support events and content opportunities requiring travel
What You’ll Bring
Professional organizational social media experience: Approximately 2–4 years managing organic social accounts for an employer, organization, or agency client, with personal ownership of deliverables and accountability for KPIs. Managing only your own personal influencer accounts does not meet this requirement; additional relevant professional experience is welcome
Proven creation and on-camera skills: Direct experience independently planning, filming, editing, and publishing compelling short-form video for a brand, plus the ability to appear on camera and support live social content. Strong social copywriting and hands-on Canva, Capcut, or comparable design skills are also expected
Demonstrated growth and analytical judgment: Evidence that you have grown audiences, not solely maintained existing accounts; ability to explain the KPIs you owned, results you achieved, and changes you made based on data. Familiarity with engagement, website traffic, lead or application attribution, and testing is valuable
Audience-focused collaboration and execution: Experience adapting tone, formats, and channels for distinct audiences; engaging communities through comments and DMs; and working within a marketing team to manage a busy editorial calendar, multiple priorities, and cross-functional projects
Required professional portfolio: Include an accessible portfolio link or relevant work samples showing organizational/client accounts, short-form videos you personally produced, and ideally measurable outcomes. Redacted or anonymized case studies are welcome for confidential work. Education/edtech experience, previous influencer-program coordination, Reddit knowledge, a related bachelor's degree, and familiarity with tools such as Sprout Social or ClickUp are helpful but not required. Occasional travel may be necessary
Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use
Experience with every tool below is not required. We care more about your ability to create strong work, manage the process, and make decisions from results than about checking specific software boxes.
Social channels: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and Reddit or other educator communities
Video creation: CapCut or comparable filming and editing workflows. The team is open to effective tools you already know and use
Design and production: Canva, Capcut, and brand templates or design review with an in-house Graphic Designer
Scheduling, analytics, and collaboration: Sprout Social or comparable social management and native analytics tools; ClickUp or similar project-management platforms
Measurement and improvement: Reporting dashboards, campaign tracking, tests, performance reviews, and thoughtful use of AI for ideation, research, repurposing, or productivity while maintaining originality and brand standards
Why You’ll Love Working Here
Own the organic social presence of a mission-driven education ecosystem and shape how our brands show up online
Create original, video-first content and tell relevant stories for teachers, future educators, alumni, and school leaders
Grow priority channels such as Instagram and TikTok while testing thoughtful community opportunities, including Reddit
Collaborate with content, design, and marketing colleagues while retaining autonomy over day-to-day creative execution
Connect creative work to measurable engagement, leads, and applications while helping evolve an established influencer-partnership program
We Encourage You to Apply
You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome applicants with relevant experience in education, edtech, consumer brands, nonprofit or mission-driven organizations, agencies, and other environments where they have managed professional social channels, served distinct audiences, and delivered measurable results.
However, this position does require professional responsibility for an organization’s or client’s social presence, hands-on short-form video creation, comfort contributing on camera, and the ability to assess performance against KPIs. If your experience has primarily been creating content for your own personal influencer accounts, without managing an organization’s or client’s channels and results, this role is unlikely to be the right match.
A professional social media portfolio or relevant work samples must be included with your application to be considered. Please share a working link to campaigns, social accounts, video examples, or case studies that demonstrate your direct work and impact. If your work is confidential, you may submit redacted or anonymized case studies and examples that respect client or employer requirements.
If you enjoy creating content yourself, collaborating within a marketing team, using data to make it better, and helping real communities connect with an education brand, we would love to hear from you.
What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process
We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next. We do not use AI to review applications; your application is reviewed by a human on the Talent Acquisition team. While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:
1.  Recruiter Conversation: An introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition about your professional social media background, interests, expectations, and fit for this position
2.  Hiring Manager Conversation: A deeper conversation with the Senior Director of Marketing, including review of your work, approach to short-form video, audience segmentation, strategy, and results
3.  Team / Cross-Functional Conversation: A conversation with team members, focused on collaboration and the capabilities relevant to day-to-day success in this role
4.  Final Conversation and Decision: A final conversation with the team. For finalists, there may be an optional opportunity to connect with additional content teammates. Talent Acquisition will share details and preparation expectations throughout the process.
Application deadline: Tuesday, October 20th, 2026.
Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.
Our Commitment to Inclusion
Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Decentralized Training and Inference Verification
jobs.description:
Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13332). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning https://pluralis.ai/blog/a-third-path-protocol-learning/.

Our training and inference network is trustless, and the workers are GPUs scattered across the world. Many things can go wrong in this system. An inference worker can return tokens from a cheaper model, or a highly quantized version of the one it's supposed to run. Even with the right model, it can sample with the wrong parameters. Training faces its own attacks, and Agora showed what a permissionless run deals with in practice: participants who disrupt training by dropping updates or flooding the system, free-riders who submit trivial work and collect the rewards, poisoned updates that plant backdoors, attempts to extract private data from gradients and activations, and contributors who inflate their reported work to claim rewards they didn't earn. Sentinel https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03592 is our first published answer on the training side. Your primary role is to come up with efficient algorithms and systems that verify the work: that tokens came from the claimed model and sampling parameters, and that training contributions are what they claim to be.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the threat model: You enumerate what a malicious or careless worker can do across pre-training, post-training, and inference — training disruption and denial-of-service, free-riding, model poisoning and backdoors, data extraction from gradients and activations, reputation and reward manipulation — and you keep that model current as the network grows.

 - Design and calibrate the tests: You build statistical verification methods with stated error rates, tune them with rigorous benchmarks, and keep false positives and false negatives controlled across heterogeneous hardware, including different GPUs and Macs.

 - Ship the verifier: You build and run the verification service in the inference path, and you live with its mistakes.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Verification systems, shipped or published: You've built a calibrated statistical decision system with stated error rates and lived with its mistakes. Publications in inference and training verification count; fraud detection, anti-cheat, and experimentation platforms count as much as papers do.

 - Statistical depth: Deep expertise in statistics and probability, with the ability to design experiments, calibrate decision thresholds, and defend the error rates you claim.

FYI'S

jobs.title: GEOINT Analyst, Scams
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Scam Disruption team is TRM's tip of the spear against pig butchering syndicates, romance fraud networks, and investment scam operations that steal billions from victims each year. As a GEOINT Analyst, you’ll be the team's location specialist: finding where scam compounds are, who is operating them, and how they move, then turning that picture into intelligence law enforcement partners can act on.

You will operate the "intelligence flywheel" daily, fusing geospatial, ad tech, on-chain, and off-chain data to build operational pictures that help dismantle scam operations.

 


THE IMPACT YOU WILL HAVE

 - Locate and map scam compounds using satellite and aerial imagery, geolocation, and open-source geospatial data, and track how they change over time, including construction, expansion, and relocation after raids

 - Place people and devices to a location using ad tech and commercial location data, IP geolocation, and other location-bearing telemetry, and build pattern-of-life pictures of operators and controllers

 - Fuse location intelligence with on-chain attribution, OSINT, and commercially available data to identify operators, controllers, and movement patterns

 - Find the seams: pivot from a single address, IP, photo, or victim lead to the compound and the people running it

 - Partner with the Threat Intelligence Analyst (Scams Expert), the CTI Analyst, and the All-Source Lead to translate disruption strategy into targeting packages that influence law enforcement and government action
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3 to 5 years of hands-on GEOINT, imagery analysis, or location-based targeting experience: military or Intelligence Community geospatial roles (e.g., NGA, Army 35G), law enforcement targeting, or a mission-aligned private sector equivalent such as a GEOINT or OSINT services firm

 - Geolocation and imagery tradecraft: you can take a photo, video, IP, or set of coordinates, place it with confidence, and explain how you got there

 - Ad tech and commercial location data (strongly preferred): experience with mobile ad IDs, bidstream, or other commercial location data. Ideally you bring both GEOINT and ad tech

 - Works beyond the government toolkit: you can get answers from open-source and commercial tools when classified systems and data aren't available

 - Creative tactical thinking — demonstrated ability to pivot from a single point to a network view, identifying operators behind operations

 - Link and pattern analysis fluency — ability to correlate disparate data sources to generate defensible target packages

 - Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain your methods, your confidence, and your own role in plain terms, and write memos, attribution write-ups, and leads that are actionable

 - AI fluency (required) — you use AI tools in your workflow, synthesizing data, drafting outputs, and accelerating analysis, with examples of how AI has impacted your work

 - Crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement — we teach on-chain tradecraft; we cannot teach the targeter's instinct

 - Familiarity with Southeast Asia scam compounds or Chinese-run criminal networks is a plus

 - Location: remote in the UK, EMEA, or US (including Washington, DC). You must already have the right to work where you're based.


ABOUT THE TEAM

 - The Scam Disruption team operates within TRM’s Blockchain Intelligence organization, alongside threat intelligence analysts, on-chain investigators, and federal partners

 - All-Source Investigators are the operational core, converting strategy and tooling into prosecutable, actionable intelligence

 - Distributed team with an async-first approach via Slack and Notion, plus structured syncs for alignment

 - High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy — work directly with analysts, engineers, and customers who depend on your output

 


TEAM OPERATING RHYTHMS

 - Weekly team syncs to align targeting priorities and review disruption opportunities

 - Daily async standups via Slack on active work, returns, and target packages in flight

 - Primary time zone overlap: US Eastern / Central

 - All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

 - Surge availability expected during time-sensitive disruption windows


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 





PRIVACY POLICY AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.trmlabs.com/policies/privacy-policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc6e8jRCl2cQwgIzXLpIGQXtwvMQh__TcokvO2toAAkT44A6Q/viewform?usp=dialog. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSevmAzPxWOYm_7kMHb9lEJlX3tpdBeHvvvNWjsI_6xhUfnXjw/viewform?usp=dialog.




RECRUITMENT AGENCIES

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Overall Purpose and Objective of Position

The Lead Logistics Specialist serves as the subject matter expert for bulk food-grade transportation operations at a large integrated oilseeds processing facility. This role provides leadership in transportation planning, carrier strategy, freight risk management, and supply chain optimization. The position is responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives, influencing logistics strategy, mentoring team members, and ensuring operational excellence across inbound and outbound transportation activities. The Lead Logistics Specialist partners closely with commercial, operations, quality, and logistics teams to identify opportunities that improve service, reduce costs, mitigate risk, and support business growth, with a strong commitment to safety, sustainability, and customer service.

Primary Responsibilities / Essential Functions

• Lead freight procurement, transportation strategy, and logistics execution to ensure cost-effective, efficient, and reliable movement of products.
• Manage transportation planning, scheduling, inventory positioning, and shipment execution to support customer requirements and on-time delivery performance.
• Serve as the primary logistics subject matter expert for carriers, customers, and internal stakeholders, providing guidance on freight markets, transportation requirements, and supply chain risks.
• Lead carrier and customer relationship management, issue resolution, and escalation activities to maintain service excellence and operational continuity.
• Analyze transportation, inventory, and market data to identify risks, improve performance, and support business decision-making.
• Coordinate cross-functional activities with Sales, Operations, Quality, Customer Service, and Logistics teams to optimize inventory, order fulfillment, and customer satisfaction.
• Oversee order call-offs, shipping documentation, contract balances, carrier records, compliance requirements, and logistics data within applicable systems.
• Lead continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, audits, projects, and performance measurement activities that drive operational and financial results.
• Provide leadership, mentoring, cross-training, and technical support to Logistics Coordinators, Associates, and Specialists.
• Support strategic logistics planning, capacity management, and other responsibilities as assigned by the Head of Logistics.
• Identify and implement transportation network optimization opportunities to improve service, capacity utilization, and total delivered cost.

Education/Professional Certifications/Licenses

Basic qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• 4+ years of progressively responsible experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain management, import/export logistics, or customs clearance of food-grade products.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with freight rates from various origins.
• Experience with food-grade products, CARM, AES filing, and USMCA guidelines.
• Experience leading projects, process improvement initiatives, or cross-functional teams.
• Demonstrated expertise in freight procurement, carrier management, transportation analytics, and transportation risk management.
• Experience mentoring team members and serving as a recognized logistics subject matter expert.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities (including any physical demands)

Basic qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of handling food grade bulk liquid shipments.
• In depth understanding of incoterms and transit times.
• Ability to communicate and minimize risks associated with bulk shipments.
• Knowledge of transporting food products.
• Knowledge of grain industry practices, terminology and settlement process.
• Strong practical accounting, analytical and organizational skills.
• Proficient in Excel and Office products.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to work independently.
• Ability to set deadlines and adhere to them.

jobs.title: Scientist, Process Development
jobs.description:
The Cell Therapy Process Development Scientist will play a critical role in the development and optimization of robust and reproducible processes for the manufacturing of Prokidney’s cell therapy product, Rilparencel, which is in phase three clinical trial. The process development scientist will design and execute studies and shape implementation of cutting-edge technologies for commercial production. You will work in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, engaging with various internal teams, external partners, and key stakeholders to ensure the seamless transition of processes from the laboratory to clinical and, eventually, commercial production.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact on the development of life-saving therapies while applying your scientific expertise to solve complex challenges in cell therapy.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and execute studies to develop and optimize cell therapy manufacturing processes, including cell expansion, selection, purification, formulation, and cryopreservation. Analyze and interpret experiment results. Write and review study reports.

• Design and implement process improvements that reduce cost, improve efficiency, and enhance product quality, while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Work closely with Manufacturing teams to ensure smooth technology transfer and the successful execution of GMP manufacturing runs, ensuring process robustness and troubleshooting any issues that arise.

• Perform process risk assessment using tools including FMEA. Design and execute experimental plans to characterize and assess process parameters of cell therapy products.

• Participate in project teams and contribute technical expertise to support the transition from pre-clinical to clinical and commercial manufacturing.

• Stay current with the latest trends, technologies, and regulatory developments in the cell therapy field.

• Contribute to scientific publications, presentations, and internal knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

• Degree in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Cell Biology, Bioengineering, or a related discipline.

• PhD with 2+ years experience, MS with 8+ years experience, or BS with 12+ years experience in bioprocess or cell therapy process development.

• Extensive hands-on experience with cell expansion, cell selection and cell purification. Proven track record of contributing to successful technology transfer of manufacturing processes.

• Experience in QbD and process characterization including the use of DoE (Design of Experiments) and statistical analysis.

• Knowledge of analytical methods such as flow cytometry, PCR, ELISA, cell counting, and other assays for cell therapy characterization.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex process-related challenges.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, multidisciplinary team.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in preparing regulatory filings.

• Familiarity with data analysis software (e.g., JMP).

• Experience in GMP regulations.

ProKidney is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant because of race, creed, color, age, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, military status, application for military service or any other class protected by state or federal law.

jobs.title: Print On Demand Technician
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW:

At Alo, our focus is on our associate culture, customer promise, quality, and safety. The Printer Technician supports print-on-demand (POD) production and fulfillment operations by troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining production printers, related equipment, and automated material handling systems. Working independently or with minimal guidance, this role helps maintain equipment reliability, print quality, and daily volume output while minimizing disruptions to production.

The Printer Technician serves as an onsite technical resource, coordinates maintenance with Operations and Facilities, and applies an understanding of equipment performance, product flow, and production priorities to resolve issues safely and efficiently.

REQUIREMENTS:

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, and controls issues affecting production printers, related machinery, and automated material handling equipment using technical drawings, equipment manuals, and diagnostic tools.

• Respond promptly to equipment issues that affect daily workflow or volume output; communicate downtime, repair status, and expected return to service to Operations and Facilities.

• Perform equipment audits, preventive maintenance, cleaning, adjustments, component replacement, and repairs according to manufacturer guidance and established safety and quality procedures.

• Troubleshoot print production issues, including equipment faults and print quality concerns; coordinate with production staff and vendors when specialized software or technical support is needed.

• Support equipment installation, testing, modifications, and upgrades; verify safe operation and production readiness following maintenance or repairs.

• Maintain and repair three-phase electrical systems up to 480 VAC, and troubleshoot programmable logic controllers (PLCs), low-voltage controls, and external input/output (I/O) devices within authorized scope.

• Troubleshoot and maintain conveyor, sortation, and other fulfillment equipment; assist technicians and mechanics with complex repairs as needed.

• Complete work orders and maintenance records, documenting diagnostics, repairs, parts used, and recurring issues in written or computer-based systems.

• Coordinate planned maintenance around production needs, identify recurring equipment failures, and recommend improvements that reduce downtime and support department goals.

• Maintain company-supplied tools and an organized maintenance area; participate in cleaning equipment and conveyor systems as appropriate.

• Provide general facility maintenance support, including lighting, plumbing, electrical repairs, and furniture relocation, and perform other related duties assigned by management.

• Follow established safe work practices, including lockout/tagout, use of protective equipment, and procedures for elevated work and access to tight or confined spaces.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Five to ten years of related experience in mechanical and technical troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and/or equipment installation.

• Associate of Applied Science degree in an engineering-related field, or equivalent relevant experience, including military service. High school diploma or GED preferred.

• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills, including experience with three-phase systems up to 480 VAC, low-voltage controls, and PLCs.

• Experience or working knowledge of conveyor and/or sortation systems, preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment installation, and modification or upgrade support.

• Ability to read technical drawings and equipment manuals, use diagnostic tools, and work independently or with minimal guidance to resolve equipment problems.

• Ability to read, write, understand, and follow verbal and written instructions in English; basic math skills to maintain accurate inventory and maintenance records.

• Understanding of safe maintenance practices, including lockout/tagout, and willingness and ability to obtain required certification to operate powered industrial equipment.

• Ability to prioritize production-critical repairs, communicate effectively with Operations and Facilities, and adjust work hours when maintenance or repair needs require it.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience with printing equipment, industrial machinery, and/or robotics that supports mechanical diagnostics and troubleshooting.

• Print production experience, including raster image processor (RIP) software, printer maintenance and repair, and color management.

• Related technical certifications or licenses, such as Journeyman or Master Electrician, Certified Maintenance and Reliability Professional (CMRP), or Certified Maintenance and Reliability Technician (CMRT).

• Experience using a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), Allen-Bradley and/or Siemens products, and network troubleshooting.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook; experience coordinating with outside vendors, customers, and business partners.

• Previous experience in fulfillment, manufacturing, or a similar production environment, and familiarity with facility software, platforms, and systems.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to perform diagnostics and repairs in tight or confined spaces as needed, following established access and safety procedures.

• Frequent standing, walking, bending, stooping, kneeling, reaching, and grasping; ability to climb stairs and work at heights of 40 feet or more using appropriate safety equipment.

• Ability to lift up to 75 pounds and push or pull carts weighing up to 200 pounds, using appropriate equipment and safe handling methods.

• Ability to read fine print and technical information, receive and understand verbal instructions, and use tools requiring hand-eye coordination.

• Work in a warehouse and production environment, including occasional exposure to extreme temperatures; safely use manual and powered equipment to move materials.

Shift: 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.; schedule adjustments may be required for repairs, maintenance, and operational needs, including weekends or holidays as necessary.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Chemistry AI Science Factory
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila's AI Science Factories (AISFs) are the automated experimental systems that let AI learn science by running it. The Chemistry AISF spans a broad array of domains including molecular chemistry and small-molecule synthesis, targeted drug delivery and LNP formulation, colloidal nanochemistry and quantum materials, and the flow-chemistry and analytical backbone that connects them.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own the product layer for the Chemistry AISF; deciding which capabilities we build, in what order, to what specification, and how we know they are working. You will partner with the Chemistry AISF Program Lead, who owns scientific direction, and with AISF Engineering, which owns the build. Your lane is the what and the why: turning commercial pull, scientific ambition, and AI model needs into a prioritized capability roadmap, and then into requirements crisp enough that engineering teams can scope, staff, and execute against them.

What You'll Be Building

• Set the product vision, roadmap, and capability priorities for the Chemistry AISF, spanning molecular chemistry and small-molecule synthesis, targeted drug delivery and formulation, colloidal nanochemistry, and the shared analytical backbone.

• Translate commercial pull, scientific ambition, and AI model needs into a single prioritized roadmap, making the tradeoffs between competing demands explicit and defensible.

• Define what a capability must do to count as delivered, including scope, throughput, performance, and level of autonomy, in requirements that engineering teams can scope, staff, and build against.

• Co-own the Chemistry AISF program charter with the Program Lead, including the capital plan, resourcing, and phasing that turn a roadmap into a funded sequence of work.

• Drive product execution from concept through commissioning across science, engineering, automation, software, and AI.

• Own the build-versus-buy and platform architecture decisions that determine how the Chemistry AISF scales.

• Represent the Chemistry AISF to executives, scientific leaders, partners, and customers as the product voice for the domain, and report progress against technical, product, and commercial milestones.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• MS, PhD, or equivalent experience in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials chemistry, or a closely related field.

• 5+ years in product management, technical product ownership, or a product-adjacent platform role delivering complex hardware and software systems: lab automation, scientific instrumentation, robotics, or ML-enabled experimental platforms.

• Working fluency in at least one Chemistry AISF domain and the ability to get credible quickly in the others. You should be able to hold a real conversation about reaction workup and purification, analytical characterization, or nanoparticle formulation, and know which questions you cannot answer yourself.

• A track record of writing requirements engineers can actually build from, not feature wish lists.

• Comfort making prioritization calls on incomplete information, in front of people who disagree, and writing down the reasoning so it survives the next reorganization.

• Experience leading through influence in a matrixed organization spanning science, engineering, software, and commercial teams.

• Strong written communication. A large share of this job is producing artifacts, including charters, roadmaps, and requirements documents, that other people act on without you in the room.

Bonus Points For

• Hands-on experience with automated synthesis platforms (ChemSpeed or similar), liquid handling under inert atmosphere, or high-throughput formulation systems.

• Familiarity with closed-loop and self-driving lab architectures: Bayesian optimization, active learning, agentic experiment design.

• Experience with lab orchestration and scheduling software, instrument integration, or scientific data capture architecture.

• Background in small-molecule discovery workflows or in LNP and nucleic acid delivery.

• Experience supporting partner-funded or customer-funded platform programs, including scoping deliverables and structuring milestones.

• Capital equipment planning experience: specification, vendor evaluation, commissioning and qualification timelines.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$140,000—$197,333 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Geo-Distributed Inference
jobs.description:
Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13332). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning https://pluralis.ai/blog/a-third-path-protocol-learning/.

Our inference pipeline generates the rollouts for reinforcement learning (RL) training today, and it'll serve our models once they're trained. It also runs in a permissionless, trustless setting, which makes the usual serving problem much harder. The hardware is Macs and consumer GPUs owned by strangers, the network is the public internet, nodes join and leave mid-run, and the weights change under the server as training moves. Your primary role is to build the systems that keep this pipeline fast and reliable under these conditions.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the inference stack: You build and own it end-to-end. Pipeline-parallel execution, placement and routing, the transport, the serving engine, and failure handling. You set the direction, and you make things happen.

 - Invent the algorithms: Making inference fast on consumer hardware over the public internet takes methods that don't exist yet. You design them, validate them, and put them in production.

 - Serve training and users: You keep the rollout pipeline fast and reliable for RL training now, and turn it into the serving layer for our models once they're trained.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Shipped serving systems: You've shipped serving-engine internals or built a large-scale inference system yourself, and you can do this work hands-on today.

 - Research ability: Publications (papers and blogposts) in distributed inference or a nearby field, such as LLM serving systems, pipeline parallelism over slow networks, or decentralized training, are a strong signal. So is unpublished work you can walk us through.

 - Low-bandwidth networking: Experience with systems that run in low-bandwidth, high-latency settings like the public internet is a strong signal.

 - Mission alignment: You believe Protocol Learning is the viable third path for collective, trustless, and sovereign AI.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with RL post-training.

 - Exposure to Apple silicon or MLX.

 - Experience with P2P networking and NAT traversal.

 - Experience at proprietary, open-weight and open-source AI labs


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Equity-Heavy Package: We offer significant ownership for key technical contributors in addition to a high base salary.

 - Remote-First Culture: Flexible work environment with team members distributed globally.

 - Visa Sponsorship: Optional full visa sponsorship and relocation support to either Australia or the US.

 - Open Problems: Training and serving frontier models on hardware you don't control, over networks you don't own, mostly has no published answers yet. You'll write some of the first ones.


FYI'S

 - We work remotely across the world, with the main teams in Australia and North America. You'll need to be comfortable working across timezones.

 - Applicants must have professional-level English proficiency (written and spoken).

 - Recruiters: we aren't looking for agency support at this time. We'll reach out if we need help.

We are backed by Union Square Ventures https://www.usv.com/ and other tier-1 investors, and we are a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers. Pluralis is unapologetically ideological. We believe AI, and the world, end up on a better path if we succeed in implementing the protocol for intelligence. If this resonates, please apply.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise
 
The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.
For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.
This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

jobs.title: GEAR-UP Tutor
jobs.description:
Wonderful College Prep Academy is accepting applications for part-time tutor positions in the GEAR UP program at Sanger High School. GEAR UP Tutors will follow the student cohorts through their high school years. Assignments will be approximately 24 hours per week during lunch periods, and/or during class times (mornings and/or afternoons). Workdays will align with the Sanger Unified School District and Wonderful College Prep Academy calendars. This position will report to the GEAR UP Coordinator in Sanger, CA. This is an in-person position. Subject Focus: Math

The GEAR UP Tutor’s responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

• Provide 1:1 or small-group tutoring services to students in classrooms.
• Collaborate with and provide support for GEAR UP staff.
• Work directly with students to provide academic support services (e.g., tutoring; help completing forms; workshop support).
• Assist in the planning, organizing, and implementing GEAR UP grant activities.
• Follow school and GEAR UP protocols and procedures.
• Perform related duties as assigned.

Work Schedule:

• Monday: 8:00 am-4:30 pm (8 hours)
• Wednesday: 8:00 am-4:30 pm (8 hours)
• Friday: 8:00 am-4:30 pm (8 hours)

ABOUT THE GEAR UP GRANT: GEAR UP is a federally funded Title III Grant. Wonderful College Prep Academy, in partnership with Avenal and Sanger Unified School Districts, will work with 6th and 7th-grade students from four middle schools to prepare them for college. The Federal Department of Education website for GEAR UP is http://www2.ed.gov/programs/gearup/index.html.

This discretionary grant program is designed to increase the number of low-income students who are prepared to enter and succeed in postsecondary education. GEAR UP provides seven-year grants to states and partnerships to provide services at high-poverty middle and high schools. GEAR UP grantees serve an entire cohort of students beginning no later than the seventh grade and follow the cohort through high school and their first year of college.

• College graduate or be enrolled in college and have completed freshman English, college math (Algebra II).
• At least one year of tutoring experience.
• An eager, flexible learner and problem solver who feels comfortable taking initiative.
• A self-starter with exceptional work ethic and the ability to work well away from colleagues and management.
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
• An ability to quickly establish rapport and communicate well with scholars.
• Bilingual in Spanish is a plus.

Pay: $18.00/hour

• Wonderful College Prep Academy offers highly competitive compensation, commensurate with experience.
• Full-time staff benefits include medical coverage, dental, vision, and life insurance at no cost to the employee.
• WCPA offers an optional 403b with company match (5%)
• Employees have free access to the Wonderful Wellness Center and gym.

Quality of Life in the Central Valley:

Framed by the Sierra Nevada to the east and the Coast Ranges to the west, California's Central Valley is one of the world's most productive agricultural regions and the base of The Wonderful Company's agricultural operations. This vast area enjoys a moderate climate and offers residents a high quality of life, low cost of living, and a host of diverse cultural and recreational activities. From wine tasting and hiking to rafting, fishing, skiing, and surfing -- all within a two-hour drive -- the family-friendly Central Valley has much to offer.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - South East
jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

We're looking for a field-based sales professional to join Teya's rapidly growing sales organisation. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who wants to build a career in sales, develop real commercial skills, and grow within a high-performing, fast-scaling business.

You don't need a sales track record to succeed in this role. What you need is hunger, coachability, and something to prove. We invest heavily in structured onboarding and hands-on coaching because we're not hiring you for who you've been — we're hiring you for who you're going to become.



Your responsibilities will include:

 - Proactively identify and engage prospective customers within your defined territory through outreach, networking, referrals and face to face meetings

 - Meet business owners to understand their needs, challenges and goals, and recommend relevant Teya products and solutions.

 - Learn and apply Teya's value-led sales methodology to win new business and achieve performance targets

 - Develop positive, long-term customer relationships that support market penetration, growth and retention.

 - Develop strong knowledge across Teya's products and solutions through our structured training programme

 - Share insights from the field to help improve our products and customer experience

 - Represent Teya as a credible, professional and values-led ambassador within your territory

 - Build positive, long-term customer relationships that support growth and retention



Your Story

This role is about more than just sales — it's a launchpad. It's an opportunity to build genuine commercial confidence, develop transferable sales skills, and create meaningful relationships with business owners from day one.

We're not looking for a finished product. We're looking for potential, drive, and the right mindset — the rest we'll teach you.



We're looking for people who bring:

 - A competitive mindset and a genuine desire to win

 - Strong work ethic and high activity orientation — you show up and put the reps in

 - Coachability — you take feedback, apply it, and improve fast

 - Curiosity and learning agility

 - Ambition and resilience — you treat setbacks as information, not defeat

 - Emotional intelligence and the ability to read a room or a customer

 - Self-direction and a proactive, self-driven mindset

 - Confidence engaging with new people and building rapport quickly

 - Effective time management and organisational skills

 - A collaborative, team-oriented approach

 - A strong willingness to learn and continuously develop

 - Fluency in English

 - A full UK driving licence

This is a fully field-based sales role. You must be located in the South East.



The Perks

 - Competitive basic salary plus commission, with typical on-target earnings of £60,000 - £80,000 in your first year - depending on your skills and experience

 - 25 days of Annual Leave + Bank Holidays

 - Extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices

 - Private Medical and Life Insurance

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
