jobs.title: Senior Physical Security Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Crusoe is building the infrastructure that powers the AI revolution. As our global footprint expands across data centers, power generation, manufacturing, construction sites, and corporate offices, understanding the people, places, organizations, and events that could impact our operations is increasingly critical.

We are seeking a Senior Physical Security Intelligence Analyst to join our Global Physical Security team. This role will provide intelligence and investigative support across Crusoe's global operations, combining open-source intelligence (OSINT), investigative research, threat assessment, and data analysis to identify and assess risks before they impact our people or operations.

This is the first dedicated intelligence hire in Crusoe's Physical Security organization. You will not inherit a mature intelligence program; you will stand one up alongside the GSOC Manager and in close partnership with Protective Operations. You will shape the collection framework, source library, platform configuration, and product cadence from the ground up during a period of rapid company growth and new site activation.

The ideal candidate brings experience from the intelligence community, military intelligence, federal law enforcement, corporate intelligence, or a similarly rigorous analytical environment and can translate complex information into concise, actionable security intelligence.



What You'll Be Working On:

Intelligence Production and Threat Monitoring

 - Monitor and assess threats involving people, places, organizations, events, and emerging issues relevant to Crusoe personnel and operations.

 - Produce concise intelligence products including threat assessments, investigative reports, intelligence briefs, profiles, timelines, link analysis, and executive-level summaries.

 - Monitor geopolitical, criminal, activist, extremist, infrastructure, and community-level developments that could affect Crusoe facilities or personnel.

 - Identify connections, patterns, relationships, and behavioral indicators across disparate information sources.

 - Maintain investigative and intelligence records within approved case-management systems and establish clear sourcing and confidence levels.

OSINT and Investigative Research

 - Conduct in-depth OSINT research across publicly available information, social media, databases, corporate records, and other authorized sources.

 - Develop comprehensive profiles and assessments of persons, organizations, locations, and issues of security interest using lawful and authorized sources.

 - Support investigations involving threats, suspicious activity, workplace violence concerns, insider risk indicators, fraud, theft, vandalism, trespassing, and other security incidents.

 - Distinguish verified information from assumptions and clearly communicate analytical confidence and information gaps.

Threat and Behavioral Assessment

 - Conduct threat assessments related to individuals or groups demonstrating concerning interest in Crusoe, its employees, executives, facilities, or operations.

 - Apply structured behavioral threat assessment methodologies to workplace violence, targeted violence, and insider risk indicators.

 - Partner with HR, Employee Relations, Legal, and Protective Operations on threat cases requiring coordinated response.

Protective Intelligence and Executive Travel Support

 - Provide intelligence support for executive protection, including protective intelligence, travel assessments, event intelligence, and advance planning.

 - Produce destination threat assessments, travel advisories, and principal-specific intelligence packages.

 - Partner with Protective Operations to translate intelligence into protective actions, movement planning, and principal protection decisions.

Site and Build Intelligence

 - Conduct location and site intelligence assessments supporting new facilities, acquisitions, construction projects, executive travel, and expansion into new markets.

 - Produce pre-construction and pre-activation intelligence packages for new builds, informing site security design, local law enforcement engagement, and risk mitigation.

 - Track threats to critical infrastructure, including risks affecting data centers, electrical infrastructure, energy generation, utilities, telecommunications, and supporting supply chains.

Incident and Crisis Support

 - Support major incident and crisis response by rapidly collecting, validating, analyzing, and communicating relevant intelligence.

 - Provide intelligence support during significant incidents, developing assessments for Physical Security leadership and business stakeholders under time pressure.

 - Partner with the GSOC to feed real-time intelligence into operational decision-making during active incidents.

Partnership and Program Building

 - Partner closely with the GSOC, Protective Operations, Security Operations, GRC, Legal, People, Employee Relations, IT/Security, and Workplace Teams.

 - Own the deployment of Ontic as Crusoe's intelligence and case management platform from a tradecraft perspective, designing collection workflows, building entity and watchlist structures, operationalizing OSINT and signals ingestion, and defining how intelligence products flow to the GSOC, Protective Operations, investigations, and leadership.

 - Build and maintain relationships with government, law enforcement, intelligence, and private-sector security partners, including organizations such as the FBI, DHS, CISA, OSAC, DSAC, InfraGard, and relevant state and local agencies.

 - Develop intelligence requirements and collection plans based on emerging risks and business priorities.

 - Help establish scalable standards, procedures, and governance for Crusoe's physical security intelligence and investigative capabilities.

 - Identify opportunities to use automation, artificial intelligence, and data analytics to improve threat detection, intelligence collection, triage, correlation, and reporting.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - 5+ years of experience in intelligence analysis, investigations, protective intelligence, threat assessment, military intelligence, law enforcement intelligence, or a related field.

 - Experience within the U.S. Intelligence Community, Department of Defense, federal law enforcement, or a sophisticated corporate intelligence/security organization strongly preferred.

 - Demonstrated ability to conduct complex research and synthesize large volumes of fragmented information.

 - Strong OSINT and investigative research capabilities, including source validation and assessment of information reliability.

 - Experience analyzing individuals, organizations, networks, locations, events, and patterns of activity.

 - Familiarity with threat assessment, protective intelligence, workplace violence prevention, insider risk, or behavioral threat assessment.

 - Ability to distinguish verified information from assumptions and clearly communicate analytical confidence and information gaps.

 - Excellent analytical writing skills with the ability to turn complex research into concise, actionable intelligence for security leaders and executives.

 - Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive investigations and personal information.

 - Understanding of privacy, civil liberties, data protection, and appropriate intelligence collection practices in a corporate environment.

 - Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, rapidly evolving situations.



Bonus Points

 - Previous experience with NSA, FBI, DHS, DoD, military intelligence, another Intelligence Community organization, or an equivalent investigative/intelligence environment.

 - Hands-on experience with Ontic; platform deployment, workflow design, entity management, watchlist configuration, or administrator-level fluency.

 - Experience supporting executive protection or protective intelligence programs.

 - Experience conducting link analysis, social-network analysis, geospatial analysis, or pattern-of-life research.

 - Experience with commercial intelligence and alerting platforms such as Dataminr, LifeRaft, AlertMedia, Silobreaker, Flashpoint, Everbridge, Crisis24, or similar tools.

 - Familiarity with physical security systems and data, including access control, video surveillance, visitor management, alarm monitoring, and incident-management platforms.

 - Experience supporting global operations, critical infrastructure, technology companies, data centers, energy, or other high-growth environments.

 - Familiarity with intelligence requirements, collection management, structured analytic techniques, and intelligence lifecycle methodologies.

 - Experience working with government and private-sector information-sharing organizations such as OSAC, DSAC, InfraGard, or regional fusion centers

 - Relevant certifications or formal intelligence-analysis, investigative, or threat-assessment training (ATAP, ASIS CPP/PSP, intelligence community training programs, or peer credentials).

 - Bachelor's degree in Intelligence Studies, Criminal Justice, International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, or a related discipline; equivalent professional or government experience will also be considered.



SOME ADDITIONAL INFORMATION PERTINENT TO THE ROLE:

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You will help Crusoe move from reacting to security incidents to understanding potential threats early enough to act. You will become a trusted analytical resource for Global Physical Security, connecting information across people, locations, incidents, travel, facilities, and external events, and turning those connections into actionable intelligence.

This role will work closely with the GSOC but will focus on deeper analysis and investigations rather than routine alarm monitoring or dispatch. You should be equally comfortable spending several days developing a complex investigative picture and rapidly producing an intelligence assessment during an unfolding incident.

Within the first year, success means:

 - A standing intelligence product cadence that Crusoe leadership, the GSOC, and Protective Operations rely on.

 - A collection framework, source library, and tradecraft discipline established from scratch.

 - Ontic deployed and operationalized as the backbone of Crusoe's intelligence and case management workflows.

 - Clear intelligence-to-operations handoffs defined with the GSOC and intelligence-to-protection handoffs defined with Protective Operations.

 - Credible external relationships established with government, law enforcement, and private-sector intelligence partners.

 - A foundation for the intelligence function to grow with Crusoe as the company scales.


OPERATING CONDITIONS:

 - Dallas, TX on-site, with occasional travel to Crusoe sites across North America for pre-activation intelligence work, site threat assessments, and partnership development.

 - Primarily business hours Monday–Friday with on-call rotation for critical incidents, executive travel windows, and high-impact geopolitical or weather events.

 - Occasional nights, weekends, and holidays as the operational tempo demands.

 - Handling of sensitive, confidential, and executive-protection information with appropriate discretion is a core expectation of the role.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $150,000 - $180,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.




ROLE PURPOSE

Nurse Practitioner to deliver Neko's preventive-care model to members in New York — using advanced, non-invasive technology and clinical expertise to identify health risks early and translate findings into action plans that genuinely change what a member does next. This is a deeply collaborative role at the intersection of clinical excellence, member experience, and a conviction that catching things early changes lives. You'll practice with autonomous scope where appropriate, partner closely with Physicians for escalation and collaborative review, and work alongside Operators and cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless, insight-driven member experience.


WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER IN THE FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

Comprehensive preventive health screenings delivered using Neko's high-resolution skin imaging, cardiovascular assessments, and AI-powered decision support — with consistent quality across every member visit.

Personalized, action-oriented health plans created from screening data, translated into next steps the member actually takes — measured by member follow-through and downstream outcomes.

Member education on dermatological and cardiovascular risk factors and lifestyle strategies that lands — measured by how the member felt about the consultation, not just the clinical findings.

Clear, timely escalation to Physicians on findings that warrant physician-level review — strengthening continuity of care and clinical quality across the clinic.

Cross-functional collaboration with Operators, Physicians, and care teams that improves continuity of care and the end-to-end member experience.


WHAT WE'RE HIRING FOR

 - Genuine belief in the mission — a personal commitment to preventive medicine, not just as a specialism, but as a way of practicing. You think it's wrong that this isn't how everyone practices medicine.

 - Member-first instinct — you take the member experience personally, not just procedurally, and measure a consultation's success by how the member felt, not only by the findings.

 - Team-lifting collaboration — you make the people around you better by showing up consistently, sharing what you know, and caring how the team performs as a whole.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - Active New York State Nurse Practitioner license.

 - National board certification (ANCC or AANP) in good standing.

 - At least 1 year of post-residency experience.

 - Must Meet New York's independent practice requirement

 - Recent outpatient experience (at least a year in the past 5 years).

 - Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross,

 - Comfort working in a tech-forward, fast-moving clinical environment.


BENEFITS

 - Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and mental health coverage.

 - Complimentary full Neko scan for you and eligible family members.

 - CME benefits

 - Flexible time off.

jobs.title: Site Director, DC
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW:

At Alo our focus is on our employee customer promise, quality and safety. The Site Director, DC is responsible for leading and managing all aspects of the Warehouse’s operations to ensure on time delivery of all shipments, efficiency, productivity, and compliance with company policies and industry standards. This role is critical for driving performance and throughput capacity, overseeing inventory management, coordinating inbound and outbound logistics, and ensuring that goods are processed and shipped on time to meet customer demands. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills and an in-depth understanding of supply chain, logistics, and warehouse management.

The Site Director, DC is responsible for end-to-end leadership of a high-volume, fast-paced distribution center. This role ensures exceptional customer service through accurate, same-day/next-day order fulfillment while optimizing cost, speed, scalability, and safety. The Site Director drives operational excellence across people, processes, technology, and automation in an always-on fulfillment environment.

RESPONSBILITIES:

• E-Commerce Fulfillment Operations

• Lead all fulfillment center operations including inbound receiving, put-away, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and reverse logistics.

• Deliver high service levels for same-day, next-day, and peak-season order fulfillment (e.g., holidays, promotions).

• Ensure high order accuracy, fast cycle times, and consistent customer experience across all channels.

• Peak & Capacity Management

• Own peak planning and execution (holiday surges, flash sales, promotional events).

• Manage labor forecasting, flex staffing models, and capacity planning to meet demand volatility.

• Develop contingency plans to ensure uninterrupted operations during demand spikes or system outages.

• People Leadership & Culture

• Build and lead a high-performing leadership team in a 24/7 or extended-hours environment.

• Drive employee engagement, retention, training, and career development.

• Champion a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with all OSHA and workplace safety standards.

• Technology & Automation

• Oversee performance and optimization of WMS, OMS, TMS, labor management, and fulfillment technologies.

• Lead implementation and scaling of automation (sortation, robotics, AMRs, goods-to-person, packing automation).

• Partner with IT and engineering teams to improve system reliability and throughput.

• Continuous Improvement & Execution

• Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen principles to improve speed, quality, and cost.

• Analyze fulfillment KPIs such as units per hour, order cycle time, on-time ship rate, and cost per order.

• Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for service failures and customer escalations.

• Financial & Performance Ownership

• Own the site budget, including labor, freight, packaging, maintenance, and capital expenditures.

• Deliver productivity gains and cost-per-order improvements while maintaining service excellence.

• Track and report site performance to senior leadership with clear action plans.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with E-Commerce, Merchandising, Transportation, Customer Experience, HR, Finance, and IT teams.

• Act as the primary site contact for executive leadership and third-party logistics partners (3PLs).

• Assume additional responsibilities as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).

• 8–12+ years of operations leadership experience in e-commerce, omnichannel, or high-volume fulfillment.

• Proven experience managing large, multi-shift teams in a fast-paced fulfillment environment.

• Skills & Competencies

• Deep understanding of e-commerce fulfillment workflows and last-mile delivery requirements.

• Strong data-driven decision-making and KPI management skills.

• Experience leading automation, technology, and change initiatives.

• Financial acumen with site-level P&L or budget ownership.

• Strong leadership, communication, and execution focus.

• Working Conditions

• Distribution/fulfillment center environment with extended hours and peak-season demands.

• Ability to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

• Limited travel may be required.

• Success Measures

• On-time ship rate and order accuracy

• Order cycle time and throughput

• Cost per order and labor productivity

• Peak-season execution

• Safety, engagement, and retention metrics

jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

About the Role

Gruve is seeking a motivated and technically curious Fresh Graduate Full Stack Developer to join a team building and modernizing a remote instrument monitoring platform for hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate who is interested in full-stack development, cloud technologies, IoT, AI, and modern software engineering. You will have the opportunity to work with technologies including React, TypeScript, .NET/C#, Python, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, and AI development tools.

You will work closely with experienced engineers and contribute to a greenfield cloud-native platform while gaining exposure to IoT connectivity, cloud applications, software packaging, AI agents, and automated testing.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain web applications using React and TypeScript.

• Support backend development using .NET/C# and/or Python.

• Build and integrate REST APIs and event-driven services.

• Assist with IoT and instrument connectivity using technologies such as MQTT, AMQP, and REST APIs.

• Develop and support lightweight applications for Windows/Linux environments.

• Assist with software packaging, application updates, version management, and deployment.

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

• Work with Docker and cloud-based development environments.

• Assist with AWS-based application development and deployment.

• Explore and develop AI-powered engineering tools using technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, or similar frameworks.

• Assist with RAG applications using technical documentation and knowledge bases.

• Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.

• Participate in code reviews, debugging, documentation, and troubleshooting.

• Collaborate with senior engineers across software development, cloud, IoT, AI, and DevOps.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Recent graduate or graduating student with 0–2 years of professional experience.

• Strong foundation in programming and software development concepts.

• Academic, internship, personal, or project experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET/C#, Python, or similar technologies.

• Basic understanding of REST APIs and web application development.

• Familiarity with Git/GitHub and software development workflows.

• Basic understanding of databases and SQL.

• Exposure to Docker, CI/CD, AWS, or cloud technologies through coursework or projects is a plus.

• Interest in AI development, IoT, and modern software engineering.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

These are nice-to-have qualifications and are not required for fresh graduates:

• Academic or personal project involving IoT or MQTT/AMQP.

• Experience with AWS, Docker, Terraform, or Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience with GitHub Actions or another CI/CD platform.

• Experience using AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.

• Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, RAG, or AI agents.

• Experience developing applications for Windows or Linux.

• Knowledge of software packaging, installers, or application update mechanisms.

• Familiarity with automated testing.

• Coursework or project experience involving medical devices, healthcare technology, IVD, or regulated software.

• Familiarity with React, TypeScript, .NET, Python/FastAPI, Next.js, GraphQL, or event-driven architectures.

Salary Range

$60,000 - $70,000 USD/Yearly

C2C contractor opportunity for fresh graduates; no prior professional experience required; hired for a Gruve customer; no visa sponsorship available.

‍

Why Gruve

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: UX Researcher
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

UX Researcher

6sense builds AI-driven products for B2B marketing and sales teams. Our research team helps decide what we build, and we have built AI research agents so product managers, product designers, and content designers can run more of their own studies. As a UX Researcher II, you will help make that self-serve research trustworthy and help it grow.

You will coach partners, triage requests by the risk of the decision at stake, build safeguards for AI-assisted research, and run focused studies where a researcher adds the most value. You will work in fast sprint cycles with product management, product design, content design, engineering, analytics, and R&D Operations.

Our market and our AI tools move quickly, and many questions arrive before the answers are clear. You will bring clarity to that work: well-framed questions, organized operations, and findings told as clear, honest stories that state plainly what we know, what we do not, and how confident we are.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is humble, adaptable, and teachable, and who never compromises on the truth. Tools, methods, and priorities will keep changing. Respect for evidence will not.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Partners with product managers, designers and engineers to scope and conduct qualitative and quantitative research that deliver actionable insights and product recommendations.

• Designs studies to be as efficient as possible without negatively impacting rigor.

• Creates research reports that are clear, concise, compelling, and actionable.

• Guides Product Managers and Designers in conducting their own user research, including recommending the right methodologies for specific initiatives and sharing best practices.

• Help standup and run measurement programs like NPS.

• Support vendor management and research operations. Evaluate new vendor features worth adopting.

Educational and Experience Requirements

• 2-4 years of UX research experience in a product development environment, ideally B2B SaaS or other complex products, with a portfolio or case studies that show studies you owned, how you told the story, and the decisions it informed.

• Excellent reading, writing, and speaking skills. You absorb dense technical, quantitative, and qualitative information, simplify it without losing accuracy, and tell a clear, compelling story that supports sound decisions. You also push back respectfully and use evidence to help a team align.

• Proven experience collaborating with product managers, designers, and engineers.

• Working knowledge of usability and mixed methods, with a clear approach to data analysis and measurement.

• Experience using AI tools in research, and a critical eye for hallucinations, unsupported claims, and weak reasoning. You verify before you share.

• Demonstrated proficiency in using industry-standard UX research tools, like Great Question, UserTesting, Dovetail, Qualtrics, Pendo.

• Exposure to B2B marketing, sales, or martech products. We will help you learn the domain.

Competencies and Behaviors

• Designs clear, efficient studies built around research goals and questions. Ensures research studies will yield actionable insights.

• Analyzes data using industry standards and statistics.

• Clearly connects research insights to overarching UX vision.

• Proficiency in survey design, including question wording, response scales, and techniques for reducing bias.

• Excellent communication skills whether writing, speaking informally, or presenting at all levels of the organization.

• Humility, adaptability, and teachability, shown in how you seek feedback, admit what you do not know, and adjust to change.

• Collaborative across disciplines and teams and takes a proactive approach to drive positive product outcomes.

• Plays an active role in providing feedback to peers to shape research studies.

• Comfort with ambiguity, and a track record of creating clarity through organized communication, documentation, and operations.

• Comfort with fast sprint cycles, several projects at once, and asynchronous work with a distributed team.

• Proactively adapts to changing tooling and workflows to find more efficient and effective ways of working.

Base Salary Range: $94,500.00 - $138,600.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy

Our Benefits:

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

jobs.title: Senior Video Editor, Shows
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times is looking for a Senior Video Editor who can help bring our shows portfolio to mobile, social and digital audiences through horizontal video podcasts and vertical video clips.

This is a post-production position to manage the editing of individual shows as well as clips. You have a refined understanding of editing techniques in multi-camera environments, a meticulous attention to detail, and are adept at working on complex edits autonomously and under deadline. You have an in-depth knowledge of Adobe systems.

You will work with producers, editors, journalists and other internal and external collaborators to lead the edit and publication of the Shows department's work. This role is for someone with a deep understanding of social video trends who takes an innovative and adaptive approach to video formats and techniques.

You will report to the the Post Production Supervisor.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

• Edit and color-correct Newsroom podcasts across our entire show portfolio, delivering content in both short-form vertical and long-form horizontal format

• Deliver top-notch product under intense deadline pressure, and without the need for direct supervision, continuous editorial guidance, or task management

• Bring a digital first mindset to editing on-platform and for social media

• Edit creatively both for full-length videos and video clips, and in coordination with an audio edit

• Assist in defining style and techniques that give our videos a voice and make them stand out from the pack

• Collaborate on optimizing a post production and archival workflow

• Perform related work as assigned

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

• 8+ years of multimedia storytelling, video editing and production experience at at a major video outlet or production company

• Strong digital video editing background

• Must have a strong portfolio of digital work

• Experience creating original videos that incorporate audio, video, still images, graphics and text

• Expertise in Adobe Premiere and CS

Preferred Qualifications:

• Must be up to speed on the latest media techniques and technologies

• Work with colleagues and reporters to synthesize news into a tight, informative and engaging video

• Experience working in video podcasts

• Experience producing, scripting, and/or structuring digital news or documentary stories

• Experience making quick decisions under intense deadlines in a high-pressure newsroom setting

• A foundational knowledge of legal, ethical, copyright and usage issues for visuals

• Well-versed in the world of social and digital media, with a keen eye on what competitors are doing and what new tools are being used

• Willingness to work a flexible schedule

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
OUR VISION

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.

 


OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

 - 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

 - 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

 - 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

 - 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

 


ABOUT VITALIZE'S DESIGN TEAM

Design at Vitalize is grounded in a deep understanding of the people and systems that power healthcare. We spend time in hospitals, learn how work happens from the frontline to the C-suite, and use those insights to design products that make complex operational decisions easier. We care deeply about craft, but we believe great design starts with getting the workflow right—not just the interface. As a small team, we work closely with Product and Engineering, share work early, challenge each other’s thinking, and stay close to the customers using what we build.




THE ROLE

You’ll be the third product designer at Vitalize, joining at a stage where you’ll help define not just what we build, but how we design. You’ll set the design direction for our most complex and strategic product areas, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into clear, intuitive experiences.

We want design at Vitalize to be AI-first, and we’ll be honest: we’re not there yet. We’ve started using AI for early exploration and prototyping, but we don’t have a consistent workflow or clear best practices. A big part of this role is changing that. You’ll help define what an AI-first design process looks like here: how we use AI to explore more ideas, prototype faster, and get to real customer feedback sooner, without lowering the craft bar.

You’ll also shape how AI shows up in the product itself, design across data-dense, AI-powered workflows, lead the evolution of our design system, and set a consistently high bar for everything we ship as Vitalize scales.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build our AI-first design workflow: figure out how AI fits into every stage of our design process, from exploration and prototyping to production. Set the best practices, workflows, and quality standards the team adopts

 - Lead by example: use AI daily to explore, prototype, and test ideas quickly, then bring the strongest directions to production quality

 - Set design direction across the product: lead design for our most complex, cross-cutting product areas from discovery through launch, and shape the long-term product vision alongside Product and Engineering leadership

 - Design complex, workflow-heavy experiences: make data-dense operational tools intuitive for users ranging from central staffing teams and unit managers to frontline clinicians

 - Shape how AI shows up in the product: decide where AI meaningfully improves workflows and how its recommendations, reasoning, and actions appear, so clinical and operational users can trust and act on them

 - Work directly with customers: visit hospitals, observe real workflows, lead research, and translate what you learn into product decisions and strategy

 - Influence the roadmap: question the underlying workflow, find opportunities beyond the immediate request, and connect design decisions to customer and business outcomes

 - Raise the bar for the whole team: mentor other designers, lead critique, and build the practices, rituals, and quality standards that help a small design team do exceptional work




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 8+ years of product design experience, including significant time designing complex, workflow-heavy B2B SaaS products, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership of high-impact, ambiguous problems, from problem definition through shipped product and measurable outcomes

 - An AI-first design workflow you can teach: AI is already central to how you design, you have a clear point of view on where it speeds up the process, where it falls short, and how to keep quality high, and you’re excited to help a team build that muscle

 - Experience designing AI-powered products: you’ve shipped experiences where AI makes recommendations or takes action, and you think carefully about trust, transparency, and when a human should stay in the loop

 - Exceptional product instincts and craft: you look beyond the immediate UI, challenge whether the workflow itself is right, and turn complicated systems into experiences that feel simple

 - Strategic influence: you set direction, not just respond to requests, and can align product, engineering, and leadership around a design vision backed by evidence

 - A customer- and outcomes-oriented mindset: you’re comfortable in hospitals observing operational workflows firsthand, and you connect your work to measurable impact for customers and the business

 - Design systems leadership: you’ve built or led the evolution of a design system and know how to balance consistency with the speed of an early-stage company

 - A multiplier on the team: you’ve mentored designers, raised the craft bar through critique, and shaped how a design team works, and you’re excited to stay hands-on while helping build the function




BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Flexible PTO

 - Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

 - Twice-yearly company off-sites

 - Free meals in-office

 - $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

 - Desk setup reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits

 - Monthly gym/wellness stipend

 - An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

jobs.title: Channel & Alliance Partnerships, Senior Manager | Housing
jobs.description:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
   
   

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million https://eliseai.com/blog/intelligence-is-getting-cheaper-life-should-too funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

 

About The Role

As Channel & Alliances Partnerships, Senior Manager, you will build and lead EliseAI's channel and alliances motion—the indirect, ecosystem-driven engine that extends our reach and revenue through resellers, referral partners, co-sell relationships, and technology alliances. Reporting to the Director of Business Development & Partnerships, you will own the strategy, program architecture, economics, and execution that turn partners into a scalable, repeatable source of growth.

 

This is a builder's role. You won't inherit a mature program to maintain—you will design the playbook from the ground up, stand up the infrastructure and incentives that make it work, and land the anchor partnerships that prove the model. You'll operate with significant autonomy and be accountable for a genuine growth channel, not a set of one-off deals.

 

Key Responsibilities

 - Build EliseAI's channel & alliances program from 0→1—partner segmentation and tiering, deal registration, referral and co-sell economics, enablement, certification, and joint go-to-market

 - Source, negotiate, and launch high-impact channel and alliance partnerships across resellers, referral partners, technology alliances, systems integrators, and platform ecosystems

 - Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline as a measurable growth channel, and the metrics that govern it (partner-sourced ARR, attach rate, deal-registration volume, time-to-first-deal)

 - Stand up the operational backbone that lets the motion scale—partner onboarding, deal flow, co-marketing, and the systems (PRM, reporting, incentive tracking) behind it

 - Align internal stakeholders across sales, product, marketing, and leadership around a coherent partner strategy and shared incentives

 - Build and manage senior, executive-level relationships with partners ranging from startups to large enterprises, and represent EliseAI in high-stakes partner conversations

 - Help attract, hire, and develop top-tier talent as the function grows

 - Note: This is a partnership-building role focused on channel and ecosystem partners. It carries revenue accountability through partners, but it is not a direct, quota-carrying sales
   
   role.

 

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

 

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

 

Requirements

 - 7-9 years of experience in channel partnerships, alliances, or business development, with a proven track record of leading channel/alliance motions at high-growth startups or
   
   technology companies

 - Demonstrated experience building a channel or alliances motion from 0→1—designing the program, economics, and enablement, not only operating one that already exists

 - Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with the ability to model partner economics and translate data into program and prioritization decisions 

 - Excellent executive communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders internally and across partner organizations

 - Experience with APIs and technical integrations strongly preferred, given the ecosystem and alliances nature of the role

 - Ability and willingness to work in person at our NYC headquarters 4-5 days a week

 

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

 

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

 - Equity in the company

 - Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

 - Fully paid parental leave

 - Commuter benefits

 - 401k benefits

 - Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

 - A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

 - Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

 - We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

 

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.



EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - LATAM
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer

Remote role based in Latin America. Must work at least 6 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time.

 

What We Do

Wagmo is a modern pet healthcare company built around how pet parents actually care for their pets. We partner with employers to provide a complete approach to pet and pet-parent wellbeing, from preventive wellness plans and emergency coverage to 24/7 pet telehealth guidance. Our purpose is to unlock every pet parent's potential to provide extraordinary care, and we do it by bringing the same intentionality to pet benefits that the best employers bring to human healthcare. Founded in 2017 and female-founded, Wagmo is headquartered in New York City and trusted by leading employers nationwide.

 

What’s Important To Us

Our mission shapes everything we build and how we work together. We take fearless ownership of outcomes, collaborate with radical candor, and are always driven by the customers and pet parents who trust us. We think critically, follow through relentlessly, and find the extra 10% that turns good work into exceptional work. We keep it weird because the obvious answer is rarely the most interesting one. Our values aren't aspirational. We interview for them and hold each other accountable to them. If what you've read so far resonates with you and you want to be part of a team where every person makes the company meaningfully better, we'd love to hear from you..

 

About The Role

Wagmo uses AI to process pet wellness and insurance claims. When it works, a pet parent submits a claim and gets reimbursed without anyone on our team touching it. We already automate a meaningful share of claims, and we’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to take that much further.

You’ll join our Pet Parents squad and take on our claims automation system, the pipeline that reads invoices, decides what’s covered, and pays claims. In your first year, you’ll make it cheaper to run, easier to change, and able to handle claims it can’t handle today. You’ll own that work from design to production and partner with Product on what to build next.

This role is for someone who has shipped AI features that real users and real money depend on, and who knows the difference between a demo and a system you can trust.

 

Our Tech Stack: Python · Django · TypeScript · React · LLM APIs · OpenRouter · LangSmith · GitHub · Linear · Claude Code · CodeRabbit

 

Core Responsibilities

 - Learn our claims automation pipeline in depth and become a core owner, reviewing and shipping changes on your own within your first few months.

 - Lower the cost of every claim we process by routing work to the right models, while keeping accuracy at or above where it is today.

 - Restructure the pipeline so each stage can be changed, tested, and rolled out independently, with evaluations gating every change.

 - Ship new automation that lets more claims resolve without manual review, working with Product to decide what comes next.

 - Use AI to read veterinary records and make better coverage decisions on more types of claims.



What You’ll Need To Be Successful

 - You’ve shipped an LLM-powered feature to production that real users or real money depend on. You set up evaluations before rollout, versioned your prompts and models, and planned for rollback.

 - You’ve designed or substantially refactored a system the business depends on, such as payments or claims, without breaking it, and left it easier to change than you found it.

 - You’ve taken over a complex system someone else built and become the person others trust with it. Your code reviews change designs, not just style.

 - You’ve made real tradeoffs between model cost and quality, and you can show the numbers that proved quality held.

 - You use coding agents and AI review tools every day, and they’ve changed how fast you ship without lowering the quality of your work.

 - Strong Python skills. Experience with Django and TypeScript is a plus.



Why Consider This Role?

 - Your work pays real claims to real pet parents. You’ll see the impact in production.

 - AI is the core of the product here, not a side project. You’ll own one of the most important systems at the company.

 - You’ll have real scope on a small team, making decisions a larger company would spread across several people.

 - You’ll help pet parents get reimbursed faster for the care their pets need.



Key Benefits

 - Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage

 - HSA/FSA

 - 401(k) retirement planning with employer matching

 - Unlimited paid time off

 - Annual company holidays

 - Additional company-wide recharge days off

 - 12 weeks parental leave for eligible employees

 - Company paid Wagmo pet wellness and insurance plans

 - Regular company-wide events and team gatherings

 - Pet-friendly office

 - Catered lunches

 

We here at Wagmo strive to build a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities that will help us to grow, not only as a company, but also as individuals. Wagmo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Fully Remote
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow the technical estate, replace existing systems with new and scale and develop the platform. It's an exciting time to join the team in this captivating period.

As an SRE you will be part of the Partnerize Technical Operations team, they work with the business, development and IT functions. You’ll be building the infrastructure, delivering projects and processes required to ensure we remain available, scalable and secure. Involved in support, project delivery and maintenance activities completed by the Operational Team.

You should have a keen interest in problem-solving accompanied with experience in Linux systems, an understanding of web servers, basic database skills and have an interest in DevOps and systems administration.

We’re looking for a mix of technical generalists, specialists, candidates that are new to IT or very experienced. For us, it's more about the person and the character than the role. We need people that will get excited about taking us to the next stage of our evolution helping us with their specific skills and experience but learning new ones along the way.

As an SRE at Partnerize, You Will:

• Provide primary operational support and engineering for multiple large, distributed software applications

• Measure and optimise system performance, with an eye toward pushing our capabilities forward, getting ahead of customer needs, and innovating to continually improve

• Build software and systems to manage platform infrastructure and applications

• Improve reliability, quality, and time-to-market of our suite of software solutions

• Partner with development teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures

• Participate in system design consulting, platform management, and capacity planning

• Work closely with development and tech teams ensuring technical Issues and projects are correctly managed.

• Deliver small and large technical projects in a prompt and timely manner.

• Act as an escalation for Support Incidents and assignments while maintaining a high level of quality

• Be responsible for continuous improvement, continuous delivery and continuous integration.

• Participate in the On-Call Rotation.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

• Experience of databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis)

• Understanding of scripting languages (Python, Bash, PHP)

• Knowledge of platform or application automated deployment and configuration management (Ansible, Docker, terraform etc)

• An awareness of AWS and other cloud infrastructure services

• Linux system administration skills.

• Ability to troubleshoot, diagnose and solve issues independently.

• Self-learner, ability to document learning as experience is gained.

• Experience as part of a team supporting and maintaining an infrastructure.

• A proactive approach to spotting problems, areas for improvement, and performance bottlenecks

• Ability to prioritise workload including occasional Incidents and Problem management

• Knowledge of and experience with the ITIL practices.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

• An interest in development, new technologies and innovation

• Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt

• Kubernetes, docker and containers

jobs.title: Category Manager (Technology Sourcing)
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Okta's Strategic Sourcing and Procurement (SS&P) team is looking for an experienced Category Manager (Technology Sourcing) to to join our energetic Strategic Sourcing team to support and be part of Okta's continued growth.  You will lead sourcing activities for our Technology spend globally. This includes leading complex, high-value sourcing projects and contract negotiations for IT service and product categories such as Software, Network, SaaS, IaaS, Telephony, and other direct or indirect technology requirements on a local or global scale.

In this role, you will be a trusted, senior partner to our Technology stakeholders — owning the sourcing strategy for some of SS&P's most complex and highest-impact categories, leading high-stakes negotiations, and driving cost-saving initiatives while maintaining service quality and mitigating risk. You will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior Category Managers and serve as an escalation point for Tactical Sourcing on technology-related matters.

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and collaborative individual who works well in a fast-paced environment and can operate with a high degree of autonomy. This role will report to the Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – Technology.

This is a hybrid role (2 days a week in office) and must be based in either Bellevue, WA, or the San Francisco Bay Area.

Key Responsibilities:

• Category Strategy & Planning: Develop and lead sourcing strategies for Technology categories (Software, Network, SaaS, IaaS, Telephony, AI, and related technology requirements), working closely with senior stakeholders to understand long-term needs and deliver measurable value. Gather business and technical requirements to produce documentation supporting RFx events, and develop internal presentations and business cases to secure management approval for multi-year supplier agreements.

• Sourcing & Project Management: Lead and support all aspects of the strategic sourcing process end-to-end — RFx events, supplier evaluations, and day-to-day commercial contract negotiations — for the most complex, high-value technology sourcing initiatives.

• Contract Negotiation: Lead commercial term negotiations for project-level agreements and partner with Legal on Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and related exhibits, applying strong negotiation and legal acumen to secure favorable terms on high-stakes, high-dollar technology contracts.

• Cost Optimization & Risk Management: Use industry expertise to identify and lead cost optimization initiatives across the largest or most strategic Technology categories, where outcomes carry cross-functional or company-wide impact. Provide economic analysis of supplier proposals for high-dollar or high-risk expenditures, and identify and mitigate the associated internal and external risks. Identify and mitigate both internal and external risks associated with technology purchase transactions.

• Stakeholder Partnership: Build effective, strategic relationships with senior business stakeholders and cross-functional teams (Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy) to align sourcing initiatives with business requirements, ensuring policies and procedures are followed and met.

• Supplier Relaitonship Management: Own the relationship strategy for Okta's most strategic or highest-spend Technology suppliers. Drive supplier performance review meetings and serve as the escalation point when supplier issues or negotiations exceed what P3 Category Managers can resolve independently.

• Process, Governance, & Compliance: Ensure adherence to Okta's policies and procedures. Provide guidance and mentorship to and serve as an escalation point for junior team members.

• Data Analysis & Reporting: Build the data models and spend analysis that inform leadership's Technology category decisions — identifying opportunities for streamlining and consolidation of spend across the portfolio. Regularly brief leadership on strategy progress, savings, and market trends, presenting insights in an executive-ready format

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in Sourcing and Procurement of Technology (Infrastructure, SaaS, Telecom, IaaS, AI, etc.), including category management, strategic sourcing, vendor management, risk management, and/or procurement in a large, global company environment.

• Proven ability to independently lead complex contract and commercial term negotiations, including deep understanding of tech contract law, commercial terms, and risk requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end management of the most complex, highest-dollar, or highest-risk sourcing projects, with minimal oversight.

• Experience mentoring or providing guidance to junior category managers or sourcing staff.

• Demonstrated ability to build data models and spend analyses that inform senior leadership decisions, and to present findings and recommendations in an executive-ready format.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated track record of building trust and driving alignment with senior-level business stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and key vendors.

• Experience owning strategic relationships with an organization's highest-spend or most critical suppliers, including serving as an escalation point for issues beyond junior team members' authority to resolve.

• Advanced proficiency in sourcing and contract systems (e.g., Workday Strategic Sourcing/Scout, Coupa, Ironclad), with experience identifying and driving improvements to how these tools are used across the category management function.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional certifications such as CSCP, CPSM, or CPIM.

• Experience driving M&A-related sourcing activity, including contract novation and consolidation.

• Proven track record of process or policy improvements that scaled across a sourcing function.

• Proficiency with analytics and reporting; strong data-oriented approach to category strategy and negotiations.

• Experience with ERP and financial systems; familiarity with Coupa, Workday Strategic Sourcing (Scout), etc.

• Ability to travel as needed.
