 - Experience with high-speed circuit design and signal integrity analysis.

 - Experience developing test automation tools using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.

 - Experience with EMC/EMI compliance testing and regulatory validation.

 - Familiarity with Nvidia Jetson platforms and embedded compute systems.

 - Experience working with sensors, cameras, LiDAR, motors, battery systems, thermal systems, or cellular networking technologies.

 - Experience with cable harness design and manufacturing support.

 - Experience supporting production ramp activities and overseas manufacturing partners.

This role may require occasional travel to support prototype builds, manufacturing activities, supplier engagement, and engineering validation efforts. The position is expected to operate with a high degree of technical ownership while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable electrical systems at scale.

jobs.title: Head of AI Research Product
jobs.description:
Via is a global leader in smart transportation, using technology to revolutionize mobility worldwide. Our impact ranges from transforming individual daily commutes to reducing the collective environmental cost of transit systems. We're driven by ambitious goals. This is an opportunity to join a core team reshaping how public mobility operates at scale.

We are looking for a Head of AI Research Product to lead the intersection of applied machine learning research and product innovation across Via's rider and transit operations platform. This role sits at the frontier of what AI can do for public transportation, not as a feature layer, but as the engine that makes the system smarter, more equitable, and more efficient for every rider and agency we serve.

This is a three-part role: innovating with lighthouse customers to pilot and pressure-test cutting-edge approaches in real-world transit environments, conducting original applied research, and driving productization of proven methods into Via's core platform.

What you'll do:

• Build and lead Via's AI research product function, defining the roadmap for how machine learning advances rider experience and transit network performance.

• Design and deploy reinforcement learning systems that optimize routing, pooling efficiency, and real-time dispatching, balancing rider satisfaction against vehicle utilization and transit agency cost targets.

• Pioneer AlphaGo-style machine learning for transit: combine deep reinforcement learning, and tree search over high-fidelity simulations of real transit networks, training policy and value networks that discover dispatching, pooling, and network-design strategies beyond what hand-built heuristics or conventional optimization can reach.

• Develop weighted ensemble models and multi-objective optimization frameworks that surface the right tradeoffs between competing system goals: wait times, cost per ride, emissions, and equity of service.

• Invent personalization systems that adapt the rider mobile experience in real time, surfacing relevant trip options, proactive alerts, and dynamic pricing signals, in close partnership with the rider mobile product team.

• Research and productize behavioral incentive models that increase ridership and shift demand to improve aggregation: surge smoothing mechanisms, loyalty structures, and gamified engagement grounded in behavioral economics and causal inference.

• Partner with lighthouse transit agencies to co-develop and validate novel AI approaches, turning field pilots into scalable platform features.

• Establish rigorous experimentation infrastructure (A/B testing, contextual bandits, offline policy evaluation) to measure the real-world impact of model changes on rider behavior and agency outcomes.

What we are looking for:

• MS or PhD in a quantitative field: machine learning, operations research, statistics, applied mathematics, or a related discipline.

• Deep hands-on proficiency in ML: reinforcement learning, supervised and unsupervised methods, probabilistic modeling, and optimization. Experience with AlphaGo-style approaches (self-play, Monte Carlo tree search, policy/value networks) and with large-scale real-time inference systems is a strong plus.

• Genuine user empathy: you think as carefully about what a rider or agency dispatcher experiences as you do about model architecture.

• Very user-minded and clear-eyed about outcomes for users. You work closely with the mobile and SaaS product teams on experimentation, and you know how to find the balance between a delightful user experience and service KPIs such as efficiency and rider experience.

• Business sense and product instincts: you know how to translate a research finding into a shipped product and a shipped product into a business outcome.

• Experience partnering with engineering teams to move models from research into production at scale.

• Track record of working with external customers or partners to iterate on novel solutions in ambiguous, real-world conditions.

• Comfort operating across research, product, and commercial contexts: you can present a model architecture to an ML engineer and a product strategy to a transit authority CEO.

• Passion for building technology that makes public transit work better for everyone, especially riders in underserved communities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

• Salary Range: $250,000 - $310,000 per year

• Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans

• A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting

• Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options

• Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks)

• 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Construction Project Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Jukebox Health, our mission is to empower everyone to live safer, healthier, more independent lives at home. We partner with health plans to make homes safer and more accessible for older adults and high-needs populations. We achieve this by combining technology with networks of clinicians, suppliers, and installers to deliver personalized home modifications and environmental supports nationwide. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, Jukebox Health is a fast growing healthcare services company backed by top venture capital firms like Valtruis and The Home Depot.

We are seeking a Project Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone for a portfolio of home modification projects within their assigned region. You'll be the primary point of contact for Jukebox's service provider network, helping move home modification projects from bid through completion. You'll spend much of your day communicating with service providers - scheduling work, following up on bids, checking in on active projects, collecting closeout documentation, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You'll work closely with our Project Managers and Member Engagement team to surface risks early, resolve issues quickly, and create a smooth experience for our service providers and members. You'll also support the operational side of the business through order entry, claims processing, and maintaining accurate project records in our CRM.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on a high volume of work, is a resourceful problem solver who takes initiative, and enjoys building relationships.

Key Responsibilities

Service Provider Coordination

• Answer inbound calls and emails, handle routine questions, and escalate to the Project Manager when needed

• Follow up with service providers to get bids submitted

• Schedule and confirm project start dates

• Check in on active projects and flag delays or risks early

• Make sure providers understand expectations, timelines, and documentation requirements

• Build trusted relationships with our network to keep providers responsive, engaged, and eager to take on our projects

Project Throughput

• Keep a high volume of active projects moving through each stage without letting them stall

• Work daily from operational queues to determine priorities and next actions

• Send reminders ahead of key milestones and deadlines

Documentation, Claims & Administration

• Collect closeout documents, photos, and required forms, and follow up until everything is complete and accurate

• Assist with claims entry and processing

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Product Manager, Conversational AI
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Staff Technical Product Manager to own strategy & execution across AI powered product experiences within a fast-moving, AI-driven organization. This role goes beyond delivering against a roadmap — you'll help define the roadmap itself, using data-driven prioritization and strong product sense to decide what matters most. You'll operate across a wider cross-functional surface area, requiring sharper stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills to align multiple teams and senior partners around a shared direction.

This role is for someone with proven, hands-on execution experience at scale — not theoretical AI knowledge. We're looking for concrete evidence of AI products you've shipped, the technical and business tradeoffs you navigated, and the cross-functional outcomes you drove, not conceptual familiarity with AI.

What You'll Own

• Strategy and execution for a broad product area to accelerate agent productivity, including defining the roadmap and prioritization framework, not just executing against one.
• Data-driven decision-making at scale: using product analytics, experimentation, and usage data to make prioritization calls with meaningful business impact.
• High-quality strategy and requirements documents that senior stakeholders and engineering leadership rely on to align and execute.
• Cross-functional leadership: aligning multiple teams, engineering, data science, and senior stakeholders around shared priorities, often without direct authority.
• Mentorship of more junior product managers, raising the execution and technical bar across the team.

Why This Role Matters

• Broader scope and higher-leverage ownership over how a significant piece of the AI portfolio evolves.
• Direct influence on strategy and prioritization decisions with visible impact on business outcomes.
• A seat at the table with senior engineering, data science, and product leadership shaping the direction of a fast-scaling AI organization.

What Success Looks Like

• A roadmap and prioritization framework that is data-backed, well-understood by stakeholders, and consistently delivered against.
• Strategy and requirements documents that require minimal rework and are trusted by senior technical and business stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to align and influence senior cross-functional partners without direct authority, resolving competing priorities effectively.
• Evidence of raising the bar for more junior PMs through mentorship and modeling strong execution.

To be successful in this role you have:

• Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
• 12+ years of product management experience, with recent, hands-on experience shipping AI or data-powered products at meaningful scale — not just conceptual AI knowledge.
• Strong data sense and demonstrated ability to drive prioritization decisions using product analytics and experimentation, with measurable business impact.
• Proven ability to write clear, senior-level strategy, requirements, and prioritization documents that stakeholders rely on.
• Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills across senior, cross-functional, and sometimes competing priorities.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of aligning diverse technical and business audiences.
• A track record of proven execution — specific, verifiable examples of AI products shipped, tradeoffs navigated, and outcomes delivered.

Your work will have a direct impact on client satisfaction and retention, as well as the firm’s overall growth and success. As an integral part of our team, you'll support, nurture, and guide clients through their legal journeys, ensuring every interaction is steeped in empathy, respect, and strategic acumen.

What you’ll do:

• Client Engagement: Handle 10–15 intake calls daily for criminal and personal injury cases, ensuring each call is informative and engaging.

• Consultation Management: Conduct confident, consultative calls to qualify leads, build rapport, and convert interactions into signed cases.

• Objection Handling: Address pricing and payment plan concerns, offering solutions that align with client needs and firm policies.

• Follow-up Excellence: Send post-call follow-ups using firm videos and assets to maintain engagement and improve conversion rates. You will also help build and continuously improve our follow-up system (templates, cadence, messaging, and assets) so leads don’t fall through the cracks.

• Systems Management: Maintain accurate records and track leads in Clio,; utilize tools effectively.

• Collaboration: Work closely with attorneys and staff providing timely updates and enhancing team synergy.

• Process Improvement: Continuously refine the intake process using training and best practices to boost efficiency and effectiveness.

What we’re looking for:

• Intake Experience: Minimum 1-3 years in a legal (preferably PI or criminal) setting, handling client intake processes.

• Sales Skills: Proven ability in objection handling and ethical sales practices, with confidence in discussing payment plans.

• Tech Proficiency: Familiarity with Clio is preferred.

• Communication Skills: Excellent organization, note-taking, and follow-through with strong verbal and written communication.

• Multitasking Ability: Capable of managing multiple leads and tasks simultaneously, effectively prioritizing as needed.

• Problem Solving: Proactive approach in identifying problems and implementing innovative solutions.

• Learning Mindset: Open to continuous improvement and self-education to enhance skills and productivity.

• Bilingual Capability: Spanish fluency is a valuable asset in serving a diverse client base.

Why you should work here:

• High-Impact Role: Your work will have a significant impact on the firm’s growth and client satisfaction.

• Autonomy and Ownership: Opportunity to shape and improve the intake function, making it uniquely yours.

• Career Growth: Clear pathway to advance into leadership roles within the intake department.

• Learning Environment: Access to premier training resources and encouragement to innovate with support from firm leadership.

Additional perks:

• Comprehensive Benefits: Full medical benefits, including dependents, along with dental and vision coverage.

• Generous PTO: Four weeks annual paid time off, with additional sick pay according to state law.

• Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 4% employer match, fully vested from day one.

This is more than just an intake specialist position—it is a chance to shape the future of client engagement at NextLaw. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges, ready to collaborate with a team of dedicated legal professionals, and eager to drive the firm’s growth and success, we invite you to apply. Join us in our mission to provide unparalleled legal service and make a real difference in our clients’ lives.

jobs.title: Sr. Marketing Manager; Basketball and Ice Hockey
jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

The Sr. Marketing Manager for Basketball & Ice Hockey is a critical pod leader and individual contributor, responsible for the strategic development, execution, and optimisation of the basketball and ice hockey marketing calendar. This role's primary focus is on the Elite basketball segment, driving brand awareness, increasing demand, and positioning Hudl as the go-to sports technology provider for Elite buyers across analytics, human performance, and player recruitment personas — with secondary ownership of the ice hockey pod and its outputs. The ideal candidate is highly strategic, execution-focused, and deeply knowledgeable about the elite basketball landscape.

As the Sr. Marketing Manager for Basketball & Ice Hockey, you will:

• Own strategy and execution. Lead the marketing strategy for elite basketball and ice hockey, creating quarterly plans with KPIs to drive brand awareness, demand generation, and customer retention through integrated, multi-channel campaigns. You'll ensure this strategy aligns with overall business goals by collaborating closely with sales and strategy teams.

• Lead the pod. Take ownership of the basketball and ice hockey pod's output — guiding campaign development, ensuring operational excellence, and maintaining a strong go-to-market process and cross-functional alignment.

• Champion a test-and-learn culture. Implement a test-and-learn environment where you challenge assumptions, use data to optimize campaigns, scale what works, and continuously improve our approach.

• Partner and collaborate. Work with central marketing functions (web, content, social, design) and product marketing teams to deliver cohesive, high-quality outputs for product launches and feature rollouts. Maintain strong relationships with leaders in Product Management, Customer Success, and Support to ensure business alignment.

• Manage external partners. Manage external agencies in partnership with the Paid Media Manager, ensuring alignment on strategy, market insights, and performance expectations.

• Understand the customer deeply. Utilize insights from Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Decision Science to maintain a strong understanding of the elite buyer. Dive into customer research and product engagement metrics to inform the team's efforts.

• Analyze and report. Track and report on marketing performance, providing clear insights and recommendations to stakeholders based on key metrics such as CTR, CPL, CRO, and ROAS.

• Manage budget and resources. Ensure marketing budget and resources deliver positive ROI by evaluating channel mix and progress toward key business metrics

Time spent collaborating with other Hudlies in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently prioritizing applicants within commuting distance of Lincoln, Nebraska. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

• Experienced. You have 5–8 years of marketing experience, an understanding of marketing strategy and go-to-market approaches, and a bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

• Basketball domain knowledge. You have strong knowledge of the elite basketball landscape and the relevant buyer personas: analytics, human performance, and player recruitment.

• B2B marketing expertise. You have proven experience marketing to elite sports organizations in a B2B environment, with a track record of driving demand and retention.

• Digital marketing expert. You have deep expertise in digital marketing channels including SEO/SEM, PPC, email marketing and automation, and social media, with a proven ability to devise campaigns that engage, inform, and motivate elite buyers.

• Data fluent. You have experience with web analytics applications (such as Google Analytics), optimizing campaigns through A/B testing, and leveraging data to analyze and report on performance.

• Autonomous and operationally strong. You are self-motivated with strong leadership skills and a proven ability to manage time, prioritize across a dual-sport remit, and deliver high-quality work in a dynamic organization.

Nice-to-Haves

• Ice hockey knowledge. Familiarity with the elite ice hockey market and its buyer landscape.

• Vendor management. Experience managing external vendors as an extension of an internal marketing team.

• SaaS experience. Experience working in a Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

Our Role

• Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.

• Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.

• Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.

• Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.

• Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.

• Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000—$137,000 USD

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital partners, is embarking on a journey to build the world’s most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. The Industrial Compute team is central to this mission, setting the core infra strategy and implementing this vision. From site selection to the buildout process, this team sits at the intersection of commercial, technical, strategy, and operations, interacting with teams and executives inside and outside of OpenAI.

About the Role

The Clean Energy and New Technology Lead will own infrastructure clean energy and emerging energy technology strategy and execution, identifying and deploying scalable solutions that enable resilient, low-carbon compute and data center growth. The role will work closely with regulatory and policy teams to align infrastructure expansion with OpenAI’s long-term environmental and operational objectives.

This is an individual contributor lead role and does not have direct reports initially. The role will evaluate where emerging energy technologies can materially improve reliability, cost, carbon, speed, or resilience; translate those options into practical deployment pathways; and help ensure OpenAI’s infrastructure growth remains aligned with sustainability considerations.

Key Responsibilities 

 - Evaluate emerging energy solutions such as clean firm power, advanced storage, grid flexibility, low-carbon backup power, heat reuse, water-related energy efficiency, and other scalable technologies where relevant.

 - Identify pilot opportunities and deployment pathways that can move promising energy technologies from concept to commercially and operationally credible execution.

 - Translate technical options into clear reliability, cost, schedule, carbon, regulatory, and operational implications for infrastructure decision-making.

 - Partner with energy regulatory, policy, procurement, engineering, deployment, finance, legal, and site-readiness teams to align technology and sustainability choices with project needs.

 - Track external market, policy, utility, and technology developments

 - 15+ years in energy technology, infrastructure sustainability, clean energy procurement, power markets, data center energy strategy, utility programs, or related roles.

 - Strong understanding of power systems, low-carbon energy, grid constraints, infrastructure reliability, and the practical requirements of large-scale deployment.

 - Experience evaluating emerging technologies, structuring pilots, or moving early-stage solutions toward commercial implementation.

jobs.title: Agricultural R&D Manager (Fixed-Term)
jobs.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

About the Role

This role  leads the country program Ag R&D strategy execution, trial execution, standardization of research designs and tools, implementation of FAIR data principles  across operating countries, Ag R&D efficiency metrics and KPI  tracking and driving Ag research dashboard. By optimizing the research pipeline from ideation to field adoption, the Regional Ag R&D Manager ensures that spatially and temporally tailored innovations directly improve smallholder farmer yields, profits, and long-term soil health.

This role also guides research-backed agricultural recommendations to program teams on optimized input choices, soil health, alternative fertilizers, and crop management decisions.  Additionally, this role designs and administers staff training in research in general.

Responsibilities

• Provide thought leadership and technical guidance for the development and implementation of strategies to deepen farmer impact through improved (e.g. spatially and temporally tailored) agronomy, for example: Variety recommendations - leadership and oversight of research to generate high-impact and adoptable seed recommendations at region to field level, and drive development of country-level strategies to diversify seed catalogs and encourage farmers to experiment with and adopt varieties that improve their productivity.

• Crop nutrition - Develop recommendations to improve profitability & sustainability of fertilizer use through improved rates, composition, timing or methods of application, or reduce fertilizer requirements through the use of organic or biological alternatives.

• Soil health - Develop recommendations for adoption of erosion-mitigation practices, soil micro-ogarnisms build-up and soil structure improvement.This will be delivered through a combination of desk research, trial, survey and qualitative research.

• Technical consulting - Serve as the regional technical expert, delivering rapid, evidence-backed advice for urgent field challenges or unexpected trial anomalies.

• Research strategy & trial design - provide technical leadership to ensure research methodologies and execution produce rigorous data for characterisation of technology performance and adoption potential, and that innovation pipelines are efficiently designed to generate the data and insights needed to inform program decision making and drive farmer adoption of improved technologies.

• Research data analysis & interpretation - execute and provide oversight for analysis of trials, survey and other data to generate actionable recommendations for program decision-makers and farmers.

• R&D operations, efficiency metrics & KPI tracking - establish standardized efficiency metrics and KPI tracking systems across all operating countries to monitor trial progress, protocol compliance, data quality, and milestone achievement. Develop and manage routine reporting cadence and country-level dashboards to keep global and country leadership teams informed on Ag R&D execution and emerging findings.

• R&D pipeline management - participate in stage-gate processes to evaluate innovations based on clear impact and adoption potential metrics and keep the pipeline up to date.

• Capacity Building - design training materials and conduct regional workshops on trial design, data analysis and management for country research staff.

• Outsight - Collaborate and share information with various other institutions and the private sector in agriculture research (universities, CGIAR, NARES, seed companies, donors) to ensure that their research priorities are influenced by field perspectives on key knowledge gaps or market opportunities, and to ensure that One Acre Fund is well-positioned to benefit from state-of-the-art applied agricultural research.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

• Fluency in agronomy, physiology, G x E x M, and major pests of crops widely cultivated in our operating areas, especially maize (and related cereals), solanaceae, beans (and other legumes) as well as high value crops (e.g. chilli)

• Ability to translate knowledge of technically optimal agronomy into simpler, practical and prioritized recommendations for field teams and farmers

• PhD with 3 years or MSc with 5 years experience in applied agricultural sciences

• Experience in designing and managing on-station and on-farm trials (with smallholder farmers)

• Knowledge of appropriate application and interpretation of parametric and non-parametric statistical analysis techniques and visualizations for agronomic trial data

• Familiarity with predictive and classification machine learning algorithms and their potential applications to the development and delivery of agronomic recommendations (using relevant climate and soil data layers)

• Demonstrated track record of establishing project management frameworks, country-level KPI tracking, R&D efficiency metrics and executive status reporting.

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Flexible, Countries of Operations

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Contract Duration

3 years

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Ethiopia, Malawi, Democratic Republic of Congo, Zambia and Nigeria

Application Deadline

08 January 2027. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (Post-Sales)
jobs.description:
Posit's mission is to create free and open-source software for data science, scientific research, and technical communication to enhance the production and consumption of knowledge by everyone, regardless of economic means. We are a different kind of software company, and we’re proud to build and sell products that help people understand and improve the world through data.

About the Team

Posit’s Solutions Engineering (Sol-Eng) team aims to reduce the distance between customers of our professional products and open source offerings.

We help our customers – especially their IT/SysAdmin teams – deploy, install, configure, and use our professional products. We aim to bring curiosity and empathy to every customer engagement, leaning into the customer experiences as they seek to get value from open source data science.

But that’s only half the job.

As we learn about what customers want and need, we use that knowledge to improve our products, documentation, and processes.

On Sol-Eng, you’ll play an essential role in both unblocking and empowering customers  and making Posit and our products work better in the future.

People who thrive in this role tend to:

• Find joy in working directly with and unblocking customers. This role is customer-facing.

• Love learning and sharing your knowledge of the server infrastructure and architecture that underlies enterprise data science. You’ll be an advisor to IT teams who administer Posit’s products in a wide variety of architectures and with a range of integrations. You have exposure to some of these topics and technologies (e.g. cloud services, Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, Slurm, authentication, connecting to data sources) and look forward to opportunities to dive deeply and learn in other areas. Knowing all of these topics on Day 1 is not required, but having interest in learning more about how they work is fundamental to the job.

• Be curious about data science workflows and use cases. We make tools to multiply the impact of Data Scientists who work in open source. You won’t be doing data science or writing code, but you’ll need to understand what a Data Scientist does (e.g., exploratory data analysis, modeling, reporting, app development). . Prior experience specifically with data science or our professional products is not necessary, but may be helpful.

• Be hungry and humble. Sol-Eng covers an impossibly broad technical scope.. Great Sol-Eng team members are quick to admit what they don’t know and constantly seek to learn more. As a trusted advisor to customers, your credibility comes from being honest about the limits of your knowledge and following through to close the gaps.

• Find excitement in having many demands on your time, rather than overwhelm. The Sol-Eng team has close relationships with almost every other team at Posit. There’s no limit to the different projects Sol-Eng could take on, being able to choose important things (with help and guidance from managers) and ignore distractions is a key skill for a Posit Solutions Engineer.

What you’ll own own:

• Serving as a proactive, ongoing technical advisor to customers discussing server configurations and architectures, supporting technical strategy planning, and sharing best practices for doing open source data science at scale with Posit’s professional products. You’ll collaborate with sales and customer success to enable the customer to realize the full value of their Posit environment.

• Scaling our reach through webinars, talks, workshops, documentation, automation, and how-tos that help customers adopt Posit products.

• Leading scoped, project-based implementation work, from onboarding through delivery of defined outcomes.

• Providing the voice of the customer to other teams at Posit, especially Product Management and Product Engineering.

What you’ll help with:

• Improving our team’s processes so our workflows facilitate us doing great work, taking adequate focus time, and having time off to rest and recharge.

• Setting the direction of our products by influencing the Product Management and engineering teams.

You will learn...

So much.

No one has ever (or ever will) start on Sol-Eng knowing everything we do. Strong candidates for this role generally have prior experience with approximately half of the things below.

• How to navigate deeply technical post-sales customer calls and have the ability to speak about technical topics to internal and external audiences of different levels. Even people with substantial customer experience find that Sol-Eng demands new depths of empathy, curiosity, and clarity of thinking and explanation.

• How Posit’s Pro Products work. On customer calls, you will be the expert on our Pro Products – explaining how to install and configure them, as well as how they help make life better for Data Scientists.

• How to speak fluently about enterprise infrastructure. Solutions Engineers help our customers IT/Admins determine the best product architecture for them, which requires they speak knowledgeably about integrations to other data (science) tools and platforms, and how to get things done on Linux servers including system administration, authentication, networking, and virtualization.

What to expect:

Within 1 month, you’ll…

• Meet the rest of the Sol-Eng team and start meeting members of Customer Success, Sales, and other nearby teams.

• Configure Posit’s Pro Products for yourself to start learning the ins and outs.

• Have joined dozens of IT architecture and post-sales calls with IT/Admins of Posit’s Pro products.

Within 3 months, you’ll...

• Lead customer calls, helping our customers determine how Posit’s Pro products fit into their existing data and technology stacks. You won’t need to know all the answers, but you will lead with curiosity to build the right mental models that will allow you to go back to find answers.

• Be comfortable discussing general architectures and deployment patterns for our product

• Begin getting hands on with customers who are installing and maintaining our products, looking over their shoulders and suggesting how to set up and configure their environments.

Within 12 months, you’ll…

• Contribute to projects in roles of escalating size and scope.

• Take on larger, more strategic, and higher-touch customer engagements that might include weekly meetings with the same customer.

Posit offers competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This hiring range reflects base salary and assumes that the job will be performed in the United States.

Hiring Range

$141,800—$187,110 USD

Working at Posit:

• We welcome all talented colleagues and are committed to a culture that represents diversity in all its forms.

• We prioritize giving ourselves “focus time” to get deep work done. We minimize meetings and attempt to operate asynchronously.

• We are a learning organization and take mentorship and career growth seriously. We hope to learn from you and we anticipate that you will also deepen your skills, influence, and leadership as a result of working at Posit.

• We operate under a unique sustainable business model: We have over 50% of our engineering dedicated to creating free and open source software. We are profitable and we plan to be around decades from now.

• Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a Certified B Corporation®, which means our open-source mission is codified into our charter. As a result, our corporate decisions balance the community's interests, customers, employees, and shareholders. Hear more about why we think this matters here.

Notable:

We offer competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. These benefits apply to full-time positions only.

• 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums are covered for employees and their families! Fertility and gender-affirming healthcare is included in all of our plans.

• Supplemental mental health and wellness benefits are available via Ginger even if you don’t opt in to our insurance plans, including Ginger for teen family members.

• Posit's gender-neutral paid parental leave policy covers all new parents, including foster and adoptive parents.

• All full-time employees are eligible for 401k enrollment starting on day one.

• After six months of employment, Posit provides a substantial yearly match to employee 401K contributions.

• An annual profit-sharing bonus for employees recognizes our team’s contributions to company performance across the year.

• We are a 100% distributed team. You are also welcome to come into our Boston office.

• We offer a $400 monthly reimbursement for coworking space rental if you prefer to work away from home.

• Our Lifestyle Savings Account offers an initial deposit of $1800 and then an additional quarterly stipend of $375 to cover the costs of professional development, wellness, financial health, charitable giving, and remote work support.

• We provide a flexible environment with a generous vacation policy that encourages a minimum of four weeks PTO per year plus 15 paid company holidays.

Are you excited about this role but not sure if your experience aligns with every qualification in the job description? That’s okay. We know multiple perspectives are essential for a thriving organization and we'd still love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Head of Payor Partnerships
jobs.description:
HEAD OF PAYER PARTNERSHIPS AT DUET




ABOUT DUET

Duet is proving that nurse-practitioner-led care isn't just more accessible, it's better. We help NPs build and scale independent practices in communities too often overlooked by the health system: rural towns, immigrant populations, LGBTQ+ patients, and more. Backed by AI-driven tools that give independent NPs the backing of a much bigger system, our network of 100+ practices covering 400,000 annual visits has driven a 30% increase in preventative visits and a 35% drop in hospitalizations, the clearest sign yet that localized NP-led care means better outcomes.

We're a well-funded, early-stage company led by seasoned entrepreneurs and nurse practitioners, and backed by investors including Lerer Hippeau and Kairos.




WHY DUET, WHY NOW

Independent primary care is disappearing, swallowed by hospital systems and private equity roll-ups, often pulling out of the communities that need it most. But 31 states now support autonomous NP practice, and the results back up what we've long believed. We built the first value-based care contracts for NPs with major payors, taking on real financial risk for outcomes. In our anchor market in New Hampshire, our network outperformed the state on total cost of care by 19%, proof that a solo NP in an underserved area can outperform a system ten times their size and get rewarded for it.

Role Overview:

Duet is looking for a dynamic, strategic, and execution-oriented Head of Payor Partnerships to lead our health plan and payor relationships. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth company and shape the future of our go-to-market and reimbursement strategy. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll play a pivotal role in defining how Duet engages with payors and scales value-based partnerships across the country.

You’ll lead everything from market strategy and outreach to contract negotiation and implementation—building partnerships that enable NP-owned practices to thrive. This is a high-impact, highly visible role ideal for someone who knows how to navigate health plans and thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. This role will be hybrid out of NYC and report into Duet’s CEO.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Lead identification, negotiation, and implementation of strategic partnerships with commercial and government payors.

 - Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with payor stakeholders.

 - Build and execute a comprehensive prospecting strategy—including outreach, referrals, events, and networking.

 - Deeply understand Duet’s capabilities and align them with the strategic goals of potential partners to identify high-value opportunities.

 - Own the contracting pipeline: manage payor scoping, negotiations, contract review, implementation, and go-live.

 - Provide feedback loops on Duet’s performance and value-add to internal and external stakeholders.

 - Create and maintain market-specific payor models—analyzing revenue, utilization, provider types, product lines, and payment methodologies.

 - Prepare and execute negotiation strategies, including term sheet creation and financial modeling.

 - Lead review and redlining of contract language through to execution.

 - Use CRM (e.g., Salesforce, Hubspot, etc.) to track activity, market insights, and progress across deals.

 - Define and track KPIs to measure the impact and performance of partnerships.

 - Represent Duet at industry events, conferences, and networking forums.

Qualifications:

 - 4-6 years of experience in healthcare, ideally in an external-facing role with a focus on payor relations, business development, or health plan or provider network management.

 - Demonstrated experience with value-based care contracting—either direct or in a strong supporting role—is required.

 - Proven ability to lead negotiations, draft proposals, and present complex partnership strategies to C-level audiences.

 - Strong project management skills and ability to lead cross-functional initiatives to completion.

 - Proficiency in data modeling, contract performance analysis, and market intelligence gathering is strongly preferred.

 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adept at juggling multiple workstreams and deadlines.

 - Self-starter with a bias toward action; thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

 - Willingness to travel monthly for conferences and partner meetings.

The total compensation for this role will be $200,000-$220,000 per year plus equity. This role is hybrid in NYC.

jobs.title: Manager, Account Manager | Growth
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.



About The Role

The next chapter of Ramp's growth runs straight through the customers we already have: 80,000+ finance teams who adopted us for one thing and haven't yet seen what the rest of the platform can do for them. Account Management owns that opportunity - and this role owns the team building the motion to capture it.

You'll lead a group of 5-8 Account Managers, each carrying a book of ~3,000 emerging and SMB customers with real latitude over how they grow it. This is a build role, not a maintain role: the playbooks, coaching systems, and performance bar you set are the ones this team runs on next year. Your ceiling is set by how well you turn individual AM judgment into a repeatable, scalable motion that grows the segment.

What You’ll Do

 - Build and run a high-performing team of 5-8 Account Managers - setting the bar for culture, morale, and daily execution.

 - Understand where to prioritize your teams time. Engage directly with AMs to identify and break into top accounts, especially where trust is being built or repaired.

 - Own the number. Manage quota performance and pipeline generation across your team to hit spend activation, product activation, retention, and expansion goals. Forecast your business to senior leadership on a weekly cadence.

 - Hire and develop the next generation of AMs - training on product, buyer personas, competition, and tooling through role-plays, game film, and real deal work.

 - Coach relentlessly. Run daily 1:1s, dissect call feedback, lead enablement sessions, and build career paths for every rep on your team.

 - Turn what works into a system. Continuously refine team processes and tooling to improve output and efficiency as the segment scales.

 - Represent Account Management cross-functionally, partnering with Sales, CX, CSM, Risk, and Product to remove blockers and drive outcomes.

What You’ll Need

 - Minimum 2+ years of quota-carrying sales or account management experience as an individual contributor, with a proven, consistent track record of exceeding goals (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)

 - Minimum 1+ years building and leading account management or sales teams, with a track record of exceeding goal (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)

jobs.title: Environmental Technician I
jobs.description:
Environmental Technicians are the backbone of our company.  You’ll be joining a team of dedicated professionals with the opportunity to learn environmental regulations and how we remove hazardous materials from the waste stream.  Once trained in this role, you will consolidate, treat, store, transport and/or dispose of hazardous waste in accordance with environmentally responsible and compliant practices, policies, and procedures.  This is a physically active job where you’ll be lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds throughout the day, operating a forklift and other mobile equipment to move containers to and from storage and treatment areas and to load and unload trailers. You will complete required documentation accurately, timely and legibly in accordance with applicable regulations and customer policies, practices and procedures.

Basic requirements:

• High school diploma or GED
• Ability to repeatedly lift and carry 50 pounds throughout the workday
• Ability to stand and walk over uneven surfaces for extended periods
• Visual acuity to read labels and documentation; depth perception to safely drive forklifts
• Ability to hear vehicle warning chimes and alarms
• Ability to work outdoors in all climate conditions and indoors in non-climate-controlled conditions
• Willingness and ability to wear company-issued personal protection equipment including safety glasses, hard had, steel toed shoes, gloves, Tyvek coveralls, and respirator (gentlemen – this means no beards)

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in warehouse or manufacturing environment
• Basic computer skills to complete web-based training
• Ability to understand and respond to written and verbal English
• Ability to predictably and regularly attend work during scheduled hours. Must be willing and able to occasionally work nights, weekends and variable schedule(s) as necessary.
• Ability to deal politely and professionally with customers and coworker

jobs.title: Senior Assembly Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Assembly Technician to join our Parts Super Center team in Indianapolis, IN!

Summary:

The Senior Assembly Technician is responsible for assembling, electrical testing, troubleshooting and quality control of electromechanical assemblies and sub-assemblies. Ensure assemblies meet specified quality standards and maintain quality documentation. Train and assist junior level Assembly Technicians.

What You'll Do:

• Read, understand and interpret engineering drawings, bills of material and work instructions
• Install and wire electrical components (connectors, leads, harnesses, switches, sensors, PCB modules) into mechanical assemblies per schematics and/or wiring diagrams
• Perform required electrical testing and verification of assembled units using multimeters, oscilloscopes, hipot (high-potential) testers, functional test fixtures, and other test equipment
• Utilize various hand tools, measuring tools (micrometers, calipers, gauge pins), testing tools (hipot tester, Multimeter) and other standard power hand tools to complete work tasks
• Test finished product according to schematics and/or wiring diagram
• Assemble product according to schematics and/or wiring diagram
• Verify items and quantities on the pick list shipping out per Work Orders. Pack finished product per instructions
• Visually inspect parts on queued WO to ensure that parts meet Rexel quality standards and are in good condition
• Support ISO Certification, maintenance of documents, and audits. Participate in ISO yearly training
• Report all non-conforming material to NCMR Coordinator / Quality engineer
• Will lead one on one buddy training for Level I and Level II Assembly Technicians
• Assist in inventory management
• Other duties as assigned

Job Duties Disclaimer:

The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. Please note that management retains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrate commitment to effective customer service delivery, integrity, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Rexel USA.

What You'll Need

• 5+ years of experience in Assembly, Quality Control, or Inventory Management
• Prior experience in mechanical assembly of electromechanical products
• Demonstrated experience performing electrical testing on assemblies (use of multimeter, oscilloscope, and continuity testing)
• High School or GED - Required
• Other - Preferred
• Technical school a plus

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Ability to read work instructions, bills of material, wiring and mechanical diagrams
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams and simple schematics
• Basic knowledge of electrical fundamentals (voltage, current, resistance, continuity, polarity, ground)
• Familiarity with test documentation and traceability requirements
• Strong mechanical aptitude a must
• Strong mathematical skills
• Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
• Basic computer skills with strong attention to detail. Familiarity with Microsoft products a must
• Ability to effectively communicate with co-workers to aid in satisfying customer requirements
• Ability to organize and prioritize job tasks and requirements
• Able to meet deadlines
• Able to work overtime as required

jobs.title: Process Design Engineer
jobs.description:
We invite you to bring your experience and skills in Process Design Engineering to help develop innovative solutions for Ramboll's customers’ industrial chemical process projects. To succeed in this role, you must have a B.S. or greater Chemical Engineering and 3+ years of experience in chemical process design. Are you our new Process Design Engineer?

The Process Design Engineer will support design activities for customer process projects and is responsible for day-to-day project tasks. This individual will be required to coordinate work across multi-disciplined design teams in multiple geographies, can be working on several projects at once for multiple customers and may interface directly with the customer to execute projects.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Develops engineering studies, front-end loading (FEL) evaluations, detailed designs, and assists in developing cost estimates for industrial processes.

Develops conceptual designs and cost estimates for new plants or plant expansions.

Performs engineering calculations and develops study reports summarizing results.

Prepares mass and energy balances, process flow diagrams, piping & instrumentation diagrams, equipment specifications, and other design documents.

Solicits and reviews process equipment quotations, develops technical bid evaluations, selects equipment suppliers, and reviews fabrication approval drawings.

Responsible for working with internal and external teams to meet project objectives.

Participates in project meetings and design reviews and tracks progress of day-to-day commitments.

Adheres to the policies and standards set forth in the Firm’s Quality Management System.

Participates actively in creating a safety culture in the office and at project sites.

To facilitate in-person collaboration, the position will require working in the Syracuse, NY office at least three days per week. The remaining workdays may be remote.

10 to 30% travel, valid driver’s license required.

Education and Experience:

Education: Bachelor of Science Degree in Chemical Engineering

Experience: 3+ years of relevant design experience. This experience is to have been gained in industry (e.g., consulting, manufacturing). Academic experience (e.g., laboratory work, teaching assistance, etc.) gained during the applicant’s education is valued, but would not sufficiently satisfy this requirement.

Proficient with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, etc.).

Ability to collaborate and work as a part of a team or independently.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Interest in continued growth and learning.

Experience with Process Simulation Software (CHEMCAD or other) is a plus.

Job Title:

Automotive Service Advisor / Writer

Location:

2190 Church Road, Arnold, United States, 63010

Job Overview:

As an Automotive Service Advisor/Writer with Christian Brothers Automotive, you are the trusted professional our guests rely on for assistance with their vehicles. Your role is crucial in building lasting relationships, as you are the face they see every time they invest in their vehicle.

Service Advisors guide our guests through the entire repair process, keeping them informed about the status of their vehicles and ensuring their satisfaction before they leave our facility. Responsibilities include building repair estimates and advising the guest on repairs and maintenance using our CBA presentation standards,

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Greet every guest that enters our facility with hospitality and respect
• Present the best solution to properly repair our guest vehicle in a way that is easy for them to understand
• Manage the store’s workflow in an effective and efficient manner
• Consistently and effectively sell our services without jeopardizing honesty and integrity
• Maintain a positive attitude and team atmosphere at all times
• Communicate on the phone in a clear professional manner
• Build long-term relationships between the store, yourself and our customer
• Directs, coordinates, and participates in performing customer service activities
• Shuttle guest as needed in CBA branded vehicle
• Ensure that all repairs are performed to proper specifications.
• Work together as a team and assist other employees as needed
• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

• Current driver’s licenses
• Driving record acceptable to our current insurance carrier
• Proficiency in Windows based computer software and automotive store applications
• Experience in an Automotive Customer Service role or Automotive Service Write/Advisor/Sales role

Physical Requirements:

• Being dependable and reliable for a position that is scheduled for Monday – Friday, 7am – 6pm
• Being on your feet the majority of the workday (standing, walking, coordinating parts, etc.)
• Occasionally lifting and carrying objects over 50 lbs.
• Keeping a brisk work pace in a high-volume environment

Christian Brothers Automotive (CBA) began in 1982 with the simple premise of providing precision auto repair with transparency, integrity and a philosophy of people first. All 300+ CBA locations offer a modern facility equipped with manufacture-level diagnostic equipment and the latest factory scan tools. CBA shops also offer their technicians a consistent workload, free training, full-time live technician support and access to our private Technician Assistance Center.

All of your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Christian Brothers Automotive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Christian Brothers Automotive locations practice "At-will" employment practices.

jobs.description:
DSA – Mid-Market

The Basics

As a Director of Strategic Accounts (DSA) on the Tanium field sales team, you will be responsible for generating opportunities to position the Tanium platform within an assigned territory and/or accounts. You’ll be equally as comfortable with the CIO, CISO or VP Ops as you would hosting a room of Red Team members; from talking business benefits to bits and bytes. The successful DSA drives a superior customer experience by delivering technology solutions tailored to customer needs and is able to exceed their assigned quota.

This role will cover Mississippi, South Carolina, and Alabama.

What you’ll do

• Articulate the value of the Tanium platform to decision makers and expertly manage the complex sales cycle

• Nurture and develop relationships within the assigned territory and/or accounts, presenting to the C-suite the value of the Tanium platform

• Work with the Partner and Marketing teams to define and support prospecting and sales efforts within assigned territory and/or accounts

• Generate appropriate sales development activity to ensure healthy pipeline management

• Accurately forecast, maintaining excellent SFDC hygiene

• Conduct online webinars or in-person presentations to generate qualified leads

• Travel as needed

We’re looking for someone with

• Significant enterprise software sales experience, generating and closing large & complex software transactions with the biggest customers in the region

• A strong team mentality - selling is a team sport at Tanium, where managing and using virtual resources to tackle large and complex sales cycles is a must have skill

• Proven track record of exceeding quota

• Experience calling on and presenting to C-Suite level contacts

• The ability to evangelize and build new business opportunities within an assigned territory and/or accounts

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Systems Support Analyst
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Supply Chain Systems Support Analyst

Anduril Industries

About the Team

Anduril's Supply Chain organization is building the systems infrastructure to scale procurement, planning, and logistics across a rapidly growing defense technology portfolio. Within this organization, the Digital Supply Chain function is responsible for optimizing supply chain operations through implementation, management, and continuous improvement of the digital platforms that power sourcing, inventory, fulfillment, and supplier management. The team ensures that supply chain processes are efficient, scalable, and integrated with the latest industry standards.

About the Role

As a Supply Chain Systems Specialist, your primary responsibility is to respond to reported supply chain system incidents submitted by internal stakeholders across Anduril's global supply chain user base. You will own the intake, evaluation, debug, escalation, communications, and tracking of reported incidents across the platforms that support procurement, purchasing, planning, inventory, and logistics operations. The user base supported by this role includes supply chain analysts, procurement specialists, buyers, planners, and program managers. Support case duration and technical complexity will range widely.

Beyond reactive support, you will be embedded in supply chain operations, working cross-functionally with Procurement, Purchasing, Planning, Program Management, IT, Engineering, Business Systems, and other stakeholders to solve complex systems problems that span multiple teams and don't fall neatly into any single domain. You bring structure to ambiguity, think in systems, and drive solutions where others see only complexity.

What You'll Do

Triage, Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution

• Serve as the critical bridge between supply chain operations and digital supply chain systems (ERP, PR apps) identifying and resolving software issues that impact supply chain efficiency.

• Monitor intake of reported software problems across multiple supply chain platforms and triage based on urgency, impact, and scope.

• Conduct root cause analysis by observing actual supply chain processes and how they interact with digital systems to identify disconnects between software functionality and operational needs.

• Escalate to engineering support when required and provide clear operational context to software development teams about supply chain realities and downstream impacts.

• Develop workarounds and best practices that accommodate both system limitations and supply chain requirements, minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.

• Proactively identify potential unreported problems by regularly analyzing system data patterns, monitoring supply chain KPIs, and reviewing process adherence across platforms.

Cross-Functional Problem Solving & Systems Thinking

• Step into high-priority problems that span multiple teams and systems, bringing structure to ambiguity and driving resolution without waiting for clear ownership or prescribed solutions.

• Project manage across large, cross-functional groups of stakeholders—leading meetings, managing communications, and driving alignment toward solutions amid challenging deadlines and moving milestones.

• Support system implementations, upgrades, and migrations by leading user acceptance testing, developing training materials, and championing change management across the organization.

• Propose targeted improvements to existing workflows and system configurations that enhance the end-user experience and reduce recurring support needs.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelors Degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field.

• 2+ years of experience in supply chain systems, technical support, ERP/MRP administration, business systems analysis, or a related operations/technology role, with hands-on experience in one or more supply chain platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, or similar).

• Hands-on debug expertise with integrated enterprise systems, including ERP, MRP, WMS, PLM, or procurement platforms.

• Functional understanding of core supply chain concepts, processes, and terminology (sourcing, procurement, inventory, payment) and how they relate to software tools and data objects.

• Demonstrated ability to multitask competing support demands in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

• History of collaborative engagement with software engineers and cross-functional technical teams.

• Self-driven and proactive. You don't wait on others to solve problems. You step into the gap to offer solutions yourself.

• Comfortable communicating broadly: presenting findings and recommendations to leadership, facilitating discussions across technical and non-technical audiences, and documenting solutions clearly.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Procurement Software/Tools.

• Experience with system integration tools, APIs, or middleware platforms

• Experience supporting ERP implementations, major system migrations, and/or continuous enhancement projects

• Experience in working on process optimization projects with both internal and external stakeholders under tight deadlines

• Background in hardware manufacturing, aerospace and defense, or other complex supply chain environments.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. jobs.description:
The Enterprise Account Executive is a high-level sales professional responsible for managing and growing relationships with large, strategic clients. The role focuses on driving revenue through new business acquisitions, account expansion, and customer retention within complex enterprise accounts. The Enterprise Account Executive will build relationships at all levels within the customer's organization, including the C-suite, while understanding their unique needs and goals.

This role will be a critical part of Lumos’ enterprise sales team. The EAE will specialize in building and nurturing relationships with customers while understanding their challenges and delivering impactful strategies that align with their business objectives.

Why Lumos:

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

jobs.title: Manager, Biosample Operations
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a team committed to making a meaningful impact on cancer treatment through the discovery and development of precision medicines? At Kura Oncology, you have an opportunity to be a part of something bigger, with a lasting impact that you can be proud of.

At Kura Oncology, we are working to change the paradigm and improve the science of cancer treatment. As an organization, we strive to cultivate a diverse and talented professional culture driven to develop precision medicine therapeutics.

As we continue to build a leading biotech organization with a strong culture, a patient-focused mindset and a team focused on relentless execution, we are looking for innovative, passionate professionals to join us and make our vision a reality.

To succeed at Kura, you will need to have a demonstrated ability for excellence in drug discovery and development and a roll-up your sleeves attitude. The ideal candidate will possess a values-driven work style where integrity and grit drive all behaviors, decisions, and actions.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

The Manager, Biosample Operations plans, implements, manages and drives biological sample logistics within Kura Oncology Phase I-IV Clinical Trials, working within our Clinical Operations function, under the leadership of the Head of Clinical Operations (or designee) and in collaboration with Clinical Trial Leaders (CTLs) and cross-functional development team.

• The Manager, Biosample Operations advises on and delivers the biosample strategy within clinical program(s) in accordance with the requirements of quality, and ethical and regulatory standards, including ICH/GCP/GLP.

• Ensures standardization and harmonization of biosample activities across clinical trials and oversight of sample collection, processing, storage, and reconciliation, maximizing biosample sample accrual and quality.

• Review clinical study protocols, informed consents, laboratory documents, case report forms, and service provider laboratory scope of work documents for sample handling details.

• Responsible for ensuring ethical use of biosamples collected in Kura Oncology clinical trials.

• Accountable for planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of patient samples (oversight of sample collection at site, shipment to vendor for testing/processing, analysis and final sample disposition)

• Ensures project level consistency occurs for biosampling across studies and is the primary point of contact for project, clinical, and study teams; contributing to innovation and improvement activities in collection, processing and data delivery.

• Track and report on biosample management status/progress, address issues, and resolutions.

• Collaborate with internal and external team members

• Complete other duties as assigned by the manager.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in science/healthcare field, a nursing degree, or equivalent combined education.

• A minimum of 4-6 years of clinical trial management experience preferred.

• 2+ years of strong hands-on experience in clinical biosample project management preferred.

• Must understand the drug development process in order to effectively manage internal and external cross-functional teams.

• Proven ability to build strong relationships with external partners, CROs, and biosample vendors

• In-depth, working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.

• Knowledge of regulations and requirements for clinical trial authorization and tissue storage and transfer in major countries.

• Project management skills with ability to identify risks and issues, and propose appropriate measures as required

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.

• Analytical thinker with problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Planning, organization and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

• Accountable for executing decisions made within the function.

• Collaborates with cross-functional partners as needed to support team objectives and ensure alignment with broader program activities.

• Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally as required (~10%).

• Experience with Investigational New Drug applications (INDs) and New Drug Applications (NDAs) submissions, EU and Asia filing experience a plus.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office

The base range for this role at the Manager level is $150,000 - $178,000 per year. Individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including, and without limitation, job-related skills, experience, work location, and relevant education or training. Kura's compensation package also includes generous benefits, equity, and participation in an annual target bonus.

#LI-RM1

Kura’s Values that are used for candidate selection and performance assessments:

• We work as one for patients

• We are goal-focused and deliver with excellence

• We are science-driven courageous innovators

• We strive to bring out the best in each other and ourselves

The Kura Package

• Career advancement/ development opportunities

• Competitive comp package

• Bonus

• 401K + Employer contributions

• Generous stock options

• ESPP Plan

• 20 days of PTO to start

• 18 Holidays (Including Summer & Winter Break)

• Home Office Setup

• Lifestyle Spending Stipend

• Commuter Stipend (Boston Office)

• Regular employee social activities, including happy hours, monthly birthday celebrations, Kura Koffee Talks, and much more!

Kura Oncology is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to discovering and developing innovative precision medicines to help patients with cancer lead better, longer lives.

Through our deep understanding of cancer biology and decades of experience in precision oncology, we are studying the underlying causes of treatment resistance. This enables us to design smart combination regimens with other cancer therapies to target tumors from multiple directions, with the goal of improving long-term clinical benefit.

Kura developed and is commercializing KOMZIFTI® (ziftomenib), the FDA-approved once-daily, oral menin inhibitor for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory NPM1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia, and continues to pioneer advancements in menin inhibition and farnesyl transferase inhibition. For additional information, please visit Kura’s website at www.kuraoncology.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Director of Communications
jobs.description:
