Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) mainstream, building the infrastructure to enable every satellite mission to enter this new orbital domain. We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, below 300 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.

As part of the first 100 employees at Albedo, you will have a big impact on Albedo’s trajectory to proliferating VLEO — whether you’re advancing hardware to increase satellite longevity, scaling production for large constellations, building next-gen flight and ground software to push performance, or enabling missions that matter for national security and our day-to-day life here on Earth.

How We Operate: Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield, CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.

Who We're Looking For: Builders who want to own outcomes, not tasks. Systems thinkers who balance precision with iteration while thinking about the big picture. Individuals who are energized by creating a category rather than competing in an existing one. You’ll join a team that has already proven what others said wasn’t feasible and is now scaling and upgrading our VLEO buses & payloads to serve mission sets across sensing, communications, and responsive operations.

If you can feel the excitement running through your veins, apply to be one of the Bedo 100.

About This Role:

Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit mainstream, and we’re looking for a versatile communications and marketing generalist to lead how we show up in the world. As Albedo’s first dedicated communications and marketing hire, you’ll build the function from the ground up, owning everything from social media, press, and content to events and external partners. Working closely with our founders and teams across engineering, BD, and government relations, you’ll translate Albedo’s milestones, missions, and technical breakthroughs into compelling stories while strengthening our brand and external presence across every channel.

• Create and direct visual and video assets, translating complex technical subject matter into narratives that land with both industry insiders and smart outsiders.

• Plan and execute Albedo's presence at industry events, sponsorships, booths, side events, and executive/customer engagements.

• Manage Albedo’s event program and develop creative ideas for how we show up, from side events and customer engagements to new formats that make our presence more memorable.

• Build and manage a network of outside creative partners, agencies, and contractors to extend your capacity across content, design, video, events, and other projects.

jobs.title: Information Security Lead
jobs.description:
ROLE

The Information Security Lead exists to make security an operating discipline across ACQ, with clear ownership for information security operations, incident readiness, risk, and the ongoing operation of ISO 27001 and ISO 42001.

ACQ holds data from thousands of client businesses and uses AI across its products and internal operations. We've established foundational identity controls, and we're moving from certification readiness into the daily work of keeping our management systems effective, our risks visible, and our response capabilities ready.

This is a hands-on, founding information security role with its deepest ownership in GRC and security operations. You will build repeatable operating systems, lead investigations, and provide an independent view of risk. You will also bring enough technical depth to review application and infrastructure code, understand attack paths, and work with engineering owners on practical code remediation.

You will report to the IT Systems Manager, partner daily with platform, application, and AI engineering, collaborate with Legal on privacy, and work with the CTO as an executive sponsor of the function.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Operate the ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 management systems through continuous evidence collection, risk management, control testing, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions, and surveillance audit preparation.

 - Build and run security operations across centralized logging, detection engineering, alert triage, incident response, security investigations, insider-risk escalation, tabletop exercises, and post-incident improvement.

 - Own the information security operating model, including policies, standards, risk acceptance, vulnerability governance, quarterly leadership reporting, security awareness, and the roadmap for maturing the function.

 - Lead identity, access, vendor, and data-protection controls through privileged-access governance, quarterly reviews, third-party assessment, classification, retention, deletion, and clear boundaries between operating companies.

 - Provide independent technical assurance across applications and cloud systems by reviewing architecture, application code, infrastructure-as-code, IAM policies, CI/CD workflows, and material vulnerabilities with the engineers who own remediation.

 - Establish security and governance controls for AI systems, including inventories, impact assessments, model and tool access, agent permissions, prompt-injection and data-exfiltration risks, audit trails, and tested shutdown mechanisms.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 7+ years of information security experience, including experience operating ISO 27001 programs. Active CISSP certification, or eligibility and commitment to obtain it within six months of hire, is required; ISO 42001 and CGRC experience are preferred.

 - Experience remediating security incidents, including practical experience building logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities.

 - Ability to read and write code, ideally in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, to identify potential attack paths, assess vulnerabilities, and recommend code-level fixes.

 - Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Pulumi or Terraform, cloud IAM, and deployment workflows.

 - Knowledge of AI and agentic systems, with experience establishing practical security controls for their use.

 - Experience serving as a foundational or sole information security owner is highly preferred.


RESULTS

 - ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 operate on a continuous cadence, with current evidence, tested controls, reviewed risks, and corrective actions ready for surveillance audits.

 - Security signals are centralized and actionable, incident procedures are rehearsed, investigations are handled with clear ownership, and lessons produce verified control improvements.

 - Leadership receives a plain-language quarterly view of material risk, overdue remediation, control effectiveness, accepted exceptions, and the decisions or investment required.

 - Privileged access is reviewed quarterly, identity lifecycle controls are auditable, critical vendors are assessed before receiving company data, and data-handling expectations are implemented in the systems that matter.

 - Application and cloud findings have named engineering owners and deadlines, technical reviews happen early enough to change designs, and remediation is validated rather than closed on assertion.

 - AI systems have a current inventory, defined owners and access boundaries, completed impact assessments, traceable activity, tested shutdown controls, and a prioritized plan for scaling the information security function.


SCHEDULE

 - Full-time, standard Pacific Time business hours, Monday through Friday.

 - Flexibility to support security incidents and critical business needs.


LOCATION

 - Remote, USA.

 - Some travel to Las Vegas will be required.


COMPENSATION

 - $200,000-$225,000 base salary.

 - The salary range may be inclusive of several levels applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise. This range is inclusive of base salary only and does not include benefits.


BENEFITS:

We offer a comprehensive, evolving benefits package designed to support your health, family, and wellbeing. Some key offerings:

 - Flexible Unlimited Paid Time Off and Company-wide Holidays

 - Employer sponsored Medical, Dental, & Vision plans
   
   - $1,950 annual Employer HSA contribution
   
   - FSA options including dependent care
   
   - Employee assistance program and mental health resources

 - Employer match program for 401(k), eligible for both Traditional and Roth accounts

 - $1,200 annual wellness reimbursement through JOON https://joon.io/ that supports health, family care, pet care, fitness, and more!

 - For local or visiting team members, enjoy access to a state of the art gym at our HQ in Las Vegas

* Benefits eligibility applies only to full-time exempt roles.




ACQ CORE VALUES:

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.


COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns.


SINCERE CANDOR

Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally.


UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join Vibe's GTM Operations team, the group that owns the systems Sales, SDRs, CSMs, and AMs use every day. Salesforce is our source of truth for prospect and customer data, account assignment, and pipeline management. Until now, a strong team of distributed contractors has maintained it. We're bringing it in house, and you'll be one of the people who builds and runs it day to day.

You'll work alongside our Senior Salesforce Administrator, to build and execute the systems roadmap. You'll build against that shared roadmap: shipping flows, fixing data issues, and keeping our integrations healthy. You'll get real ownership over pieces of an instance the whole company depends on. You'll also work with the newest AI tooling for CRM administration, and you'll sit close enough to the business to see why each request matters. This role is built for growth. Our goal is for you to take on more of the design work over time.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build and maintain the Salesforce instance

 - Build, test, and maintain the flows behind our funnel (assignment, routing, etc.), working from designs agreed with the Senior Admin

 - Own the day-to-day admin queue: user management, permissions, fields, layouts, reports, and dashboards

 - Investigate and fix data integrity issues before they reach a rep's workflow

 - Document what you build so the next person can understand and extend it

Keep the GTM stack healthy

 - Monitor our integrations with Outreach/Kaia, Default, and other connected tools, and catch sync failures early

 - Triage issues as they come up: fix what's in your lane and escalate the rest with a clear diagnosis

 - Contribute to integration changes and to monitoring for data divergence between Salesforce and our other internal systems

Partner with the business

 - Take requests from Sales, SDR, CSM, and AM teams, ask the questions needed to understand the real need, and scope them into the roadmap with the Senior Admin

 - Help reps and managers get the most out of the systems we've built

 - Use AI to speed up Salesforce build, testing, and documentation, and share what works with the team
   
   


WHAT YOU NEED

 - 2–4 years of hands-on Salesforce admin experience in a production org

 - Salesforce Administrator certification, or equivalent hands-on experience

 - Experience building and troubleshooting Salesforce flows in a live revenue environment

 - Familiarity with how GTM tools like Outreach, Default, Calendly, or Gong connect to a CRM, and comfort debugging when a sync breaks

 - Hands-on use of Claude or a comparable AI tool in your Salesforce work, with specific examples of what it changed

 - A habit of asking "why" before building, and of writing things down

 - Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship 
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Exposure to the Salesforce API, SOQL, or Apex, even if you're still building depth there

 - Experience on an in-house team, not only client-side implementation work

 - Enough comfort with pipeline and GTM metrics to understand what a request is trying to move

 - Experience with data quality checks, validation rules, or CRM hygiene projects
   
   


OUR VALUES

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you take ownership of your work, default to action, ask for help early when you're stuck, and measure yourself on results rather than effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards. You'll work alongside people who push you and get real ownership over hard problems in a fast-moving market, with the support to grow into more.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.




WHAT WE OFFER

For candidates in New York, the base salary range for this role is $125,000–$175,000, plus variable.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

 - Variable pay: Based on real Vibe business goals.

 - Full health coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k) with matching: We invest in your future, not just your output.

 - Flex PTO: Take the time you need. We measure results, not hours.

 - Workspace worth showing up for: Our Flatiron office is full of natural light, we're in 4 days a week with flexibility built in, and our amazing workplace experiences manager keeps the space.

 - Parental leave: Paid leave for all parents.

 - Annual offsite: The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.
   
   


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, with no surprises and no ghosting.

 1. Recruiter screen: 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

 2. Manager interview: Meet the person you'd work with directly.

 3. Take-home assignment + live debrief: A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

 4. Calibration interview: A senior leader joins to make sure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

 5. Offer: Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.
    
    


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison, Lymphoma (Lacutamab)
jobs.description:
As the Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Lymphoma (Lacutamab), you will be a field-based scientific expert for cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) and lacutamab, a humanized monoclonal antibody immunotherapy targeting KIR3DL2. You will build trusted scientific relationships, exchange balanced medical information, and generate actionable insights that inform US Medical Affairs strategy and launch readiness.

You will support Sobi's rare disease portfolio in the hematology franchise and serve as a trusted scientific resource across the hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology communities. You will collaborate with academic, community, and multidisciplinary care teams, always in accordance with regulatory, legal, and compliance requirements.

This is a field execution role within Hematology Medical Affairs. You will contribute insights and a field perspective to the CTCL medical strategy, which is led by Medical Affairs leadership.

What You Will Do

Scientific Engagement and External Relationships

• Serve as a primary field-based scientific point of contact for Sobi Medical Affairs within your assigned geography.
• Develop and maintain meaningful, two-way relationships with opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, medical organizations, investigators, and other stakeholders involved in CTCL care.
• Exchange accurate, fair, balanced, and scientifically rigorous information on CTCL, lacutamab, relevant clinical data, disease biology, treatment approaches, and the evolving care landscape.
• Engage across academic, community, and multidisciplinary settings, including hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology practices.
• Respond appropriately to unsolicited scientific inquiries and connect stakeholders with Sobi resources in line with applicable policies and procedures.

Medical Insights and Strategy Execution

• Identify, document, and share high-quality field insights on unmet needs, clinical practice, patient pathways, evidence gaps, stakeholder perspectives, competitive developments, and the treatment landscape.
• Partner with Medical Affairs leadership and cross-functional colleagues to interpret insights and inform adjustments to medical strategy, tactics, educational priorities, and engagement plans.
• Execute territory-level medical plans aligned with the US CTCL and lacutamab medical strategy, adapting engagement to local and regional stakeholder needs.
• Support key institution and stakeholder engagement planning, helping establish Sobi as a trusted scientific partner in CTCL.

Launch Readiness, Education, and Congress Support

• Contribute to lacutamab launch preparedness through disease-state education, articulation of unmet need, scientific exchange, stakeholder mapping, and field execution of approved medical tactics.
• Provide internal and external scientific training on CTCL disease biology, preclinical science, clinical data, evidence gaps, and relevant outcomes.
• Participate in or support advisory boards, medical roundtables, webinars, symposia, and other educational activities at local, regional, and national levels.
• Represent Sobi Medical Affairs at scientific and medical congresses, and synthesize and communicate key updates and implications to internal stakeholders.
• Collaborate on identifying and developing field resources and scientific materials specific to CTCL and lacutamab.

Evidence Generation and Clinical Development Support

• Provide field-based support to Clinical Development and Clinical Operations, including site identification and recommendations, investigator engagement, communication facilitation, site initiation support, and patient accrual support.
• Identify evidence gaps and potential research opportunities, and communicate them to appropriate internal partners.
• Contribute scientific and field perspectives to evidence generation activities, real-world evidence initiatives, publications, and medical education programs, as appropriate.
• Support investigator-sponsored research and other research collaborations in accordance with company processes and governance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Territory Leadership

• Partner with colleagues in Medical Affairs, Medical Information, Clinical Development, Market Access, Patient Advocacy, Commercial, Legal, Compliance, and other functions, while maintaining the independence and integrity of the Medical Affairs role.
• Serve as a scientific resource to internal stakeholders and contribute to cross-functional initiatives consistent with Medical Affairs objectives and company guidelines.
• Demonstrate excellence in territory planning, stakeholder prioritization, documentation, follow-through, and management of multiple projects and competing priorities.
• Contribute to the success of the broader Field Medical organization by sharing best practices, supporting colleagues, and fostering a collaborative, respectful, and patient-focused culture.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is marked by:

• Scientific credibility and curiosity
• Strategic territory leadership
• Insight generation and synthesis
• Trusted stakeholder partnership
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Clear, balanced communication
• Agility and a solution-oriented approach
• Operational excellence
• A patient-centered mindset

What You Bring

Required and Preferred Qualifications

• Education: Accredited doctorate degree in a life-science, health-science, or basic-science discipline, such as PharmD, PhD, DNP, DSc, MD, or DO.Candidates with another advanced health degree and extensive relevant industry or clinical experience may be considered.
• Experience: At least 5 years of MSL experience in hematology/oncology or a closely related therapeutic area is highly preferred.Experience in rare disease and/or product launch is highly preferred.Experience in clinical practice, CTCL, lymphoma, dermatology, dermato-oncology, is valued.
• Scientific acumen: Strong ability to understand, critically evaluate, and clearly communicate complex scientific and clinical information.A hematology-oncology background is highly preferred.Knowledge of CTCL and the multidisciplinary care environment is an advantage.

Skills and Attributes

• Stakeholder engagement: Demonstrated ability to initiate and sustain credible scientific relationships and respond effectively to the needs of key stakeholders.
• Communication: Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and listening skills, including the ability to shape and articulate a clear scientific story.
• Collaboration: Demonstrated success working with internal and external stakeholders and influencing across cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
• Execution: Proven strategic thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, project management, and prioritization skills. Self-directed, adaptable, and comfortable in a dynamic environment.
• Integrity and compliance: High personal integrity, sound judgment, and emotional intelligence, with an understanding of the legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements of the biopharmaceutical industry.
• Patient focus: Strong commitment to patient needs and advancing scientific understanding within the CTCL community.

Location, Travel, and Work Environment

• Remote, field-based position supporting an assigned US geography.
• Frequent domestic travel by ground and/or air is required (60% or more), depending on territory size, stakeholder needs, congress participation, and business requirements.
• Ability to attend local, regional, and national meetings, including occasional evening or weekend programs, as business needs require.
• Ability to work effectively from a remote office and manage a geographically dispersed territory.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

• A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
• Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
• A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
• Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

The base salary range for this role is $215,000 - $230,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Sobi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Sobi are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veterans and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status or protected groups by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.title: Director of Data
jobs.description:
ROLE

Acquisition.com http://Acquisition.com helps businesses scale. We hold data from thousands of client businesses, including company profiles, purchases, product usage, and live connections to bank, CRM, and advertising accounts. Our founders have said the company must be data-first before it can be AI-first. This role makes that true.

We are hiring our first Director of Data, the first leader solely accountable for the data function. Three Senior Data Engineers and a half-time analyst run the warehouse, single-client-record pipelines, and reporting used by Finance and Leadership, supporting two client-facing products in daily use. What is missing is one owner for accurate numbers, one reliable client record, AI-ready data, and one data program.

The mandate is to make data reliable and usable by people, products, and AI systems. You own the data platform, single client record, governed business metrics, and data used to train, evaluate, and ground AI systems. You lead the team and data quality program while remaining hands-on enough to write SQL, inspect models, and diagnose failures. You report to the CTO; Platform owns infrastructure and application engineering; AI Engineering owns model architecture and runtime; and you own the data those systems train on, evaluate against, and retrieve from. The existing team reports to you on day one, and you set the standards every data-producing team must meet.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the data platform end to end, including the warehouse, ingestion, transformation, semantic layer, orchestration, observability, vendors, and cost.

 - Build the governed data systems behind production ML and LLM products, including versioned training, evaluation, feature, and retrieval datasets, embeddings and vector indexes, and controls for labeling, lineage, leakage, drift, and retrieval quality.

 - Establish one authoritative client record across source systems with identity resolution, field-level provenance, and enforceable data contracts.

 - Create the governed metrics layer and data quality program that Leadership and Finance use, including one definition per metric, published freshness standards, automated reconciliation, and named ownership by domain.

 - Enforce privacy and access controls in the data layer with Security and Legal, including retention, deletion, cataloging, lineage, and boundaries between operating companies and partners.

 - Lead the data team as one program through a published roadmap, clear operating cadence, documented on-call, talent development, and hands-on technical leadership when the work requires it.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 8+ years of data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform experience, including leading a data function and directly managing senior engineers; experience as a company's first or primary data leader is preferred.

 - Hands-on experience building or rebuilding a modern cloud data stack, with advanced SQL skills and practical experience with warehouse architecture, data modeling, transformation, orchestration, and observability.

 - Experience owning data systems used by production ML or LLM products, including versioned training, evaluation, and retrieval datasets, embeddings and vector search, labeling, leakage prevention, drift monitoring, and retrieval-quality evaluation. Must be able to explain how data quality decisions affected model performance in production.

 - Experience building a customer master or identity resolution model across multiple source systems, including matching logic, survivorship rules, and field-level provenance.

 - Experience delivering governed business metrics used by executives and Finance, including automated reconciliation, published data-quality standards, clear remediation ownership, and the ability to explain data tradeoffs in plain language.

 - Experience implementing data governance and privacy controls, including retention, deletion, lineage, role-based access, and working knowledge of CCPA and CPRA; financial transaction or multi-entity data experience is preferred.


RESULTS

 - Within 60 days, publish one data roadmap, review it monthly with the CTO and quarterly with the founders, and assign an owner to every data initiative.

 - AI assistants answer the top 20 leadership metric questions; every AI product has a team-owned evaluation set; and no model ships without testing it with AI Engineering.

 - The client record covers every active client, core fields are at least 95% complete, connected-source data uses the same model, and every material field has provenance.

 - Every executive KPI and Finance statement uses governed metrics; reconciliation runs weekly; unmatched payment volume falls below 1% from $9.8 million; and critical failures are detected within one hour and resolved within one business day.

 - Retention and deletion are automated, deletion requests complete within 45 days with an audit record, and warehouse access is reviewed quarterly.

 - Every data engineer has a level, growth plan, and on-call; no critical pipeline depends on one person; and platform spend and unit cost are reported monthly.


SCHEDULE

 - Full-time, standard Pacific Time business hours, Monday through Friday.

 - Flexibility to support security incidents and critical business needs.


LOCATION

 - Remote, USA.

 - Some travel to Las Vegas will be required.


COMPENSATION:

 - $250,000-$275,000 base salary + 15% performance bonus max.

 - The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise. This range is only inclusive of base salary, not benefits (more details below).

jobs.title: Senior System Test Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT LANCEDB

AI advances at the speed of its research, and research moves at the speed of its data. LanceDB is the AI-native Multimodal Lakehouse: one system where a researcher curates petabytes of video, audio, and every signal derived from them with a few lines of Python, and the next training run starts as fast as the next idea. Customers like Runway, Midjourney, and Netflix build the future of AI on LanceDB, from frontier and world models to robots and autonomous vehicles.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Senior System Test Engineer at LanceDB, you will drive the correctness, reliability, and performance of Lance and LanceDB under demanding production conditions. You'll work at the intersection of distributed databases, systems engineering, and test infrastructure, building the frameworks and workloads that expose failures before our users encounter them.

You'll partner closely with engineering to turn architectural risks and real customer workloads into automated, reproducible tests, and to diagnose and fix complex failures. This is a hands-on role with ownership of system-level test strategy and execution, where you'll use AI tooling adeptly to accelerate development and investigation while maintaining rigorous validation.

This is an opportunity to define the quality bar for infrastructure powering the next generation of AI workloads, and to directly influence product architecture, release confidence, and the reliability our users depend on as they move from experimentation to production at scale.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - System test strategy: Define and drive system-level testing across correctness, reliability, scalability, and performance, prioritizing the highest-risk behaviors in the platform.

 - Test frameworks and workloads: Build automated test frameworks and realistic workloads covering ingestion, concurrent reads and writes, indexing, querying, and dataset maintenance.

 - Data integrity and fault injection: Validate data integrity and documented consistency guarantees under concurrency, retries, partial failures, and recovery. Develop fault-injection and resilience tests for process crashes, network disruptions, storage errors, resource exhaustion, and interrupted operations.

 - Performance testing: Design load, stress, and long-running soak tests, and identify regressions in latency, throughput, resource usage, and search quality.

 - Upgrades and compatibility: Test upgrades, compatibility, and recovery scenarios to ensure the platform behaves predictably as software and workloads evolve.

 - Partner closely with engineers to investigate failures using logs, metrics, traces, and source code, reduce complex issues to minimal reproductions, and drive fixes and regression coverage.

 - Develop and continuously improve reproducible test environments, integrating reliable, actionable checks into CI and release workflows.

 - Use AI coding assistants and other AI tools to develop test harnesses, explore failure scenarios, analyze results, and accelerate debugging, independently verifying generated code and conclusions.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of experience in software engineering, system test engineering, or test infrastructure, with substantial experience building or validating distributed databases or large-scale data systems

 - Deep understanding of distributed databases, including consistency models, replication, partitioning, concurrency control, durability, and failure recovery

 - Proven track record of designing tests that verify system invariants and uncover data corruption, race conditions, and failures that emerge only under load or partial outages

 - Strong programming skills in Python and at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, Java, or Go, with the ability to build maintainable test infrastructure and debug product code

 - Hands-on experience with fault injection, performance testing, workload generation, and automated testing in distributed environments

 - Demonstrated ability to use AI tooling adeptly in daily engineering work, including coding assistants and agent-based workflows, with sound judgment about validating outputs

 - Experience with Linux, cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and observability tools

 - Ability to own ambiguous projects, prioritize risk, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate closely with engineers to drive issues to resolution


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience testing database storage engines, query engines, vector search, or cloud object storage integrations

 - Familiarity with LanceDB, Lance, Apache Arrow, DataFusion, Parquet, or related data infrastructure

 - Experience with property-based testing, fuzzing, differential testing, or distributed consistency testing

 - Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and large-scale test environment orchestration

 - Contributions to open-source databases, distributed systems, or testing frameworks

jobs.title: Assistant Controller
jobs.description:
• Help scale a high-accountability controllership function that protects recurring close and reporting while enabling Zip’s evolving funding model.

• Bring deep technical accounting and controllership experience across funding structures, SPVs, securitization, internal controls and complex financial reporting.

• Remote-first opportunity for US-based employees with the option to work in-person out of our Manhattan office

Start your adventure with Zip

As Assistant Controller, you will be a senior individual contributor within US Accounting & Control, with primary ownership of funding and special-purpose-vehicle (SPV) accounting and Assistant Controller-level responsibilities across the broader controllership agenda. You will lead the accounting operationalization of securitizations and other funding structures from Day 1 transaction execution through recurring close, reporting, reconciliations and control ownership, while helping protect the accuracy and timeliness of Zip’s recurring financial reporting.

You will work closely with Treasury, Legal, Finance Systems, Credit Risk, Audit and other US and Global Finance partners. The role also provides accounting oversight and review of treasury, payroll and compensation-related accounting activities and acts as a key accounting lead for business change, control maturity and process improvement as Zip’s US funding and finance operations continue to scale.

Interesting problems you’ll get to solve

• Own end-to-end accounting for funding structures and SPV legal entities, including legal-entity and chart-of-accounts design, journal-entry design, recurring close, reconciliations and financial statement support.

• Lead the accounting workstream for new securitizations and funding transactions, including Day 1 transaction execution, operational readiness, post-close stabilization and transition into sustainable recurring processes.

• Own recurring trustee, investor and lender reporting support, ensuring accounting outputs, reconciliations and reporting requirements are complete, accurate and delivered on time.

• Design, document and operate effective controls for funding, SPV and related accounting processes; identify control gaps, drive remediation and support SOX, internal audit and external audit requirements.

• Protect the quality and timeliness of the US month-end close by reviewing complex accounting activity, balance-sheet substantiation, journal entries, fluxes and issues through resolution.

• Support and deliver key components of the US GAAP audited financial statement process, including financial statement and disclosure preparation, audit support schedules, technical accounting documentation and timely resolution of external audit requests.

• Oversee and review treasury, payroll and compensation-related accounting activities, including routine monthly close processes, reconciliations and associated controls.

• Coordinate with Treasury, Legal, Finance Systems, Credit Risk, Banking/Funding teams and Audit to manage change, incidents, control efficacy and cross-functional reporting requirements.

• Drive process standardization, documentation and automation opportunities across controllership, while maintaining accountable ownership of processes as systems and data capabilities mature.

• Serve as a senior accounting subject-matter expert on new products, business changes and complex transactions, translating accounting requirements into scalable operating processes and clear recommendations to support stakeholder decisions.

What you’ll bring to the team

• 7+ years of progressive Accounting or Finance experience, including controllership, audit, complex month-end close, financial reporting and balance-sheet ownership.

• Strong knowledge of US GAAP and excellent command of accounting and financial principles, including how business decisions and complex transactions impact the financial statements; IFRS knowledge is beneficial.

• CPA or CA qualified; Big 4 audit experience is an advantage.

• Hands-on experience with structured finance, securitization, SPVs, funding facilities or similar legal-entity accounting; experience in financial services, fintech, private credit or capital markets is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience designing, documenting and operating internal controls, including SOX environments, audit coordination and remediation of process or control gaps.

• Proven ability to translate transaction terms and business requirements into accounting conclusions, journal-entry logic, chart-of-accounts design, reconciliations, reporting and sustainable close processes.

• Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional work through strong coaching, prioritization and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate with and influence stakeholders at multiple management levels, manage expectations and drive issues to resolution.

• Strong analytical skills and superior attention to detail, supported by intermediate-to-advanced Excel skills, strong systems aptitude and experience improving accounting processes through better data, reconciliations, workflow design and automation.

• Comfort with ambiguity and limited precedent, with the independence and judgment to adapt in a fast-moving environment; deadline-driven and able to manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining a view of the big picture.

• Clear alignment with Zip’s core values

What you’ll get in return

Zip is a place where you’ll get out what you put in. The newness of our sector means we need to move at pace and embrace change, and our promise to you when you join the team is that you’ll feel empowered and trusted to make big things happen quickly.

We want you to feel welcome and as though you have the support to be yourself, and care for yourself at work. Because it’s important to us that you make the most of the opportunities you’ll get to grow your skills and your career, and be surrounded by smart, friendly people and leaders that have your back.

We think these are just some of the best things about being a Zipster. We will also offer you:

• Flexible working culture

• Incentive programs

• Unlimited PTO

• Generous paid parental leave

• Leading family support policies

• Company-sponsored 401k match

• Learning and wellness subscription stipend

• Beautiful Union Square office with a casual dress code

• Industry-leading, employer-sponsored insurance for you and your dependents, with several 100% Zip-covered choices available

Zip is committed to a straightforward and transparent pay structure. The actual base salary will be determined by various individualized factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, location, internal equity, as well as other objective business considerations.

The annual base Pay Range for this position is150k-160k US national compensation band (USN). Additional premium percentages may apply based on our tiered premium strategy.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or commission awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

*Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

If hired, employees will be in an 'at-will position' and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Be a part of a team that reflects the diversity of our customers

We pride ourselves on being a workplace that provides equal opportunities to people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities, veteran status, and everything else that makes you unique.

Equally, we’re committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive. Please let us know If there are any adjustments that need to be made to ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

And finally…get to know us

Zip Co Limited (ASX: ZIP) is a digital financial services company, offering innovative, people-centered products.

Operating in two core markets - Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and the US, Zip offers access to point-of-sale credit and digital payment services, connecting millions of customers with its global network of tens of thousands of merchants. We’re proud to be a values-led business and our values - Customer First, Own it, Stronger Together and Change the Game - guide us in everything we do.

jobs.title: Insurance Financial Reporting Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRANCH

Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible, so more people can be covered. We innovate using data, tech, and automation to simplify insurance from start to finish—we eliminated inaccurate quotes in favor of real prices, created a better way to bundle, and cut unnecessary costs in the traditional insurance process. Then we pass those savings along to our members. Basically, we’re doing insurance the way it was meant to be.

But we didn’t just create the insurance we’ve always wanted, we also created the company we’ve always wanted to work for. As we redefine insurance, we also want to redefine what it means to work in insurance. Find out for yourself.

Branch has a preference for candidates in Ohio, but is open to candidates located in AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, MD, MI, MO, NV, NC, OH, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, and WI. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Branch is remote first, with most Branchers choosing to work from home. Our headquarters are located in Columbus, Ohio, where we come together from time to time to build relationships and connect with each other in real life. We also have office space in Columbia and Concordia, Missouri as well as Forreston, Illinois. Once a year, the entire company gathers for “BranchFest”, a highlight of the year for many Branchers.

About the Role

As Insurance Financial Reporting Lead, you’ll own Branch’s statutory financial reporting, from the quarterly and annual NAIC filings through the statutory audit. You’ll bring every part of the annual statement together, and you’ll be the person who can explain what it shows.

You will collaborate across the Finance, Compliance, Legal and Insurance teams, and work closely with actuarial and reinsurance, to ensure data is reliable, audit-ready, and aligned with industry regulations. Your work will help Branch leadership understand performance outcomes and support the continued evolution of our finance operations as we scale.

Key Responsibilities

 - Direct the preparation and delivery of statutory financial statements, including quarterly and annual NAIC filings, RBC analysis, and NAIC RBC forecasting tools.

 - Own the annual statement end to end, including the statement pages and Schedules B, D, F and P, coordinating each schedule with the accounting, actuarial and reinsurance teams.

 - Prepare the other statutory returns Branch files beyond the annual statement.

 - Lead the annual statutory audit, including owning the PBC list and coordinating the information needed from other departments.

 - Analyze month-over-month changes in financial outcomes and provide clear reporting to enable leadership understanding, with support from actuarial and reinsurance teams.

 - Participate in the monthly close.

 - Document and maintain financial processes to support efficient and accurate reporting.

 - Work with the Data Office to help identify and define required controls and data availability needed for accurate financial reporting.

 - Support the development of audit-ready documentation for key financial processes and controls.

 - Develop an internal control testing framework that supports a growing audit function of the future.

 - Support the review and documentation of cash handling processes and reconciliation procedures.

 - Collaborate with Insurance and Compliance teams on data or regulatory requests related to state expansion or reporting needs.

 - Contribute to special projects that help improve financial transparency, data readiness, or compliance across the organization.

Skills & Experience

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field; CPA a plus.

 - 8+ years of experience in property & casualty insurance finance or accounting, with statutory reporting at the core of that experience. GAAP experience is a plus.

 - Ownership of quarterly and annual statutory statement filings, with hands-on experience across every part of the annual statement.

 - The ability to read Schedule P across years of development and explain what it shows.

 - Experience leading or coordinating a statutory audit, including the PBC process.

 - Strong working knowledge of statutory financial reporting, controls, and insurance accounting.

 - Proficiency in interpreting financial outcomes and turning data into actionable reporting.

 - Experience with a holding company structure and consolidation up to a parent is a plus.

 - Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

 - Strong communication skills and a desire to contribute to team growth and shared knowledge.

Why join us at Branch?

We’re all about getting back to getting each other’s back - that means Branchers, too. So we provide benefits that let you work and live to your fullest.

 - Above-market salary - Branch is a data-driven company, so we do the math on salaries, too. If you get an offer from Branch, you can expect compensation that hits above the mark.

 - Pay equity and transparency - Our pay isn’t just market-driven, it’s equitable. We let experience and performance drive your success, never your gender, race, orientation, or beliefs.

 - Remote-first (with perks) - Work from where you’re most comfortable. We’ll take care of your work from home set-up and monthly internet. We also have a Columbus headquarters if you’d like to join us in an office.

 - Flexible YouTime - We don’t just let you control your own time off.  We actually encourage you to use it. After your first year at Branch, we’ll give you $1000 toward your next vacation.

 - Employee stock options - You’re not just an employee. If you’re full-time, you’re also a part-owner. You’ll have stock options so you can invest in the company you’re helping to grow.

 - Medical, vision, dental - Get all the coverage you need for a healthy, happy life.

 - 401k and contribution matching - Invest in your future. Branch helps you get to retirement on time with a portion of your contributions matched each month.

What to expect

In light of recent hiring scams across the United States, here’s what the process will look like with Branch (so you know it’s us):

 - Please apply to open positions directly through our site. If you don’t see it here, then it shouldn’t exist on another job board. If you’re ever unsure about the legitimacy of a Branch  job posting found on another site, please check the listings here to verify.

 - If you're selected to move onto the next phase of the hiring process, a member of our Branch talent team will reach out to you directly from the email domain @ourbranch.com http://ourbranch.com to guide you through our process.

 - The process will include a number of interviews, which will all happen either over the phone or on video calls.

 - We will never ask for personal payment or require you to purchase equipment during our interview process. Always be sure to protect your personal information.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

At Branch, we are deeply committed to community. Branch is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants and/or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to the individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Domino's Pizza is seeking a dedicated and customer-focused Delivery Driver to join our team in Denver, United States. As a key member of our fast-paced restaurant, you'll play a crucial role in ensuring our customers receive their orders promptly and with a smile.

• Safely and efficiently deliver pizza and other menu items to customers within the designated area
• Navigate Denver's streets and traffic patterns to optimize delivery routes and ensure timely service

• Process customer payments accurately and provide excellent customer service at the point of delivery
• Assist with in-store duties during non-delivery times, including food preparation, cleaning, and order taking
• Adhere to all food safety and quality control standards
• Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth operations during peak hours
• Maintain a clean and professional appearance at all times
• Provide feedback on delivery routes and customer experiences to improve overall service

• Must be 18 years of age or older
• Valid driver's license with a minimum of one year of safe driving history
• Access to a reliable, insured vehicle suitable for deliveries
• Excellent navigational skills and familiarity with Denver's street layout
• Ability to read maps and locate addresses efficiently
• Strong time management and organizational skills
• Exceptional customer service orientation and friendly demeanor
• Basic math skills for handling cash transactions accurately
• Effective communication skills, both verbal and written
• Physical stamina to lift and carry items up to 50 pounds
• Ability to work in varying weather conditions and temperatures
• Flexibility to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
• Team player mentality with a goal-oriented approach to work
• Basic food handling knowledge (training will be provided)

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Brand Copy Manager
jobs.description:
About Bobbie

Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. No mystery ingredients. No shortcuts. Just clean, thoughtfully made formula that parents can trust.

But Bobbie has never been just a formula company. When the 2022 national infant formula shortage left parents across the country unable to feed their babies, we closed our storefront to new customers rather than leave a single existing family without formula. We went to Washington. We got loud. And we opened our Heath, Ohio manufacturing facility to make sure something like that could never happen again.

That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining.

Bobbie for Change

Our advocacy arm, Bobbie for Change, exists because making great formula isn't enough if the systems around parenthood are still broken. We fight for paid federal parental leave, push for legislation to prevent future formula shortages, advocate for feeding equity, and support families navigating impossible situations, including donating formula to parents impacted by breast and gynecologic cancers through the Bobbie Breasties program.

We're a company that genuinely believes becoming a parent makes you an activist. The people who work here feel that too.

The Role

This is a 4–5 month contract role, with the possibility to extend, covering a member of our team while she's on maternity leave. (We don't just advocate for paid parental leave, we make sure our people can take it.) We're looking for a seasoned copy leader who can step in quickly, own Bobbie's brand voice, and lead our writers from day one.

Do you live for a tagline? Agonize over the perfect ad script? Do oxford commas give you a little thrill? Bobbie is looking for a Brand Copy Manager to develop, own, and hone a differentiated brand voice across every touchpoint.

You: Are obsessed with words, character creation, and the power of storytelling. Thrive on writing as much as you do on editing. Get excited about crafting a compelling brand narrative and editing clear messaging sources of truth. Love working across creative and marketing teams to ensure Bobbie's voice is distinct, consistent, and evolving in all the right ways.

We: Are a growing team of passionate creatives and marketers on a mission to shake the stigma that surrounds parents' feeding choices.

The ideal candidate has the strategic mind of a messaging architect and the hands-on ability to execute across platforms—particularly video scripting (oh, lots of it). You will be responsible for leading messaging strategy across marketing and creative, maintaining and enforcing a brand copy style guide, and ensuring that Bobbie's voice is engaging, clear, and true to our mission.

What You Will Accomplish

• Develop & Own Brand Voice: Refine and reinforce Bobbie's unique voice across all channels, ensuring it remains consistent, compelling, and adaptable for different audiences and platforms.

• Manage a Messaging Ecosystem: Maintain and evolve a brand style guide, voice guidelines, and messaging sources of truth to ensure copy alignment across the entire business, including outside partners.

• Write & Edit Across Channels: Lead messaging strategy and execution across video, paid, email, platform, packaging, campaigns, and more—adapting tone and style as needed.

• Script Video Content: Work closely with video editors and animators to write and refine high-volume video scripts for marketing, product storytelling, and brand campaigns.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with marketing, creative, and product teams to align messaging with overall business and brand strategy.

• Ensure Strategic Messaging Alignment: Keep key stakeholders informed and aligned on messaging priorities and frameworks.

What We Would Like You to Have

• 10+ years of experience in brand copywriting (CPG, eCommerce, and startup experience preferred).

• A portfolio of compelling brand, product, or social campaigns you concepted and wrote end to end—including video scripts—that demonstrates an ability to distill complex ideas into digestible, memorable narratives.

• Experience building and managing a brand style guide and leading messaging consistency across a company.

• Skilled editing chops, an impeccable eye for detail, and an ability to elevate the work of other writers.

• A collaborator and communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and can seamlessly work with art directors, marketers, and leadership.

• A self-starter who takes ownership of projects, sees around corners, and is always thinking about how to make messaging sharper, smarter, and more compelling.

You're Inspired by Our Core Values

• Be Radical – We are change makers, rule breakers and stigma shakers. We are unapologetically bold and use our megaphone for good.

• Nurture the Tension – Parenthood is full of healthy tension, and so is building a company. We embrace the unknowns, practice humility and are a culture of learners.

• Deliver Ounce by Ounce – Our customers have entrusted us to feed their babies. We lose sleep over the details, so they don't have to.

• Don't Assume – We embrace our unique perspectives, withhold judgment, and find beauty in the paths that brought us all to Bobbie. Our strength is celebrating each other and our collective voice.

Compensation

This is a contract position. The hourly rate for this position is $85/hr.

At Bobbie, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive company. We seek to create a culture where everyone can belong because we believe that people do their best work when they can show up every day as their authentic selves. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Bobbie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: Department Coordinator
jobs.description:
Why DH Pace?

The DH Pace Company is a family-owned and privately held business with annual sales over $1 billion through 60+ offices located across the continental United States. The Company is an industry leader in the distribution, installation, maintenance, and repair of a complete range of commercial, industrial, and residential door, docking and security products. In 2026, DH Pace is celebrating its 100th anniversary in business.

Department Coordinator — DH Pace Company, Inc.

100 Years in Business | Advancement Opportunities

Build a career with a company that's been building for 100 years.

DH Pace Company, Inc., in Austin, TX, is seeking to hire a Department Coordinator who will effectively coordinate field employees. This individual will ensure that our services will meet or exceed the customer’s satisfaction. If you have experience dispatching or scheduling, this role might appeal to you!

What You'll Do

• Scheduling technicians to customer job sites and collecting, finalizing and submitting job details for processing

• Ensuring customer COD payments are collected prior to job completion

• Continually ensure technicians’ schedules are cleared of completed job tickets and that open job tickets are in correct technicians’ schedules for materials ordered, billing and voided tickets

• Run, review and manage department reports to ensure the department is meeting customer expectations and commitments

• Assist with billing paperwork and meeting customer billing document requirements

• Create and maintain service tickets to ensure service dates are met

• Work with estimating team to provide service quotes when required

• Assist field techs with technical/mechanical troubleshooting/problem solving

• Provide accurate work orders and picking lists to the warehouse for inventory pulling

• Other responsibilities as assigned

What You Bring

• Experience using Microsoft Office Suite

• Experience in a dispatch or other high volume administration field is a plus

• Must have excellent communication skills and focused on customer service

• Must have good time management skills, be organized and the ability to multi-task

• Represent the company in a professional manner

What We Offer

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage — available your first full month

• Generous paid time off plus paid holidays and floating holidays

• Company-paid life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability

• 401(k) with employer match

• Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options

• Voluntary benefits including supplemental life and critical illness coverage

• Employee discounts for you and your immediate family

• Competitive compensation with annual performance reviews

Successful completion of employment verifications, background check, drug screen, and driving record (if applicable) required in advance of hire.

Please, no phone calls or emails.

jobs.title: Principal Account Executive
jobs.description:
Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market?  Look no further than Veracode!

Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

Learn more at www.veracode.com, on the Veracode blog, and on LinkedIn and Twitter.

As a Principal Account Executive you are an experienced sales professional responsible for the full sales cycle, prospect to close within your assigned geographic territory. You will focus heavily on prospecting, selling and building strong relationships with key stakeholders in large enterprise accounts.

What you will be responsible for:

• Create and execute a strategic territory plan to attract and close business leveraging cross-functional relationships with business development and marketing as well as regional partners and system integrators

• Accurately forecast and deliver a predictable sales cycle, and understand and engage with upper management to move deals through complex sales cycles

• Challenge, consult with and inspire our prospects to think differently, beyond immediate needs, to engage in a value-based sales motion from initial discovery through proof of concept to purchase order

• Participate in industry-leading events attended by innovative cutting-edge vendors and thought leaders

Required Skills:

• 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience selling technical B2B SaaS solutions to large enterprise customers

• Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets

• Working knowledge of Force Management and MEDPICC deal qualification to identify, qualify and progress opportunities

• Ability to map and navigate complex relationships, develop and test champions, engage across all levels of the organization utilizing executive sponsors

• Team-oriented mindset

• Willingness to travel

What we offer you:

• Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs.

• Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important.

• “Take What You Need” time off policy.

• Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode.

• Generous 401k match to help save for your future.

• Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day.

Compensation Transparency

In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location.

Job Grade: Principal

Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

Here’s our recruitment promise to you:

• Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.

• Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
The ideal candidate will have anywhere from 1 year of experience in repair and maintenance (or tech school/associate degree in related field) to 6 years of experience with 4 years of experience in a maintenance/manufacturing specific field.

Responsible for equipment installation and repairs, preventative maintenance, emergency maintenance, advanced troubleshooting while applying root cause principles and other tasks necessary to address issues which arise and to provide support for plant operations.

Shift:  Monday - Friday, 7:00 am - 3:30 pm

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

• Maintenance Level IClean & apply lubricants to equipment componentsReplenish fluids for equipmentRoutine maintenance on forklifts and company vehicle.
• Maintenance Level IIAll Level I functionsInspect equipment & run diagnostic tests to discover functionality issuesTroubleshoot & repair industrial production equipment along with root cause analysisPerform thorough preventative maintenance on industrial production equipmentProvide effective assistance with equipment installations.Welding experience preferred
• Maintenance Level IIIAll Level I & IIAssist Operations Manager in inventory management of critical spare parts.Engage effectively and efficiently with vendors for parts quotes.Assist, support and train other maintenance technicians on complex maintenance issues.Act as a point of contact for maintenance team members to identify constraints and facilitate communication between production and engineering to quickly react and respond to machine issues or other factors impacting production.

High School Diploma or GED or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Maintenance I - plus 1 year experience in repair and maintenance or tech school/associate degree in related field in lieu of experience.

Maintenance II - plus three (3) years of experience in repair, or equivalent combination of education and experience.  Tech and associate degree is a plus.  Valid driver’s license/reliable transportation preferred.  Welding experience is a plus.

Maintenance III - plus six (6) years of experience in repair and maintenance field or technical/associates degree and four (4) years of experience in a maintenance related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.  Valid driver’s license/reliable transportation preferred.  Welding experience is a plus.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Core People Skills. Ability to positively interact and work collaboratively with a diverse group of people at all levels of the organization.
• Machine/Equipment Skills. Ability to read and comprehend facility and equipment drawings as well as the ability to read and comprehend equipment manuals. Knowledge of industrial production equipment. Electrical system knowledge preferred. Knowledge and use of various hand tools, multimeter, and precision tools. Trained and certified in forklift/manlift operations. Knowledge and use of various hand tools, multimeter, and precision tools. Proficient in the use of torches, plasma cutters, and other power and hand tools.
• Communication Skills. Ability to discuss job related information in one-on-one and small group situations with other employees of the organization. Ability to understand when there is a problem and report it to their supervisor in a timely manner. Ability to respond quickly and competently in emergencies.
• Customer Service. Computer/Applications Skills. Basic computer skills required to include Microsoft outlook.
• Core Business Skills. Ability to exercise sound judgement and discretion in handling of proprietary and confidential information. Strong critical thinking skills, judgment and keen attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide figures to include fractions and decimals.

Physical/Sensory Requirements

The following physical activities described here are representative of those required by an team member to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation, if feasible, will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions of position.

While performing the duties of this job, the team member is constantly required to stand; frequently required to walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel, and reach with hands or arms; occasionally required to climb stairs.  Team Member is required to lift or carry up to 25 pounds frequently, and 25 to 75 pounds occasionally.

Working Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to warm or hot conditions (non-weather), dust and hazardous materials.  The noise level in the work environment can be high.  Proper personal protective equipment is required at all times.

The minimum and maximum hourly range for this full-time position is as follows:

Maintenance I - $22.00 - $26.00 + benefits.

Maintenance II - $25.00 - $30.00 + benefits.

Maintenance III - $29.00 - $36.00 + benefits
