jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Construction Financials
jobs.description:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com.
__________________________

Senior Product Manager, Construction Financials

Built Technologies is the AI-first platform for construction and real estate finance, trusted by Goldman Sachs, Fifth Third, Ameris, and 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks to manage over $300 billion in annual capital.

As Sr. Product Manager for Construction Financials, you’ll own product strategy and execution for our platform serving construction owners and general contractors. The product has a solid foundation and significant growth potential. Your focus will be deepening our understanding of customer needs, strengthening product-market fit, and turning that understanding into product improvements that drive adoption and customer value.

You’ll lead customer discovery, rapidly test product concepts, and partner closely with engineering, design, and customer-facing teams to deliver and iterate. You’ll also identify opportunities to connect Construction Financials with lender-side workflows, creating value for customers across Built’s platform.

This is a hands-on role with ownership from strategy through delivery and post-launch outcomes. You bring solid PM experience, strong product judgment, and a track record of shipping products that deliver meaningful value to customers and the business.

What You’ll Do

• Own the product strategy and prioritized roadmap for Construction Financials, balancing owner and general contractor needs, business objectives, and technical constraints.

• Build a deep understanding of how owners and general contractors manage construction financials through customer interviews, workflow research, and feedback from customer-facing teams.

• Translate customer pain points into clear product opportunities, identifying where the existing product meets customer needs and where further iteration can strengthen product-market fit.

• Rapidly test product concepts with customers, using prototypes and focused experiments to validate assumptions before committing to broader development.

• Lead discovery, development, and launch within your area of ownership, carrying improvements through post-launch measurement and iteration.

• Serve as a thought partner for engineering and design, challenging assumptions, making clear trade-off decisions, and maintaining quality and delivery momentum.

• Define and track metrics for adoption, engagement, and customer and business outcomes, using those insights to guide roadmap decisions.

• Identify and evaluate lender-side integration opportunities where connecting construction financials workflows can create value across Built’s platform.

• Partner with product marketing and customer-facing teams to support launches, communicate product value, and bring customer feedback into ongoing development.

• Research market trends, competing solutions, and emerging technologies to inform product direction.

• Collaborate with product leadership to align your roadmap with broader platform strategy and communicate priorities and decisions clearly.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

• You are the recognized product owner for Construction Financials, with a clear, evidence-backed point of view on customer needs, product priorities, and growth opportunities.

• You have developed a strong understanding of owner and general contractor workflows and can challenge proposed solutions when they don’t fit how customers actually work.

• You have established a consistent customer discovery and concept-testing process that helps the team validate assumptions and make faster, better-informed decisions.

• You have shipped at least one meaningful product improvement with measurable customer or business impact and used post-launch findings to guide further iteration.

• You have defined the metrics that will help the team assess adoption and progress toward stronger product-market fit.

• You have evaluated relevant lender-side integration opportunities and can explain where they warrant investment relative to the team’s other priorities.

• Your cross-functional partners describe working with you as clear, efficient, and high-trust.

What You’ll Bring

• 4–7 years of experience in product management with a track record of creating products from ideation through launch and iteration.

• Experience building B2B software products that simplify complex customer workflows.

• Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery, testing product concepts, and translating feedback into product decisions.

• Experience partnering with sales and customer-facing teams to identify adoption barriers and prioritize improvements that deliver customer and business value.

• Comfortable working in an evolving product area, making trade-offs with incomplete information, and iterating quickly to strengthen product-market fit.

• Experience in construction technology or building products for construction owners and general contractors is preferred.

• Experience in a SaaS or fintech environment is a meaningful differentiator.

AI & Technology Expectations

• Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.

• Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.

• Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort through automation and AI.

• Apply AI to sharpen decision-making and strengthen strategic insights.

• Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team.

Built is the AI-first platform for construction and real estate finance, built on over $3 trillion in real estate finance data and trusted by Goldman Sachs, Fifth Third, Fulton Bank, and 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks.

Built’s salary range for this position is $135,000 - $200,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role, therefore it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.

__________________________

Travel Requirement: Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs.

Perks:

• The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1.5T industry

• Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation [US ONLY], medical, dental & vision insurance

• Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options

• Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development

• 401k with match and expedited vesting [US ONLY]

Built brings together passionate people who are driven in a variety of disciplines, each bringing their unique perspective to everything they do. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive workplace where every employee can succeed, and we recruit, hire, and promote fairly - without bias based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative

In an era of exploding content volume and complexity, the world’s most iconic brands, including Spotify, Campari, and Lacoste, trust Bynder as their single source of truth for creative content. Our industry-leading DAM platform serves as the strategic engine for brand governance and control.

We are leading the shift from management to AI-powered content orchestration. By integrating human-led, customizable AI Agents directly into our enterprise-grade infrastructure, we enable brands to augment their workforce and intelligently automate high-effort workflows without sacrificing brand integrity. We turn creative content into intelligent assets that accelerate personalization and drive measurable business outcomes.

Ready to grow your career by helping the world’s leading brands deliver exceptional content experiences? Join our global team of 600+ ‘Byndies’ and help 4,000+ organizations work smarter with their content. Explore this opportunity and apply now to join our team.

 Bynder is seeking a driven Business Development Representative to join our fast-paced team. This is a great opportunity for career growth and a break into tech sales. The ideal candidate is hard-working and goal oriented, with a “hunter” personality and a passion for sales. Our cloud-based product is utilized by over 1300+ of some of the world’s best brands like Starbucks, PUMA, and Spotify. You will be an integral member of our Sales team, responsible for generating leads and contributing to the continuous growth of our brand.


What you will do:

 - Generate new business opportunities through cold calling and prospecting

 - Work with account executives to create and manage strategic accounts

 - Effectively communicate the benefits of our products to prospects before scheduling meetings

 - Independently manage prospecting pipeline in Salesforce

 - Provide regular reports and meet quotas

 - Make 50-75 calls daily

What you have:

 - Minimum of 1 year of cold calling and selling experience

 - Exemplary and verbal communication skills

Nice to haves :

 - Enterprise technology sales experience preferred

 - Familiarity with Salesforce, SalesLoft and LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - A passion for technology sales and cloud computing

 - The ability to thrive in a fast-paced start-up culture 

About Us:

We’re proud to be a Top Workplace by the Bay Area News Group. The secret to our success is simple – we combine a great product with the best co-workers in Silicon Valley. Innovation is in our DNA. We've worked hard to build an environment that promotes creative thinking and self-initiative within a culture of fun. 

Our beautiful new office in vibrant San Carlos is open for business, but we don’t believe Byndies must be in the office to crush their goals. A hybrid approach creates the best balance. Benefits and Perks:

 - Unlimited vacation policy

 - 100% Company-paid medical, dental, vision, and life coverage for you and your family

 - 401(k) - dollar for dollar match up to 6%

 - Commuter benefits 

 - Referral bonus plans

 - Fully stocked kitchen

 - Room to advance in a high-growth tech company

 - Competitive compensation
   

Salary: We are able to offer $55K + Commission

jobs.title: Implementation Solutions Engineer (Post-Sales), Agentic AI (NY, SF, Austin)
jobs.description:
Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.


ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is a Series E, agentic AI company founded in 2017, the company has grown to 500+ employees by building AI agents that plug directly into the workflows housing and healthcare teams already use: touring, leasing, maintenance requests, resident communication, appointment scheduling, intake forms, and provider communication. The core business has real revenue and real customers. They have passed $200M in ARR and has doubled revenue five years in a row. It recently raised $350M at a $4B valuation. Large property management companies and healthcare organizations use it every day.




THE MISSION

The company's founding mission is to fix housing and healthcare with agentic AI – replacing manual, repetitive work with intelligent automation so residents, patients, providers, and staff get their time back.




THE OPPORTUNITY

As an Implementation & Delivery Solutions Engineer, you'd own enterprise implementations from the moment Sales hands the deal over until the customer goes live.

With fresh funding behind it, the company is investing heavily in this function. You'll work across a multi-product platform where every vertical has its own technical depth, so the work won't get stale.

The company has very few PMs, so Solutions Engineers drive product feedback to Engineering directly. If you want to shape what gets built as well as what gets deployed, this role does that.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run each implementation end to end: scoping, configuration, testing, go-live.

 - Work with Sales on handoffs, and with CSMs and Engagement Managers so the customer gets one consistent experience.

 - Sit down with customers, map how they actually work, and turn that into a clear plan.

 - Lead several implementations at once across product verticals.

 - Get into the data and API layer: integrations, data migration, and making sure everything lands correctly.

 - Go on-site with customers (about 25% travel) to build trust in person.

 - Pass what you learn to Product and Engineering.

 - Help build the playbooks, config templates, and onboarding frameworks the next hires will use.

 - Hand finished implementations to the Product Expert SEs who handle ongoing support.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3–7 years in a customer-facing technical role (SE, Implementation Engineer, or TAM) and owned both the tech and the relationship.

 - Experience running multiple configuration-heavy implementations at once, such as CRM or multi-vertical SaaS.

 - The ability to scope, configure, and troubleshoot API integrations and data flows without waiting on engineering.

 - A technical degree (CS, engineering, or similar).

 - A track record working with Engineering, Sales, CS, and Product.

 - Ownership of post-sales implementations at a SaaS startup, from discovery to go-live.

 - You can explain complex things clearly to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike.

 - Willingness to travel about 25% for on-site implementations, and to be in the office 4–5 days a week.

Bonus points:

 - Data migration experience, SQL and BI tools (Looker, Tableau).




KEY SUCCESS DRIVERS

 - Take ownership and drive to the finish without being chased.

 - Stay calm when the plan is still being written.

 - Work hard and move fast in a startup.

 - Build trust with customers and handle escalations.

 - Stay curious about APIs and data, and pick up new tools quickly.

 - Bring teams together around a customer.

 - Want to influence the product through what you see in the field.




WHY JOIN?

 - Compensation: 150K-200K base + meaningful equity in a company that just raised $350M at a $4B valuation. No commission or bonus, because this is a post-sales role.

 - Health & family: Medical, dental, and vision covered at 100%. Paid parental leave.

 - Logistics covered: Commuter benefits, 401(k), and relocation packages.

 - In-office, done right: Meals provided in the office. The team is in the building together 4–5 days a week in New York, Austin, or San Francisco.

 - Time off: Unlimited PTO.

 - Visa support: Open to visa transfers, including OPT and H-1B.

 - Growth and impact: $200M+ ARR and five straight years of revenue doubling. You'll build the implementation playbook and shape the product through direct feedback to Engineering.




INTERVIEWING PROCESS

 - Recruiter Screen

 - Hiring Manager Screen

 - Take-Home Practical Exercise & Presentation

 - Onsite (~2.5 hours)

jobs.description:
Hourly Pay Rate: $27.00 - $34.00

Monday to Friday:  6:00am to 3:00pm

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line automotive technician supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.

• Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.

• Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.

• Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

• Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.

• Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent

• Experience using computers

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Demonstrated functional expertise in one or more areas pertaining to Carvana’s reconditioning process

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.

• Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.

• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.

• Ability to work overtime and on weekends.

• Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Legal stuff

jobs.title: Documentation Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT LANCEDB

AI advances at the speed of its research, and research moves at the speed of its data. LanceDB is the AI-native Multimodal Lakehouse: one system where a researcher curates petabytes of video, audio, and every signal derived from them with a few lines of Python, and the next training run starts as fast as the next idea. Customers like Runway, Midjourney, and Netflix build the future of AI on LanceDB, from frontier and world models to robots and autonomous vehicles.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Documentation Engineer at LanceDB, you will make Lance and LanceDB easier to understand, adopt, and use in production. You'll work at the intersection of engineering, technical writing, and developer experience, turning complex data infrastructure concepts into clear explanations and working examples.

You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and our open-source community to document new features, build runnable examples, and keep guidance accurate as the product evolves. This role will own documentation as part of the product, with a particular emphasis on content that both developers and AI agents can discover, understand, and use reliably, while also building the tooling that keeps it accurate.

This is an opportunity to define how documentation supports a growing ecosystem of AI-assisted development and have a meaningful impact on how developers and AI agents learn and build with LanceDB.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Core documentation: Create and maintain quickstarts, tutorials, conceptual guides, API references, and troubleshooting documentation for Lance and LanceDB.

 - Documentation for AI agents: Design documentation agents can use reliably, including structured API descriptions, explicit prerequisites, complete examples, and clear error and recovery guidance. Evaluate it through agent-driven tasks to find where missing context or ambiguous instructions prevent agents from completing workflows correctly.

 - Runnable examples: Build examples and sample applications that demonstrate workflows such as data ingestion, vector search, filtering, indexing, and multimodal data management.

 - AI-assisted workflows: Use AI coding assistants and other AI tools to research the codebase, draft and revise content, generate examples, and automate maintenance, verifying outputs against product behavior and tested code.

 - Documentation tooling: Maintain documentation tooling and automate checks for code examples, API references, links, and content quality.

 - Partner closely with engineering and product teams to document new features alongside releases and keep existing guidance aligned with product changes.

 - Develop and continuously improve documentation structure, navigation, and search so developers can find the right information at each stage of their journey.

 - Use community questions, support feedback, and documentation usage to identify gaps and prioritize improvements.

 - Represent LanceDB with open-source contributors, reviewing documentation changes and establishing clear contribution guidelines.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience in documentation engineering, developer-focused technical writing, software engineering, or a related role

 - A proven track record of technical documentation, shown through a portfolio that explains complex concepts clearly and helps developers complete real tasks

 - Experience designing documentation for consumption by AI agents, with an understanding of how content structure, context, and API clarity affect agent performance

 - Demonstrated fluency with AI tooling, including coding assistants and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment about how to validate their outputs

 - Strong Python skills and the ability to write, run, and debug examples using APIs and SDKs

 - Familiarity with databases, SQL, and data workflows, plus an interest in learning vector search and multimodal AI infrastructure

 - Experience with Git, pull requests, Markdown, and documentation workflows integrated with software development

 - Demonstrated ability to learn a product by reading code, experimenting with APIs, and collaborating with engineers

 - Strong editorial judgment, attention to technical accuracy, and the ability to prioritize and work independently


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience documenting databases, data infrastructure, or AI and machine learning tools

 - Familiarity with LanceDB, Lance, Apache Arrow, or related technologies

 - Experience with TypeScript or Rust and documenting APIs across multiple languages

 - Experience with documentation platforms, generated API references, and CI-based testing of code examples

 - Experience building agent workflows, documenting tool interfaces, or evaluating agents against developer tasks

 - Contributions to open-source projects or experience supporting a developer community

jobs.title: Lead Animator
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Your main challenge

Gameloft Barcelona is looking for a Lead Animator to lead the animation team working on a new action-based, multi-platform IP featuring world-famous characters from a major licensor.

Your challenge will be to establish and maintain a high animation quality bar while leading and developing the team behind it. You will combine people leadership with strong animation expertise, working closely with Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners to ensure every animation supports the personality of our characters, gameplay readability and the overall player experience.

What it means on a daily basis

• Lead and develop the animation team, providing regular feedback, mentoring and guidance while supporting the individual growth of animators across different seniority levels.
• Own the animation quality bar, ensuring character animation delivers the expected level of movement, weight, acting, storytelling and personality while remaining consistent with the project's artistic direction and licensor expectations.
• Plan and oversee animation production, managing priorities, workload and delivery while keeping stakeholders informed and stepping into hands-on animation work when the team needs additional support.
• Collaborate closely with Game Design, Programming, Art and Technical Animation to ensure animations work effectively within gameplay, including topics related to rigging, skinning and game-engine animation states.
• Coordinate animation work with external partners, providing clear briefs, reviews and actionable feedback to ensure outsourced animation integrates consistently with the work produced internally.

What success will look like

Within your first 3 months, you will have developed a strong understanding of the project's animation direction, characters, production pipeline and team, establishing effective ways of working with the animators and key partner disciplines.

Within 6 months, you will be confidently leading animation production and team development, maintaining a consistent quality bar, identifying production or quality risks early and ensuring the team receives the direction and feedback needed to deliver.

Within 9 months, you will be a key reference for animation across the project, helping the team operate with increasing autonomy while continuously raising animation quality and strengthening collaboration between Animation, Art, Design, Programming and external partners.

Who you would be working with

You will report to the Studio Art Development Director and lead a team of 3D Animators and Technical 3D Animators.

You will work closely with the Studio Art Director, 3D Art Lead, Game Design, Programming and other production disciplines, while also collaborating with external animation partners and the project's licensor.

Your recruitment journey

Our recruitment process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet the people you would work with and explore both your animation expertise and leadership experience.

• Recruiter interview
• Hiring team interview
• Animation assessment/test, where applicable
• Final interview

Where this role can take you

This role gives you the opportunity to take ownership of animation at project level, developing both your craft and leadership expertise while contributing to a major multi-platform IP.

You will have the opportunity to grow as an animation leader, influence animation standards and workflows, develop other artists and collaborate closely with senior creative and technical stakeholders across the project.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Strong expertise in 3D character animation for games, with the ability to create and evaluate both realistic and stylized/cartoon animation.
• Excellent understanding of movement, weight, acting, timing and storytelling, with the ability to preserve the identity and personality of a character through animation.
• Ability to establish, communicate and maintain animation quality standards, translating animation principles into clear visual, written and verbal feedback.
• Strong understanding of game animation production and real-time workflows, including effective collaboration with Technical Animators on rigging, skinning and game-engine animation states.
• Ability to plan and prioritize animation work, manage production constraints and communicate clearly with stakeholders regarding scope, quality and delivery.
• Professional experience with industry-standard 3D animation tools and workflows, particularly character animation pipelines such as Maya and/or 3ds Max.
• Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively within an international and multidisciplinary development environment.
• A portfolio or showreel demonstrating strong character animation work and relevant game animation experience.

WHO YOU ARE

• A supportive people leader who can mentor and develop animators across different levels of seniority.
• Comfortable giving clear, constructive and actionable feedback while maintaining a high creative quality bar.
• Collaborative and able to act as a central point of communication between Animation, Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners.
• Organized and able to manage changing priorities in a dynamic production environment.
• Hands-on when needed, with a lead-by-example approach and the ability to balance team leadership with direct creative contribution.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year.
• Private medical health insurance.
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
• Flexible work-from-home hybrid model.
• Free language courses.
• Your birthday off!
• 1 month of remote work.
• Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career development opportunities.
• Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
• ...and Thursday after-work beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

jobs.title: Insurance Financial Reporting Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRANCH

Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible, so more people can be covered. We innovate using data, tech, and automation to simplify insurance from start to finish—we eliminated inaccurate quotes in favor of real prices, created a better way to bundle, and cut unnecessary costs in the traditional insurance process. Then we pass those savings along to our members. Basically, we’re doing insurance the way it was meant to be.

But we didn’t just create the insurance we’ve always wanted, we also created the company we’ve always wanted to work for. As we redefine insurance, we also want to redefine what it means to work in insurance. Find out for yourself.

Branch has a preference for candidates in Ohio, but is open to candidates located in AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, MD, MI, MO, NV, NC, OH, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, and WI. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Branch is remote first, with most Branchers choosing to work from home. Our headquarters are located in Columbus, Ohio, where we come together from time to time to build relationships and connect with each other in real life. We also have office space in Columbia and Concordia, Missouri as well as Forreston, Illinois. Once a year, the entire company gathers for “BranchFest”, a highlight of the year for many Branchers.

About the Role

As Insurance Financial Reporting Manager, you’ll own Branch’s statutory financial reporting, from the quarterly and annual NAIC filings through the statutory audit. You’ll bring every part of the annual statement together, and you’ll be the person who can explain what it shows. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports.

You will collaborate across the Finance, Compliance, Legal and Insurance teams, and work closely with actuarial and reinsurance, to ensure data is reliable, audit-ready, and aligned with industry regulations. Your work will help Branch leadership understand performance outcomes and support the continued evolution of our finance operations as we scale.

Key Responsibilities

 - Direct the preparation and delivery of statutory financial statements, including quarterly and annual NAIC filings, RBC analysis, and NAIC RBC forecasting tools.

 - Own the annual statement end to end, including the statement pages and Schedules B, D, F and P, coordinating each schedule with the accounting, actuarial and reinsurance teams.

 - Prepare the other statutory returns Branch files beyond the annual statement.

 - Lead the annual statutory audit, including owning the PBC list and coordinating the information needed from other departments.

 - Analyze month-over-month changes in financial outcomes and provide clear reporting to enable leadership understanding, with support from actuarial and reinsurance teams.

 - Participate in the monthly close.

 - Document and maintain financial processes to support efficient and accurate reporting.

 - Work with the Data Office to help identify and define required controls and data availability needed for accurate financial reporting.

 - Support the development of audit-ready documentation for key financial processes and controls.

 - Develop an internal control testing framework that supports a growing audit function of the future.

 - Support the review and documentation of cash handling processes and reconciliation procedures.

 - Collaborate with Insurance and Compliance teams on data or regulatory requests related to state expansion or reporting needs.

 - Contribute to special projects that help improve financial transparency, data readiness, or compliance across the organization.

Skills & Experience

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field; CPA a plus.

 - 8+ years of experience in property & casualty insurance finance or accounting, with statutory reporting at the core of that experience. GAAP experience is a plus.

 - Ownership of quarterly and annual statutory statement filings, with hands-on experience across every part of the annual statement.

 - The ability to read Schedule P across years of development and explain what it shows.

 - Experience leading or coordinating a statutory audit, including the PBC process.

 - Strong working knowledge of statutory financial reporting, controls, and insurance accounting.

 - Proficiency in interpreting financial outcomes and turning data into actionable reporting.

 - Experience with a holding company structure and consolidation up to a parent is a plus.

 - Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

 - Strong communication skills and a desire to contribute to team growth and shared knowledge.

Why join us at Branch?

We’re all about getting back to getting each other’s back - that means Branchers, too. So we provide benefits that let you work and live to your fullest.

 - Above-market salary - Branch is a data-driven company, so we do the math on salaries, too. If you get an offer from Branch, you can expect compensation that hits above the mark.

 - Pay equity and transparency - Our pay isn’t just market-driven, it’s equitable. We let experience and performance drive your success, never your gender, race, orientation, or beliefs.

 - Remote-first (with perks) - Work from where you’re most comfortable. We’ll take care of your work from home set-up and monthly internet. We also have a Columbus headquarters if you’d like to join us in an office.

 - Flexible YouTime - We don’t just let you control your own time off.  We actually encourage you to use it. After your first year at Branch, we’ll give you $1000 toward your next vacation.

 - Employee stock options - You’re not just an employee. If you’re full-time, you’re also a part-owner. You’ll have stock options so you can invest in the company you’re helping to grow.

 - Medical, vision, dental - Get all the coverage you need for a healthy, happy life.

 - 401k and contribution matching - Invest in your future. Branch helps you get to retirement on time with a portion of your contributions matched each month.

What to expect

In light of recent hiring scams across the United States, here’s what the process will look like with Branch (so you know it’s us):

 - Please apply to open positions directly through our site. If you don’t see it here, then it shouldn’t exist on another job board. If you’re ever unsure about the legitimacy of a Branch  job posting found on another site, please check the listings here to verify.

 - If you're selected to move onto the next phase of the hiring process, a member of our Branch talent team will reach out to you directly from the email domain @ourbranch.com http://ourbranch.com to guide you through our process.

 - The process will include a number of interviews, which will all happen either over the phone or on video calls.

 - We will never ask for personal payment or require you to purchase equipment during our interview process. Always be sure to protect your personal information.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

At Branch, we are deeply committed to community. Branch is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants and/or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to the individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Operational Safety & EHS Lead
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING ADVANCED AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Operational Safety & EHS Program Manager to own the programs that keep Bedrock's people, our partners' crews, and the public safe wherever our machines work. Over the next twelve months, we will rapidly scale our machine count, partners, and sites while also adding net-new machine types and a next-generation platform — each new product line and machine brings new operational, retrofit and commissioning, and partner site considerations.

This role will build and runs our inaugural EHS and Operational Safety programs, spanning human–autonomy interaction in the field, retrofit and maintenance work, test sites, and partner job sites. You'll own EHS compliance across a growing multi-state footprint and play a central role in incident management, investigation, and corrective action.

The Operational Safety & EHS Program Manager reports to the VP of Operations and partners closely with Fleet and Field Operations, Autonomy and System Safety Engineering, Hardware, Commercial, and People teams to make operational safety a critical input to deployment decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Operational Safety for Autonomous Field Operations

 - Own the operational safety program for autonomous and remotely supervised machine operations, including exclusion zones, e-stop and remote-stop protocols, safety observer roles, and human–machine interaction rules on active job sites

 - Develop and run pre-deployment site safety assessments and go / no-go readiness gates with Fleet, Deployment Operations, and System Safety Engineering

 - Lead job hazard analyses (JHA / JSA) and operational risk assessments for testing, commissioning, retrofit, and new-site launches

 - Own management of change as new machine types, hardware, and autonomy capabilities are introduced

 - Review partner Site Safety Plans and prepare Site Safety Plans for Bedrock deployments

 - Translate field learnings and safety-relevant events into feedback and requirements for Engineering

EHS Program & Regulatory Compliance

 - Build and maintain Bedrock's written EHS programs (e.g., IIPP, lockout / tagout, heavy equipment operation, fall protection, crane & rigging, high-voltage battery safety, hazard communication, heat illness, emergency action)

 - Ensure compliance with OSHA (29 CFR 1910 and 1926), Cal/OSHA, and state-plan requirements across 15+ states, including injury and illness recordkeeping and reporting

 - Own environmental compliance for field and facility operations, including fuel and fluids handling, spill prevention and response, and waste management

 - Monitor evolving regulations and industry practice for autonomous heavy equipment and advise leadership on implications

Incident Management & Investigation

 - Own the incident, near-miss, and safety-observation reporting process, including triage, escalation, and communication to leadership and partners

 - Lead root cause analyses for significant events and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to verified closure

 - Partner with Autonomy Safety and Engineering to investigate autonomy-related events using machine data and logs, and trend events across the fleet

 - Stand up and run a recurring safety review forum covering key incidents, trends, and open risks

Training, Culture & Partner Safety

 - Own the safety training matrix and onboarding for field technicians, operators, and remote supervisors

 - Support partner and general contractor safety requirements, including site-specific safety plans, prequalification (e.g., ISNetworld, Avetta), and site orientations

 - Build a visible, field-first safety culture: stop-work authority, routine site walks, and recognition of proactive reporting

 - Set safety expectations for contractors, vendors, and partners who work on or around Bedrock machines

Safety Metrics, Audits & Reporting

 - Define and track leading and lagging safety metrics (e.g., TRIR, DART, near-miss and observation rates, corrective action closure)

 - Run a field and facility audit program and drive accountability for findings across Operations

 - Deliver regular safety reporting to the VP of Operations, the executive team, and the Board as needed

 - Select and implement stage-appropriate EHS tooling for reporting, inspections, training records, and incident tracking

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Safe deployments as the fleet scales to new states, sites, and machine types

 - A documented, field-tested safety management system that scales with the business

 - Clean, audit-ready OSHA and environmental compliance across every state we operate in

 - Incidents and near-misses reported early, investigated rigorously, and closed out with verified corrective actions

 - Field teams and partner crews who know the rules, feel empowered to stop work, and report proactively

 - Operational safety data that leadership uses to make deployment decisions

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

 - 8+ years in EHS, operational safety, or safety program management, including 3+ years in heavy equipment, construction, heavy civil, mining, or industrial robotics / automation environments

 - Working knowledge of OSHA 29 CFR 1926 and 1910, with experience managing compliance across multiple sites and states

 - Experience building safety programs from the ground up in a fast-growing organization and scaling them across distributed field teams

 - Track record leading incident investigations and root cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to closure with cross-functional partners

 - Ability to influence engineers, operators, and senior leaders; comfortable making and defending stop-work and go / no-go calls

 - Strong written and verbal communication with field crews, partners, executives, and regulators

 - Strong analytical skills; able to use safety and operational data to identify trends and prioritize risk

 - Willingness to travel 30–40% to active job sites

Located in or near San Francisco preferred

Preferred

 - Experience with autonomy, autonomous vehicles, or robotics safety — particularly autonomous or remotely operated heavy machinery

 - Familiarity with machine and autonomy safety standards such as ISO 17757, ISO 12100, ISO 13849, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and UL 4600

 - Experience implementing a Safety Management System (SMS) or similar framework

 - Professional certification such as CSP, ASP, or CHST

 - Experience with general contractor safety prequalification and multi-employer job site coordination

 - Continuous improvement / Lean / Six Sigma experience

 - OSHA 30-Hour Construction (or equivalent)

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Safety is the foundation of everything we deploy. As Bedrock scales to more machines, more states, and more machine types, this role ensures our growth never outpaces our ability to protect the people on and around our job sites — and makes operational safety a core input to how and where we deploy.

jobs.title: Production Supervisor (Weekday 2nd Shift - DET)
jobs.description:
Production Supervisor (Weekday 2nd Shift - DET) | Nox Metals | Detroit, MI

 

About Nox Metals. American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company in Metro Detroit supplying aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to aerospace and defense manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to American factories faster than the industry thought possible.

 

The role. We're hiring Production Supervisors to run our floors in Detroit. Every order Nox ships starts on the floor, and you will own your shift: safety, quality, and output. You set the pace, assign the work, and train the people who run our saws. When a machine goes down or a job runs late, you are the first call and you fix it.

Part of your shift is leading: coaching your team, enforcing the standard, and passing a clean handoff to the next lead. The other part is hands on: you run the equipment and know every job on the floor. You start by learning every station in the building, and you report to the General Manager.

If you've led a crew in a factory, a metals service center, or a skilled trade, this is your next step.

 

Shift hours:

Weekdays, Second Shift: Monday through Thursday, 5:30 PM to 4:00 AM

 

You will:

· Lead your shift team, set the pace, and own the outcome for safety, quality, and output

· Assign work, set priorities, and keep the shift on the production schedule

· Train and coach team members on equipment, safety, and our software

· Enforce safety rules and PPE, stop unsafe work, and report incidents and near misses

· Run a clean handoff, pass open jobs and issues to the next shift lead

· Operate saws, CNC, and handling equipment to cut and inspect aluminum to spec

· Run forklifts and overhead cranes, we’ll train and certify you

· Record cut data and job completions in our software systems, accurately, every time

· Complete other tasks as assigned

 

You are:

· A natural leader, people follow you because of how you work, not because of a title

· A clear communicator, comfortable giving direction and holding people accountable

· Knowledgeable or experienced in a factory, metals center, or with skilled trades

· Committed to safety

· Attentive with regards to quality, every cut, every cert, every shipment

· Always thinking about how to make processes better

· Customer obsessed

· Someone who takes ownership, if it is your shift, it is your responsibility

· Self-directed, you can run the floor with a smaller team and keep production moving

· Able to lift up to 50 lbs., operate heavy equipment and be on your feet for a full shift with or without reasonable accommodation

· Not afraid to work outside normal hours when America demands it

 

Nice to have:

· Prior shift lead or supervisory experience in manufacturing

· Experience in metals, aluminum, or aerospace/defense supply chains

· Forklift and/or overhead crane certification

· Comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter

 

Benefits:

· Equity in Nox Metals

· Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance

 

This role is full time, in person in Detroit.

 

Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: IT Administrator
jobs.description:
About Nimble

Nimble is an AI robotics company building the autonomous supply chain to power fast, efficient and economical commerce. We’re training robot AGI to power a proprietary generalist supply chain superhumanoid, the first robot in the world capable of performing thousands of tasks across the supply chain. We’ve raised over $220M at over $1B valuation and formed a strategic alliance with FedEx to build a national network of autonomous warehouses capable of generating many billions in annual revenue. We are a hardcore and obsessed team of the world’s best engineers and operators. If you are obsessed with your craft, enjoy a high-intensity and fast moving high impact environment, are super high agency in getting hard things done and want to be part of building the world’s most legendary robotics company at the most pivotal moment in history, we want to work with you.

We are on a mission to empower and inspire mankind to accomplish legendary feats by inventing robots that liberate us from the menial. We will accomplish this by training robot AGI to invent and build the Autonomous Supply Chain – everything from the inside of factories and warehouses to your front door – powered by generalist superhumanoids.

Our founding team comes from the AI labs at Stanford and Carnegie Mellon and our board of directors include famed robotics and AI legends including Fei-Fei Li (Chief Scientist of AI at Google and Director of Stanford’s AI Lab), Marc Raibert (founder of Boston Dynamics), and Sebastian Thrun (founder of GoogleX, Waymo; Stanford Professor and considered the father of autonomous vehicles).

Let’s be legendary.

Link: Nimble Closes $106 Million Series C Funding Round, Scales Fully Autonomous Fulfillment with FedEx

Link: FedEx Announces Expansion of FedEx Fulfillment With Nimble Alliance

Why Join Nimble?

At Nimble, we are committed to building legendary products, a legendary team, and a legendary legacy. Join us and become part of an ambitious, humble, and resourceful culture where your work will leave a lasting impact on the future of robotics and commerce.

Nimble's Core Values:

Be relentlessly resourceful - Challenge conventions and overcome obstacles.

Be legendary - Be the very best and do work that inspires.

Be humble - Prioritize growth, learning, and doing whatever is needed to further the mission.

Be dependable - Take ownership and deliver with high agency.

The Role

Nimble Robotics is building autonomous, robot-powered fulfillment, and our IT environment has to keep pace with a fast-growing, multi-site operation. We're hiring an IT Administrator to be the generalist who keeps our people, devices, and network running and who owns the processes that make that repeatable.

You will own employee onboarding and offboarding end to end, assist with our network configuration and automations, and partner with our Compliance Officer to keep our controls and evidence audit-ready. You'll also script, integrate, and support a mixed Linux, Windows, Apple, and Android environment across our facilities.This is a fully on-site, hands-on role with the involvement with physical equipment, network gear, and in-person support at our facilities. You'll work across sites, solve problems and help shape how IT scales alongside bleeding-edge robotics logistics.

Responsibilities

• Employee Lifecycle

• Own the end-to-end IT onboarding, offboarding, and role change process across all sites, from HR handoff to closed ticket

• Maintain auditable onboarding and offboarding records, and continuously improve the process through automation

• Deprovision access promptly on departure, recover company equipment, and ensure no orphaned accounts remain

• Partner with HR, Operations, and hiring managers to keep checklists, timelines, and handoffs accurate

• Compliance and Security

• Support the Compliance Officer in implementing and operating IT controls and policies

• Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence (access lists, device inventories, configuration baselines, change records)

• Help enforce endpoint security, patching, and configuration standards across Linux, Windows, Apple, and Android devices

• Run periodic access reviews and remediate findings

• Network and Configuration Management

• Assist in the configuration, maintenance, and documentation of network equipment across sites, including switches and routers, wireless, and firewalls

• Troubleshoot network connectivity and W-iFi coverage

• Keep network diagrams, rack elevations, and other documentation current

• Automation and Integration

• Automate repetitive IT tasks

• Build and maintain integrations as needed, such as SSO and SCIM

• End-user and Site Support

• Provide day-to-day technical support for end-users on laptops, desktops, and mobile devices and their peripherals

• Deploy and maintain endpoints, servers, and peripherals across sites

• Some travel to US sites for installs, site launches, and on-site issues

• Asset Management and Documentation

• Assist in asset inventory management

• Maintain runbooks and SOPs for your areas

Qualifications

• 4-6 years experience in an IT department, or equivalent

• Experience running onboarding and offboarding, including provisioning and deprovisioning

• Hands-on Cisco IOS-XE experience: switching, routing, and wireless

• Scripting in Bash, PowerShell, or Python

• Working knowledge of firewalls

• Exposure to configuration automation such as Ansible

• Experience with Linux, Windows, Apple, and Android

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills

• Self-starter and problem solver who owns work end to end

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Identity provider and SSO/SCIM experience

• Warehouse or industrial wired and wireless networking

• Compliance or audit experience (SOC 2, ISO 27001, and/or NIST)

• CCNA, Network+, or Security+ certification

Additional Requirements

Compensation

The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $83k and $130k/year. Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this position will also receive generous equity for this position.

Culture:

We embrace challenges and strive to make the impossible possible each day. We’re not in this to do what’s easy or to be mediocre. We want to create something legendary and leave our mark on the world. We’re ambitious, we’re gritty, we’re humble and we’re relentlessly resourceful in pursuit of our goals. If this sounds like you then you might be a great fit!

Nimble Robotics, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state, federal or local laws.

Nimble's Benefits

Unlimited Flexible Time Off

Enjoy the time you need to travel, rejuvenate, and connect with friends and family.

Health Insurance

Nimble provides medical, dental, and vision insurance through several premier plans and options to support you and your family.

Paid Parental Leave

Enjoy paid bonding time following a birth.

Commuter Benefits

Take the stress out of commuting with access to fully paid parking spots.

Referral Bonus

Get a cash bonus for any friend or colleagues that you refer to us that we end up hiring.

401k

Contribute towards a 401k for retirement planning.

Equity

Be an owner in Nimble through our equity program

jobs.title: Sr. Associate, Tax
jobs.description:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry.   Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.

The Sr. Associate, Tax is an individual contributor responsible for managing the day-to-day activities related to the company’s consolidated tax provision process, investment-related tax matters, and tax technical implementation. This role serves as a technical resource across income tax accounting and emerging tax legislation, partnering closely with Finance, Treasury, Legal, and external advisors to ensure compliance and accurate financial reporting.

Tax Provision (ASC 740)

• Manage the consolidation efforts of the annual and income tax provision process under ASC 740, including current and deferred tax calculations.

• Prepare and review effective tax rate (ETR) analysis including various management metrics.

• Maintain and reconcile deferred tax assets and liabilities, including the associated valuation allowance analysis.

• Identify and incorporate the income tax provision impact of intercompany transactions, separate company calculations, and consolidated return adjustments.

• Coordinate with external auditors on tax provision review and sign-off; responding to audit inquiries and information requests.

• Enhance tax provision models, processes, and internal controls to support accuracy and efficiency.

• Prepare tax footnotes and disclosures for financial statements in compliance with U.S. GAAP.

Investment Tax

• Manage tax matters related to the company's investment portfolio, including equity investments, fixed income, alternatives, and derivatives.

• Serve as initial point of contact to facilitate information sharing between the tax investment strategy team, financial controllership, and tax operations.

• Coordinate with Treasury and Investment teams on the tax reporting impact of portfolio transactions, restructurings of existing initiatives, and new investment vehicles.

• Develop and maintain a working knowledge of our third-party investment software, including building an effective relationship with representatives of the vendor.

Tax Technical Implementation

• Serve as liaison to tax strategy to ensure proper reflection and application of their analysis, including proposed and enacted tax legislation, regulations, and IRS guidance.

• Implement tax planning opportunities, including credits, incentives, and method changes.

• Manage and respond to federal and state tax audits, notices, and information document requests (IDRs).

• Maintain tax technical library and ensure policies and procedures reflect current law.

Compliance & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Assist with preparation and review of complex federal, state, and local income tax returns, including consolidated filings.

• Collaborate with Accounting, Strategic Finance, Legal, and Treasury to facilitate tax input on business initiatives and financial reporting.

• Support junior tax staff through review, mentoring, and training on tax concepts and processes.

What You Will Have:

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

• CPA required.

• 4–7+ years of progressive corporate tax experience in public accounting (Big 4 or national firm) and/or industry.

• Strong expertise in ASC 740 income tax accounting and financial statement tax reporting.

• Demonstrated experience with investment tax matters, including alternative investments.

• Strong tax technical research and implementation skills with the ability to analyze and apply the Internal Revenue Code, regulations, and case law.

• Proficiency with tax provision software (e.g., Corptax) and Microsoft Excel.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex tax issues clearly to non-tax stakeholders.

• Interest in leveraging technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

Preferred

• Master's degree in Taxation (MST or LLM).

• Experience in financial services, insurance, or investment management industries.

• Experience with state and local tax (SALT) matters including nexus analysis and apportionment.

• Exposure to tax technology tools and process automation.

• Experience with Clearwater investment software.

jobs.title: Retail Store Manager, Sandro/Maje, Bloomingdale's, Chevy Chase
jobs.description:
SMCP - Sandro, Maje, Claudie Pierlot

Store Manager at SMCP (Sandro & Maje)

Location: Sandro/Maje, Bloomingdale's, Chevy Chase

At SMCP, we embody the essence of Parisian elegance with our renowned brands, Sandro and Maje. With a commitment to accessible luxury, we bring high-fashion designs and sustainability together, crafting exceptional products and memorable experiences. Operating in over 47 countries, we are financially stable and in an exciting phase of growth, led by a strong and experienced senior leadership team. Our culture thrives on engagement, inclusivity, and corporate social responsibility, ensuring that our success is built on both innovation and care for our planet. By 2030, we aim to meet ambitious sustainability goals, all while offering Parisian chic with a modern twist. Our collections reflect the dynamic interplay of casual elegance and evening sophistication, created for individuals who value both style and sustainability.

Why SMCP:

SMCP is more than just a fashion house—it's a forward-thinking company where innovation and sustainability come together. As we continue to lead the accessible luxury market, we focus on growth, stability, and prioritizing internal mobility for our people. With a dedicated senior leadership team guiding us, we offer a culture that fosters creativity, engagement, and meaningful career opportunities. Our collections from Sandro and Maje blend timeless Parisian style with a contemporary edge, allowing individuals to express their unique personality through fashion. Joining SMCP means becoming part of an evolving story, where passion, creativity, and sustainability are at the forefront. Together, we will continue shaping the future of fashion with a strong foundation of growth, stability, and engagement.

To learn more about our global presence and values, visit our website at SMCP Global.

At SMCP, We Style Happiness at Work—Lead with Passion and Purpose!

As a Store Manager, you’ll bring leadership, vision, and entrepreneurial spirit to your boutique, driving a dynamic and client-centric environment. With a people-first approach, you’ll develop a strong business strategy that touches on People, Product, and Planet—guiding your team to success through empathy, empowerment, and expert coaching. You will lead by example, fostering a culture of confidence, growth, and excellence that inspires your team to achieve their full potential.

In this role, you will own your business as if it were your own—creating strategies that drive key performance metrics, building long-term client relationships, and ensuring seamless store operations. From talent recruitment and development to high-level clienteling and operational expertise, you’ll be at the heart of everything that makes your boutique thrive.

What You’ll Do:

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead with vision by fostering a high-performing, positive team culture that drives engagement, collaboration, and retention.

• Recruit, mentor, retain, and develop top talent, creating an environment where team members feel empowered, supported, and motivated to grow within the organization.

Customer Experience & Brand Representation

• Act as the ultimate brand ambassador, inspiring your team to deliver exceptional customer service and create unforgettable styling experiences that reflect the brand’s identity.

• Lead clienteling initiatives by demonstrating how to build meaningful, lasting relationships that elevate the in-store experience and drive customer loyalty.

Sales Performance & Goal Achievement

• Drive key performance indicators (KPIs), including achievement of commercial target, conversion rates, units per transaction (UPT), average basket size, appointment sales, and inventory shortage.

• Motivate and guide the team to consistently meet sales goals, while identifying opportunities to improve performance and exceed expectations.

Operational Excellence & Efficiency

• Ensure seamless operations across both front and back-of-house, managing processes with precision and attention to detail to optimize store efficiency.

• Oversee and participate in daily operational tasks, ensuring compliance with company standards and fostering a smooth, organized workflow.

Business Strategy & Corporate Collaboration

• Leverage resources provided by corporate partners, serving as a key liaison between headquarters and your boutique to align strategies and maximize business success.

• Implement corporate initiatives effectively, adapting them to meet the specific needs of your team and store while driving overall performance.

Who You Are:

• 2-3+ years of prior supervisory experience, preferably in luxury retail management.

• Prior experience managing in a commission environment is a plus

• Prior merchandising experience

• A natural leader with strong coaching, communication, and people development skills.

• Passionate about client relationships and creating a high-touch, personalized shopping experience.

• Results-driven and strategic in decision-making, with a focus on achieving KPIs.

• A strong recruiter who attracts top talent to build a high-performing team.

• Achieve talent acquisition targets including open to hire percentage and hiring speed

• Achieves staff turnover goals

• Highly organized, adaptable, and solutions-oriented in managing store operations.

• A brand ambassador who embodies SMCP’s core values and vision for modern luxury.

• Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, is required.

• Fully versed in front and back of house.

Join a Career That Fits Your Life:

At SMCP, we provide more than just a job—we provide a path to grow, thrive, and be part of something exceptional.

Your talent and dedication are rewarded with a 50% shopping discount, and a seasonal wardrobe offering, so you always feel confident in the latest collections—because style starts with you. We also provide a cell phone contribution, keeping you connected and equipped for success.

We know that security and well-being matter. That’s why we provide comprehensive health, dental, life, and disability coverage, an employer-matched 401(k) with immediate 100% vesting, and paid time off—including vacation, holidays, sick time, and personal days—plus paid parental leave and pet benefits. You’ll also have access to resources like our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), which includes personalized guidance, expert care, and mental health support through every stage of life, along with MAVEN Family Planning, providing additional support for family planning and wellness.

Through extensive product knowledge training, industry insights, and the opportunity to earn more through our Monthly and Seasonal Bonus Incentive Plan, you’ll refine your expertise, elevate your skills, and make a lasting impact on the client experience. With mentorship and professional development support, plus a dynamic, engaging workplace where your contributions truly matter, you’ll discover a career that’s as fulfilling as it is inspiring.

At SMCP, you’re not just an employee, you’re a valued part of a team that celebrates passion, creativity, and excellence. With a dynamic, engaging workplace and a people-first culture, you’ll find a career that’s as rewarding as it is inspiring.

Ready to lead with confidence and style? Apply today and become part of the SMCP Dream Team!

jobs.title: Director - Regulatory Compliance (Private Funds)
jobs.description:
This position demands a high level of accuracy, critical thinking, and independent problem-solving, and a strong focus on quality and results. The role involves analyzing complex compliance issues and developing, implementing, and testing compliance programs for clients in the alternative and traditional investment sectors. It requires professionalism, sound judgment, and adaptability to client-driven schedules, while also supporting regulatory exams and outsourced Chief Compliance Officer functions.

What you’ll do

• You'll independently manage client engagements, providing strategic compliance guidance with minimal oversight from senior leadership
• You’re responsible for ensuring timely and accurate completion of client deliverables, including annual reviews, regulatory filings, and updates to compliance policies and procedures
• You will lead client trainings, mock regulatory exams, and provide hands-on support during SEC and FINRA examinations
• You’ll stay on top of regulatory changes, guide clients in developing internal controls, and offer practical solutions to complex compliance issues
• You will help foster a collaborative team culture, mentor junior staff, and support firm-wide initiatives such as business development and and operational excellence beyond client work

What we offer

• IQ-EQ offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being and work-life balance.
• Employees receive generous paid time off, including 4 weeks of PTO that increases over time, sick time and paid holidays, and financial wellness is supported through a 401(k) plan with a company match (subject to eligibility).
• Health benefits include medical, dental, vision, mental health support and additional ancillary insurance plans.

• The salary for this position will be dependent on experience and location ($160,000 - $180,000).

• You have a strong knowledge of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 and the Investment Company Act of 1940.

Our commitment to you and the environment

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 25 countries - to each achieve their potential.  Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

jobs.description:
Account Executive

*Non-Remote, In-Person Opportunity. *

The Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.

jobs.title: Director of Financial Planning & Analysis
