Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Department: Finance
Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
Location: Remote within Aspire Living & Learning’s service area; periodic travel required - MUST RESIDE IN VT, CT, MD, NH, & MA
Employment Status: Full-time, Exempt
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., with flexibility as needed
Hours: 40 hours per week
Salary Range: $120,000–$135,000 annually

About the Role

Aspire Living & Learning is seeking an experienced Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to provide strategic financial leadership across the organization. Reporting to the CFO, this role leads budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, performance analysis, and long-term financial planning.

The Director of FP&A partners with executive leadership, operational leaders, program teams, and the broader finance department to turn complex financial information into clear, actionable insights. This position supports data-informed decision-making, organizational growth, program innovation, risk management, and long-term financial sustainability.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strategic finance professional who is passionate about supporting a mission-driven nonprofit organization and improving services for the individuals and communities Aspire serves.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Financial Planning

• Partner with the CFO and senior leadership to develop and implement Aspire’s financial strategy.

• Lead multi-year financial planning in support of organizational growth, service delivery innovation, and long-term sustainability.

• Provide financial analysis, recommendations, and decision support for executive leadership and Board reporting.

• Evaluate financial risks, opportunities, and the potential impact of strategic initiatives.

Budgeting and Forecasting

• Lead the organization-wide annual budgeting process, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and operational realities.

• Develop rolling forecasts, scenario analyses, and financial models to anticipate risks and opportunities.

• Establish and maintain standardized budgeting tools, templates, and processes across programs and departments.

• Partner with operational leaders to improve budget development, monitoring, and accountability.

• Analyze budget-to-actual results and identify trends, variances, and corrective actions.

Financial Analysis and Reporting

• Deliver timely, accurate, and meaningful financial reporting to executive and operational leaders.

• Translate complex financial data into clear insights and recommendations for non-financial stakeholders.

• Develop, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to financial and operational performance.

• Prepare financial impact analyses for program expansions, strategic initiatives, funding opportunities, and organizational investments.

• Improve reporting processes, analytical tools, and financial data visibility across the organization.

Leadership and Collaboration

• Build strong working relationships with program, operational, and administrative leaders.

• Strengthen financial literacy and decision-making capabilities across the organization.

• Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of financial analysts.

• Promote a culture of transparency, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the finance department.

• Collaborate with accounting, grants management, compliance, and other teams to support financial integrity.

Compliance and Risk Management

• Support compliance with applicable financial policies, regulations, funding requirements, and reimbursement models.

• Partner with accounting, grants management, and compliance teams to promote accurate and reliable financial information.

• Assess financial risks related to funding streams, reimbursement structures, program growth, and operational changes.

• Recommend and support risk mitigation strategies.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.

• At least 8 years of progressive experience in financial planning, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial leadership.

• Experience working in a nonprofit, human services, healthcare, behavioral health, education, or similarly complex service organization preferred.

• Demonstrated expertise in financial modeling, scenario planning, forecasting, budgeting, and management reporting.

• Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to translate financial and operational data into actionable recommendations.

• Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Experience collaborating effectively with executive leaders and stakeholders at all organizational levels.

• Experience supervising, mentoring, and developing high-performing finance or analytics teams.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling.

• Experience with financial systems, ERP platforms, budgeting software, and reporting tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master of Business Administration (MBA), master’s degree in finance, or related advanced degree.

• Experience with nonprofit financial management, grants, contracts, or reimbursement-based funding models.

• Experience supporting program expansion, organizational growth, or multi-site operations.

• Familiarity with data visualization, business intelligence, or financial planning and analysis software.

Core Competencies

• Strategic agility

• Financial acumen

• Business insight

• Financial modeling and analysis

• Collaboration and relationship building

• Results orientation

• Communication and data storytelling

• Leadership and team development

• Integrity and professionalism

• Continuous improvement

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

• This position operates primarily in a professional remote or office environment.

• Periodic day and/or overnight travel may be required within Aspire’s service area.

• Occasional evening or holiday work may be necessary to meet operational needs.

• The position requires routine use of computers, telephones, copiers, and audio/visual equipment.

• Physical requirements may include prolonged sitting, standing, walking, speaking, reaching, bending, balancing, and using fingers to handle or feel.

• The employee may occasionally lift or carry items weighing up to 10 pounds.

• Close vision is required for reviewing documents and working with computer equipment.

• Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Why Join Aspire Living & Learning?

Join a mission-driven organization where your financial expertise can directly support sustainable growth, operational excellence, and meaningful services for individuals and families. As Director of FP&A, you will have the opportunity to influence organization-wide strategy, strengthen financial decision-making, and help Aspire advance its mission.

Employees at Aspire enjoy working with a collaborative and dedicated team that values a culture of belonging and care. We take pride in offering a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

• Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance - Choose from multiple medical plans, with vision coverage included at no extra cost.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Saving Account (HSA) options - Use pre-tax dollars for medical and dependent care expenses.

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts with JOON - Monthly funds for wellness, fitness, commuting, childcare, pet care, and more.

• Generous Paid Time Off - Paid sick, personal, and vacation days, plus holidays.

• Professional Growth Opportunities - Access to training, leadership and management courses, mentorship, and career advancement.

• Employer-Paid Life & Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Telehealth Services and more!

If you want to join us in making a difference and positively impact the lives of others while charting your own path of development, then we at the Aspire team would love to hear from you.

Aspire Living & Learning believes it must play an active role in creating a community of employees that is diverse, inclusive and equitable. jobs.title: GTM Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role exists to build the systems that keep our GTM engine fast, accurate, and scalable. We’re looking for a technical, systems-minded individual with experience improving how GTM teams operate. You’ll work across Sales, Marketing, and Engineering to design and implement better workflows, connect data across systems, and build tools that help our teams move faster and operate more effectively.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how people work, translating that into system design, and building technical solutions that make operating the machine easy and efficient.



You will be expected to have strong software foundations even if you use AI to implement (understand what good code looks like, how to structure and architect solutions across data systems).




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work with Sales, Marketing, and other GTM teams to optimize how to deliver 5-10x scale in moving leads and onboarding members through our systems

 - Collaborate with Engineering to ensure clean and consistent data pipelines and integrations across CRM and internal tools.

 - Improve the operating system that connects Sales, Marketing, and Member Experience by identifying system gaps/bottlenecks and shipping fixes. Design workflows, automations, and systems that improve the speed and quality of GTM execution.

 - Build a roadmap based on GTM needs, data insights, and your own observations.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience in technical product, sales ops, data engineering, software, or other ops roles.

 - You’re a systems thinker who likes understanding how processes fit together across teams.

 - High levels of persistence to find a way through complex constraints.

 - You can build software within the constraints of existing infrastructure (not 0 → 1 AI coding)

 - You communicate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Strong data fundamentals.

 - Ability to build reports to investigate problems, analyze results, and drive action from insights.

 - Affinity towards measuring and sharing impact of implemented solutions across stakeholders

 - Experience with CRM tools or working with GTM teams.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Growth team sets the pace for how fast Base can deliver affordable, reliable power to the people who need it. We operate as one team across marketing, sales, support, product, and design, lean and high-ownership. Everything we build comes back to one question: are we solving people's problems? We're building the world's most beloved company.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Strategic Program Manager, Agency
jobs.description:
At MNTN, we put our people first, full stop. This allows our company culture to be defined by our team members and their shared values, like trust, ambition, quality, radical honesty, and compassionate leadership. It’s why we all really love working for the Hardest Working Software in Television™ (and also why we were named one of Ad Age’s Best Places To Work in 2026.)

We pride ourselves on bringing unrivaled performance and simplicity to Connected TV advertising. Our self-serve technology makes running TV ads as easy as search and social, helping brands drive measurable conversions, revenue, site visits, and more. It’s what led MNTN to being named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2023. You can learn more about us and everything we do by visiting https://mountain.com/.

We’re committed to innovation that empowers, not replaces. At MNTN, AI is a tool for growth, enhancing efficiency while keeping a people-first approach. Our goal is to streamline workflows and drive new solutions—without compromising the human element that makes our company great.

So if wanting to do more, own more, and make a bigger impact comes naturally to you, then you may be the person we're looking for to join us in our next stage of growth.

Strategic Program Manager, Agency

MNTN is expanding what brands and agencies can achieve with Performance TV. We’re seeking a Strategic Program Manager, Agency to help our agency partners deliver measurable results and build the processes, insights, and expertise that support long-term growth.

This role combines hands-on account optimization with program development and partner enablement. You’ll work closely with Sales and Partner Management to help agency accounts hit performance goals, turn broader account trends into actionable insights, and equip key agencies with the best practices to succeed on MNTN.

What you’ll do

• Build repeatable processes for agency sales motions. Develop playbooks and workflows that support agency evaluation, onboarding, account launches, and expansion, with clear responsibilities and handoffs across Sales and Partner Management.

• Turn account trends into insights and case studies. Analyze performance across agencies and their advertiser portfolios to identify patterns, surface successful strategies, and develop evidence-backed stories that inform client recommendations and sales conversations.

• Optimize Performance TV accounts to achieve client goals. Support the Partner Management teams to monitor performance against agreed-upon KPIs, identify opportunities, and execute optimizations across audience strategy, budget allocation, creative, and testing in partnership with account teams.

• Project Management for Agency Programs: Support our agency pods in implementing partnerships plans for top agencies. Project management across co-marketing initiatives, co-development and MCP/ tech integrations across key agencies. There is a heavy XFN element to the role.

• Lead enablement and best-practice training for key agencies. Create and deliver practical training, workshops, and resources that strengthen agencies’ ability to plan, launch, measure, and optimize Performance TV campaigns.

• Bring agency learnings back into the business. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to address recurring challenges, share successful approaches, and improve the agency experience.

What you’ll bring

• 7+ years of experience in digital advertising, performance marketing, advertising technology, or agency account strategy, with direct responsibility for campaign performance.

• Hands-on experience optimizing paid media against business outcomes such as cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and conversion volume; connected TV or Performance TV experience is a plus.

• An understanding of how agencies evaluate media partners, manage advertiser portfolios, and make campaign and budget decisions.

• Demonstrated analytical skills, with the ability to identify meaningful trends across accounts and translate them into practical recommendations and compelling client stories.

• Strong 3rd party measurement tool expertise. E.g. Northbeam, Triplewhale, Fospha, Workmagic, Measured.

• Experience building processes, playbooks, or programs that make cross-functional teams more effective.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, including experience leading client conversations, training sessions, or partner enablement.

• The ability to build trusted relationships and influence internal teams and external partners without direct authority.

• Strong project management skills and the ability to balance immediate account needs with longer-term initiatives in a fast-moving environment.

• Proficiency with spreadsheets, reporting platforms, and CRM tools such as Salesforce.

What success looks like

• You will develop repeatable processes that Sales and Partner Management adopt to streamline agency onboarding, accelerate account launches, and support expansion across advertiser portfolios.

• You will help agency accounts make measurable progress toward their performance goals, turning account trends and testing results into actionable optimizations, best practices, and credible case studies.

• You will equip key agency partners with the training, tools, and confidence to plan, launch, measure, and optimize Performance TV campaigns, building a foundation for long-term growth with MNTN.

• You will help scale agency enablement to ensure best practice adoption and advertiser success.

About MNTN

Our recruiters will always reach out using an email address ending with @mountain.com OR @mntn.com. If you’re contacted by someone without that address and they mention a Reference Code (which we never use), then that ain’t us folks. Tell those trolls to take a hike–you’re waiting to climb a MNTN.

MNTN provides advertising software for brands to reach their audience across Connected TV, web, and mobile. MNTN Performance TV has redefined what it means to advertise on television, transforming Connected TV into a direct-response, performance marketing channel. Our web retargeting has been leveraged by thousands of top brands for over a decade, driving billions of dollars in revenue.

Our solutions give advertisers total transparency and complete control over their campaigns all with the fastest go-live in the industry. As a result, thousands of top brands have partnered with MNTN, including Tarte, Decked, and National University.

Centerfield’s digital experiences and digital brands, such as Business.com http://Business.com and BroadbandNow.com http://BroadbandNow.com, reach more than 150 million in-market shoppers annually. Centerfield is headquartered in Silicon Beach and is proud to be recognized by Built in LA as a Best Place to Work in Los Angeles.


The Opportunity...
You will own and grow a book of ~100–125 insurance agents, helping them acquire in-market auto and home insurance customers through exclusive, consumer-initiated inbound calls. These consumers are connected in real time via warm transfers from our pre-qualification call center, sourced from high-quality online experiences, including AutoInsurance.com http://AutoInsurance.com.


This is a revenue-forward role. Success requires a sales mindset and comfort operating around conversion rate, cost per call, and cost per policy (COA). You are responsible for driving measurable outcomes across your book.


How You’ll Contribute...

 - Own and grow a book of ~100–125 accounts at ~$5K/month in spend

 - Drive revenue through upsell, cross-sell, and new campaign creation

 - Build and manage portfolios of campaigns across targeting, filters, and pricing

 - Lead performance conversations using conversion rate, cost per call, and COA

 - Align bids and structure to achieve profitable customer acquisition

 - Identify underperformance and take action on pricing, targeting, and expectations

 - Partner with media and operations to improve call quality and volume

 - Maintain retention through consistent performance and value delivery


What We’re Looking For...

 - 4+ years in account management or sales, ideally in performance marketing, lead gen, or insurance

 - Comfortable owning a revenue number and managing a high-volume book

 - Strong grasp of conversion rate, CPA/COA, and ROI

 - Ability to turn data into clear actions and recommendations

 - Confident communicator on pricing, expectations, and results

 - Comfortable picking up the phone and leading conversations; not an email-only role

 - Experience managing multiple campaigns within an account

 - Proficient in Salesforce and Excel

 - Organized and accountable


How We Operate...
You should be comfortable discussing conversion to policy and COA with agencies. Our clients tend to realize ~18–30% conversion rates, so that’s generally where the conversation starts.

We connect in-market auto and home shoppers with the right agent and carrier, aligned to coverage and price. The model is built on continuous optimization across quality, routing, and pricing.

We take our relationships with carriers and agents seriously, with an emphasis on performance, transparency, and long-term growth.


Reality of the Role...

 - High-activity, performance-driven environment

 - Expected to drive growth, not maintain

 - Conversations focused on outcomes, not activity

 - Comfortable pushing on pricing, account setup, and setting realistic expectations so agents can realize their full potential within our marketplace

WellPower envisions a community where every person’s mental health is fostered through strength, resilience and hope. We empower people to overcome barriers and achieve lasting well-being through collaborative behavioral health care and comprehensive support.

Our Guiding Principles:

• Person Centered. We honor people’s identities, lived experience and journeys and treat every person with the dignity we all deserve.

• Exceptional Care. We offer compassionate, innovative services that meet people where they are, from immediate support to long-term recovery.

• Organizational Resilience. We meet the moment and adapt to changing contexts with collaborative creativity, agile business processes, and financial stewardship.

Position Summary:

The Bilingual Intensive Treatment Clinician provides trauma-informed, culturally responsive, community-based mental health services to children, adolescents, and families experiencing significant behavioral health needs. This position serves youth enrolled in Homebased and STAY SAFE programs, providing stabilization-focused interventions for individuals experiencing acute mental health concerns, including suicidal ideation, recent suicide attempts, family conflict, trauma-related symptoms, and other behavioral health challenges. Services are delivered in homes, schools, clinics, and other community settings throughout the Denver Metro area.

The clinician provides individual therapy, family therapy, crisis intervention, safety planning, and care coordination while working collaboratively with families, schools, medical providers, and community partners to improve stability, functioning, and long-term outcomes.

Compensation & Benefits:

• LPC/LMFT/LCSW: $34.78/hour - $72,342.40/year

• LAC Differential - $1.00

• Language Differential - $1-$2.50/hour for bilingual proficiency in Spanish or ASL

• For complete overview of our robust Benefits: https://wellpower.org/workplace-of-choice/

The posted range represents the full hiring range. Offers will not exceed this range, the majority of candidates are placed near the midpoint based on experience and qualifications.

Job Duties & Functions:

• Provide intensive family therapy and crisis intervention in the home and in the community.

• Research, create, and maintain connections to services and resources to minimize out of home placement and hospitalization.

• Develop short-term treatment plans; continually monitor treatment progress, and coordinate transitions to other services.

• Stabilize acute conditions, family supports, and environments to allow the child to benefit from other levels of care.

• Take responsibility for crises, including on-call duties, with own consumers and weekly rotating on-call duties for other homebased clinicians’ consumers.

• With supervision, learn and implement "best practices" among in-home family treatment models, e.g. Brief Strategic Family Therapy.

• Working with psychiatrists, nurses, and other professionals, help coordinate medication/medicinal needs of consumers with medical resources.

• Transport consumers

• Maintain accurate and timely clinical records consistent with Corporation standards.

• Participate in team meetings, in-services, and supervisory sessions as required.

• Perform 27-10 (M-1) “mental health hold” evaluations.

• Maintain a trauma informed environment of wellbeing.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

• May require occasional evening or weekend hours. Local driving required.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

Requirements & Qualifications:

Education:

• Master’s Degree in psychology, social work, or other related human services degree required

• Must be licensed as an LCSW, LPC or LMFT by the State of Colorado.

Experience:

• Knowledge, experience, and skill in clinical modalities used in family therapy.

• Experience with cross-agency collaboration, treating aggression, family conflict, parental depression/mental health issues, and trauma

• Must have valid CO driver license and good driving record.

• Own the roadmap and day-to-day administration of LeanData and Outreach, including workflow configuration, troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, BioPharma Platforms
jobs.description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.

Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials.  Rigorous science and careful analysis is critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.

As a Staff Product Manager, Biopharma Platforms, you will shape and drive the core digital platforms that power clinical development  and translational research pipelines. In this high-impact strategic role, you will bridge cutting-edge cloud software engineering, clinical trials, machine learning, and clinical research, transforming clinical workflows into seamless, scalable platform capabilities. You will champion platform product thinking across PathAI, ensuring our engineering and clinical  teams and biopharma partners can discover, develop, and deliver transformative therapies with unprecedented velocity.

Key responsibilities include:

• Define and execute the multi-year product strategy, vision, and roadmap for enterprise biopharma platforms supporting translational research and clinical development

• Lead end-to-end product development lifecycles from customer discovery and problem framing through MVP prototyping, technical requirement definition (PRDs), backlog prioritization, and enterprise-scale rollouts.

• Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory, Quality, and Data Governance teams to architect platform standards compliant with GxP, data privacy regulations, and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) validation frameworks where applicable.

• Establish product telemetry, quantitative adoption metrics, and reliability benchmarks to measure the velocity, scientific impact, and operational health of platform services.

• Champion platform product management best practices, mentoring cross-functional team members and advocating for modular, interoperable system architectures.

• Act as the strategic partner to senior scientific leaders and biopharma collaborators, aligning technical platform investments directly with enterprise pipeline milestones and portfolio priorities.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You hold a Bachelor’s or advanced degree (Master’s/Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Computational Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

• You possess 7+ years of product management experience, with a track record of conceptualizing, building, and scaling enterprise platforms, data infrastructure, or SaaS products for healthcare.

• You bring proven experience driving software and data products within life sciences, biotechnology, digital health, bioinformatics, or clinical research environments.

• You are an exceptional communicator and influencer who effortlessly navigates technical, scientific, and executive stakeholders to drive consensus and strategic alignment.

Preferred

• You have an advanced degree in Computer Science, Computational Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated success delivering platforms that support machine learning operations (MLOps), digital pathology, multi-omics, or regulated clinical trial analytics.

• Practical understanding of regulatory validation and quality compliance in biopharma or diagnostics (e.g., 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, HIPAA, GDPR, SaMD).

• Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced R&D environments while balancing long-term architectural stability with agile feature delivery.

This is a US based position based in Boston, MA (preferred) or remote.
Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $146,250 - $224,250.  Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
DevOps Engineer II

Who We Are
OpenEye, the cloud video platform company, provides solutions for video security, business intelligence, and loss prevention. For over 20 years, OpenEye has been committed to developing an easy-to-use, comprehensive video management system backed by Heroic Customer Service® and support. Our on-site and cloud-based products can be found protecting schools, hospitals, banks, retail stores, and other facilities worldwide. OpenEye’s solutions are available globally through our trusted network of certified service providers.

OpenEye is a subsidiary of Alarm.com. Learn more at www.openeye.net .

OpenEye is proud to be one of the 2023 Best Places to Work in the Inland Northwest. Ready to join a casual, fun, and creative culture? Apply to join our team!

Job Summary
OpenEye is seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer II to play a key role in our DevOps Engineering Team. In this individual contributor role, you will drive up to production-level DevOps tasks, contribute technical expertise, and add significant value to our organization. The ideal candidate is a strong programmer or scripter, excels in working within a collaborative team, and operates independently in complex operational and production environments.

As a DevOps Engineer II, you will be responsible for the managing the cloud environment, assisting developers with the release and deployment of software, building, maintaining, and monitoring the health of the environment using a combination of technical proficiencies, organizational aptitude and interpersonal skills, as well as learning and progressing with evolving technology, including advance agentic workflows. You’ll leverage your expertise to improve our DevOps workflows, debug challenging issues, and ultimately independently oversee deployments and production systems.

Role and Responsibilities

• Maintain highly available AWS-based infrastructure for global video and related services.

• Provide recommendations for platform scalability, performance, and cost optimization.

• Optimize CI/CD pipelines that deliver releases faster and more reliably.

• Automate environment provisioning, system updates, and security patch workflows.

• Collaborate with developers to containerize workloads and streamline service deployments.

• Partner with the SRE team on advanced monitoring and alerting systems and to define and maintain service-level objectives (SLOs) and ensure they are met consistently.

• Utilize infrastructure patterns with security, scalability, and compliance in mind, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and future certification readiness.

• Assist in production deployments ensuring consistent adherence to compliance and operational procedures.

• Diagnose live production issues, identify root causes, and ship fixes.

• Assist with cloud cost optimization by refining resource allocation and scaling strategies.

• Other duties as assigned.

The Tech Stack
AWS, Docker, K8s, Grafana, OTEL, Agentic AI, Git, GitOps, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, MySQL, CrateDB, and more.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of DevOps or related experience.

• Strong AWS knowledge, including scaling, networking, security, and automation.

jobs.title: Senior Client Manager
jobs.description:
CTS delivers comprehensive IT solutions to meet the unique demands of mission-driven organizations. We have deep expertise in supporting nonprofits and educational institutions, however our team is equipped to handle the complexities of IT across a variety of sectors. We’re committed to making technology work seamlessly, so our clients can focus on making a difference, regardless of their industry.

At CTS, we believe in building a company culture that fosters growth, collaboration, and innovation. By joining our team, you will not only help empower businesses with cutting-edge IT solutions but also build a rewarding career in a dynamic and supportive environment. Discover the many reasons why CTS is a great place to advance your career. We are headquartered in Brooklyn, NY with 90+ employees across the US and several other countries.  Learn more about us at https://www.charterts.com

JOB OVERVIEW

As a Senior Client Manager, you are the primary advocate and trusted advisor for a set of clients within CTS. Clients will often contact you to purchase new technology equipment, to escalate a service request, or to discuss a new technology initiative within their organization. Sometimes they’ll just be looking to you as an expert to answer a question they have about IT.

You’re responsible for keeping the pulse of your clients and bringing in the right resources from within CTS to get your clients the answers they need. Above all, you are managing the relationship with each of your clients and are working to ensure their experience with CTS is an excellent one.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop strong relationships with key client contacts and identify clients who may be at risk.

• Monitor client health via monthly internal reviews to ensure all clients are happy, profitable, and carrying minimal technology risks.

• Complete recurring tactical check-in calls with clients to review their health and open issues.

• Complete recurring and one-off training events (such as Lunch & Learns) with clients on core technologies such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Smart Boards.

• Advocate for clients by answering questions and ensuring issues are escalated properly across all departments in CTS. This includes ownership of the Potential At Risk Client (PARC) Process.

• Complete Strategic Assessments and 1-3 Year IT Budgets.

• Regularly consult with your clients to provide them with solutions to meet their technology requirements and develop/present technical proposals working in tandem with our Solutions team.

• Own the overall opportunity pipeline, ensuring that we meet our NRR forecast each quarter.

• Address client questions with regards to ongoing invoicing.

• Occasionally manage Projects for clients based on available capacity and client requirements.

• Occasionally participate in discussions with Prospects as a resource to New Sales Team.

• Work with client contacts to develop referrals for new business.

QUALIFICATIONS | SKILLS

• 6+ Years of work experience, ideally within a technology services business.

• RECOMMENDED: Relevant experience in an IT role such as IT Support, Engineering, or as a Technical Account Manager at a Managed Services Provider.

• Understanding of core network infrastructure concepts, such as switches, wireless, firewall, and WAN connectivity.

• Experience administering, implementing, or consulting with clients regarding Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, as well as other cloud services.

• Project Management Certifications (CAPM, PMP) are a plus!

• Strong written and oral communication skills.

• Ability to occasionally manage multiple projects with competing deadlines and associated teams.

• Ability to handle multiple tasks with a clear sense of ownership and priority.

• Strong Microsoft Office or Google Apps skills, especially Excel / Sheets.

• Self-motivated, able to move and adapt to rapidly changing priorities & client needs.

WORK SCHEDULE & LOCATION

The hours for this position are typically 9 AM to 5:30 PM EST, with some occasional after-hours work required based on client requests. This position is hybrid based out of Brooklyn, NY. Local travel throughout NYC (5 boroughs) and occasional regional travel is expected. It is acceptable to work from home when not at client locations, with the expectation of working in our Brooklyn office at least 1 day per week.

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $100,000 to $120,000 annually.

BENEFITS

• Competitive compensation

jobs.title: Civil Bridge Inspector
jobs.description:
Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

Olsson provides construction management, administration, and observation services for both public and private projects to ensure work is performed in conformance with project documents. Our construction services include daily observation/inspection, project documentation, submittal review, design support, shop drawing review, and oversight of materials testing. We provide technically qualified personnel for our clients’ specific project requirements.

As a Civil Bridge Inspector, you will play a key role in the inspection and evaluation of bridge and structural construction projects. Your primary responsibilities will include performing and coordinating inspections of bridges and related structures, interpreting project plans and specifications, ensuring construction activities comply with applicable standards, and documenting construction progress in accordance with project and regulatory requirements.

You will work closely with construction managers, engineers, contractors, and clients to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with design intent. This role requires a strong understanding of structural components, materials, and construction practices specific to bridges.

You will travel to various job sites at different stages of construction and work in a variety of terrain and weather conditions.

This position includes:

• The use of a company truck for transportation to and from job sites.

• Applicable PPE (personal protective equipment) provided.

• Work boot reimbursement program.

• Company-issued laptop.

• Cell phone reimbursement options.

• Opportunities for continued training, mentorship, and professional development.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

• Working collaboratively with others.

• Having ownership in the work you do.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You bring to the team:

• Strong communication and documentation skills.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, construction management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• A minimum of five (5) years of experience in bridge inspection, structural inspection, or construction inspection related to transportation structures.

• Knowledge of ODOT/OTA standards, NBIS requirements, and bridge inspection procedures preferred.

• Experience with bridge components such as decks, substructures, superstructures, and rehabilitation work.

• Certification(s) such as OSHA 10/30, NBIS (or ability to obtain) preferred.

• The ability to work in a constant state of alertness and in a safe manner.

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving history.

• Ability to lift and carry 50lbs.

• Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including occasional extended hours based on project needs.

jobs.description:
The role…

At Soho House, the Bartender is responsible for preparing alcoholic and nonalcoholic beverages, serving food and providing excellent service accompanied by memorable experiences to all guests and members who visit a Soho House & Co. property. As a Bartender you are an extension of the brand, management team and global food and drink program. As a result, you will be responsible for professional behavior, charismatic and positive energy to create a fun environment that drives conversation and sales.

A successful Bartender will greet customers, learn and remember their preferences, answer questions, recommend menu items, and prepare and serve beverages. You will also upsell items, create recipes, utilize proper equipment and ingredients, and handle basic cleaning duties. To succeed as a Soho House Bartender, you should have a neat appearance and an engaging, friendly personality. You should be efficient, observant, knowledgeable, and personable with a thirst for all things craft cocktails!

Main Duties

• Follow steps of service and company guidelines for preparing cocktails, juices, coffee and drinks used at the bar

• Maintain a clean and organized section as well as collaborate with other bartenders to; wash glassware and utensils after each use, Clean up after customers and clean work area

• Educate guests and members about beverage options learned through House Tonic trainings

• Discuss and describe daily specials, seasonally influenced menu items and food pairing options to promote additional sales through creating optimal experience for dining

• Collect payment on all sold items and operate a cash register

• Check identification of customers to make sure they meet age requirements for purchase of alcohol and tobacco products as well as determine when a customer has had too much alcohol

• Arrange bottles and glasses to make attractive displays that promote specific beverage options and can increase overall sales and member / guest experience

• Serve customers in a friendly and helpful manner

• Monitor and maintain an inventory of supplies and delegate replenishment of items to Barbacks

• Mix ingredients according to drink recipes to maintain a globally unified beverage program and consistent experience

• Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor/manager

Required Skills/Qualifications

• 2+ years’ experience working in high-volume F&B operation

• Craft cocktail experience and working with seasonally influenced perishable items

• Experience making coffee drinks a plus

• Ability to multitask and deliver drink requests in a timely and efficient manner while maintaining consistency

• Strong communication and people skills

• Flexible schedule and reliable

• Tips certified

• Micros a plus

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to seize, grasp, turn and hold objects with hands.

• Must be able to work on your feet for at least 8 hours.

• Fast paced movements are required to go from one part of the club to others.

• Must be able to move, pull, carry or lift at least 40 pounds.

• Occasionally kneel, bend, crouch and climb as required.

Why work with us...

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career.

jobs.title: Senior Internal Audit Manager
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is seeking a seasoned Senior Internal Audit Manager to join our Internal Audit team. In this senior individual contributor role, you will operate with significant autonomy and influence, leading our most complex and highest-visibility operational audits across the business and partnering directly with senior leaders to evaluate risk, strengthen processes, and shape how the business makes decisions. This position requires strong business acumen, excellent analytical and communication skills, and the ability to independently manage complex audits from planning through reporting, while bringing a point of view that senior stakeholders seek out before decisions are made.

The ideal candidate brings deep operational audit experience, business process and enterprise risk expertise, data analytics capabilities, and a passion for leveraging emerging technologies, including the use of AI embedded into audit activities to improve audit quality and efficiency. You hold yourself and the function to a standard of integrity that never bends to timeline pressure, and you escalate control or policy gaps with a proposed solution, not a workaround. Beyond executing audits, this role sets the agenda for its areas of coverage, drives durable remediation of systemic risks across the organization, serves as a sought-after voice before key decisions are made, and raises the standard for the broader audit function. This is NOT a SOX-focused role. Instead, the position emphasizes operational audits, business process and enterprise risk assessment, and strategic partnership across the organization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead complex, ambiguous, and high-visibility operational audits and advisory engagements from planning through reporting, often spanning multiple functions, systems, or geographies, with full accountability for quality, timelines, and deliverables.

• Set the risk assessment and audit agenda for your areas of coverage, determining scope, depth, priorities, and appropriate trade-offs.

• Proactively identify untapped risks or improvement opportunities ahead of the audit plan, and pressure-test whether the function’s coverage and priorities are ambitious enough - not just execute against what’s already scoped.

• Develop risk-based audit objectives, scope, and testing procedures aligned with business and organizational priorities.

• Conduct process walkthroughs, control testing, data analysis, and evidence evaluation to assess the effectiveness of business processes and controls.

• Identify systemic risks, control gaps, and process improvement opportunities; assess root cause and business impact; and develop practical recommendations.

• Drive accountability for remediation of significant and systemic issues to sustainable resolution - regardless of where formal ownership sits - by building alignment across stakeholders, including where you do not have formal authority.

• Prepare and present clear, concise audit reports that communicate findings, business impact, root causes, and recommended actions to senior stakeholders.

• Leverage data analytics, predictive techniques, AI, and emerging technologies to enhance risk identification, audit coverage, insight, efficiency, and quality, while applying appropriate professional judgment and validation.

• Build durable, repeatable solutions - through automation, standardized methodology, or AI-enabled approaches - that are adopted beyond your own engagements and continue to operate without requiring your ongoing involvement.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to business and functional leaders, proactively bringing a risk, control, and process point of view into strategic initiatives and key business decisions before they are finalized - and being direct when you disagree with the course being taken.

• Support Internal Audit operations and broader CFO organization initiatives, including planning, performance metrics, methodology for IA and Finance-org wide learning, capability building, and talent development.

• Set a high standard for audit quality and professionalism and coach, mentor, and develop other auditors.

• Manage multiple complex tasks effectively prioritizing competing demands while maintaining a high standard of quality, judgment, and attention to detail.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 10+ years of internal audit, operational audit, risk advisory, or related experience focused on business operation processes including a track record of independently leading complex, high-visibility audits.

• Track record of mentoring colleagues at multiple levels, contributing to hiring, and helping shape standards and practices for the broader function, not just coaching your immediate project team.

• Deep understanding of business processes, enterprise and operational risk, risk assessment methodologies, and internal control concepts across diverse functional areas.

• Demonstrated ability to influence and partner with senior leaders and drive alignment, change, and remediation across functions without formal authority.

• Proven experience identifying systemic issues, performing root cause analysis, and driving sustainable remediation.

• Experience conducting process walkthroughs, control testing, evidence evaluation, and audit reporting.

• Proficiency using data analytics to support risk assessment, audit planning, testing, and insight generation.

• Hands-on experience using AI, audit technologies, or other emerging technologies to improve audit effectiveness and efficiency.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to provide practical, risk-based advisory support beyond traditional assurance engagements.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated track record of senior leaders adopting your recommendations and changing decisions as a result.

• Experience supporting Internal Audit operations and improving audit processes, methodology, reporting, or functional capabilities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

• CPA or CIA certification preferred. CISA or other relevant professional certifications are a plus.

• Experience within the technology industry and/or a Big 4 accounting firm is preferred.

#LI-TH3,  #LI-ONSITE

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The annual base salary range is:

$168,000—$252,000 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

• Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

• Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

• Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Join us and bring your best.

Pure and simple.

jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

Overview

The Service Delivery Manager owns the customer journey from signed agreement through go-live, including new implementations and customer migrations. This role translates scope into an executable delivery plan, leads customer kickoffs, manages schedules and dependencies, coordinates cross-functional resources, and drives environments successfully into production.

This is a technical service delivery role requiring strong working knowledge of cloud and private cloud infrastructure, virtualization, networking, storage, backup, and disaster recovery. While Engineering owns technical execution, the Service Delivery Manager owns the plan, timeline, communication, coordination, and overall delivery outcome.

The Service Delivery Manager also develops and maintains the standards, processes, documentation, and project artifacts used to deliver consistent customer implementations and migrations at scale.

The compensation range for this position is between $125k-$155k.

Responsibilities

Implementation & Migration Delivery

• Own the customer journey from signed agreement through go-live, including scope, planning, sequencing, delivery, and customer communication.
• Lead technical implementations and migrations using structured project management practices, including kickoffs, schedules, milestone tracking, risk management, status reporting, and formal go-live sign-off.
• Manage private cloud migration programs, including multi-wave and multi-customer migrations.
• Coordinate dependency mapping, resource sequencing, network and IP changes, cutover planning, rollback criteria, and post-cutover validation.
• Own and improve time-to-value for Managed Cloud implementations.
• Identify and escalate delivery risks, dependencies, and blockers early with clear mitigation or recovery plans.
• Maintain scope discipline and ensure changes are addressed through appropriate change-control and commercial processes.

Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership

• Serve as the primary delivery owner and escalation point throughout implementation and migration projects.
• Coordinate Engineering, Solution Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Sales, and other stakeholders around a single delivery plan.
• Partner with Sales and Solution Engineering during complex pre-sales engagements to support discovery, evaluate delivery risk, estimate effort, and validate feasibility.
• Ensure customer expectations, contractual commitments, delivery plans, and internal execution remain aligned.
• Lead customer kickoffs that establish scope, responsibilities, prerequisites, timelines, escalation paths, communication expectations, and definitions of completion.

Process & Delivery Standards

• Build and maintain the Managed Cloud implementation playbook, including kickoff templates, onboarding plans, runbooks, welcome materials, and standard project artifacts.
• Develop, document, version, and maintain SOPs for implementation and migration processes.
• Partner with technical and customer-facing teams to ensure processes are practical, scalable, and aligned with actual delivery capabilities.
• Develop documentation appropriate for different audiences, including technical runbooks, internal enablement materials, and customer-facing onboarding resources.
• Drive adoption of established processes through training, reinforcement, measurement, and review.
• Facilitate post-mortems and incorporate customer and internal feedback into continuous process improvement.
• Identify opportunities for automation and partner with Engineering and Product to reduce unnecessary manual effort.

Program & Team Leadership

• Maintain program schedules across multiple customers, migration waves, dependencies, resources, and critical-path activities.
• Report implementation status, capacity, risks, and delivery performance to Managed Cloud leadership.
• Establish scalable project management practices as implementation volume grows.
• Hire, develop, and lead project managers and migration coordinators as the function expands.
• Travel approximately 5–10% as business needs require.

Additional Expectations

• Demonstrates and promotes the company's Impact Behaviors in all interactions and decision-making.
• DesignOwnershipFirst TeamPerformance
• Maintains a professional, collaborative, and client-focused approach while supporting team and organizational objectives.
• Performs other duties, responsibilities, and special projects as assigned to meet business needs.

Qualifications

Required

• B2B customers, including at least 2 years supporting mid-market or enterprise engagements.
• Strong working knowledge of cloud and private cloud infrastructure, virtualization, compute, storage, networking, backup, and disaster recovery.
• Experience delivering cloud or infrastructure migrations involving platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, or managed hosting environments.
• Experience managing migration activities including discovery, dependency mapping, wave planning, cutover planning, IP and DNS changes, rollback criteria, and post-cutover validation.
• Experience supporting projects from pre-sales discovery and scoping through implementation and production delivery.
• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex project schedules involving dependencies, resource sequencing, milestones, and critical-path activities.
• Experience developing and implementing delivery processes, SOPs, runbooks, and repeatable project standards.
• Strong technical writing skills with the ability to produce clear and actionable documentation.
• Demonstrated ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
• Experience with Agile delivery practices, including backlogs, prioritization, stand-ups, acceptance criteria, and iterative delivery.
• Strong project management fundamentals, including work breakdown, dependency management, risk tracking, change control, and executive-level reporting.
• Direct customer-facing delivery experience with mid-market or enterprise stakeholders.
• Experience using project management or PSA tools such as Linear, Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday, Kantata, or similar platforms.
• Ability to independently manage complex projects, identify risks, escalate concerns, and drive work through completion.

Preferred

• Experience within managed hosting, managed cloud, private cloud, or MSP environments.
• Experience managing repeatable, multi-wave migration programs.
• Agile delivery certification such as CSM, PSM, or SAFe; demonstrated experience is valued over certification.
• Experience applying Scrum or Kanban methodologies within customer delivery environments.
• Experience defining and implementing self-service and human-led delivery models.
• Experience building or scaling a project management or service delivery team.
• Experience supporting Nutanix migration programs.

Key Performance Indicators

• Maintain customer onboarding satisfaction of 90% or higher, with feedback collected and addressed following completed implementations.
• Achieve on-time delivery of 90% or higher against customer commitments established during project kickoff.
• Improve average time-to-value from signed agreement through go-live by 30% within 12 months.
• Deliver migration programs according to approved schedules without unplanned customer-impacting downtime attributable to planning or coordination.
• Establish and maintain standardized implementation processes and project artifacts across new Managed Cloud implementations.
• Maintain documented scope baselines and change logs for active projects.
• Improve early customer retention and satisfaction through consistent implementation quality.
• Increase the number of successfully implemented customers willing to serve as customer references.

Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

• While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to speak and hear
• While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to use hands for keyboarding, gross manipulation, and fine manipulation
• Works at a desk and computer screen for extended periods of time
• Works in a traditional climate controlled office environment or from home
• Works in a highly stressful environment dealing with a wide variety of challenges, deadlines and diverse employee population

Disclaimer

This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of the position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all job responsibilities, tasks, or duties. Additional duties and tasks may be assigned as part of the job function. Liquid Web Inc. reserves the right to modify, interpret, or apply this job description in a way that best supports the organizational needs. The job description in no way creates or implies an employment contract. The employment contract remains “at will”.

jobs.title: Partner Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

We’re looking for a fast, creative, forward-thinking professional who has a strong background in retention. You’re the right fit for this role if you are comfortable with figuring things out as you go, defaulting to action, and adapting to additional responsibilities. You’ll have a proven record of achieving your goals and the goals of your team.

What you get to do every day

• Provide comprehensive, end-to-end support to our key partners, acting as a relationship manager. Employ proactive and reactive measures to ensure a "white glove" experience for our most valued payroll partners.

• Serve as the primary point of contact within Human Interest for all payroll and CPA partners, providing general reactive support and handling escalations.

• Act as a liaison between internal teams to facilitate the development and implementation of solutions, and ensure these resolutions are communicated effectively to partners.

• Develop, propose, and implement solutions tailored to partner needs to increase retention and satisfaction.

• Assist with maintaining and further developing the partner support teams' standard operating procedures documentation.

• Communicate any blockers or potential risks to leadership as soon as they arise to mitigate potential risks to reputation.

• Always be ready to share your wins and what you're working on to show leadership the impact you're making and help shape what we do next.

What you bring to the role

• 3+ years of experience working in a Partnership, Sales, and/or business development environment

• 3+ years of experience with innovative strategic partnerships for consumer-facing, web services, and SAAS products

• Demonstrated capacity to anticipate partner needs, identify challenges proactively, and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment, all while sustaining a positive attitude.

• You don't wait for others to act on your behalf; you proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they escalate.

• Experience in developing and leveraging strategic insights to foster and/or improve business relationships

• Ability to translate complex business problems into easy-to-understand concepts for external stakeholders

• Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills using tools such as Google Docs, Google Slides, Google Sheets, and/or equivalent Microsoft products

• Experience facilitating meetings, handling external partner escalations, and conducting proactive service outreach

• Experience using a CRM platform (preferably Salesforce) to forecast sales and draw insights from service performance metrics

• Strong understanding of the Human Interest partner process, demands and needs for continued success

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

• Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.

• Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.

• Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!

• An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.

• Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

jobs.title: Senior Field Truck Technician
jobs.description:
Kodiak Robotics, Inc. was founded in 2018 and has become a leader in autonomous ground transportation committed to a safer and more efficient future for all. The company has developed an artificial intelligence (AI) powered technology stack purpose-built for commercial trucking and the public sector. The company delivers freight daily for its customers across the southern United States using its autonomous technology. In 2024, Kodiak became the first known company to publicly announce delivering a driverless semi-truck to a customer. Kodiak is also leveraging its commercial self-driving software to develop, test and deploy autonomous capabilities for the U.S. Department of Defense.

We are looking for Field Technicians to join us in maintaining and repairing our vehicles out in the Permian Basin in West Texas.

What we offer:

• Our Senior Field Truck Technicians in Kermit, TX start anywhere from 39/hr - in addition we offer $1500 annual bonus, OT, and RSU's!

• Housing provided with Free hot meals

• Competitive benefits, including medical, dental & vision.

• 14/7 ROTATION

• & More!

In this role, you will:

• Be responsible for maintenance and modifications to autonomous vehicle platforms, including trucks, trailers, and autonomous systems

• Repair modular and sub-systems and related harnesses on the bench and in-vehicle

• Inspect and certify the operational health of trucks, trailers, and Autonomous Vehicle platforms

• Work closely with design and validation engineers to aid in the development of hardware systems

• Execute work according to scheduled preventative maintenance and demand of related upkeep programs

• Support material staging and workflow readiness for remote tasks and field based teams

• Provide technical coverage when needed in other locations

• Maintain a safe and clean work environment

• Coordinate the replenishment and distribution of consumed items used in maintaining vehicle operations.

What you'll bring:

• Ability to read, inspect and implement directions, as outlined and depicted in Electrical Harness Diagrams and Mechanical Prints

• Experience with industry based tooling including specialized electrical and mechanical tooling such as: wire crimpers, multimeters, oscilloscopes, torque wrenches, fabrication tooling and hand tools.

• Proficient with diagnostic instrumentation related to trucks and the ability to perform failure analysis on related components

• Solid hands-on background. The ability to rely on previous experience or training to inspect and identify defects and failures on complex systems. These range from visual to operational in nature and can generate aptitude in learning Autonomous Vehicle diagnostics and repair

• Reliability and consistency. You have a track record of meticulous work. You are comfortable developing and practicing methodical service through the use of checklists, protocols, and work documentation

• Clear communication. You are comfortable providing feedback to engineers, and sharing insights with the team at large to improve products and processes. You know how to collaborate, and when to get secondary inspection and review for safety-critical decisions

• Innovative mindset. You like to find ways to improve the system you are working on. You can solve problems and complete tasks even when the path to the solution is not clear at the outset

• Flexibility for working hours and days. Daytime/night/weekend shifts are being hired for. Periodic travel back to main locations for short term cross training and support.

• Experience in the energy sector is a bonus
