jobs.title: Supervisor, Logistics (Materials Management) - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SUPERVISOR, LOGISTICS (MATERIALS MANAGEMENT) - 3RD SHIFT

The Cape Logistics team plays a vital role within the Materials Management organization, overseeing the daily transport and distribution of materials essential to the refurbishment and launch of SpaceX rockets. Our mission is to set the industry standard in logistics performance through a strong safety focus, exceptional on-time delivery, and operational excellence. We are seeking a highly motivated 3rd-shift Supervisor to lead and support the day-to-day logistics operations at our Cape Canaveral facility. This role is responsible for fostering a strong safety culture, managing team performance, and ensuring timely and accurate receipt and movement of critical materials. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and creative leader with a passion for continuous improvement and a commitment to exceeding customer expectations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Promote a strong safety culture through the enforcement of company safety policies.

• Cultivate a team culture that embraces change, encourages innovative thinking, and supports the evaluation and implementation of process improvement ideas.

• Oversee administrative functions, including timecard approvals, team scheduling, performance reviews, fleet management, and direct report development through regular one-on-one mentoring and training.

• Ensure compliance with Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and site-specific transportation policies, including those related to oversized loads and hazardous materials.

• Monitor and support the achievement of operational metrics and performance goals.

• Implement and enforce best practices for loading, unloading, and transporting materials in alignment with company procedures and industry standards.

• Manage and delegate Transportation Move Requests tasks effectively to ensure timely resolution and maintain high performance against due dates.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with shipping, receiving, inventory, production coordination, quality control, planning, purchasing, and other departments to resolve material handling and distribution challenges.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for audits and ensure the team’s readiness for inspections and compliance evaluations.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient work environment by driving continuous improvements in workspace layout and design.

• Perform additional duties as assigned to support an efficient, safe, and productive work environment.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

• 3+ years of experience in logistics, transportation, receiving, distribution, supply chain, or materials management.

• 1+ years of leadership or supervisory experience in an operational environment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) at the time of application.

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year university, with a minimum of 2 years of experience in materials management, supply chain, or a related field.

• In-depth knowledge of transportation processes and procedures specific to Federal property and Cape Canaveral operations.

• APICS certification such as Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM) or Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP).

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a demonstrated ability to lead and build effective teams.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook).

• Experience building AI applications with demonstrated operational efficiency gains.

• Working knowledge of transportation regulations and compliance standards, including DOT, 49 CFR, and IATA.

• Ability to work a flexible schedule, including second shift and weekends, as required to support operational needs.

• Strong commitment to meeting deadlines, maintaining accountability, and communicating operational changes or challenges proactively to leadership.

• Experience with Lean or Six Sigma methodologies; Green or Black Belt certification is a strong plus.

• Previous experience in aerospace, aviation, or automotive manufacturing environments, with a solid understanding of the logistical demands and compliance requirements in high-performance industries.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work 3rd shift: 5:00pm - 3:30am

• Willingness to work extended hours, including evenings and weekends, as required to meet operational demands.

• Ability to perform physical tasks associated with the role, including lifting up to 50 lbs., standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying.

• Flexibility to support a dynamic work schedule, including varied shifts and on-call availability to support mission-critical activities.

• Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: IT Help Desk Supervisor
jobs.description:
Cranial Technologies is the only company in the world completely dedicated to researching and treating plagiocephaly (commonly called flat head syndrome). With over 500,000 babies successfully treated, we are the plagiocephaly experts and the leader in pediatric cranial shaping orthoses.

Cranial Technologies also provides treatment with EarWell® to correct infant ear shapes without surgery. With over 600,000+ successful outcomes, EarWell® is a proven, non-invasive treatment option for families.

We are looking for a IT Help Desk Supervisor to join our growing team.

The IT Help Desk Supervisor leads first- and second-tier support across the organization, ensuring timely, professional, and effective service. Serving as both a people leader and senior technical resource, this role supervises support staff, manages queues and escalations, coordinates hardware and software delivery, and partners with IT teams and business leaders to resolve issues. The Supervisor maintains a positive outlook while anticipating problems to drive practical solutions.

This position is 100% in office at our Headquarters in Tempe, AZ.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Helpdesk Operations

• Oversee daily operations and ensure appropriate coverage during business hours.

• Monitor incidents, service requests, and queues; manage assignments, priorities, aging and escalations to meet service-level expectations.

• Track and report performance metrics to ensure high-impact or business-critical incidents are escalated promptly.

• Coordinate support for hardware, software, networks, telecommunications, printers, mobile devices, and business applications.

• Serve as the escalation point for complex issues and coordinate with Infrastructure, Network, Security, Applications, and other IT teams.

• Keep users informed of outstanding incidents and address recurring problems by working with the appropriate teams on root causes.

Team Leadership & Supervision

• Provide direct supervision and day-to-day leadership to Helpdesk technicians and support staff.

• Assign workload and ensure work is distributed appropriately across the team.

• Establish clear expectations regarding technical support, customer service, documentation, communication, and professionalism.

• Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with team members to provide coaching, mentoring and technical guidance.

• Identify training opportunities and create development plans for Helpdesk employees.

• Participate in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training new Helpdesk employees.

• Conduct performance evaluations and provide ongoing performance feedback.

• Address performance or attendance concerns in accordance with company policies.

• Encourage knowledge sharing and cross-training to reduce dependency on individual team members.

Incident & Request Management

• Ensure all support requests are properly documented within the organization's IT Service Management platform.

• Establish and maintain ticket categorization, prioritization, assignment, escalation, and closure standards.

• Review aging tickets and actively drive resolution of overdue requests.

• Ensure tickets contain sufficient troubleshooting notes, resolution details, and user communication.

• Manage escalations from employees, managers, executives, and business departments.

• Coordinate response to widespread technical incidents and outages.

End-User Technology

Oversee support for the following technologies:

• Windows workstations and laptops; Microsoft 365; Teams; Outlook and Exchange Online

• Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and multifactor authentication (MFA)

• VPN and remote access; Remote Desktop environments

• Mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and conference-room technology

• Business applications, network connectivity, Wi-Fi, VoIP, and telecommunications

• Ensure technicians follow standardized troubleshooting procedures before escalating incidents.

User Lifecycle Management

• Oversee IT onboarding and offboarding activities.

• Ensure new employees receive required hardware, software, accounts, licensing, and access before their start date whenever possible.

• Coordinate account creation and access requests with appropriate IT teams.

• Ensure terminated employee access is disabled according to established procedures.

• Oversee collection, reconfiguration, and redistribution of returned IT equipment.

• Ensure Helpdesk processes follow approved identity and access-management practices.

• Review requests for access changes and ensure proper authorization is obtained.

Endpoint & Device Management

• Assist with deployment and management of company computers and mobile devices, including endpoint configuration through Intune or other management platforms.

• Ensure endpoints meet company configuration and security requirements.

• Coordinate operating system upgrades, application deployments, patches, and device replacements.

• Maintain accurate hardware and software inventories and manage equipment lifecycle processes, including procurement coordination, deployment, repair, replacement, and retirement.

• Identify aging or problematic equipment and recommend replacement strategies.

IT Service Management & Process Improvement

• Develop, document, and continuously improve Helpdesk procedures.

• Create standardized troubleshooting workflows and escalation paths.

• Maintain a knowledge base of common issues and documented resolutions.

• Identify opportunities for automation and self-service.

• Reduce repetitive manual support tasks wherever practical.

• Work with IT leadership to establish service-level objectives and Helpdesk performance standards.

• Recommend improvements to tools, processes, staffing, and technology based on support trends.

• Support the development and adoption of company standard operating procedures (SOPs), including those involving teams outside IT.

Security & Compliance

• Ensure Help Desk activities comply with cybersecurity policies and protect confidential, sensitive, and patient information.

• Verify user identity before password resets or access changes; apply least-privilege principles when granting access.

• Immediately escalate suspected phishing, malware, compromised accounts, and other cybersecurity incidents.

• Support endpoint security, MFA, encryption, patching, device compliance, security awareness, and compliance initiatives.

• Apply relevant company requirements, including HIPAA and FDA 21 CFR Part 11, as applicable.

Vendor, Budget & Service Delivery

• Coordinate IT hardware and software delivery at new and existing clinics.

• Manage vendor relationships, including business reviews, requests for proposals, issue resolution, and cost-saving opportunities.

• Assist with annual capital and operating budget planning and management, including service agreements and computer-replacement plans.

• Manage telecommunications services, including company cellular devices and internet connections; share responsibility for supporting cloud-based VoIP services.

• Drive continual improvement in processes, cost efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

ROLE EXPECTATIONS

• Communicate technical information clearly to nontechnical users and provide realistic expectations and regular status updates.

• Remain professional with urgent or frustrated users and prioritize issues by business impact, not solely by order received.

• Understand the business impact of technical issues, build strong relationships across departments, and help employees work effectively.

• Apply IT service management frameworks and standards, including ITSM and ITIL.

REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 5+ years’ experience in Information Technology.

• 3+ years’ experience in a supervisory or management role.

• Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written.

• Strong knowledge of Windows desktop operating system and experience supporting Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory environments.

• Experience with endpoint and mobile-device management technologies and an IT Service Management or ticketing platform.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, authentication, and business applications.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, documentation and organizational skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality, manage competing priorities, troubleshoot independently and engage specialized IT teams when needed.

We offer an excellent benefits package:

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Insurance

• 401k Retirement Plan

• 18 Days of Paid Time Off plus 7 company-paid Holidays

• Life Insurance

• Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

• The salary range for this position is $75,000 - $95,000 and is dependent on the applicant's relevant skills and experience.

Headquarters Address: 1405 W Auto Drive Tempe, AZ 85284.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Florida Candidates Only: We are an employer covered by AHCA's screening program and the person who fills this position will be required to complete this screening. No action is required on your part, and we will reach out once that screening is required. More information can be found here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com/

You will receive a confirmation email stating your application has been submitted. If selected for next steps, you will receive a text and/or email notification from Cranial Technologies Recruiting. **Please keep an eye on your spam and junk mail**’

Please no phone calls to the clinic or offices regarding the position.

If you are unable to submit your application, please email the recruiting department at careers@cranialtech.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Senior Insurance Manager
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is seeking a Senior Insurance Manager to lead our global corporate insurance and risk-transfer program and protect enterprise value across our scaling operations.

Reporting to the Corporate Treasurer, you will serve as Everpure’s primary subject-matter expert for corporate insurance, risk financing, and contractual risk transfer. You’ll own our global insurance portfolio and develop capital-efficient strategies across property, casualty, financial, supply chain, and specialty risks.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role partnering across Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Credit, HR, InfoSec, and Facilities to identify emerging exposures, optimize our total cost of risk, and ensure our insurance strategy evolves alongside the business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead Global Insurance Strategy & Renewals: Own Everpure’s global corporate insurance portfolio across property, casualty, financial, and specialty lines. Lead end-to-end annual renewals, including exposure analysis, underwriting submissions, market negotiations, coverage structure, limits, deductibles and retentions, binding, and policy issuance.

• Optimize Risk Financing & Capital Efficiency: Develop Everpure’s risk-retention and risk-financing strategy, using quantitative analysis to evaluate commercial insurance, self-insurance, retention, and alternative risk-transfer structures. Assess captive insurance opportunities and support implementation and governance where economically justified.

• Manage Trade Credit & Financial Risk Protection: Partner with Credit and Finance to manage Everpure’s trade credit insurance program, monitor customer exposures against insurer limits, and optimize protection of receivables and financial performance.

• Mitigate Supply Chain & Operational Risk: Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Facilities to assess exposures across contract manufacturers, suppliers, inventory, transit, and logistics providers. Evaluate stock throughput, cargo, property, business interruption, catastrophe, and concentration risks and drive solutions to close material coverage gaps.

• Establish Contractual Risk-Transfer Standards: Serve as the enterprise authority on insurance and risk allocation within commercial contracts, partnering closely with Legal on indemnification, additional insured requirements, subrogation, liability terms, and other contractual risk-transfer provisions.

• Lead Claims, Loss Prevention & Risk Engineering: Oversee significant insurance claims and work with brokers, adjusters, carriers, and Legal to maximize recoveries. Coordinate site inspections, risk engineering, and property/catastrophe evaluations, driving remediation of recommendations that improve Everpure’s overall risk profile and insurability.

• Evaluate Emerging & Strategic Risks: Assess the insurance and risk-financing implications of new business models, products, global expansion, M&A, and other strategic initiatives as Everpure grows.

• Drive Insurance Analytics & Executive Governance: Build and maintain risk-financing analytics covering premiums, limits, deductibles, losses, claims, and total cost of risk. Provide executive reporting on coverage strategy, emerging exposures, and the effectiveness of Everpure’s risk-financing framework.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Deep Corporate Insurance Expertise: 10+ years of progressive corporate insurance, risk management, or brokerage experience, with demonstrated expertise managing complex, multi-line insurance portfolios and global renewals across property, casualty, financial, and specialty lines.

• Risk Financing & Quantitative Acumen: Strong experience evaluating insurance structures, retention strategies, total cost of risk, and alternative risk-transfer solutions, with the ability to translate quantitative analysis into clear business recommendations.

• Complex Operational Risk Experience: Experience navigating insurance and risk within a global technology, hardware, manufacturing, or similarly complex operating environment. Exposure to supply chain, stock throughput, cargo, trade credit, captive structures, or M&A risk is highly valued.

• Commercial & Contractual Risk Expertise: Strong understanding of contractual risk transfer and the ability to advise Legal and business partners on indemnification, liability allocation, insurance requirements, and related commercial terms.

• Executive & Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to operate as a trusted subject-matter expert across Finance, Legal, Operations, and executive leadership, influence decisions without direct authority, and communicate complex risk concepts in clear business terms.

• Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, or a related field. CPCU, ARM, CRM, or other relevant professional designations are a plus.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

#LI-TH3,  #LI-ONSITE

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The annual base salary range is:

$168,000—$252,000 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

• Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

• Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

• Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Join us and bring your best.

Bring your bold.

Pure and simple.

jobs.title: Senior HR Partner
jobs.description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will...

• Grow with an Ownership Mindset: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place.

• Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike: At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.

• Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose: We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward.

Shift: M-F, 3:00 pm- 11:00 pm

Location: 4779 Hanoverville Rd building 200, Bethlehem, PA 18020

Role Description:

The Sr. HR Partner is a hands-on role that serves as the People Team representative within their assigned ShipBob Innovation (Fulfillment) Center and Hub location, tasked with providing full cycle Human Resources support to all employees, managers, and regional directors within the assigned location(s). In addition, you will work closely with our business leaders to execute HR initiatives and strategies to guide organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, workforce planning, and compliance within your assigned location. This role reports to the Manager, People Experience.

What you’ll do:

• Serve as the first point of contact for employees to resolve issues and conduct investigations partnering with People Team Leadership, HRBPs, and Legal as needed.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date human resource records and documentation, upholding compliance guidelines and regulations by performing periodic audits.

• Train, coach, and counsel managers on people matters.

• Partner with 3rd party staffing agency on-site representative to ensure proper staffing.

• Participate in recruiting events and career fairs both onsite and offsite.

• Source, schedule, coordinate, and conduct new employee interviews for hourly roles.

• Facilitate new hire onboarding training and ensure new hires are processed correctly with all required paperwork and approvals being completed properly.

• Conduct new hire check-ins with all associates.

• Participate in ShipBob Culture Committee and support Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).

• Establish, plan, coordinate, and participate in employee retention efforts at assigned location(s) in partnership with site General Manager.

• Host employee office hours / open door hours

• Facilitate the smooth exit of employees by maintaining a consistent offboarding process to include acting as the HR representation during involuntary separation meetings and conducting exit interviews with voluntary separations.

• Track employee attendance and manage disciplinary write-ups.

• Participate in the progressive discipline and PIP process for associates within assigned location(s).

• Provide support and communication to employees regarding new People Team initiatives and programs.

• Present at site monthly town hall and start-up meetings.

• Monitor, address, and communicate key people metrics monthly with site leadership.

• Administer periodic employee satisfaction surveys and compile results as scheduled by the company.

• Provide training and resources to the onsite Leadership team.

• Partner with operations on worker’s comp and return to work processes.

• Additional duties, projects, and responsibilities as necessary or assigned by the Manager, People Experience, Director, HR Business Partner and the People Leadership team.

• Additional duties and responsibilities as necessary.

What you’ll bring to the table:

• Bachelor's degree in human resources or related degree and a minimum of 5 years of Human Resources experience.

• Bilingual in English/Spanish.

• SHRM or SPHR Certification.

• Solid understanding of Labor related laws and statutes.

• Prior experience working in a fulfillment center, warehouse, or manufacturing facility.

• Ability to understand and interpret data as well as the ability to make recommendations and take action utilizing that data.

• Must be able to manage highly confidential information.

• Able to work in a fast-paced, highly energized and open environment and work with all levels of management.

• Solid presentation and speaking skills to a wide range of group sizes.

• Must have stellar interpersonal skills (written and verbal).

• Proficient in using MS Office, Excel, and data related tools.

• Ability to work independently, requiring minimal direction.

• Ability to travel is required.

ShipBob believes in transparency while providing a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance approach. We are targeting a salary range of $77,775 - $103,700 for this role. In addition to base salary, this role includes the opportunity to be eligible for participation in the Company's discretionary bonus plan based on Company's plans and in accordance with Company’s policies.

Perks & Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, Vision & Basic Life Insurance

• Paid Maternity/Parental Leave Program

• Paid Holidays & Flexible Time Off Program

• Paid Sick Leave

• Wellness Days (1 day/quarter)

• 401K Match

• Comprehensive Benefits Package >>> https://www.shipbob.com/careers/

• See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob)

#LI-JN1

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

About You:

Building the world’s leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob’s environment isn’t the right fit for everyone, and that’s okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you.

Learn more about our core values and how we perform at a high level in our day-to-day work on our Culture page (https://www.shipbob.com/careers/culture/).

About Us:

ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob’s proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob’s dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. ShipBob is backed by leading investors like Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and is one of the fastest-growing tech companies headquartered in Chicago.

At ShipBob, every full-time employee gets access to our best-in-class AI and productivity tools from Day 1 at no cost. This isn't a pilot or a perk for select teams. It's standard for everyone. We believe innovation isn't owned by one department. Whether you're in Talent, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or Customer Success, we expect you to ask: how can this be done better, faster, or smarter? These tools are our investment in your ability to find those answers.

Use of AI-Assisted Tools During Recruitment

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to support administrative functions such as transcribing interviews, generating summaries or notes, organizing interview feedback, facilitating candidate communications, and helping recruiters identify candidates whose qualifications may align with job requirements. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and are not used to make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by trained human reviewers who consider the candidate's application, interview performance, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. AI-assisted tools do not independently determine whether a candidate advances in the hiring process or receives an offer of employment. Where required by applicable law, candidates will be provided with notice regarding our use of AI-assisted technologies and, where available, information about any applicable rights relating to such processing, including the ability to request additional information or opt out of certain AI-assisted processing activities. Candidates who exercise available opt-out rights may be reviewed through alternative processes consistent with applicable law.

ShipBob provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

There is no deadline to apply for this position, as ShipBob accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets https://socket.dev/love to see for yourself!)


Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh https://www.linkedin.com/in/feross/, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $ https://socket.dev/blog/series-b125M in funding https://socket.dev/blog/series-c from top angels, operators, and security leaders.



About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join as Socket's dedicated support hire in the United States. You'll be the go-to person for developers and security teams across Zendesk, Slack, and Discord, working to resolve the majority of issues independently. Day to day, that looks like troubleshooting technical issues, guiding customers through Socket's products, and building out the docs and resources that reduce repeat questions. You'll jump on video calls with enterprise customers when needed and flag patterns that shape our product roadmap. The runbooks you write, the macros you build, and the patterns you spot will shape how Socket scales support going forward.

This role works 8am to 5pm within your time zone in the United States, with some overlap with other global time zones.



Responsibilities

 - Own inbound support tickets during US business hours from first response through resolution, meeting SLA targets independently.

 - Dig into integration issues across Socket's GitHub App, CLI, API, and CI/CD pipeline checks by reading logs, tracing webhook failures, inspecting JSON payloads, and reproducing edge cases.

 - When something needs to go to Engineering, send it with everything they need: repro steps, scan output, environment details, and your best hypothesis.

 - Understand package ecosystems well enough to explain scan results, manifest files, lockfile behaviors, and flagged risks to both developers and security stakeholders.

 - Build out support resources including runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and Zendesk macros for common issues.

 - Spot patterns in tickets and bring recurring issues and undocumented edge cases back to the Customer Engineering and Product teams.

 - Participate in on-call duties to cover urgent tickets for regional holidays, Socket company holidays, and a global rotation for weekend support.

 - Keep the broader team in the loop with clear, thorough handoffs.



What We're Looking For

 - 2+ years in technical support, support engineering, or TAM at a B2B SaaS company, 

 - Supported developer-facing products with API/integration complexity, or have strong linux system administration and troubleshooting experience. 

 - Comfortable in a terminal and with code. Reading a JSON payload, parsing a stack trace, understanding what a lockfile does, and writing or tweaking a basic Python or JavaScript script should all feel familiar.

 - A solid grasp of developer workflows. You know what a CI/CD pipeline does, how build processes work, and what it means when a dependency gets flagged.

 - Some familiarity with the security or DevSecOps space is a plus. SCA tools, CVEs, SBOM, supply chain risk. You do not need to be a security researcher, but caring about the problem goes a long way.

 - Clear, concise written English. Most communication here happens async and in writing, so getting your point across cleanly matters.

 - A habit of writing things down. When you solve something, your instinct is to document it so the next person does not have to start from scratch.

 - Experience with Zendesk or a similar ticketing tool is a plus, as is exposure to open source ecosystems (npm, PyPI, Maven) or CI tooling like GitHub Actions or CircleCI.

 - Ability to work 8am - 5pm within your time zone in the United States, Monday through Friday; plus availability for rotational on-call support for weekend/holiday rotation.



Our Interview Process

 1. Informational with a member from our Talent Team

 2. Virtual f2f with the Hiring Manager

 3. Technical Interviews

 4. Presentation phase

 5. Final call with our Founder

 6. References

 7. Decision/Offer

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy  https://socket.dev/hiring-philosophyand how we approach the process at Socket.



Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

 - Market competitive salary bands

 - Meaningful equity program

 - Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

 - Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

 - Paid parental leave

 - Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites 



At Socket, we

 1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

 2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

 3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

 4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

 5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

 6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

jobs.title: Salesforce Administrator
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team

Our Customer Support Technology Product and Program management team enables a global support organization and self-service ecosystem that supports our human advisors and millions of customers. We own the technology systems that power our support operations team, including our CRM (Salesforce Service Cloud), telephony/CTI integrations, knowledge workflows, dashboards/analytics, and continuous improvement of agent productivity and customer satisfaction. You’ll work closely with product and program management, support operations, engineering, data science, and more to deliver a compelling support experience.

About the role

Roku is committed to providing industry-leading customer support through intelligent, streamlined agent tools and world-class service experiences. We’re seeking a hands-on Salesforce Administrator to join our support technology team, build out our Service Cloud capabilities, and partner with engineering to deliver a best-in-class agent platform.

You will own the day-to-day administration and evolution of our Salesforce Service Cloud platform for support operations. Your responsibilities will include user management, configuration, automation, reporting, and support for existing integrations. You will serve as the administrator partner to agent teams and collaborate closely with engineering (Salesforce developers) and product teams on enhancements and integrations. This includes gathering requirements and delivering scalable platform improvements. The position is a high-impact role in a fast-moving support environment.

For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $153,100 - $178,900 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates can frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, validate output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

For this role, that means staying ahead of Salesforce's AI direction. We want an admin who already tracks these changes, has a point of view on how they could speed up our Service Cloud work, can tell what’s ready to use and use it.

What you'll be doing

• Configure and fine-tune our Salesforce Service Cloud setup — think workflows, custom fields, layouts, integrations, and beyond — to power smarter, faster service across the business.

• Stay up to date on Salesforce capabilities and work closely with CX leadership to shape the technology roadmap that supports our vision and drives business success.

• Champion efficiency: continuously assess our systems and processes to identify opportunities that boost team productivity, improve user experience, and enhance customer satisfaction.

• Oversee data integrity within the Salesforce Service Cloud instance, ensuring data compliance and security via security reviews, release updates, and health checks.

• Lead Salesforce projects from start to finish — whether it’s a new integration, major upgrade, or process overhaul — delivering on time and within budget.

• Create and maintain individual reports, dashboards, and reporting infrastructure to provide stakeholders with real-time and historical visibility into key performance metrics and operational details.

• Evaluate and pilot Salesforce AI capabilities (Agentforce, Agent Builder, Prompt Builder, headless and MCP access) against our roadmap, and recommend what to adopt, what to wait on, and how we'd test it.

• Use AI tools (such as Claude Code or Agentforce Vibes) in a sandbox to speed up configuration, documentation, and testing, and review and test everything before it ships.

• Govern how AI agents and AI tools access Salesforce: purpose-built permission sets, field-level security, OAuth and external client app settings, and audit and monitoring so we can see what an agent did and why.

• Prepare our data and knowledge for AI: ensure data quality, field design, and knowledge structure so agents have accurate context.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across the company to understand goals, gather requirements, and deliver smart, scalable solutions, and be the go-to communicator for platform changes and updates.

• Create and maintain technical documentation that reflects our current Salesforce usage and enables continued scaling of Service Cloud.

• Maintain vendor relationships with Salesforce and other strategic technologies that integrate with Service Cloud.

We're excited if you have

• 2–5 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator in a customer support, service, or contact-center context.

• Experience supporting agent workflows and service operations in Salesforce Service Cloud.

• You are a Salesforce Certified Administrator.

• Strongly preferred: Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator (Admin II).

• Strongly preferred: Hands-on experience configuring Agentforce agents or Prompt Builder templates (topics, actions, instructions, testing).

• Strongly preferred: Understanding of how external tools and agents connect to Salesforce (APIs, MCP, OAuth) and the security model around them.

• Nice to have: Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant (or other cloud cert such as Sales Cloud, Field Service, Nonprofit Cloud).

• Nice to have: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist.

• Nice to have: Experience using AI tools in a sandbox to build or review Salesforce configuration, and a view on where they fail.

• Nice to have: Familiarity with Data 360 (Data Cloud) concepts.

• Nice to have: Experience integrating Amazon Connect with Salesforce (telephony/CTI, call routing, screen-pop, call logging).

• Excellent documentation, training, communication and stakeholder-collaboration skills.

• Experience working with engineering teams, agile or sprint-based development environment, and balancing production support with continuous improvement.

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business or equivalent professional experience.

#LI-RN1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

jobs.description:

The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

Who Are We Looking For?

What Will You Be Doing?

Requirements
The Necessities

• Demonstrated leadership and management experience

• Ability to travel as needed

The Extras

• Outgoing personality and a love of socializing/working with institutional clients

• Understanding of ABLE Accounts

• Experience in financial services

• Experience with state savings programs

This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation. For exceptional candidates with 5+ years of specific experience, we're open to hiring this role fully remote.

The expected base salary range for this position is $150K - $165K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

Employee Benefits
We’re an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Interview Process

jobs.title: Sr. Hedging Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Sr. Hedging Analyst supports the firm’s hedging program by executing, analyzing, and managing derivative transactions and related risk activities. The role oversees the derivative trade lifecycle and supports the controls, reporting, and processes used to manage market risk. All work is performed in accordance with approved hedging strategies, risk limits, policies, and procedures.

The successful candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and accurate in a time sensitive environment. The role partners closely with internal teams and external counterparties, brokers, and service providers.

The role improves hedging processes and reporting through automation and data quality enhancements. It also analyzes derivative valuations, market risk, sensitivities, profit and loss, hedge performance, and new product or bespoke-structure proposals.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Execute approved derivative hedging transactions within delegated authority and manage the trade lifecycle, including pre-trade checks, trade capture, confirmation, reconciliation, settlement coordination, and issue resolution.

• Serve as a primary contact for trade execution and support matters with internal teams, counterparties, brokers, and service providers.

• Monitor derivative positions, market data, and operational deadlines to support effective hedge execution, timely processing, and adherence to established controls.

• Prepare, validate, and distribute recurring hedging, risk, and management reports; identify issues, control gaps, and improvement opportunities.

• Analyze portfolio exposures, market sensitivities, profit and loss, hedge performance, broker quotes, trade economics, and valuation outputs to support execution, risk oversight, and reporting.

• Support analysis of bespoke indices, payoff structures, and new products, including derivative characteristics, hedging implications, operational readiness, and reporting needs.

• Use Python, SQL, Excel, and related tools to automate workflows, improve data quality, and enhance reporting and trade support.

• Lead or contribute to enhancements of hedging processes, trading and risk systems, and reporting, including requirements, testing, implementation, and procedure updates.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on hedging processes and trade workflows, maintain process documentation, and support ad hoc business, audit, regulatory, and risk management requests.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  This role does not have formal people leadership responsibilities but may provide guidance, mentorship, or subject matter expertise to others.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, particularly when managing trade details, reports, reconciliations, and time-sensitive deliverables.

• Ability to follow established processes and controls, recognize exceptions, and escalate issues promptly.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with internal stakeholders, counterparties, and service providers.

• Ability to make sound, timely decisions within defined authority limits while managing recurring workflows, reporting, and controls in a fast paced, market sensitive, deadline driven environment.

• Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to prioritize competing requests, manage concurrent responsibilities, and follow through.

• Analytical and quantitative aptitude, including an understanding of derivative pricing, market risk, portfolio exposures, sensitivities, profit and loss, hedge performance, and valuation concepts.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset, including the ability to identify opportunities for automation and reporting improvements.

• Ability to work independently within established procedures and collaborate effectively across business, investment, risk, technology, and operations teams.

• Strong interest in capital markets, derivatives, hedging, portfolio management, and ongoing professional development.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required; working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, such as SQL Server, is preferred.

• Familiarity with using Bloomberg or comparable platforms for investment analysis, portfolio management, and reporting.

• High standards of professionalism, confidentiality, accountability, and ethical conduct.

Qualifications

Education Level

Bachelor's Degree

• Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Years of Experience

3+ year of relevant experience

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian - Indianapolis, IN (Nora)
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Admissions Coordinator/Receptionist
jobs.description:
The Admissions Coordinator is an essential member of the campus admissions team, supporting the successful onboarding of new students by ensuring accurate enrollment entry, document tracking, and a positive first impression for all visitors. This entry-level, campus-based role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and enjoys working in a fast-paced, student-facing environment.  The Admissions Coordinator will also provide front desk support.

Job responsibilities:

• Enter new student enrollments and status changes into the Student Information and Client Management Systems.
• Manage and track all enrollment documents (e.g., background checks, immunizations, proof of graduation, valid IDs) to ensure timely, complete student files.
• Proactively assist students in completing and submitting required documents.
• Serve as the primary contact for enrollment systems support (e.g., Complio, Enrollment Portal).
• Ensure enrollment documents meet admissions and compliance standards.
• Administer entrance assessments per established protocols, report on requirement status and test outcomes.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• High school diploma required; some college preferred.
• Minimum 1 year of administrative, front desk, or customer service experience (education/admissions setting preferred).
• Excellent attention to detail, data accuracy, and time management.
• Professional, customer-focused communicator with strong integrity and work ethic.
• Tech-savvy with strong computer skills and ability to learn quickly.
• Flexible and adaptable in a changing environment.

We Offer:

• Medical, Dental and Vision starting the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment
• 2 Weeks’ starting Vacation per year. Increasing based on years of service with company
• 12 paid Holidays and 2 Floating Holidays
• 401K with a Company Match
• Company Paid Life Insurance at 1x’s your annual salary
• Leadership development and training for career advancement
• Tuition assistance and Forgiveness for you and your family up to 100% depending on program

jobs.title: Product Analyst (Growth)
jobs.description:
Приєднуйся до нас як Product Analyst у Growth-напрямі та стань людиною, яка зробить growth-рішення в Zeely системними, швидкими та статистично обґрунтованими.

Ми шукаємо аналітика, який візьме ownership за growth-аналітику Zeely та допоможе командам ухвалювати системні, швидкі й обґрунтовані даними рішення.

Ти працюватимеш на перетині продукту, маркетингу та монетизації: досліджуватимеш поведінку користувачів, знаходитимеш нові точки росту та оцінюватимеш ефективність продуктових і бізнес-рішень. Це роль із реальним впливом на ключові метрики компанії та можливістю формувати підходи до growth-аналітики.

Про Zeely

Zeely AI — це агентна AI-платформа для створення, запуску та масштабування платної реклами.

Платформа дозволяє створювати рекламні креативи, UGC-відео, viral content, банери та запускати ефективні paid і organic кампанії у Facebook та Instagram.

Простими словами: ми зробили доступними для малого бізнесу AI-маркетингові рішення та інструменти, які раніше були переважно доступні великим брендам із дорогими маркетинговими командами.

Цифри, які говорять краще за слова:

 - 4 роки на ринку — стабільна прибуткова компанія з міжнародними інвесторами;

 - ×6 зростання за минулий рік;

 - 2 000 000+ бізнесів уже використовують Zeely;

 - Топ-1 у своїй категорії на ринку США;

 - 200+ спеціалістів у команді;

 - Ринки: США + worldwide.

Ми не стартап у пошуках product-market fit, а бізнес із доведеним результатом і чітким розумінням того, що працює. Зараз ми активно масштабуємося та підсилюємо команду людьми, які можуть впливати на ключові метрики й драйвити наступний етап росту.

З чим ти працюватимеш на цій позиції?

 - Аналізуватимеш ключові growth-воронки та знаходити точки росту на всьому шляху користувача — від залучення до покупки, активації та подальшої монетизації.

 - Відповідатимеш за аналітику експериментів: допомагатимеш формувати дизайн A/B-тестів, оцінювати результати та будувати єдині стандарти ухвалення рішень.

 - Досліджуватимеш поведінку та сегменти користувачів, щоб розуміти, що впливає на конверсію, активацію, retention, LTV та ефективність залучення.

 - Працюватимеш із монетизаційною аналітикою: оцінюватимеш вплив змін у ціноутворенні, підписочній та транзакційних моделях та продуктових механіках на дохід і юніт економіку.

 - Перетворюватимеш дані на конкретні рекомендації для growth-, product- і marketing-команд та допомагатимеш визначати, які можливості мають найбільший потенціал для бізнесу.

 - Розвиватимеш growth-аналітику як систему: self-service звітність, моніторинг ключових метрик, алерти та підходи, які дозволяють командам швидше й самостійніше працювати з даними.

Що потрібно, щоб приєднатися до нас?

 - 3+ роки досвіду аналітиком у продуктових компаніях.

 - Практичний досвід роботи з B2C / subscription продуктами: воронки, конверсія в підписку, монетизаційні метрики.

 - Великий досвід аналізу A/B-тестів і впевнене знання статистики: ти розумієш, коли результат є, а коли його немає, і вмієш пояснити це команді.

 - Досвід сегментації користувачів і пошуку сегментів, які краще конвертуються та окуповуються.

 - Розуміння продуктових і монетизаційних метрик: LTV, conversion rate, activation, retention, ARPU, тощо.

 - Вміння формулювати висновки для стейкхолдерів і доносити, чому рішення має бути саме таким.

 - Високий рівень ownership і проактивності: ти сам бачиш, що варто дослідити, а не лише закриваєш запити з беклогу.

Буде плюсом:

 - Досвід побудови системних рішень: фреймворків для експериментів, сегментації, персоналізації.

 - Досвід роботи з веб-воронками.

 - Досвід побудови систем алертингу та моніторингу метрик.

 - Досвід роботи як аналітика, який покривав і acquisition, і продукт, і монетизацію.

 - Досвід роботи з payment / monetization analytics.

Чому працювати з нами — цікаво і перспективно:

 - Реальний ownership: ти будеш першою людиною, яка відповідає за growth-аналітику, і визначатимеш, як вона працюватиме.

 - Можливість будувати з нуля: процеси експериментів, стандарти ухвалення рішень, систему алертів, сегментацію.

 - Великий business impact: ти працюватимеш з основним джерелом монетизації компанії в момент трансформації прайсингу та продукту.

 - Постійний потік експериментів — багато даних і швидкий цикл від гіпотези до результату.

 - Працюємо з найсучаснішими технологіями та розвиваємо AI-інструменти.

 - Сильна команда, яка мотивує розвиватися й зростати разом із найкращими.

 - Remote-first формат: працюй звідки зручно, а якщо хочеш — будемо раді бачити тебе в наших офісах у Варшаві та Києві.

 - Надаємо 18 Day Off на рік.

 - 3 повністю оплачувані Sick Leave дні на рік + unlimited Sick Leave із компенсацією 70%.

 - Проводимо регулярні performance review, щоб розвиток був прозорим, а результати — належно оцінені.

 - Маємо повний супровід українського ФОПу.

Рекрутмент процес:

Intro Call → Hiring Team Interview → Test Task → Final Interview → Reference Check → Offer

Надсилай резюме — будемо раді познайомитися ближче 💚

jobs.description:

You'll sit within our Claims team, owning auto property damage liability claims from first notice to resolution, and making sure every customer feels heard and fairly treated along the way.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.
