jobs.title: Contracts & Finance Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Broadway Ventures, we transform challenges into opportunities with expert program management, cutting-edge technology, and innovative consulting solutions. As an 8(a), HUBZone, and Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), we empower government and private sector clients by delivering tailored solutions that drive operational success, sustainability, and growth. Built on integrity, collaboration, and excellence, we’re more than a service provider—we’re your trusted partner in innovation.

Broadway Ventures seeks an experienced, detail-oriented Contracts & Finance Manager to join our Corporate team. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Contracts & Finance Manager will own contract administration, financial management, forecasting, and federal pricing across Broadway’s portfolio of prime contracts and subcontracts supporting federal healthcare and IT programs. The role works closely with the CEO, COO, Project Managers, Accounting, Human Resources, Recruiting, and Proposal/Business Development to keep every contract compliant, funded, and profitable. Primary responsibilities include:

Contract Administration

• Maintain complete and accurate files for all prime contracts and subcontracts.

• Independently track periods of performance, option periods, funding, ceilings, CLINs, labor categories, and contractual requirements.

• Track, review, and process contract modifications.

• Maintain a company-wide contract calendar covering period of performance expirations, option exercises, funding needs, reporting deadlines, and other critical dates.

• Coordinate with Project Managers on upcoming contract actions and customer requirements.

• Monitor funding and burn rates and flag ceiling or funding issues early enough for corrective action.

• Support contract closeouts, compliance documentation, subcontract administration, and review of subcontractor invoices.

• Serve as the company’s internal resource on FAR and DFARS matters.

Accounting and Financial Management

• Work with the Accounting Manager on the monthly close, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

• Support payroll processing and reconciliation.

• Produce monthly profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow reporting.

• Coordinate with the company’s outside CPA and accounting partners.

• Maintain accounting controls and support government contract accounting compliance.

Forecasting and Management Reporting

• Prepare and maintain the annual budget and rolling revenue and cash flow forecasts.

• Work with Project Managers to forecast revenue by contract, track gross margin and profitability by contract, and monitor indirect rate performance.

• Build monthly financial and contract dashboards for leadership.

• Identify negative trends, funding concerns, and margin deterioration early enough for leadership to act.

Federal Pricing and Proposal Support

• Lead or substantially support pricing for proposals, task orders, modifications, and recompetes.

• Develop labor rate and compensation models, indirect rates, escalation, and fee assumptions.

• Own or substantially contribute to cost and price volumes.

• Review solicitations for contractual, pricing, and compliance requirements and flag concerns to leadership.

Leadership and Process Documentation

Document contracts, finance, and pricing processes so institutional knowledge resides with the company rather than with any one individual.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or business, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 8 to 15 years of relevant experience in federal contracting, government contract accounting, or comparable military roles.

• Demonstrated experience in federal contract administration and government contract accounting.

• Experience managing federal funding, budgets, and contract actions across the acquisition lifecycle, gained in either military or civilian roles.

• Experience developing and monitoring indirect rates.

• Working knowledge of the FAR and DFARS.

• Experience with Costpoint, Unanet, or a comparable government contract accounting system.

• Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple contract, reporting, and proposal deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

• Military experience is strongly preferred, particularly in contracting, comptroller, resource management, or acquisition roles.

• Hands-on experience pricing federal proposals and task orders.

• Experience as a DoD Contracting Officer or Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR).

Pay Range:

• $140,000 - $180,000 based on skills and experieince

What to Expect Next:

After submitting your application, our recruiting team will review your qualifications. This may include a brief telephone interview or email communication to verify resume details and discuss compensation expectations. Interviews will be conducted with the most qualified candidates. Broadway Ventures conducts background checks and drug testing prior to the start of employment. Some positions may also require fingerprinting.

Broadway Ventures is an equal opportunity employer and a VEVRAA federal contractor. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities. Broadway Ventures utilizes the OFCCP-approved Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability Form (CC-305).

The pay range shown is a good-faith estimate of the compensation Broadway Ventures reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. It is not a guarantee of any particular wage, salary, or total compensation. Actual pay offered depends on job-related factors, which may include skills, experience, education, certifications and licensure, geographic work location, contract funding and budget. For positions covered by the Service Contract Act, pay is also governed by the applicable Department of Labor wage determination, which the government may revise.

Location Eligibility: Broadway Ventures cannot consider applicants who live in, or would work from, any of the following locations: California, Colorado, Connecticut, the District of Columbia, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oregon, Rhode Island, Washington State, and Wyoming. Candidates must live in and work from an eligible U.S. state when they are hired and for as long as they are employed. Applications from residents of the locations listed above will not be considered.

Notice: Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process

Broadway Ventures uses an artificial intelligence (AI) tool to help review applications for this position.

• Who built it: Broadway Ventures developed the tool in-house.

• What it does: It compares your resume to the requirements in this job posting and gives a score from 0 to 100 showing how closely your qualifications match.

• What information it uses: The text of your resume, your name, your current or most recent job title, your location, and this job posting.

• What it cannot see: Your answers to voluntary demographic or equal employment opportunity questions, interview feedback, or offer information.

• How it is used: The score is one factor in our initial review of applications. The tool does not reject anyone. A member of our recruiting team reviews every application before any decision is made.

• Your options: If you would like your application reviewed without the AI tool, or you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, contact us at recruiting@broadwayventures.net. Making a request will not affect whether you are considered for this position.

Some positions are posted in support of a contract proposal that has not yet been awarded. Where that is the case, the position and its final compensation are contingent upon award of the contract to Broadway Ventures and on the terms of the awarded contract, including any government-approved labor rates and the applicable wage determination.

Broadway Ventures offers a comprehensive benefits package. A general description of benefits is below.

• 401(k) and company match

• PTO that grows the longer you stay

• Health, Vision, Dental

• Company provided Life Insurance and Voluntary Life Insurance

• Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability

jobs.title: PRN Psychometric Rater/Clinical Rater
jobs.description:
At Headlands Research, we are dedicated to enhancing clinical trial delivery within our communities. As a leading network of advanced clinical trial sites, we leverage cutting-edge technology and exceptional support services to broaden outreach and participation. Founded in 2018, our rapidly growing company currently operates 20+ sites across the US and Canada, with plans for further expansion.

Join a Leading Clinical Research Organization Advancing Neurology & Psychiatry Treatments

Caribbean Medical Research Center (CMRC), a wholly owned subsidiary of Headlands Research, is a premier clinical research company specializing in Neurology, Psychiatry, Internal Medicine, and Women’s Health, that is seeking a Clinical Rater (RN, Psychometrist, or Psychometrician) to conduct cognitive and psychometric assessments for groundbreaking Alzheimer’s, Mild Cognitive Impairment, Depression, Anxiety, and Parkinson’s Disease clinical trials.

As part of Headlands Research, a fast-growing network of cutting-edge clinical trial sites, we are committed to improving patient outcomes and advancing medical breakthroughs through innovative research and technology.

We are currently seeking a Part-time (one 8-hour day per week or two 4-hour days per week) experienced Clinical Rater or Psychometrician to perform neurocognitive and psychiatric assessments for adult and geriatric populations in FDA-regulated trials. The ideal candidate has experience administering standardized neurocognitive and psychiatric rating scales such as CDR (Clinical Dementia Rating) and PACC-5 (Preclinical Alzheimer’s Cognitive Composite 5).

📍 Location: San Juan, PR (Onsite – No Remote Work)
⏰ Clinic Hours: Mondays through Fridays, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
💲 Pay:  Based upon relevant experience, certifications, and education.
🚗 Travel Required: No

Responsibilities:

• Administer and score study-specific standardized clinical scales and psychometric tests to evaluate cognitive function, disease severity/progression, and study eligibility.

• Conduct in-person cognitive, diagnostic, and clinical assessments with study participants and caregivers following protocols, GCP, and FDA regulations.

• Maintain consistency in rating performance over time to ensure accuracy and prevent rater drift.

• Communicate assessment findings with lead physicians, study sponsors, CROs, and internal teams.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation for all assessments and study-related activities.

• Identify and report any participant safety concerns or risks per company policy.

• Offer referrals and resources to study participants and their families when appropriate.

Requirements:

• Master’s Degree (or higher) in Psychology, Nursing, or a related field OR an RN license with 1+ year of experience administering and evaluating patients using CDR and/or PACC-5 assessments OR Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology or a related field with 1+ year of experience delegated as a Rater/Psychometrician/Psychometrist on a clinical trial study.

• Prior experience conducting cognitive assessments for adult and geriatric populations required

• Previous experience as a Clinical Rater, Psychometrist, or Psychometrician in a clinical trial or research setting highly preferred

• Strong knowledge of neurocognitive and psychiatric assessment tools (e.g., CDR, PACC-5, MADRS, HAM-D, etc.)

• Excellent verbal & written communication skills for working with patients, caregivers, and research teams.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow study protocols precisely.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative research team.

• Commitment to patient safety, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance.

Why Join CMRC?

✅ Cutting-Edge Clinical Trials: Be part of breakthrough psychiatric and addiction research.
✅ Flexible PRN/Per-Diem Schedule: Achieve better work-life balance without the demands of hospital shifts.
✅ Competitive Pay & Growth Opportunities – Earn industry-leading compensation while expanding your expertise in clinical research.
✅ Collaborative & Supportive Team – Work alongside top neurology and psychiatry researchers in a patient-focused environment.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Payments - Core
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Overview

Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics Holdings, Inc. As a Staff Engineer on the Payments team, you will be the technical owner of the systems that move money into, out of, and across Fanatics: deposits, withdrawals, and payments at checkout.

The platform you will own serves Sportsbook and Casino today and is being extended to other Fanatics businesses. A key part of that work is letting a customer's shared balance appear as a payment option alongside cards and bank transfers wherever they shop, so that money already held at Fanatics does not have to leave and come back. You will also shape how Fanatics connects to processors, acquirers, and banking partners, with the aim of improving approval rates, lowering cost per transaction, and reducing the number of times the same funds are moved.

This role combines deep backend expertise with architectural leadership. You will set the technical direction for payments across several teams and work closely with Fraud, Responsible Gaming, Finance, Legal, and Compliance partners to build payment flows that are reliable, cost-effective, and compliant with state regulations and card scheme rules.

Responsibilities

• Own the architecture of the payments platform, including provider integrations, deposit and withdrawal flows, and the services other Fanatics businesses call to take payment.

• Design and build distributed services in Java and Spring Boot that process high transaction volume with strict requirements for correctness, security, and uptime.

• Build payment orchestration and routing across processors, acquirers, and payment methods, using approval rate, cost, and provider health to decide where each transaction goes, with failover when a provider degrades.

• Handle failure in third-party integrations by design, including timeouts, retries, idempotency, duplicate callbacks, partial failures, and reconciliation against provider and bank settlement files.

• Lead the technical work of onboarding new providers and banking partners, including evaluating options and defining the integration, testing, and rollout approach.

• Build in regulatory and card scheme requirements, such as per-jurisdiction rules and how transactions are classified, in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Finance.

• Work with Fraud and Risk to bring risk signals into the payment path and to handle chargebacks and disputes, including how they are attributed when funds are used across businesses.

• Reduce payment cost through routing, provider terms, and design choices that avoid unnecessary movement of money.

• Set standards for security, data handling, and limiting PCI scope across payment services.

• Lead architectural reviews, design sessions, and incident postmortems, and mentor engineers across the team.

• Partner with product, frontend, and mobile teams so that payment experiences are consistent and clear for customers.

• Be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices or industry events for planning, collaboration, and team development.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot.

• Experience building and operating payment systems in production, such as deposit and withdrawal flows, payment gateway or processor integrations, card payments, or ACH.

• Strong understanding of idempotency, reconciliation, and failure handling in systems that depend on third-party providers.

• Experience designing secure, high-scale, low-latency distributed systems.

• Experience with event-driven architectures and message streaming platforms such as Kafka.

• Working knowledge of security and compliance requirements for handling payment data, including PCI DSS.

• Demonstrated success setting technical direction and driving alignment across multiple teams.

• Ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering, product, finance, and leadership audiences.

• Comfort working in a fast-paced, regulated environment with changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in online gaming, sports betting, fintech, or banking.

• Knowledge of how card networks, acquirers, and issuers work, including interchange, transaction classification, and chargeback processes.

• Experience with payment orchestration, smart routing, or building a payments platform that serves several business units.

• Experience integrating with banking partners or building account funding and money movement products.

• Experience with financial reconciliation and settlement reporting.

• Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch.

• Interest in developer experience, clean API design, and systems that remain maintainable as more teams depend on them.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$190,000—$237,500 USD

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Receive and stock all sample control supplies, prepare and ship sample kits and perform sampling events as needed. Daily route will usually be from Buffalo, NY to Williamsport, PA and back. Most of the work day will be driving, approximately 7 hours/day, using a company vehicle.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Perform all duties as outlined in the Standard Operating Procedures for Couriers.
• Pick up and deliver samples, bottle orders and report to the laboratory for sign-in and analysis.

• Ensure that client signs, dates, and records time on the Chain of Custody when releasing samples.
• Transport samples on ice from client site to the lab, or from our lab to a sub-contracted laboratory.

• Interact with Project Managers and clients appropriately and professionally.
• Follow directions or use maps to locate client offices/sites as specified in the courier request form.

• Verify the validity and completeness of all bottle orders being delivered. This verification is done prior to leaving for delivery.

• Maintain the shipping/receiving area to ensure a safe work environment.
• Prepare outgoing shipments of bottle kits and coolers for pick-up.

Valid driver’s license

jobs.title: Privacy Legal, Americas
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Privacy Legal team at Stripe tackles complex privacy issues that intersect with Stripe’s cutting-edge technology. We're seeking a technical and process-oriented lawyer with a passion for data, technology, privacy, and security. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of talented privacy lawyers to help solve intricate problems in a fast-paced environment.

What you’ll do

This role will be responsible for a wide variety of privacy matters. In addition to advising on product, regulatory, and operational privacy matters, you will also lead privacy legal workstreams for acquisitions and other strategic transactions, including post-close integration of acquired businesses, products, systems, and data practices.

Responsibilities

• Serve as lead privacy counsel on important cross-functional initiatives, independently identifying and assessing complex privacy and security risks, and providing pragmatic, risk-based advice that advances Stripe’s business objectives.

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Data Science, GTM, and other teams to design and implement privacy mitigations and embed privacy-by-design principles into Stripe’s products and operational processes.

• Develop, enhance, and implement Stripe’s privacy infrastructure, policies, and procedures, setting short- to medium-term direction for assigned privacy programs and improving how privacy work scales across teams.

• Lead privacy legal workstreams for acquisitions and other strategic transactions, from diligence through post-close integration. Identify and prioritize privacy risks; advise on deal terms, integration decisions, and remediation; and coordinate with Corporate Development, Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and other teams.

• Own the privacy integration of acquired businesses, products, systems, and data practices, including the integration or remediation of data inventories, notices, consent practices, data-use purposes, retention requirements, data-subject rights processes, vendor arrangements, and privacy governance.

• Lead or provide senior legal guidance for privacy compliance functions, including Data Protection Impact Assessments, Data Subject Access Requests, and Records of Processing Activities.

• Lead the legal response to significant privacy and security incidents, coordinating cross-functional risk assessment, remediation, regulatory analysis, and breach-notification decisions.

• Advise on complex commercial transactions and negotiate Data Processing Agreements and other privacy and security provisions, balancing legal risk with Stripe’s business objectives.

• Help shape and implement Stripe’s privacy and data-governance approach for AI and machine learning.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• J.D. degree (or foreign equivalent) with membership in at least one US state bar.

• Minimum of 6 years of experience as a privacy lawyer, with extensive knowledge of global privacy laws and regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, and GLBA.

• Experience leading privacy workstreams for acquisitions or other strategic transactions, including privacy diligence, risk assessment, and post-close integration or remediation.

• A strong understanding of technology, data flows, and system architecture, with the ability to work directly with engineers, and to translate complex technical facts into practical legal advice and integration requirements.

• Experience managing data-security incidents, and familiarity with data-breach notification requirements

• Proficiency in negotiating and drafting complex contracts involving privacy and security terms.

• Strong organizational and project leadership skills, including the ability to lead multiple complex, cross-functional workstreams, establish priorities, remove roadblocks, and drive matters to completion.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

• Demonstrated ability to make sound, independent, risk-based judgments in ambiguous or high-stakes situations while balancing privacy requirements with Stripe’s business objectives.

• Ability to identify the right cross-functional stakeholders, build consensus, and drive implementation across teams with different priorities.

• A pragmatic, hands-on approach, and the adaptability to move between strategic advice, detailed integration work, incident response, and program development.

• A skilled advisor and negotiator who develops practical solutions and is regularly sought out for guidance on complex privacy matters.

• Ability to communicate complex legal, technical, and business tradeoffs clearly, including preparing materials that enable senior leaders to make informed decisions.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Havoc is a leader in all-domain collaborative autonomy. Its software-defined hardware approach powers military and commercial-grade autonomous systems across sea, air, and land to sense, decide, and act together in complex and contested environments. Havoc connects assets, enabling them to share information, adapt in real time, and continue operating even when communications are disrupted or denied. Havoc optimizes mission performance and minimizes human risk.

Havoc was founded in 2024 and headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. Learn more at Havoc: All-Domain Collaborative Autonomy http://havocai.com/ .

About the Role 
 We're looking for an Electrical Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. You'll design, specify, integrate and test electrical systems for our uncrewed surface vessels (USVs) and other unmanned platforms. You'll own components and subsystems across power conversion, energy storage, RF and communications, signal distribution and overall electrical architecture.

The ideal candidate has taken electrical hardware from concept through design, assembly, integration and test. You'll work closely with mechanical, software and systems engineers to deliver robust, reliable solutions for maritime environments.



Key Responsibilities and Requirements

 - Electrical System Design & Architecture: Design, specify and integrate electrical subsystems, including power converters, radios, compute, harnesses, circuit protection, batteries, actuators and antennas. Develop system-level architectures for USVs, including power trees, grounding schemes, communications pathways and redundancy. Evaluate electrical loads, routing and environmental requirements to support vessel capabilities and mission payloads.

 - Wiring Harness & Component Integration: Produce wiring schematics, harness drawings, connector specifications and interface definitions. Oversee harness fabrication and verify assembly quality, routing, strain relief and suitability for marine environments.

 - Build, Test & Troubleshooting: Lead subsystem bring-up, bench testing, environmental validation and vehicle-level integration. Verify RF performance, signal integrity, interference mitigation and link reliability on the bench and on the vehicle. Diagnose issues with power systems, EMI/EMC, communication links, sensors and embedded electronics. Support field testing, including hands-on troubleshooting during sea trials.

 - Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work with mechanical engineers on enclosure design, thermal considerations, EMC shielding and component packaging. Partner with software and systems engineers to make sure electrical interfaces are robust, deterministic and well documented.

 - Documentation: Create and maintain electrical schematics, block diagrams, interface control documents (ICDs), test reports and configuration records. Support design reviews and engineering change processes.

 - Manufacturing Support: Partner with technicians and manufacturing teams to make sure electrical designs are manufacturable, cost-effective and suited to rugged marine environments. Help develop test procedures, build instructions and QA processes for electrical subsystems.
   
   

Qualifications

 - 5+ years of electrical engineering experience focused on system design, integration and testing

 - Strong background in power electronics, power conversion and electrical subsystem integration

 - Experience with RF and communications systems, including antennas, radios, GPS and digital communication links

 - Able to create, read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams and harness documentation

 - Hands-on experience with prototype builds, electrical assembly, test equipment and troubleshooting

 - Strong understanding of electrical components, grounding, EMI/EMC, and marine or ruggedized design

 - Experience integrating electrical subsystems into complex platforms such as unmanned vehicles

 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field

 - U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a Secret security clearance

 - Able to work onsite at our North Kingstown, RI office.

 - Must be able to travel 1 week per quarter.



Preferred Skills

 - Experience with uncrewed systems, especially maritime platforms (USVs, UUVs, UAVs or UGVs)

 - Familiarity with harness design, ECAD or PLM tools such as SolidWorks Electrical, Altium, Zuken or Arena

 - Knowledge of embedded systems packaging, grounding, shielding, and thermal and electrical tradeoffs

 - Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM) for ruggedized, outdoor or marine environments

 - Strong analytical, diagnostic and root cause analysis skills


BENEFITS:

 - 100% Employer paid Health Insurance

 - Dental and Vision Insurance for you and your families

 - Life Insurance (Employer Paid)

 - Ability to participate in the companies 401k program (Matching) 

 - Unlimited PTO policy with an enforced 2 week minimum

 - Equity Package

 - Work / Home Office Stipend

 - Global Entry

 - 16 Week Paid Parental Leave

 - Monthly Health and Wellness Stipend



OUR VALUES:

 - Innovation: We are driven to break new ground. Every day presents an opportunity to challenge the status quo, think boldly, and deliver advanced solutions that transform the future of defense technology.

 - Integrity: We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency, accountability, and trust in all our actions and partnerships.

 - Mission-Driven: We are focused on achieving impactful outcomes that align with our core mission—protecting lives through innovation.

 - Forward-Leaning: We continuously seek out new opportunities and remain at the forefront of technological advancements. We embrace change and anticipate the challenges of tomorrow with confidence and creativity.

 - Ownership of All Tasks: At HavocAI, no problem is too complex or too trivial. We believe that greatness comes from tackling the hardest challenges, but also in handling the smallest, sometimes thankless, tasks with the same level of commitment and care.

 - Servant Leadership: We lead by serving others, whether it’s supporting our employees, partners, or the broader community. Empowering those around us is key to achieving long-term success and making a lasting impact.
   
   

HavocAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.




THE ROLE

Legora is an AI-native legal software company at an inflection point. We're scaling from a lean startup and our leadership team is growing across four continents. 

This is a true leadership role and your chance to shape how world-class support looks from the inside, and make AI and automation core to how executive support gets done. EAs are the connective tissue of any high-functioning executive team. Right now, we have strong individual EAs, but we need someone to build the system: the standards, the playbooks, the culture. 

If you want to build something that lasts, work with leaders who value you, and see your fingerprints on how a real company operates, this is it!




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead a distributed EA team across four offices and time zones. You'll run the team as one cohesive unit: establish the rhythm (team meetings, 1:1s, regular retrospectives), build the culture that keeps people connected as you grow, and make sure knowledge and best practice flow freely between EAs. 

 - Co-own the Legora EA operating system with the CEO Office. You'll develop and live in playbooks for calendar principles, travel, expenses, meeting prep, inbox handling, and cross-team coverage. 

 - Lead the automation and AI initiative from EA work. You'll identify where automation adds real value, pilot new tools with your team, and turn what works into the standard. This means staying curious about new tools, running small experiments, and building a team that sees AI as part of the job.

 - Grow the team with the company. You'll work with the Chief of Staff and People team to hire EAs who match the company's growth: planning capacity before new executives join, running recruitment end to end, and making sure each EA is paired with the right executive(s). You'll also run the two-week onboarding sprint so every new EA has full access, context, and relationships by day ten.

 - Global Coverage so no executive is ever without support. You coordinate coverage when EAs are out or traveling, balance load across time zones, adjust matches as the org evolves, and partner with People and IT so new executives get a smooth handoff. You're the escalation point when something breaks, resolving it calmly, and feeding what you learn back into how the team works.

 - Develop every EA.  set clear expectations, hold regular 1:1s, and give direct feedback. Partner with each executive on their EA's performance and development, and build growth paths so strong EAs see a future in the team.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 8+ years of proven EA excellence at the C-Level.  You've supported CEOs and senior executives at the highest level and know what great looks like. You can step in and support a leader directly before their EA is hired, and you set the standard for your team.

 - 2+ years developing a team across multiple offices and time zones. You've led EAs or another executive-support function before and made a strong team stronger: clearer standards, better coverage, people who grew. You know how to scale a team without losing culture.

 - A systems builder's mindset. You think in playbooks, rotas, and standards. You get things written down and adopted without making the team bureaucratic. You see the gaps and close them.

 - An automation-first mindset. You've already used automation to take work off your own plate and you want to lead a team in doing the same. 

 - A leader through example and structure. You lead by visibility and clarity rather than hierarchy, give direct feedback, and raise the bar for the people around you.

 - Trusted and discreet.  You handle confidential information with complete integrity and have the presence to earn the trust of senior leaders quickly.

 - Calm under pressure and at home in high growth. You're the first to respond when something goes wrong, you have built structure while the business kept moving, and you finish what you start.


WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across EMEA, NORAM, APAC, and LATAM.

 - Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.

 - Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.

We started by connecting warehouses, manufacturers, and distributors with reliable workers, and hundreds of operators now run their sites on Traba. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Run pilots that convert
   
   - Lead pilot kickoffs. Agree on quantifiable success criteria, a pilot roadmap and a target number of active users with the customer

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer - Productions
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Productions is the “done for you” managed services wing of ElevenLabs, built for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts in linguistics, mixing and post-production to deliver human-edited dubs, audiobooks and more in 15+ languages, directly on the ElevenLabs platform. Our customers include global media broadcasters, publishers, gaming companies and major film studios.

We’re hiring engineers to build the systems behind it: the platforms that let human expertise and AI work together at the quality our clients expect, and the labelling tools our research teams use to improve our models. You’ll own a scope in one of these areas:

 - Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.

 - Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.

 - Editor platform: the professional editing tools our production teams work in. You’ll build in Rust, combining UI systems with a deep understanding of the underlying system.

We’re building professional tools and core infrastructure, not consumer features. The work is mostly building, with little hand-holding. You’ll carve out your own scope and own the outcome.

Requirements

 - Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in functional programming languages like Rust, with a full-stack focus on designing UI systems. You’ve shipped and run production systems end to end.

 - Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.

 - Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.

 - Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.

Bonus:

 - Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.

 - Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Lead Solutions Engineer, Strategic

Lead Solutions Engineer, Strategic

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to Forbes' 2025 "Next Billion-Dollar Startups" list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation. The Solution Engineer will use a consultative approach to understand business and technical requirements and recommend effective strategies for implementing AcuityMD solutions.

At AcuityMD, we aim to empower our solution engineers to be strategic partners to our customers and prospects. Our team is committed to developing and maintaining a deep understanding of AcuityMD's products and services while staying current with the latest medical device industry trends. We strive to build and nurture long-term customer relationships by understanding their unique needs. Working closely with cross-functional teams, we collaborate to identify new opportunities, streamline processes, and enhance product offerings. We advocate for the value of data-driven insights, educating customers and prospects on how AcuityMD's platform can transform their businesses. We embody the highest professional, ethical, and integrity standards in all interactions.

Responsibilities

• Discovery: Engage with customers to understand their business challenges, technical landscape, and requirements.

• Solution Design: Develop and present tailored AcuityMD solutions that address customer needs and demonstrate the value of the company’s products and services.

• Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the Sales team to develop account strategies and drive the sales process.

• Technical Architecture: Translate customer technical requirements into future-state system designs that show how our solutions integrate into the customer’s existing tech stack.

• Demos & POCs: Deliver compelling product demonstrations, proofs of concept, and presentations to showcase the value of AcuityMD solutions.

• RFI/RFP Response: Respond to technical inquiries, RFIs, and RFPs with functional and technical solutions.

• Cross-Functional Feedback: Provide feedback to the Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams on customer needs, industry trends, and competitive landscape to drive product innovation and improvements.

• Brand & Industry Presence: Participate in industry events, webinars, and conferences to build brand awareness and showcase AcuityMD’s capabilities.

• Team Collaboration: Work as a team player by contributing, learning, and sharing new knowledge.

• Travel: Up to 30%-40% domestic travel required.

Your Profile

• 5+ years of experience in the IT industry, with a focus on pre-sales or technical sales roles, ideally including experience at a vertical AI company. MedTech/healthcare IT background is not required; experience across multiple verticals is valued over tenure in a single one. This is a senior-level hire (high P4/low P5).

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with a focus on needs analysis, positioning, business justification, and closing techniques.

• Superior presentation and demonstration skills, with the ability to engage with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Experience working with CRM platforms, AI/ML-driven products, or other relevant enterprise SaaS applications.

• Prior experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product management, engineering, and customer success.

• Self-motivated, flexible, and able to take initiative in a dynamic environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively to develop innovative solutions for customer needs.

• Demonstrated fluency with AI-driven products and the ability to quickly learn and adapt as our AI capabilities evolve.

Nice to Haves

• Experience working in the MedTech or healthcare industry (not required, experience across multiple verticals, especially other AI-focused companies, is equally valued).

• Familiarity with data analytics, business intelligence tools, and data visualization techniques.

• Knowledge of industry common data sources such as NPI, Medicare claims, PubMed, and ICD/CPT/HCPCS codes.

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA or Canada to be considered for this position.

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided.

Base salary range: $140,000-$170,000

We Offer:

• Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).

• Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.

• Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.

• Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.

• Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.

• Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.

• Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.

• Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

jobs.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
At Element Biosciences, we are passionate about our mission to empower the scientific community with more freedom and flexibility to accelerate our collective impact on humanity. We have built a highly efficient product-driven organization where employees can learn, grow, and thrive in a challenging but encouraging environment. We are committed to scientific integrity, collegiality, honesty, objectivity, and openness.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Test Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of software across Element’s sequencing ecosystem. In this hands-on role, you will independently own verification of complex features and workflows spanning instrument software, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data-analysis interfaces. You will partner with cross-functional teams to translate requirements, user needs, and product risks into clear test strategies and objective evidence. The ideal candidate is passionate about building robust tools for scientists and brings a strong background in software and systems testing, integration troubleshooting, and regulated product development. This role will report to the Senior Manager, Software Test Engineering and is expected to be a San Diego based, daily on-site role.

If you possess the following and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to explore this role.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

• Independently design, document, and execute verification activities for complex software features and end-to-end workflows used with Element sequencing instruments

• Translate user needs, product requirements, system architecture, and risk controls into traceable test strategies, plans, cases, protocols, and reports

• Perform hands-on functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing across instrument software, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data-analysis interfaces

• Configure and maintain representative test environments, including control of software, firmware, hardware, and test-data configurations

• Isolate and troubleshoot defects using logs, command-line tools, database queries, and reproducible test evidence; clearly communicate severity, impact, and risk

• Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, assay, chemistry, product, UX, and quality partners to evaluate coverage, resolve integration issues, and improve the end-user experience

• Create accurate, review-ready test documentation in accordance with Element’s software development lifecycle and applicable design-control processes

• Identify high-value automation opportunities and contribute to maintainable automated tests and supporting tools as products and interfaces mature

• Communicate test status, quality risks, and recommendations to project leads and stakeholders, and share technical knowledge with less-experienced team members

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

• Typically 3–5 years of hands-on software or systems test experience; experience with life-science, medical-device, or laboratory-instrumentation products is strongly preferred

• Demonstrated ability to derive test coverage from requirements and user stories and to produce clear, traceable test plans, cases, protocols, defect reports, and test reports

• Experience testing interfaces among software, embedded systems, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data-analysis applications

• Proficiency with Linux and command-line tools, log analysis, and SQL or NoSQL databases; scripting or test-automation experience (for example, Python or TypeScript) is preferred

• Experience working within a regulated software development lifecycle and quality system; working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 62304, and ISO 13485 is preferred

• Understanding of product risk management and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ISO 14971 is preferred.

• Knowledge of DNA sequencing workflows or genomics applications is preferred

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage priorities and work effectively across disciplines

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to perform computer-based work and remain in a stationary position for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation

• Ability to move between office and laboratory work areas and operate benchtop laboratory instrumentation, with or without reasonable accommodation

• Ability to follow laboratory safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment

Location:

• San Diego (on-site)

Travel:

• No anticipated travel

Job Type:

• Full-time / Exempt

Base Compensation Pay Range:

• $118,000 - $144,000

In addition to the base compensation noted above, you will be eligible for stock options, a discretionary annual bonus, no-cost health insurance plans, a 401(k) with company match, and flexible paid time off.

Please note: Base compensation will depend on multiple factors, including geographic location, qualifications, and experience.

Benefits & Perks

• Hybrid-Remote Flexibility – Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.

• Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.

• Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.

• Time Off & Leave – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.

• Wellness & Growth – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend.

To learn more about our offerings, click here.

What You'll Do

The Senior Digital Product Manager will be a critical part of the Digital Product team, partnering with an interdisciplinary team of engineers, clinicians, and operators to deliver on Strive's Digital Product Vision and move strategic KPIs in a scalable and standardized way through tech-enabled solutions. This role will serve as the Voice of the Customer and SME in your product area, identify the most pressing problems to solve, and work with the cross-functional team to deliver user-driven solutions to optimize clinical workflows, reduce administrative burden, enhance the member/patient experience, and enable responsible AI-driven automation across patient and provider interactions. As a Senior Digital Product Manager in either the Patient Engagement or Patient Interventions digital product portfolio, this individual will be expected to thrive in ambiguity and creating clarity out of complex problems. This role will report to the Director of Digital Product. Following Strive's Series D funding round, and with our Board of Director's and Chief Technology Officer's enthusiastic support and funding mandate, this role will directly contribute to developing and executing digital capabilities that leverage AI, automation, and analytics to drive measurable outcomes as we transform the patient and provider journey.

The Day to Day

• Meet in person with internal and/or external stakeholders to facilitate team and business priorities/opportunities. Business travel may be required for opportunities to connect with stakeholders, serve patients, and attend Strive-sponsored team events.

• Owns day-to-day functions of a digital product value stream, including executing on the product vision and roadmap.

• Partners with Product leadership and stakeholders to define the product vision and KPIs, and product outcomes.

• Executes day-to-day of product discovery, serves as the voice of the customer, facilitates interdisciplinary team to deliver on goals, and measures success or failure, with oversight from Product leadership.

• Collaborates closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics counterparts within Strive's Agile SDLC to translate strategic goals into scalable, high-impact product solutions.

• Understands market and overall competitive dynamics of their product area with a focus on digital health, AI-enabled workflows, and value-based care models.

• Demonstrates strong stakeholder engagement skills and can influence stakeholder groups while gaining trust across the organization.

• Leverages data driven insights to make effective prioritization decisions and measure the success of initiatives.

• Leads a cross-functional agile team, consistently driving focus and strong outcomes.

• Demonstrates comfort in change and can facilitate a team to strategically adapt and evolve.

• Contributes to continuous improvement of Digital Product team best practices, helping mature product operations, backlog hygiene, and sprint delivery discipline.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

• 5+ years experience in a product management or related role.

• 4+ years experience at either a healthcare delivery organization or working on a technology product in an agile environment.

• Internet Connectivity - Min Speeds: 3.8Mbps/3.0Mbps (up/down): Latency <60 ms.

• Efficient and reliable transportation, including an active driver's license, allowing for travel across an assigned region to meet business needs.

• Ability to travel and be on-site to meet business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

• Proven understanding of digital health ecosystems, clinical workflow technology, and healthcare data interoperability.

• Proven track record in healthcare technology, ideally with value-based care, population health, or digital health platforms.

• Experience leading digital patient experience initiatives (mobile/web/omnichannel).

• Talent for distilling abstract ideas and product vision into actionable nuts and bolts user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Demonstrated success in deploying AI/LLM solutions responsibly.

• Experience operating within pod-based SDLC model, partnering directly with Engineering and Data Science teams.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Strategy, Clinical Operations, and Go-To-Market partners to ensure Digital Product roadmap aligns with enterprise priorities while remaining execution-focused.

Annual Salary Range: $108,500 - $136,000. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15%

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Campaign Operations
jobs.description:
Arbiter is the AI-powered care orchestration system that unites healthcare. We are launching our best-in-class, patient-facing Agentic platform to optimize patient outcomes through a unique multimodal approach. We optimize complex healthcare workflows that interface with patients using the latest Agentic AI approaches, and we combine it with a sophisticated platform to serve this Agentic layer at scale. 

 

Backed by one of the largest seed rounds in health tech history and operators who bring the expertise and distribution to scale nationally, we're building the connected infrastructure healthcare should have had all along.


Our Culture & Values

We are a high-performing group of engineers dedicated to delivering innovative, high-quality solutions to our clients and business partners. We believe in:

 - Excellence: Taking immense pride in our craft and the products we build, treating both with utmost respect and care.

 - Impact-Driven Development: Firmly committed to engineering high-quality, fault-tolerant, and highly scalable systems that evolve seamlessly with business needs, minimizing disruption.

 - Collaboration Over Ego: Valuing exceptional work and groundbreaking ideas above all else. We seek talented individuals who are accustomed to working in a fast-paced environment and are driven to ship often to achieve significant impact.

 - Continuous Growth: Fostering an environment of continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development, where you can deepen your expertise and grow your career.

Responsibilities

As Project Manager, reporting to the Head of Strategic Deployments & Operations. you will own the campaign calendar and the requirements behind every launch. You will turn what customers ask for into clear, buildable specs. You will keep engineering, deployment, and clinical teams working from one plan, and make sure every campaign goes live on time and works as designed. The role combines program management, requirements discipline, and close work with customers.

Campaign calendar ownership:

 - Own the master campaign calendar across all customers: launch dates, outreach waves, refresh cycles, pauses, and end dates.

 - Plan around the deadlines that matter in healthcare, including HEDIS and Star measurement year end, seasonal campaigns like flu, Medicare marketing windows, and each customer’s own reporting cycles.

 - Spot capacity conflicts, dependencies, and timeline risks early, and lead the tradeoff discussions before dates slip.

 - Run a regular launch readiness review so every campaign has the right inputs, approvals, and QA signoff before it goes live.

Requirements and intake:

 - Run campaign intake with customers and internal teams. Capture goals, target populations, measures, outreach rules, escalation paths, scheduling logic, and how success will be measured.

 - Turn business and clinical requirements into clear specs that engineering and deployment can configure without guessing.

 - Keep a single source of truth for each campaign’s requirements, versions, and approvals, so that what launches matches what the customer agreed to.

 - Run change control on live campaigns: log requested changes, assess their impact, get the right signoffs, and schedule them into releases.

Cross-functional coordination:

 - Coordinate the full launch process across customer data files, script and clinical review, compliance approval, configuration, QA, and go-live.

 - Be the main point of contact for campaign timelines on customer projects. Give status updates that are short, accurate, and honest about risk.

 - Work with QA and engineering after launch to make sure issues found on live campaigns feed back into requirements and process.

Process and tooling:

 - Build and maintain the templates and checklists that make launches repeatable: intake forms, requirements specs, readiness checklists, and launch runbooks.

 - Track delivery metrics such as on-time launch rate, intake-to-launch cycle time, and change volume, and use them to improve how the team plans.

 - Help bring the tools we use to manage the calendar and campaign configuration, which are still maturing, up to the level of a team running many campaigns at once.



Minimum Qualifications

 - 3 to 6 years in project or program management, implementation, or technical operations on a software platform with live customer deployments.

 - A proven record of running several concurrent projects with fixed external deadlines.

 - Strong requirements discipline. You can turn a vague customer request into a precise spec, and you ask the questions that prevent rework.

 - Comfort working closely with engineers, and enough technical fluency to read configuration, understand data flows, and know when a change is simple and when it is not.

 - Clear written communication and careful documentation habits.

 - Calm judgment on prioritization when timelines, customers, and internal teams are in conflict.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Healthcare experience, especially payer quality programs (HEDIS, Stars) or provider patient access and scheduling.

 - Experience with patient or member outreach, contact center, or voice AI platforms.

 - Familiarity with HIPAA, PHI handling, and compliance review of member communications.

 - Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Linear, Asana, or Smartsheet, and comfort building lightweight workflows in them.

 - PMP, CSM, or similar certification.

 

This role will be onsite in our New York City office, a fast-paced, collaborative environment where great ideas move quickly from whiteboard to production.

 

Job Benefits

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being and professional growth:

 - Highly Competitive Salary & Equity Package: Designed to rival top FAANG compensation, including meaningful equity.

 - Generous Paid Time Off (PTO): To ensure a healthy work-life balance.

 - Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance: Robust coverage for you and your family.

 - Life and Disability Insurance: Providing financial security.

 - Simple IRA Matching: To support your long-term financial goals.

 - Professional Development Budget: Support for conferences, courses, and certifications to fuel your continuous learning.

 - Wellness Programs: Initiatives to support your physical and mental health.

 

Pay Transparency

The annual base salary range for this position is $180,000-$200,000. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from the posted hiring range based on work experience, skill level, and other factors.

As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

Veeam is a leading provider of backup and recovery software for virtual, physical, and cloud environments. Our Corporate Technology team oversees the operation of the company’s information systems and supports the platforms and services that power Veeam’s business worldwide. We are seeking an AI Solutions Architect to design strategic, cross-functional, and cross-platform AI solutions that enable business transformation. In this role, you will partner with business and technology leaders to architect scalable AI solutions, drive implementation, and ensure successful adoption across the organization.

• Ensure proper rollout of AI solutions.

• Document AI solutions at a high level and ensure the appropriate low-level documentation is created and maintained by development teams.

• Facilitate continuous improvement of designed solutions
