jobs.title: Modern Workplace Architect (6 month FTC)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Modern Workplace Architect to define and own the architecture of Nexthink's corporate digital workplace: how every Nexthinker's devices, collaboration tools, productivity suite and endpoint security fit together into one secure, cloud-native and frictionless experience. As a company that sells digital employee experience, our own workplace is our showcase - this role makes it one. This is a 6-month temporary position covering a maternity leave.

You will partner with IT Operations on delivery, with the IAM and Security teams on standards and controls, and with business stakeholders on adoption, owning the target architecture and roadmap end to end.

Key Responsibilities

Workplace Strategy & Architecture

• Define and own the modern workplace target architecture across endpoints, Microsoft 365, collaboration, and end-user services.

• Develop and maintain the multi-year workplace roadmap, sequencing modernisation against business priorities, risk and cost.

• Establish architecture principles, standards, reference designs and decision records for the corporate workplace estate.

• Lead technology evaluations and vendor selection; scope and steer external partners while retaining internal ownership of design and standards.

• Act as the design authority for changes affecting the employee digital experience.

Endpoint Management & Device Lifecycle

• Architect cloud-native endpoint management for Windows and macOS using Microsoft Intune and Jamf, including co-management retirement where applicable.

• Design zero-touch provisioning (Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager / Automated Device Enrollment) for a global, hybrid workforce.

• Define configuration baselines, patching and update rings (Windows Update for Business, macOS updates), and application packaging and delivery standards.

• Own the device lifecycle model: onboarding, refresh, loss/theft, offboarding and secure wipe.

Microsoft 365 & Collaboration

• Own the architecture and governance of Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, including tenant configuration and lifecycle policies.

• Define collaboration governance: workspace provisioning, external sharing, guest access, retention and sprawl control.

• Architect integration and coexistence with the wider SaaS estate (e.g. Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace) where relevant.

• Lead the secure adoption of Microsoft Copilot and other AI productivity tools, including data readiness, oversharing remediation and usage policies.

Endpoint Security & Zero Trust

• Partner with Security and IAM to design Zero Trust controls for the workplace: device compliance, Conditional Access, and identity-bound device trust.

• Define endpoint security baselines and architecture for EDR, disk encryption, local admin removal and application control.

• Design data protection controls with Microsoft Purview: sensitivity labels, DLP and information protection across devices and collaboration tools.

• Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audit readiness with documented workplace controls and evidence.

Digital Employee Experience & Automation

• Use Nexthink's own DEX platform to measure and improve employee experience; act as an internal reference customer and feed insights back to Product.
• Drive self-service and automated remediation to reduce ticket volume and time to resolution.
• Automate workplace operations with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and scripting, and set engineering standards for workplace automation.
• Act as the technical escalation point for complex workplace incidents and architectural decisions.

• 8+ years in end-user computing, modern workplace or enterprise IT, including 3+ years in an architect or senior technical lead role.

• Demonstrable track record designing and delivering cloud-native workplace architectures at enterprise scale for a distributed, hybrid workforce.

• Deep hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot; strong experience managing macOS with Jamf or equivalent.

• Expert knowledge of Microsoft 365 architecture and governance: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Solid understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Zero Trust principles applied to devices and collaboration.

• Experience with endpoint security and data protection: Defender for Endpoint (or equivalent EDR), Microsoft Purview, encryption and application control.

• Automation skills with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API or similar scripting.

• Familiarity with ISO 27001 or SOC 2 controls and audit evidence.

• Experience with DEX or end-user experience monitoring tools is a strong plus; exposure to Copilot or AI productivity rollouts is a plus.

• Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, Endpoint Administrator, Cybersecurity Architect) are a plus.

• Ability to communicate architecture decisions clearly to senior IT, Security and business stakeholders. Fluent English.

Curious what we build on?

Have a look at how Nexthink scales to trillions of events per day with Amazon MSK, powers real-time alerts with Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink, and builds enterprise AI agents with fine-tuned LLMs on Amazon SageMaker.

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

• 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
• 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
• 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR will be entirely covered by us.
• 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
• 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
• 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
• 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
• 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
• 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, soft drinks and protein shakes at the offie.
• 🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
• 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.
• 🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country.

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Retail Analytics
jobs.description:

Our portfolio of in-house cultivated and manufactured brands features some of the highest quality, most awarded and most popular cannabis products in America. With dozens of locations nationwide, our owned and operated Sunnyside® dispensaries provide a welcoming, positive, judgement-free place to shop for anyone at any point on their cannabis journey.

Founded in 2013, Cresco Labs’ mission is to normalize and professionalize cannabis through our passionate employees. As stewards of the cannabis industry, our teams are constantly focused on supporting the needs of our fellow colleagues, consumers, customers, and communities alike. With a focus on Social Equity and Educational Development, our SEEDTM initiative ensures that our company reflects the communities in which we serve, ensuring equal opportunity for all to have the knowledge and resources to work in and own businesses in cannabis.

At Cresco Labs, we aim to revolutionize and lead the nation’s cannabis industry with a focus on quality and consistency of product, and to bring legitimacy to the industry with the highest level of integrity and professionalism.

If you’re interested in joining our mission, click the below links to join our team today!

MISSION STATEMENT

At Cresco, we aim to lead the nation’s cannabis industry with a focus on regulatory compliance, product consistency, and customer satisfaction. Our operations bring legitimacy to the cannabis industry by acting with the highest level of integrity, strictly adhering to regulations, and promoting the clinical efficacy of cannabis. As Cresco grows, we will operate with the same level of professionalism and precision in each new market we move in to.

JOB SUMMARY

Cresco Labs Corporate is seeking a Sr. Data Analyst to support our Retail teams.  Within this role, you will be responsible for mining, analyzing, visualizing data and the insights it provides.  Through those insights you will support Sunnyside’s retail initiatives, including analysis of customer purchase behavior, pricing, profitability, promotions, loyalty program, and competitive analysis.  The role will be highly collaborative, working across all Retail cross-functional teams (Merchandising, Marketing, Regional Operations, Commercial Strategy, Demand Planning, Finance, and IT teams.)

CORE JOB DUTIES

• Analyze, mine, and aggregate data from internal and external sources- drawing actional insights to present and visualize findings clearly to cross-functional partners.

• Build and own cross functional tools/processes that go beyond standard business reporting to optimize decision-making across multiple levels of organization.

• Establish relationships between retail sales performance and causal factors such as changes in pricing, assortment, and competitive activity. Ability to synthesize and explain results to decision makers on necessary actions

• Provide pricing analysis and calculate ROI of retail promotions. Make recommendations to merchants such as right breadth, depth, and frequency of promotions.

• Create and manage reporting analytics for the Loyalty rewards program. Provide guidance to retail marketing on which levers should be pulled for each event goal.

• Assume the role of data and business expert for retail merchandising, operations, and marketing teams

• Use creative problem-solving skills to answer nuanced & complex business questions

• Support development of the forecast budget and develop Monthly customer purchase behavior decompositions in coordination with Demand Planning Team.

• Act as a liaison and source of truth between the business and BI team, ensuring tableau dashboards are tailored to business reporting needs.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with other team members to drive various initiatives forward

• Leverage AI tools and large language models to design automated workflows and agent-based interactions that accelerate routine analysis and surface deeper, more nuanced insights.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND SKILLS

• 4+ years of experience in consulting, data science, quantitative marketing, merchandising, or a related data-driven field

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Operations (or similar)

• Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, advanced Excel knowledge.

• Familiarity with relational databases (SQL) and business intelligence tools (i.e., Tableau, Power BI)

• Ability to understand business operations, processes, and translate data into business insights that “tell a story” or aid decision-making

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze and communicate data and information with attention to detail and accuracy

• Experience with sales data analytics strongly preferred

• Effective time management and prioritization skills. Strong interpersonal & collaboration skills

In accordance with any local and state compensation laws, the compensation listed is the current estimated range for the position. Final offer details and future compensation may be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to, geographic location, market compensation data, skills, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this please discuss with your recruiter during the interview process.

Pay Range

$60,000—$70,000 USD

BENEFITS

Cresco Labs is proud to offer eligible employees a robust offering of benefits including, major medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(K)-match program, FSA/HSA programs, LTD/STD options, life insurance and AD&D.  We also offer eligible employees paid holidays and paid time off.  Other rewards may include annual discretionary bonuses, stock options as well as participation in our employee discount program. Benefits eligibility for permanent positions may vary by full-time or part-time roles, location, or position.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Must be 21 years of age or older to apply

• Must comply with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry

• The company does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role or any other position, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship at any time.

Cresco Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applicants will be considered without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants:

Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the Sunnyside* Privacy Policy and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com

Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

Please note that Cresco Labs does not ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career’s pages.

We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.

If you are in doubt, please contact us at Report-a-spam@crescolabs.com with questions.

Salesforce configuration and administration

• Maintain knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, new releases, internal tools, and team processes.

Automation and process improvement

• Build, maintain, and QA automation, primarily using Salesforce Flow and other native process automation.

• Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and reduce technical debt.

Production support and troubleshooting

• Investigate, diagnose, and resolve user-reported issues according to defined service levels.

• Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a business or operations environment.
• Experience configuring Salesforce objects, fields, validation rules, formulas, permissions, sharing, and Flow automation.
• Experience troubleshooting Salesforce issues and communicating technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience performing QA, supporting UAT, documenting changes, and participating in controlled releases.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality, follow-through, and clear communication.
• Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and collaboration skills.

Preferred

• Salesforce Administrator certification; additional Salesforce certifications are a plus.
• Experience with Gearset or another Salesforce deployment and release-management tool.
• Experience writing complex Salesforce formulas and validation rules.
• Experience running Apex test classes or partnering effectively with developers on code-related testing.
• Experience supporting Lead-to-Cash, order management, approvals, pricing, contracting, or other revenue operations processes.
• Experience working with Salesforce integrations or connected business systems including but not limited to: Marketing Cloud, Gong, Salesforce CPQ or other integrated CPQ tool, Ironclad, and more.

• Reliable, well-documented resolution of production support issues.
• Strong SLA adherence and reduced recurrence of known issues.
• High-quality enhancements delivered through scheduled releases.
• Low defect leakage and effective QA/UAT support.
• Complete and maintainable configuration and release documentation.

jobs.title: VP of Product, AI & Workflow Automation – Clinical Trials
jobs.description:

Florence software advances cures by helping the world’s most important research sites do their best work. Our solutions are now used by over 65,000 research teams in 90 countries around the world—we’re the most widely deployed site workflow tool in the industry. By the end of the decade, we’ll double the pace at which new medicines get to market by doubling the output of trial site teams. To date, we were named a Deloitte Fast 50 business, G2 Category Leader, an Inc. & AJC best place to work, and an Inc. 5000 company five years in a row.

At Florence, we are committed to make the world a better place by accelerating research while providing an environment for our employees where they can be happy in their lives, enjoy their jobs, and grow.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

At Florence, we're passionate about making it easy for research sites and sponsors to run clinical trials, helping therapies reach participants quickly. Our customers leverage Florence to organize regulatory documentation, partner with sponsors, and execute clinical studies. We are integrating these core offerings into a unified trial operations platform. This solution bridges Sponsor and Site operational workflows end-to-end, decreasing workload on research staff while deploying AI agents for routine manual trial responsibilities.

We are seeking a strategic leader who bridges two distinct skill sets. You possess practical experience in executing clinical research from initiation to site closeout. Simultaneously, you hold proven expertise in building and scaling enterprise SaaS platforms rather than managing single product features. While many professionals bring one side of this experience, we require both capabilities.

You will collaborate closely with the VP of Product, who directs specific application roadmaps, while you lead the overarching platform architecture and connected customer journey.

You’ll Own:

• Platform vision and experience architecture. Define how our Sponsor and Site applications function as an integrated ecosystem, establishing the shared data strategy, cross-product workflows, and integrations with CTMS, EDC, eTMF, and external systems.

• Domain authority. Serve as the internal authority on operational workflows, converting real-world clinical experience into clear platform direction for product managers and engineering units.

• AI-native capabilities. Partner with Engineering and AI teams to pinpoint where automated agents minimize operational drag for sponsors and sites, delivering these features in alignment with GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.

• Platform business outcomes. Drive platform expansion, cross-product attachment, and platform-driven ARR and retention metrics. Partner across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to refine packaging, pricing, and go-to-market strategies.

• Ecosystem. Direct our integration and partner ecosystem strategy, spanning APIs and agent frameworks like MCP, while assisting Corporate Development on build, buy, or partner choices.

• Market insight. Monitor traditional eClinical providers, emerging AI-driven platforms, and evolving guidelines such as ICH E6(R3) to transform market dynamics into long-term product bets.

What Success Looks Like:

• First 90 days: Establish an aligned platform vision and 12-month strategic roadmap endorsed by executive leadership, product, and engineering.

• 6 months: Deploy initial cross-product workflows connecting Sponsor and Site solutions in active production with design partners.

• 12 months: Demonstrate clear reductions in site effort and trial activation timelines while hitting platform retention and attach goals.

An Ideal Candidate Has:

Clinical trial operations depth (required)

• 7+ years of experience within clinical trial operations or clinical technologies, gained at, or working with, a sponsor, CRO, major site network, academic institution, or life sciences consulting practice.

• Direct knowledge of study operational workflows, including site selection, study startup, essential document management, monitoring, and Sponsor-Site alignment.

• Working understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH GCP E6(R3), and regulatory compliance requirements within computerized systems validation.

SaaS platform building (required)

• 8+ years managing B2B SaaS product portfolios, with a minimum of 3 years leading product management teams.

• Demonstrated track record scaling platform ecosystems beyond single-point features, including shared data architecture, APIs, external integrations, and partner strategies.

• Ability to partner with technical leadership on overall platform architecture, data structures, and AI/ML implementations.

Differentiators

• Prior tenure at an eClinical platform organization (eReg/eISF, CTMS, eTMF, or site enablement solutions).

• Proven experience delivering AI or machine learning functionality within regulated software platforms.

• Background in high-growth startup or venture-backed environments. An MBA or advanced science degree is a plus.

Leadership

• Skillful at cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales, with executive-level communication for clients and stakeholders.

• Entrepreneurial drive with a penchant for building scalable processes in fast-paced environments.

What’s in it for you?

• Do good. We insist that health technology is the highest calling for software development. We pride ourselves on working on something bigger than ourselves; helping advance cures and therapies.

jobs.title: Payroll Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is seeking a Payroll Systems Analyst to help us streamline our payroll operations and build the tools that connect payroll to the rest of the business. We're looking for someone who is excited about solving complex process, data and technical challenges in a high-growth fintech environment, and who knows that every payroll error lands on a real person's payslip.

The Payroll Systems Analyst will report to the HR Systems Lead within the HR Technology team. You'll join just after we go live on our new HRIS. In this role, you'll act as a bridge between our Payroll, People and Finance teams and our technical capabilities, designing processes and building tools that handle multi-country payroll, different statutory and tax regimes, multiple currencies, and varying local requirements.

In this role, you’ll:

• Defining and strengthening our Payroll team's ways of working Mapping how payroll runs today in each of our markets: inputs, calendars, cut-offs, approvals, handoffs with HR and Finance, and the in-country providers involved. You'll identify where effort is manual, duplicated or at risk. Aligning global payroll standards, system controls and RACIs across countries, while keeping room for the local statutory requirements that can't be standardized. Defining how payroll requests, changes and issues are received, tracked and resolved, for example through our internal service desk, so that nothing depends on email threads or individual memory. Training Payroll team members on new processes and tools, and acting as their primary partner for systems questions. Building our in-house payroll-to-finance reconciliation tool Owning the design and delivery of an internal tool that reconciles payroll outputs from our providers against the HRIS and the general ledger across entities and countries, from requirements through build, testing and rollout. Defining the reconciliation logic with Payroll and Finance: headcount, gross-to-net, employer costs, accruals, cost center and entity mapping, FX, and variance thresholds. Automating data ingestion from payroll provider reports and HRIS extracts, and building clear exception reporting so the teams spend their time on discrepancies rather than on matching rows. Iterating on the tool after launch based on user feedback and month-end close needs, and documenting it so it can be maintained and extended. Providing core Payroll Systems support Supporting the stabilization of HRIS-to-payroll data flows after our new HRIS go-live, so that hires, job and compensation changes, leave and terminations reach payroll accurately and on time. Analyzing payroll workflows and integrations to recommend improvements, with a focus on reducing manual inputs and spreadsheet handoffs between HR, Payroll and Finance. Supporting future payroll provider changes, consolidations, integrations and new-market launches. Coordinating the testing of legislative and system updates so that statutory changes (tax tables, social contributions, minimum wage) are applied correctly. Driving Payroll Data Quality and Reporting Owning payroll data quality across systems and conducting regular audits to find and resolve discrepancies. Developing payroll reporting and dashboards that support HR, Finance and business decisions, such as payroll cost by entity and country, and period-over-period variance. Managing data privacy and access controls for sensitive pay and banking data in line with GDPR and other applicable regulations.

Key details

• Employees in remote positions at Wave can work remotely from anywhere (between UTC -8 and +4) with reliable internet access in the US, Canada, United Kingdom, Belgium, Poland, Spain, Senegal, Cote d’Ivoire, Mali, Uganda, Kenya, or Ghana.

• Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering an annual gross salary range of $88,100 -$125,900 depending on your level and location.

• Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).

• 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.

• Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30-40 days per year.

• $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

• Fluent in English and French.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in HRIS, payroll operations, payroll systems or payroll accounting, ideally in a multi-country or multi-entity organization.

• Experience and understanding of end-to-end payroll processes, including inputs, calendars and cut-offs, gross-to-net, statutory deductions, and payments.

• Hands-on experience reconciling payroll to the general ledger, including employer costs, accruals, and cost center and entity mapping.

• Experience working with third-party or in-country payroll providers, and with the data flows between the HRIS, payroll and finance systems.

• Demonstrated experience documenting, standardizing and improving processes, such as controls, checklists, sign-off flows and RACIs.

• Advanced knowledge of data management, analysis and reporting

• Experience building tools or automations (scripts, Apps Script, low-code platforms like Workato or Zapier), or a strong interest in learning to.

• Experience with Business Intelligence systems like Sigma, Power BI or Looker.

• Effective written and verbal communication to collaborate with Payroll, HR and Finance stakeholders and explain technical information to non-technical audiences.

• Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills.

Nice to have:

• Payroll experience in francophone West Africa (e.g. CNPS, IPRES/CSS, ITS/IRPP) or with OHADA accounting.

• Experience with Workday or another enterprise HRIS.

• A payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP)

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Creative Project Manager
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

Roku's Global Brand Studio brings the Roku brand to life through creative work that connects with consumers, advertisers, and partners. We work across brand marketing, advertising, content, and events, partnering with teams across the business to turn priorities into compelling creative. Creative Project Management connects people, priorities, and production, giving our creative teams the clarity and support they need to do their best work.

What is the role?

We are looking for a Creative Project Manager to join the Global Brand and Creative Studio team, with dedicated support for the Roku Advertising organization. This role will manage the day-to-day execution of creative projects across design, video, animation, motion graphics, events, executive presentations, and sales materials with a focus on supporting those teams through AI tools, workflows, and forward-thinking AI initiatives to support team creativity, capabilities, and efficiency. The Creative Project Manager will partner closely with creative teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate requests into clear scopes, timelines, workflows, and deliverables. This is an individual-contributor role that will report into the Manager of Creative Project Management and operate as part of the broader project management team. The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, solutions-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple fast-moving creative workstreams with experience using AI tools and practices from a project management standpoint. Our industry changes quickly, so we expect this person to be comfortable responding to changing business needs, working through ambiguity, and helping teams stay aligned and moving forward.

For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $120,000 and 135,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

• Manage revenue-supporting creative projects end-to-end, from intake and kickoff to reviews, approvals, delivery, and launch, including hour tracking and running meetings as needed

• Build and maintain project timelines, workback schedules, and milestone plans for sales materials, presentations, sizzle reels, and other revenue-driving initiatives

• Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify scope, gather inputs, and align on priorities, deliverables, reviews, and approvals

• Balance planned work with fast-moving business opportunities while maintaining clear communication around timing, scope, and tradeoffs

• Provide the creative team with the assets, feedback, and decisions they need to move forward, whether working with internal team members, freelancers, contractors, agencies, production companies, or post-production partners

• Maintain organized records of project costs, approvals, and external partner commitments

• Help coordinate high-visibility Roku Advertising moments, including NewFronts, Cannes Lions, Advertising Week, CES, executive presentations, and partner events

• Use AI tools to streamline work, including status tracking and updates, meeting summaries, daily workflows, and reporting tools to track efficiencies and help surface risks

• Leverage AI to create cost-savings and efficiencies that positively impact Roku's bottom line

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

• 5+ years of experience in project management, creative operations, integrated production, or related roles, with meaningful experience in integrated marketing, AI, or creative development

• Experience supporting an in-house creative team, advertising organization, agency, media company, entertainment company, or technology brand

• Strong understanding of creative development, production workflows, reviews, approvals, and final asset delivery

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholder workflows, deadlines, and changing priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment where business needs can shift quickly

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

What should I know about Roku's culture?

jobs.title: Financial Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including Momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is looking for a NetSuite / Salesforce / FloQast Administrator to join our Enterprise Applications team within Finance. You'll be the day-to-day owner of configuration, user administration, and integration health across our core finance and revenue systems — the person who actually knows why a saved search broke, why a workflow stalled, or why a sync between NetSuite and Salesforce didn't fire. This role rewards curiosity and precision: you don't need to arrive as a NetSuite expert, but you do need to want to become one, and you need to be the kind of person who double-checks a config change before it touches production. You'll work closely with Finance, Accounting, Sales Ops, and Engineering, and partner with senior systems analysts and architects on the bigger roadmap items — but the daily craft of keeping these systems accurate, well-documented, and running smoothly is yours.

This role will be required to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Administer day-to-day configuration of NetSuite, Salesforce, FloQast and Blackline: user setup/deactivation, roles and permissions, saved searches, SuiteAnalytics workbooks/dashboards, Salesforce flows and validation rules, troubleshooting issues within Salesforce.

 - Serve as backup administrator for Expensify, supporting user provisioning, system configuration, synchronization issues, and end-user troubleshooting

 - Build and maintain NetSuite SuiteFlow workflows and troubleshoot existing SuiteScript customizations — you don't need to write scripts from scratch on day one, but you should be comfortable reading one, tracing what it does, and knowing when to escalate to a developer.

 - Triage and resolve support tickets from Finance and general employees related to expense reports, financial records, and account access, digging into root cause rather than just closing the ticket.

 - Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between NetSuite and Salesforce — including iPaaS/middleware tools and direct API/SFTP data feeds — escalating to engineering when needed.

 - Support month-end and quarter-end close by ensuring system data accuracy, running reports, and resolving reconciliation discrepancies.

 - Support the month-end close by managing file-based data transfers to the external reporting platform, validating successful loads, and troubleshooting exceptions with the Reporting team

 - Perform sandbox testing and validate NetSuite's release upgrades against existing customizations and integrations before anything touches production.

 - Maintain user access lists and perform basic access reviews to support audit, SOX, and compliance needs.

 - Create and maintain clear documentation, quick-reference guides, and training materials — you take pride in writing something a new teammate could actually follow without asking you a follow-up question.

 - Partner with senior systems analysts/architects to implement approved process changes and provide hands-on support during testing and hypercare for larger rollouts, without owning roadmap prioritization.




PLEASE APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

 - 2-4 years of hands-on administration experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, and/or Expensify (or similar ERP/CRM/expense platforms) — OR strong ERP/CRM administration fundamentals elsewhere plus genuine enthusiasm for going deep on NetSuite specifically. We'd rather hire for curiosity and a learning mindset than a perfect checklist of prior tools.

 - Familiarity with (or eagerness to quickly learn) NetSuite's configuration layer: saved searches, SuiteFlow, roles/permissions, custom fields and records, and at least reading-level comfort with SuiteScript.

 - Working knowledge of basic system integrations (API/SFTP, or iPaaS tools like Celigo/Workato/Boomi) and comfort troubleshooting data sync issues.

 - Real attention to detail — the kind that notices a saved search is returning one extra row before it becomes a finance reporting problem.

jobs.title: Manager, Web Content Strategy
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking a Manager, Web Content Strategy to lead how our product, technology, and solution content is planned, structured, governed, and optimized across renesas.com and the broader digital ecosystem. This role will ensure customers can easily find and understand authoritative information throughout the buying and design journey, whether they are using the website, traditional search engines, partner platforms, or emerging AI-powered experiences.

This is both a strategic and people-leadership role. You will define the vision, roadmap, governance model, and standards for Renesas content across web experiences, product content, blogs, videos, and other digital channels. You will also guide the team and cross-functional partners in improving content quality, consistency, discoverability, operational efficiency, and business impact across the global digital ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in web content strategy, content operations, governance, digital experience optimization, and team leadership, with an understanding of how search and emerging AI experiences influence content discovery.

Key Responsibilities:

· Content strategy: Define and evolve Renesas content strategy across product, technical, and marketing content, ensuring the information customers need is available throughout the buying and design journey. Establish content priorities, identify gaps, guide editorial roadmaps, and align content investments with business objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities.

· Team leadership: Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team responsible for content strategy, search strategy, governance, intake processes, and optimization initiatives. Establish priorities, clarify ownership, drive execution, and foster a customer-centric, data-driven approach to content quality and discoverability.

· Content operations & governance: Establish scalable content intake, review, and governance processes that ensure content requirements, metadata, taxonomy, discoverability considerations, and supporting assets are complete before work is handed off to web production and development teams. Drive consistency, quality, and operational efficiency across the content lifecycle.

· Search & content discoverability: Provide strategic direction for SEO, GEO, onsite search, and emerging AI discovery initiatives, partnering with search specialists to establish priorities and integrate discoverability considerations into the broader content strategy. Ensure Renesas content is structured to be findable, understandable, and authoritative across web, search, partner, and AI-powered experiences.

· Information architecture & taxonomy: Define and evolve content architecture, taxonomy, metadata standards, and organizational frameworks that improve findability, scalability, consistency, and discoverability across web, search, AI, and partner ecosystems.

· Measurement and insights: Establish reporting frameworks across content quality, customer engagement, discoverability, operational effectiveness, and business impact. Partner with analytics and search specialists to define meaningful measures for SEO and AI visibility, identify optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

· Market awareness: Monitor platform changes, competitive activity, emerging tools, and shifts in search behavior to recommend strategic adjustments, bringing an experimentation mindset that tests new approaches and doubles down on what works.

· Cross-functional partnership: Act as the connective tissue across content, web, engineering, product, and executive stakeholders to communicate priorities, create shared touchpoints, and drive execution.

· 7+ years of experience in web content strategy, digital content, content operations, digital experience, or related disciplines, including experience leading teams and cross-functional initiatives. Experience incorporating SEO, onsite search, or emerging discovery channels into a broader content strategy is preferred.

· Working knowledge of how search engines, LLMs, and answer engines discover and surface content, along with an interest in how emerging search behaviors are influencing content strategy and brand visibility.

· Experience developing and scaling content programs across web, product, technical, and marketing channels, including editorial planning, content standards, and quality management.

· Experience establishing content intake processes, governance models, and workflows that enable efficient content operations at scale.

· Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving alignment across marketing, product, engineering, and web teams.

· Familiarity with onsite search and relevance tuning, monitoring search behavior, and maintaining synonyms and rules.

· Familiarity with technical SEO concepts such as structured data, schema markup, crawl efficiency, and site architecture, with the ability to partner effectively with search and development specialists.

· Strong analytical skills and the ability to transform data into compelling stories that drive informed business decisions.

· Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, engineering, data science, communications, or related field.

· Experience in the semiconductor industry is a plus.

Dallas TX and San Jose CA are other locations for consideration.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

jobs.title: Director, Business Management
jobs.description:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.

Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.

Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.

At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.

At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.

Responsibilities

• Partnering with portfolio managers and trading leaders to understand their strategies, business economics, constraints and priorities, and identify opportunities to grow or protect trading P&L

• Developing and evaluating initiatives involving new markets, products, venues, trading capabilities, commercial partnerships, financing and clearing arrangements, market data, and infrastructure

• Creating fact-based business cases using market and trading data, scenario analysis, and commercial judgment, quantifying potential benefits, costs, capital requirements, implementation effort, and risks

• Serving as a senior thought partner to portfolio managers, trading leadership, and firm management, challenging assumptions constructively to help distinguish attractive opportunities from initiatives that are unlikely to generate sufficient returns, and prioritizing opportunities in the context of engineering capacity, organizational resources, risk, and expected commercial impact

• Developing and maintaining senior relationships with banks, prime brokers, FCMs, executing brokers, exchanges, trading venues, clearing organizations, and other strategic counterparties

• Advocating and negotiating on commercial terms, market access, financing and clearing arrangements, product design, venue functionality, and other strategic matters

• Representing Tower in industry groups and promoting market-structure outcomes that support fair, resilient, and competitive markets

• Leading complex cross-functional initiatives by coordinating with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Risk, Operations, and other internal teams, by establishing clear ownership, resolving dependencies, escalating decisions, and maintaining accountability for outcomes

• Improving efficiency of internal processes through better data, automation, decision frameworks particularly where doing so increases speed, scalability, or commercial effectiveness

• Promoting sound operating standards across the Americas Business Management team

Qualifications

• A bachelor’s or advanced degree from a top university

• At least 10 years of relevant experience within quantitative trading, proprietary trading, a systematic hedge fund, electronic trading at a bank, a trading venue, or a closely related market-structure business

• Direct experience working with portfolio managers, traders, quantitative researchers, or electronic-trading businesses

• A demonstrated record of originating and implementing initiatives that produced measurable revenue, capacity, cost, capital, or risk benefits

• Strong quantitative and commercial judgment, including the ability to analyze data, structure ambiguous problems, test assumptions, and translate analysis into decisions

• A practical understanding of how systematic trading businesses make money, including relevant considerations such as liquidity, transaction costs, execution quality, capacity, exchange economics, financing, margin, market access, data, and technology

• Deep expertise in at least one relevant asset class or market, with the ability and intellectual range to work across several others

• Experience negotiating with banks, brokers, FCMs, exchanges, trading venues, or other financial-market infrastructure providers

• Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple senior stakeholders

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make concise, well-supported recommendations to portfolio managers and senior management

• Strong judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate independently while escalating material decisions appropriately

• Experience engaging with industry associations or market-structure working groups

Anticipated annual base salary range is $200,00 - $250,000, plus eligible for discretionary bonus.

Benefits

Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.

At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.

Our benefits include:

• Generous paid time off policies

• Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region

• Hybrid working opportunities

• Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily

• In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)

• Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)

• Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving

• Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year

• Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.

jobs.title: Computational Biologist Principal Research Scientist II
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an accomplished scientific leader in AI-enabled computational biology to establish and advance next-generation immunogenicity and translational immunology capabilities across biologics discovery and development. The successful candidate will serve as a discipline expert and strategic partner, combining machine learning, protein language models, structural modeling, systems immunology, and computational biology to predict, understand, and mitigate anti-drug antibody (ADA) responses and other immune-mediated liabilities across therapeutic proteins, multispecific antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, gene therapies, and novel modalities.

This individual will define scientific strategy, lead high-impact cross-functional programs, build fit-for-purpose computational capabilities, and translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for project teams, governance bodies, and senior leaders. The role includes direct people leadership and accountability for developing an effective, collaborative, and scientifically excellent team.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Strategy and Functional Leadership

• Develop and deliver the computational immunogenicity strategy in alignment with Development Sciences priorities and key scientific objectives.
• Serve as the discipline expert and primary contact for AI/ML-enabled immunogenicity, protein engineering, and translational modeling.
• Identify emerging scientific and technology trends, assess their relevance, and translate them into short- and long-term functional objectives.
• Create, champion, and implement innovative approaches that improve candidate selection, risk mitigation, and transition success.

AI/ML-Based Immunogenicity and Protein Modeling

• Lead development and deployment of predictive models for preclinical and clinical immunogenicity risk assessment.
• Integrate ADA incidence, PK/PD, HLA, sequence, structure, developability, assay, and patient-level data using machine learning and deep learning approaches.
• Apply protein language models, foundation models, transformers, generative AI, and physics-informed modeling to identify immunogenicity drivers, biomarkers, and design opportunities.
• Develop or guide methods to predict ADA incidence and persistence, T-cell epitope content, HLA-associated risk, patient susceptibility, and drug-like properties of biologics.

Systems Immunology, Multi-Omics, and Translational Modeling

• Integrate transcriptomic, proteomic, single-cell, spatial biology, flow cytometry, bioanalytical, and clinical datasets to characterize immune responses to biologics.
• Build computational frameworks linking in vitro and ex vivo assays, nonclinical observations, molecular mechanisms, and clinical ADA or neutralizing-antibody outcomes.
• Identify biomarkers associated with immune activation, tolerance, and ADA development, and use findings to inform translational and clinical strategies.

Generative AI, Knowledge Integration, and Data Platforms

• Lead development of PLM- and LLM-enabled tools for scientific knowledge mining, hypothesis generation, and immunogenicity risk assessment.
• Guide retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows that use scientific literature, historical studies, internal reports, and regulatory guidance.
• Establish integrated, traceable immunogenicity data assets and scalable data pipelines spanning discovery, nonclinical, and clinical development.
• Ensure analytical approaches are reproducible, scientifically defensible, appropriately documented, and fit for their intended use.

Cross-Functional Influence and Communication

• Collaborate with experts across Discovery, Protein Sciences, Bioanalysis, Clinical, Regulatory, Toxicology, Data Science, and other Development Sciences functions.
• Communicate complex scientific concepts, model performance, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Present scientific strategies and results to project teams, functional leadership, governance committees, senior management, and internal or external partners.
• Build strong working relationships, reconcile differing technical perspectives, and influence decisions through evidence-based recommendations.

People Leadership and Talent Development

• Manage, mentor, and develop a team of computational scientists and/or computational protein engineers; set clear priorities and maintain accountability for high-quality delivery.
• Provide technical guidance, performance coaching, career development, and timely feedback to direct reports.
• Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that encourages scientific rigor, innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
• Assess capability needs and help build the talent, partnerships, and operating model required to achieve functional goals.

Required Qualifications

• Ph.D. in computational biology, computational structural biology, bioinformatics, biomedical informatics, computer science, data science, biophysics, or a related scientific field, with typically 8 or more years of related work experience; or a Master’s degree with typically 14 or more years.
• Demonstrated discipline expertise in computational protein science, biologics discovery or development, AI/ML, and predictive modeling.
• Proven ability to define scientific strategy, lead complex multidisciplinary programs, and deliver innovative computational capabilities with measurable scientific or product impact.
• Demonstrated people-management experience, including leading scientific teams, setting priorities, coaching employees, and supporting performance and career development.
• Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively to scientific, non-scientific, and senior-leadership audiences.
• Strong record of collaboration and influence across diverse internal and external groups.
• Experience with HLA binding prediction, T-cell epitope prediction, MHC-II modeling, single-cell analysis, knowledge graphs, causal AI, RAG systems, or biomedical language models.
• Experience handling, curating, integrating, and governing large experimental, biological, clinical, structural, or multi-omics datasets.
• Experience developing and maintaining reproducible data pipelines, automated workflows, and deployable computational tools.
• Demonstrated understanding of physical principles governing protein structure, folding, binding, developability, and molecular recognition.

Scientific and Technical Expertise

• Protein language models, generative protein design, structural modeling, and computational antibody engineering.
• Biologics developability, property prediction, sequence and structure optimization, and translational decision support.
• Immunology, adaptive immune responses, ADA and neutralizing-antibody biology, immune tolerance, and translational medicine.
• Proficiency in Python and relevant scientific computing, data science, and machine-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or XGBoost.
• Cloud or scalable computing environments such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake, and effective scientific data visualization.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with immunogenicity risk assessment, ADA data interpretation, and relevant FDA or EMA guidance.
• Experience converting computational prototypes into tools that are adopted by research or development teams.
• Publication, patent, invited-presentation, or other record demonstrating scientific innovation and external or internal recognition.
• Experience building collaborations across computational, experimental, translational, and clinical disciplines.

Commercial Ag Credit Intern – Summer 2027

Capital Farm Credit's summer internship program provides students with hands-on experience in agricultural finance while working alongside professionals who serve farmers, ranchers, and rural communities across Texas. Interns gain valuable industry experience, build professional connections, and develop skills to prepare them for their future careers.

What You'll Experience

• Gain hands-on experience in the daily operations of an agricultural lending office, including loan input, analysis, and credit processes.

• Work alongside loan officers, credit analysts, appraisers, and loan administrators to learn how agricultural financing decisions are made.

• Tour agricultural operations, visit other Capital Farm Credit offices, and shadow professionals across different areas of the organization to better understand our customers and the industries we serve.

• Develop working knowledge of the systems and technology used in agricultural lending and credit operations.

• Build relationships with employees and executive leaders through orientation, professional development activities, and networking opportunities.

• Complete a summer project and present your work to members of Capital Farm Credit's executive leadership team during the closing session.

• Develop practical analytical, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills through meaningful projects and daily business activities.

Qualifications Required:

• Currently pursuing a bachelor's or graduate degree at an accredited college or university in Finance, Accounting, Business, Agricultural Business, Agricultural Economics, or a related field supporting a career in agricultural finance. Enrollment in summer courses is not required.

• Minimum cumulative GPA of 2.5 on a 4.0 scale.

• Junior, senior, or graduate student standing by the start of the internship.

• Ability to work full-time, in person, at the assigned Capital Farm Credit office throughout the internship.

Preferred:

• Anticipated graduation in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028.

• Previous work experience in the financial industry, although not required.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrated initiative, leadership potential, and willingness to learn.

• Ability to work collaboratively with others and demonstrate a strong work ethic.

• Dependability, punctuality, and commitment to consistent attendance.

Internship Schedule & Program Expectations

• Program Dates: May 26 – August 12, 2027. This is a full-time, in-person internship.

• Required Program Events: Interns must attend three in-person sessions at Capital Farm Credit's headquarters in College Station, TX: Orientation: May 26–28, 2027 Mid-Summer Session: Tentatively scheduled for the week of July 5, 2027 Closing Session: August 12, 2027

• Summer Project: Interns are required to complete a project during the summer and present their work to members of the executive leadership team at the closing session.

• Travel: Capital Farm Credit may provide mileage reimbursement and overnight accommodations for required program events, when applicable.

• Location & Transportation: Interns must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of their assigned office and have reliable transportation to meet work and required travel expectations.

• Attendance: Due to the condensed nature of the program, regular and reliable attendance is essential. Interns should not plan more than three workdays of personal absence during the internship. Extended vacations or other significant planned absences are strongly discouraged. Applicants should consider existing summer commitments before applying and disclose significant pre-planned personal absences during the interview or offer process. Interns who are unable to meet program expectations may not be able to successfully complete the internship. Attendance expectations do not apply to absences protected by applicable law or approved as a reasonable accommodation.

Compensation & Relocation Assistance

• $18 per hour.

• $1,500 relocation stipend for eligible interns who relocate for the internship.

How to Apply

Application Deadline: Monday, November 16, 2026

• Visit Capital Farm Credit Careers to submit a completed online application, resume, and cover letter.

• Your cover letter should briefly explain your interest in Capital Farm Credit and what you hope to gain from the internship experience.

• Qualified applicants should expect an invitation to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire within approximately five business days of submitting their application. If you do not receive an invitation, please check your junk or spam folders.

• To be considered for internships in multiple locations or departments, submit a separate application for each position of interest.

At the discretion of CFC, position may be offered at alternate titles and other business experience may be considered relevant.

AA/EOE/M/F/D/V; Full description available on request.

Applicants should personally complete and submit their application materials. Submissions generated through automated tools or third-party mass application services may not be reviewed.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Capital Farm Credit is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The position title and requirements may be adjusted based on the candidate's experience and qualifications. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, gender, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status. A full job description is available upon request. Candidates selected for hire will be required to complete a background check, including criminal history, education verification, and employment verification. A credit check will be required for roles that require NMLS registration.

jobs.description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is hiring a highly qualified 6-8th Grade Social Studies Teacher at Thompson School for Girls in Cleveland, Ohio dedicated to providing a superior education for all students. We are seeking teachers who are passionate and dedicated to bringing the curriculum to life for each student. We want our teachers to be excited to create a positive classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development.

Be part of the difference at Thompson School for Girls! Providing students in EK-11 grades an opportunity for cultivating confidence, leadership and academic excellence in a nurturing, all-girls environment that empowers students to achieve their full potential. Thompson School for Girls is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

Responsibilities of the Teacher include to-

• Prepare and deliver lesson plans with the ability to modify accordingly during the school year

• Differentiate instruction to meet the needs of all students

• Maintain accurate and complete records of students’ progress and development

• Utilize research-based best practices in daily planning and classroom instruction

• Manage student behavior in the classroom

• Create a positive classroom environment for students to learn in

• Utilize school approved curricula that reflects the diverse educational, cultural, and linguistic backgrounds of the students

• Implement school-wide culture expectations and norms

• Communicate and meet with families regarding the academic and social-emotional growth of their child

• Incorporate technology skills into daily classroom practice to support learning

• Participate in the planning and implementation of non-instructional activities, as needed

• Collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues

• Perform other duties as assigned

About You:

• Active and current state of Ohio teaching license in appropriate content area

• Bachelor’s degree in education or related field

• High level of comfort working in a growth-focused coaching environment based on frequent observations, debriefs, action planning, and progress monitoring

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to properly manage confidential information

• Able to supervise students of various ages in different school settings (playground, cafeteria, etc.)

• Ability to pass federal and state criminal background checks

• Experience working within an urban environment

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $41,000 - 50,500. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

• Paid time off

• Retirement contributions

• Optional Basic Life and AD&D insurance

• Voluntary life insurance (employee, spouse, child)

• Discounted childcare at Early Learning Academies locations

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Employee Assistance Program

• Voluntary short-term disability insurance

• Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

• Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

jobs.title: CEI Senior Inspector
jobs.description:
AECOM is actively seeking a highly skilled CEI Senior Inspector to join our team and support ongoing construction engineering and inspection efforts in the North Port, FL area. This role will play a critical part in ensuring that major transportation and infrastructure projects are delivered in accordance with FDOT standards, contract requirements, and overall project objectives.

• Performs highly complex technical assignments related to field surveying and construction layout, ensuring accuracy and adherence to project specifications
• Verifies engineering computations, inspects construction work, and conducts field testing to maintain quality and compliance standards
• Coordinates, oversees, and provides guidance to junior inspectors to ensure consistent execution of inspection activities
• Operates under the general supervision of the Project Administrator while exercising independent judgment in daily responsibilities
• Utilizes experience and sound judgment to effectively plan, prioritize, and accomplish project goals
• Establishes and manages project timelines and deadlines to support overall project delivery
• Provides on-the-job training and mentorship to new team members to support their development and integration
• Monitors conformance to quality, performance, specifications, and applicable code requirements through detailed inspection activities
• Conducts daily field inspections and maintains accurate, organized inspection records and reports
• Participates in punch list development, system testing, and commissioning activities to ensure project completion standards are met
• Tracks and reports on quality assurance progress, identifying and addressing any deficiencies
• Contributes to documentation for area and equipment turnover packages, ensuring completeness and accuracy for project closeout

Minimum Requirements:

• High School Diploma plus 4 years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education
• Valid US Driver’s License required to visit project sites, clients, and other AECOM offices. As a condition of employment, selected candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Records review

Preferred Qualifications:

• Four (4) years of CEI experience in roadway or bridge construction
• CTQP Final Estimates Level I
• CTQP Concrete Field Technician Level I
• CTQP Concrete Field Inspector Level II (Bridges)
• CTQP Asphalt Roadway Level I
• CTQP Asphalt Roadway Level II
• CTQP Earthwork Construction Inspection Level I
• CTQP Earthwork Construction Inspection Level II
• CTQP Pile Driving Inspection
• CTQP Drilled Shaft Inspection
• FDOT Intermediate MOT
• IMSA Traffic Signal Inspector Level I
• Nuclear Radiation Safety
• Florida Stormwater, Erosion, and Sedimentation Control Training and Certification Program for Inspectors and Contractors

*Relevant certifications are essential for ongoing advancement and enhanced opportunities for assignments*

Occasional overnight work and/or assignments outside of employee’s primary location may be required

Relocation assistance is not available for this position

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
