jobs.description:
Walden Security is currently recruiting experienced Court Security Officers. CSOs will provide armed security to courthouses under the USMS contract.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Includes the following and other duties may be assigned:

Perform entrance control: Enforce the District’s entry and identification system which includes operating security screening equipment to detect weapons, contraband, and prohibited items, checking items such as handbags, briefcases, computers, packages, baby carriages, wheelchairs, etc.

Perform roving patrol: Patrol court facilities and grounds of the facility in accordance with applicable post orders.

Perform stationary post assignments: Stand guard at stationary posts which include (but not limited to) monitoring closed-circuit television, duress alarm systems and other security equipment, courtrooms, judge chambers, and jury rooms.

Perform escort duties: When directed, provide armed escort services for judges, court personnel, jurors, and other designated individuals.

Perform garage parking and pedestrian control: Where applicable, direct traffic and control lights on court facility properties, as described in the post orders and/or standard operating procedures.

Enforce law and order: Enforce federal law while in the performance of assigned duties. This includes (but not limited to) detaining any person attempting to gain unauthorized access to Government property, or a court proceeding(s), or attempting to commit acts that imperil the safety and security of Government employees, property, and the public.

Prepare reports and records: Prepare various reports and records regarding contract performance issues, such as labor hours worked, accidents, fire, bomb threats, unusual incidents, or unlawful acts that occurred within the court facility area.

Court attendance: Responsible for securing unattended courtrooms, an inspection of courtrooms prior to a proceeding, testing of security devices, and other duties concerning security of the court area.

Requirements

Education and/or Experience: High school diploma or general education degree (GED). Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Must possess the ability to understand, explain, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, directives, and procedures.

Must have completed or graduated from certified Federal, state, county, local or military law enforcement training academy and able to provide certification as proof.

jobs.description:
AECOM is hosting an exclusive, invitation-only hiring event in Raleigh on October 28-29, 2026. This is a great opportunity to learn and connect with AECOM for career opportunities starting Spring/Summer 2027.

• Assist with the design and preparation of roadway construction plans including alignments, profiles, cross-sections, and quantity summaries.
• Support senior engineers in developing right-of-way (ROW) plans, maintenance of traffic (MOT) layouts, and cost estimates.
• Learn and apply NCDOT roadway design standards , manuals, and plan preparation procedures.

• Experience with MicroStation or OpenRoads Designer in an academic or professional setting.
• Coursework or exposure to transportation engineering, highway design, and/or traffic engineering

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
• Interest in learning MicroStation , OpenRoads Designer , and NCDOT plan preparation standards

Who you'll be:

As a PM/Scrum Master, you will take on the dual role of guiding project management initiatives and promoting Agile/Scrum practices within the development team. You will be central in defining project scopes, setting objectives, and managing deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders. Your role will also encompass creating detailed project plans, managing resources and budgets, assessing risks, and facilitating Scrum ceremonies to ensure effective team functioning.

• Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

There are more than 9 million immunocompromised people in the United States. Almost half a million of those represent a population that are moderately to severely immunocompromised and at highest risk for severe COVID-19, including stem cell and solid organ transplant patients as well as those with hematologic cancers.

At Invivyd, Inc., we take those numbers very seriously and we come to work each day on a mission to deliver protection from serious viral infectious diseases, beginning with SARS-CoV-2. Invivyd deploys a proprietary integrated technology platform unique in the industry designed to assess, monitor, develop, and adapt to create best in class antibodies.

In March 2024, Invivyd received emergency use authorization (EUA) from the U.S. FDA for a monoclonal antibody (mAb) in its pipeline of innovative antibody candidates.

In October 2025, the FDA cleared the company's Investigational New Drug (IND) application and provided feedback to advance the company's REVOLUTION clinical program, Invivyd's development program for VYD2311, a vaccine alternative monoclonal antibody being investigated for the prevention of COVID-19.

Be part of making a difference. Be part of Invivyd.

Location: Remote (Boston)

Position Summary:

At Invivyd, we’re building a new category of infectious disease prevention. With an authorized product already on the market, a next-generation program in Phase 3 and a strong pipeline behind it, we are at a defining moment of growth.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Strategic Account Manager who will play a pivotal role at Invivyd. This is an incredible opportunity for someone who is passionate about making a difference for patients, executing successful sales strategies and supporting a culture of adaptability and compliance. In this role, you will lead strategic territory planning, cultivate high-value partnerships across key accounts, and deliver clear, compliant education on approved messaging to diverse healthcare stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

• The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for providing solutions to our customers by acting as a key business owner of Invivyd resources and solutions for a variety of customers, including Health Care Providers, Health Care Organizations, Centers of Excellence, Integrated Delivery Network (IDN) Stakeholders, Veterans Affairs (VA) Centers, Reimbursement Personnel, and Practice Administrators and is accountable for working collaboratively to help ensure customer inquiries are resolved.

• Facilitate clinical dialogue that compels the customer to act on behalf of their patients and engage the entire account to understand any obstacles that exist to provide appropriate solutions

• Identify shared priorities and leverage knowledge and tactics within full account to develop a strategic territory business plan that drives product demand by meeting the needs of key partners and ultimately their patients to drive superior results

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners on overall account and territory strategy to maximize internal/external knowledge on how to access products and services

• Aggregate customer, market data, and insights to effectively apply multiple channels to drive total selling engagements.

• Utilize data driven approach to prioritize customers/accounts to maximize impact aligned to strategic plan.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree strongly preferred; candidates without a degree with significant relevant, related industry experience will be considered

• A minimum of 10 years of sales in the biopharma industry is preferred

• Candidates must live within the stated territory

• Ability to travel up to 100% within your geography is required, with the ability to drive and/or fly within the territory is required

• Candidate is required to be in the field five days a week, conducting visits, while also completing all administrative tasks related to the role

• Proven track record of consistent high performance, and well versed in navigating and successfully selling to large accounts and key customer segments is required

• Strong ability to communicate compliant clinical product information is required

• Diverse experience in a matrixed environment and exposure to Reimbursement, Buy-and-Bill, Specialty Pharmacies, IDNs, and Federal channels is required

• Strong understanding and experience with following the laws, regulations, and industry codes (e.g., the PhRMA Code on Interactions with Healthcare Professionals) that govern appropriate interactions with Healthcare Professionals and Healthcare Organizations is required

• Demonstrates knowledge of the Veterans Affairs (VA) system within territory and the rules and regulations to conduct business within the VA system

• Must be results oriented and can demonstrate time management skills

• Possess a broad understanding of case management, market access, reimbursement and selling a medical benefit product

• Has experience working with Hem/Onc, Rheumatology, Transplant, Hospital/IDN, Veterans Affairs, immunology, account management strategy, and new product launches

• Demonstrated effective time management, organizational and interpersonal skills to prioritize opportunities

• Proven winning attitude and experience demonstrated by sales numbers that consistently beat quotas, Presidents Club wins and other awards won

$152,000 - $202,000

jobs.title: Director, FP&A
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Director, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), you'll lead finance for GitLab's Research & Development (R&D) organization, our largest operating expense area. You'll be the strategic finance partner to our Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and their leadership team, owning R&D planning, forecasting, and investment decisions.

R&D builds our AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform, which more than 100,000 organizations use. You'll connect investment in headcount, infrastructure, AI and cloud usage, and tooling to product outcomes, with clear measurement and reliable forecasts.

You'll sit at the CTO's staff table, shape GitLab's long-range plan, and help leadership decide where to invest next, making R&D spend predictable.

What you’ll do

• Serve as the finance advisor to the CTO and R&D leadership. Hold partners accountable for execution against plan and connect R&D priorities to company financial targets.

• Lead annual planning, and rolling forecasts for R&D. Own the operating plan across headcount, compensation, contractors, hosting and cloud, AI and large language model (LLM) costs, software, and tooling.

• Build frameworks that connect R&D investment to product roadmap outcomes. Evaluate business cases for new initiatives, AI capabilities, build-versus-buy decisions, and vendor commitments, and present risks and opportunities to leadership.

• Define and track R&D efficiency metrics, including R&D spend as a percentage of revenue, cost per engineer, hosting cost per user, and AI inference cost per feature. Identify large-scale savings and reallocation opportunities and see them through to completion.

• Partner with People and R&D leaders on hiring plans, location strategy, and organizational design. Keep headcount forecasts accurate and reconciled to actuals.

• Lead the AI transformation of R&D finance. Rethink planning, forecasting, and reporting workflows, and use AI tools to make them faster, more accurate, and more insightful.

• Redesign FP&A processes, policies, and planning and reporting systems for efficiency and effectiveness, with AI in the center. Work with Accounting on capitalized software, accruals, and allocations, and with Procurement on process improvements.

• Lead and develop your R&D finance team:: hire and coach team members, set goals and priorities, and give expert feedback. Put GitLab's values into practice through handbook-first, asynchronous collaboration across time zones.

What you’ll bring

• Extensive finance experience, including serving as the lead finance partner to an R&D, Engineering, or Product organization plus experience leading a team of analysts

• A strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and R&D cost drivers, including engineering headcount, cloud hosting, AI and LLM usage, software licenses, and capitalized software development.

• Experience leading process redesign and change in a finance team, including hands-on use of AI tools to improve how work gets done.

• Expertise in influencing senior technical stakeholders and translating complex analysis into clear recommendations for executives.

• Advanced financial modeling skills that follow industry best practices, expertise in Google Sheets, and hands-on experience with financial and data visualization tools. We don't use Excel for modeling.

• A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, and the ability to use GitLab.

• Preferred experience includes enterprise software-as-a-service (SaaS) finance; direct CTO partnership; NetSuite, Sisense, Adaptive Planning, or SQL; or a Master of Business Administration (MBA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification.

This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. jobs.title: Finance Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management.  Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.

What We Need

NetBrain is looking for a Finance Operations Manager to make the finance team faster, clearer and easier to work with. You will own the flow of information between accounting, FP&A and the rest of the business, and you will use modern AI tools to take manual work out of it. You do not need to be a CPA. You need to be a builder who understands how finance work moves, can see where it gets stuck, and can fix it.

What You'll Do

Run the Finance Operating Rhythm

• Own the monthly close calendar and give everyone outside accounting a clear view of what is open and when it lands.

• Keep a single tracker for deadlines, owners and dependencies across accounting, FP&A, orders and RevOps.

• Run the recurring finance meetings, capture decisions and follow every action item to closure.

Fix How Information Moves

• Map how information flows between finance teams and find where work waits.

• Set up simple, repeatable hand-offs, so teams are told about changes (new vendors, entities, team moves) before systems break.

• Turn one-off requests into standard reports and dashboards that go out on a schedule.

Automate With AI

• Find manual, repetitive finance tasks and replace them with AI tools and automated workflows.

• Write short playbooks and train finance team members to use them.

• Measure results: hours saved, days cut from the close, errors avoided.

Support Projects and Audits

• Coordinate cross-functional finance projects from scoping to delivery, including audit requests and year-end work.

• Prepare clean, well-organized support for auditors and the executive team.

• Help prepare and track budget and planning milestones.

What You Bring

• 4 to 6 years in finance operations, FP&A, revenue accounting, accounting operations, business operations or a similar role

• Comfortable with the close, month-end reporting and the order-to-cash flow, even if you have not run them

• AI experience (Claude preferred) with curiosity for trying new tools.

• You can run a project with many owners, track it and finish it

• Clear writing, steady follow-up, and the ability to work with people you do not manage

• Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.

• Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.

What We Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.

For this role, the estimated base is $115,000 - $140,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.

NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Permit Operations
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY 


The U.S. construction permitting process is a black box. Over 500,000 forms and 20,000 processes, yet 95% of cities use the same building code. Every permitting delay costs businesses revenue, stalls expansion, and disrupts construction schedules.

Founded in 2022 by builders, entrepreneurs, and industry experts, GreenLite  https://greenlite.comeliminates permitting uncertainty for developers nationwide. 
We combine AI-powered technology with an in-house team of registered architects, engineers, and city planners to deliver the fastest, most predictable path to permit approval. Our expert-led compliance process ensures plans are code-ready before submission, reducing revisions, delays, and costs.

GreenLite has raised $86M in venture funding from leading investors including Insight Partners, Energize Capital, Craft Ventures, LiveOak Ventures, Trust Ventures, and Chicago Ventures. National brands, including Walgreens, TD Bank, and Driven Brands, trust us to accelerate approvals, reduce risk, and unlock growth.




THE ROLE

GreenLite is seeking a Project Manager, Permit Operations to join our GLX Operations and Regulatory Team, and work closely with the Operations Manager. This person will also work hip-to-hip with the Head of Code Enforcement and the rest of the Permit Operations TeamYour day consists of doing the day to day work, servicing customers, managing your portfolio of projects, and working with Permit Coordinators. This is a client-facing role that requires good verbal and written communication skills, a deep understanding of construction / development cycles (for commercial and residential) as well as confirming that there are good outcomes between client / design teams and the building department. 





WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING  

On any given day, you can expect to do the following key activities:  

 - Regulatory Research and diligence for commercial/residential development projects, Public Works/Utility Projects, EV Charging,  Minor Land Use/Entitlements, as well as internal Operational/Development initiatives that involve licensing & regulatory requirements.

 - Communicating with local governments to confirm research findings and gather additional information on processes that can be communicated to customers. (e.g. - Calling the Jurisdiction to ensure the permitting process pertaining to  a client’s project doesn’t involve any extra forms/fees that may not be listed online)

 - Gathering supporting documents (internally, and obtaining them from clients externally via software/email), completing applications and submitting them to local and state government agencies – typically building/construction permits.

 - Frequently following up on submitted applications, and managing/communicating the timeline or estimated completion date, with the goal of getting all applications approved ASAP.

 - Forecasting and projecting project timelines and dates of permit issuance

 - Working in close conjunction with Permit Coordinators to further support project milestones

 - Utilizing Agentic workflow tools to further enable the functions listed above





HOW YOU’LL BE EVALUATED  

We will define specific goals together for your first 30, 60, and 90 days: 

 - Applications for client projects, as well as internal registrations & licenses are completed and submitted quickly, and correctly with minimum supervision.

 - Research & diligence projects are completed thoroughly and efficiently, with direct, reliable sources/data and findings.

 - Good relationships established with a network of government agencies and local expertise across different jurisdictions that can be called upon for help navigating processes for future projects.

 - Positive, responsive relationship with clients, that fosters trust, and credibility for the company.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 

We will define specific goals together for your first 30, 60, and 90 days: 

 - 2-4 years of experience  in construction permitting, entitlements, legal filings, zoning, land use, business licensing, government affairs, or a combination of these.

 - Degree in Public Policy, Urban Planning, Real Estate Development, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or other research-focused program preferred, but not required. Paralegal Certs/CPM/RE License/Contractors License + experience in place of degree.

 - Ability to serve as a technical resource for sales calls

 - Ability to read, analyze and translate/summarize government and legal code/statutes - including Building Code, Land Use/Zoning, Development Ordinances, Code Enforcement Policies

 - Excellent written and interpersonal skills - not afraid to make phone calls, negotiate and over-communicate both internally and externally with clients and jurisdictions

 - Independently motivated, but willing to work with a team — able to work independently on assigned projects, but also willing to assist teammates and ask for help from teammates when needed.

 - Strong organizational skills and extreme attention to detail

 - Demonstrated ability to manage priorities and projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

 - Initiative and bias for action, on-time delivery, and operational excellence

 - Honest and direct without any ego

 - Ability to utilize, or quickly learn to use, multiple software applications including our own platform, Asana, Notion, G-Suite, UpCode

 - Ability to utilize AI tools including Claude and Chat GPT


THRIVE WITH GREENLITE

 - Competitive Compensation - Generous base salary & access to our Employee Equity Program, so you can grow with us.

 - Performance-Based Annual Bonuses - Rewards for high-impact results and contributions that move the needle.

 - Premium Health Coverage - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance for full-time team members and their families.

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan - Helping you invest in your future with smart saving options.

 - Parental Leave - Generous parental leave for all parents to support your growing family.

 - Wellness Support - Monthly Wellness Stipend and full access to Wellhub, Talkspace, & Teladoc for your physical and mental well-being.

 - Weekly Team Lunches - Enjoy catered lunches every week in our NYC office. Great food, better company.

 - Company-Wide Team All Hands - Held twice a year, fostering transparency, alignment, and inspiration.

 - Team-Building Events - Regular opportunities to connect, collaborate, and celebrate as a team.

 - Unlimited PTO - Flexible time off so you can recharge, travel, or take care of life as needed.

 - Hybrid Work Environment – Our team thrives on collaboration, so we’re in the office 4 days per week. In the summer, we switch to a 3-day in-office schedule to give everyone extra flexibility.
   
   


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT 

GreenLite values people from all walks of life and professional backgrounds. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about the construction industry and want the opportunity to grow in your career, we encourage you to apply.

GreenLite is an equal employment opportunity employer, committed to an inclusive workplace where we do not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, gender, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or familial status, age, ancestry, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We believe in diversity and encourage any qualified individual to apply.

jobs.description:

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. jobs.title: Senior Creative Technologist
jobs.description:
Kettle designs digital products with soul, for some of the most ambitious consumer brands in the world. Our work lives at the intersection of product thinking and brand storytelling; products that are just as considered in feeling as they are in function.

We are looking for a Senior Creative Technologist to join our team, someone who builds the tools, workflows, and accelerators that help Kettle do its best work. In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of emerging AI capabilities and our creative and product practices, rapidly turning what's newly possible into things our teams can use. This is a role for someone who is deeply technical and deeply curious; you’re equally comfortable in the code and in a creative conversation, and you know when to move fast, and when to bring in technical rigor.

Candidates should have:

• Hands-on experience in creative technology, applied AI development, or a related technical discipline, with a track record of shipping things that work in real environments, not just a sandbox

• A portfolio that demonstrates technical depth and creative range: client work, functional tools, interactive experiences, AI-powered demos, or workflow systems built with intention

• Fluency across the generative AI landscape.You follow new model launches and capability releases closely, and you have recent examples of work that responds to what's emerging

• Strong command of modern front-end development, headless CMSs, AI APIs and tooling

• You understand what it means to build something secure, performant, and structurally sound, and you know when to bring in software build principles to experiments

• The self-direction to pick up problems independently and drive them to completion

• Collaborate across disciplines, including Design, Product Management, Copy, Strategy, and Production. You enjoy helping others bring their best ideas to life

Nice to have:

• Experience building AI-powered pipelines or workflow accelerators in an agency or product environment

• Familiarity with agentic systems and AI-native development environments

• Experience with Python, Node, and Swift

We'd like to know that you can:

• Move quickly from "what could we do with this?" to something working and worth sharing, without waiting for a fully defined brief

• Translate experiments into clear, reusable outputs (working code, demos, documentation, shared patterns) that make new capabilities accessible across disciplines and stick beyond a single project

• Show up credibly in a room: present your work and represent technical thinking to internal stakeholders and in client conversations

• Adapt across contexts, from rapid prototyping and experimentation, to more structured build and delivery

The target range of base compensation for this role is $140k - 160k. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

jobs.title: Controls Design Manager - Data Center Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking a Controls Design Manager to work with our team and partner with our client, supporting design leadership for new and existing construction builds, with a focus on data center development.

The Controls Design Manager should have a strong background in building automation systems (BAS), industrial controls, SCADA, PLC-based systems, and data center critical infrastructure controls, with deep experience in controls design, engineering leadership, integration, and commissioning support.

Responsibilities:

• Provides support and reports to the assigned Project Manager(s) or Project Director. This position has frequent interaction with the Owner/Client, consultants, design professionals, systems integrators, and contractors.
• Directly assist the Project Manager(s) in managing, coordinating, and administering the project through all phases of design and construction, with an emphasis on controls systems design, integration, and automation strategy.
• Responsible for ensuring all aspects of client services are delivered at the highest level to ensure the client's needs are addressed, including technical guidance on Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), SCADA systems, and critical facility controls architecture.
• Aids in the preparation of documents (reports, schedules, invoices, RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes/agendas, daily reports, change orders, inspections, closeout, and client presentations) for programming, design, and construction, and will assist in maintaining information in project management software.
• Coordinate and schedule meetings with the project team as directed by the Project Manager(s).
• Communicate conceptual controls designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction, including controls sequences of operation, controls design standards, points lists, network architecture drawings, and controls specifications.
• Maintain Basis of Design (BOD), prototype controls designs, and template specifications for automation and controls systems, ensuring alignment with evolving business, operational, and reliability requirements.
• Review and inform design RFPs, including scope development for controls engineering and systems integration services.
• Manage external controls consultants, commissioning providers, and systems integrators through the design and construction process, ensuring controls contract documents are completed on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with company standards.
• Effectively communicate controls standards and automation requirements to internal and external project partners, including engineering, operations, commissioning, and facilities teams.
• Manage multiple fast-paced projects simultaneously, providing strategic technical leadership across controls system design, integration, and operational readiness activities.
• Think outside the box to identify innovative controls solutions that improve operational efficiency, reliability, monitoring capabilities, and scalability while reducing lifecycle costs.
• Support procurement activities through vendor submittal reviews, controls equipment evaluations, factory witness testing (FAT), and integrated systems testing planning.
• Lead the review of controls sequences, alarms, trending strategies, system integrations, and monitoring requirements to ensure compliance with operational and reliability objectives.
• Identify and implement innovative technologies that enhance automation, predictive monitoring, energy efficiency, fault detection, and system resilience.
• Support commissioning and startup efforts, including controls functional performance testing, integrated systems testing (IST), and turnover documentation reviews.
• Stay current with industry advancements and apply best practices related to controls systems, automation technologies, cybersecurity requirements, and data center operations.
• Communicate and enforce engineering, controls, and design policies across the organization.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role and are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in controls design, building automation, industrial automation, or mission-critical facilities.
• Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), SCADA, PLCs, and networked control systems.
• Experience supporting hyperscale data center, mission-critical, or industrial facility projects.
• Strong understanding of integrated systems testing, commissioning, and controls system operations.
• Familiarity with control system cybersecurity requirements and industry standards.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package.  Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist Solutions Engineer, Cloudflare One
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: London, Munich, Amsterdam, Paris, Lisbon

About the Department

The Specialist Solutions Engineering team at Cloudflare is a group of trusted technical advisors who partner with our customers to solve their most complex security and performance challenges. We work hand-in-hand with the sales organization to navigate the entire customer journey, from initial discovery and solution design to proof-of-concept and implementation. We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping our customers understand and leverage the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve their business critical objectives.

About the Role

As a Senior Solutions Engineer Specialist, you will be a pivotal technical expert and strategic advisor, focusing on the Cloudflare One product suite. You will partner with our sales team and engage directly with our customers to architect and demonstrate how our SASE platform can solve their unique security, performance, and reliability needs. Your expertise will be crucial in guiding prospects through complex technical evaluations, ensuring they have the confidence to adopt Cloudflare as a core component of their IT and security infrastructure.

This role requires a blend of deep technical curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine passion for helping customers transform their network and security architecture. Candidates are expected to actively use AI tools in their day-to-day life for research, preparation, automation, or customer engagement.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to our customers, helping them architect the optimal solution for their business needs using the Cloudflare One product suite.

• Stay at the forefront of AI-era security challenges by developing expertise in how enterprises govern and secure AI tool adoption, including Shadow AI visibility, data loss prevention for AI applications, MCP server access controls and Agentic AI Governance.

• Guide qualified prospects through the solution design and proof-of-value stages, effectively demonstrating the key capabilities and value of the Cloudflare One portfolio.

• Collaborate with sales partners to consistently achieve pipeline generation and revenue goals.

• Analyze customer IT landscapes and security requirements to develop robust architectures that support their strategic objectives.

• Clearly articulate the benefits and technical differentiators of the Cloudflare One product portfolio against competing solutions.

• Enhance customer retention by identifying, capturing, and communicating product gaps or feature requests to internal product and engineering teams.

• Collaborate with Product Teams by being the voice of our customers by sharing insights, trends, and product gaps to help shape the product suite and solution roadmap.

Qualifications

Successful candidates are curious, customer-focused, and have a passion for learning. We are looking for individuals with a strong background in technical sales or systems engineering who can effectively communicate complex concepts to both technical and executive audiences.

Key Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Sales, Solutions/Systems Engineering, or a related field.

• Active adoption of the use of AI tools in professional day to day workflows and knowledge on AI security concepts relevant to enterprise customers: Securing employee AI tool usage, Governing AI application access, and understanding the data leakage risks posed by generative AI tools

• Demonstrated experience presenting technical solutions and communicating the value of network and security transformation to senior-level executives.

• Deep understanding of the modern cybersecurity landscape, including common threats (e.g., malware, ransomware, phishing, botnets) and mitigation strategies.

• Fundamental knowledge of customer network and application architectures, including hybrid environments leveraging public clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP).

• Solid grasp of SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.

• Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Secure Web Gateway (SWG), CASB, DLP, DNS security (including DNS over HTTPS), Identity Provider (IdP) integration (SAML, OTP), and SIEM/log analytics platforms.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

• Fluent in English (written & spoken), Russian and/or Hebrew advantageous

• Proficiency with networking fundamentals, including routing, subnetting, VPNs, and SD-WAN concepts.

• Understanding of AI agentic architecture and the security requirements and challenges in implementation at scale.

• Familiarity with client operating system fundamentals and software distribution methods.

• Knowledge of the competitive landscape for CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions.

• Direct experience with Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions (Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation) is a significant plus.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to work to deadlines and prioritize effectively among competing goals.

Compensation

• For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €116,000 - €165,000.

Equity

• This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.description:
Ruby Labs is a leading technology company specialising in innovative consumer products across multiple technology sectors. The company focuses on D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) subscription products. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for Senior User Acquisition Manager (UAM) to take full ownership of TikTok acquisition for D2C products. This is a hands-on media buying role. You will be the owner of TikTok as an acquisition channel for your brand: from account structure, bidding and budget allocation to creative testing, measurement and scaling. You will work against real revenue data (CPA, ROAS, payback), not surface-level platform metrics, and you are expected to find and unlock new growth levers on your own.

We work AI-first, so we also expect you to use Claude and automation to speed up campaign builds, analysis, reporting and optimization.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own all TikTok acquisition: strategy, execution, and results.

 - Scale spend profitably across geos and funnels while holding CPA, ROAS and payback targets based on real revenue data.

 - Build and optimize account structure, conversion events, bidding strategies and budget allocation (including Smart+ / automated campaign types, Spark Ads and other TikTok formats).

 - Run a structured creative testing process: brief and iterate with the creative team, define hypotheses, decide what to kill and what to scale, and fight creative fatigue.

 - Analyze performance daily and weekly, diagnose drops and spikes quickly, and act on them.

 - Work with product, analytics and creative teams to improve funnels, signals and attribution quality.

 - Maintain account health: handle ad disapprovals, appeals and restrictions, and build prevention-first habits so policy issues are caught before launch.

 - Work with the TikTok team on betas, new campaign types, product changes and escalations.

 - Document tests, learnings and playbooks so knowledge does not depend on one person.

 - Use Claude and automation to speed up campaign builds, QA, reporting and optimization.

 - Test new Paid Social Channels, such as: OpenAI Ads, X Ads, and others.


QUALIFICATIONS


MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - Senior: 5+ years of hands-on paid social / user acquisition experience.

 - Strong hands-on TikTok Ads experience as a primary channel: scaling accounts profitably, not just running tests.

 - Proven record of managing sizeable budgets independently: ideally $1M+/month on TikTok or paid social.

 - Strong understanding of subscription / app economics: LTV, ROAS, payback windows, cohorts.

 - Solid creative testing discipline and experience working with creative teams on concepts and iteration.

 - Experience with policy issues: disapprovals, appeals, account restrictions.

 - Analytical mindset: comfortable working with MMP / backend data and diagnosing performance from account-level data.

 - Ownership mentality: able to run a channel end-to-end with minimal supervision.

 - Clear, direct communication.


STRONG ADVANTAGE

 - Experience with D2C subscription, health, wellness or app products, and with web-to-app / web funnels.

 - Experience with Meta or other paid social platforms alongside TikTok.

 - Experience working directly with TikTok platform reps on betas and escalations.

 - Experience building Claude, AI or automation workflows for media buying.


LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.


BENEFITS

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

 - Company-provided MacBook: Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Read more about it here: Independent Contractor Agreement https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dHF4ctKlez75whdn-ybUwP5d5Wr0BdwVrorrm_fM40Q/preview

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!


INTERVIEW PROCESS

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

 - Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

 - Technical Interview (60 minutes)

 - Final Interview (45 minutes)


LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we're a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that a diversity of thought and backgrounds builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status. Join us and be part of a company that is crafting the future of technology across multiple industries.

jobs.title: Anlægs- eller konstruktionsingeniør til Rambøll Grønland A/S
jobs.description:
Søger du nye udfordringer, så er Rambøll Grønland A/S måske noget for dig?

Grundet en stigende tilgang af opgaver søger Rambøll Grønland A/S en anlægs- eller konstruktionsingeniør med erfaring og interesse inden for anlæg, geoteknik og marine byggerier.

Jobbeskrivelse

Du bliver en del af vores anlægsafdeling, hvor du særligt vil blive tilknyttet vores mange havneopgaver. Du vil her blive inddraget i alle faser fra registrering hen over projektering til udførelse. Opgaverne spænder bredt hvorfor fra renovering og nybyggeri til rådgivning i strategisk planlægning, hvorfor du skal trives med meget forskellige og alsidige opgaver.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver alsidige, hvor du vil tilegne dig en høj grad af lokalkendskab i de enkelte byer og bygder, og du får rig lejlighed til at udforske den nyeste viden og teknologi inden for ”Arctic Engineering”. Mange opgaver løses i tværfaglige projektteams, hvor du har ansvaret for dit eget fagområde. Du kan forvente rejseaktiviteter i forbindelse med havne projekter langs den grønlandske kyst.

Din profil

Det er ikke afgørende om du har 1-5 års erfaring eller 15 år+, da vi har mulighed for at tilrettelægge stillingens indhold og ansvar med udgangspunkt i din specifikke baggrund i samspil med kolleger inden for anlæg og havne i Rambøll Grønland samt i afdelingen for marine konstruktioner i Rambøll Danmark.

Da vi udgør en blandet medarbejdersammensætning med mange engagerede og specialiserede ingeniører, er det vigtigt, at du trives i et mangfoldigt miljø og besidder en vis rummelighed. Derudover forventer vi, at du:

• er udadvendt, engageret, fleksibel og løsningsorienteret
• har erfaring med beregning af spunskonstruktioner og geoteknik
• har erfaring med beregninger af stål- og betonkonstruktioner i øvrigt
• har erfaring med udarbejdelse af arbejdsbeskrivelser
• har erfaring med Revit eller MicroStation
• har evt. erfaring med anlægsprojekteirng
• har evt. erfaring med byggeledelse
• har evt. erfaring med projektledelse
• har evt. kendskab til Plaxis el. lignende geotekniske beregningsprogrammer.

Ligeledes vil erfaring med projekter i Grønland/Arktis være en fordel, men ingen betingelse.

Bliv en del af Rambøll Grønland

Rambøll Grønland A/S har kontorer i Nuuk, Sisimiut og Ilulissat. Dit arbejdssted vil som udgangspunkt være på hovedkontoret i Nuuk med mulighed for kortere perioder i Sisimiut og/eller Ilulissat. Vi hjælper gerne med oplysninger i forbindelse med bolig og andre lokalforhold.

Om at arbejde hos Rambøll

Når du arbejder hos Rambøll, bliver du en del af en vidensorganisation med mennesket i fokus. Vi fokuserer på videndeling og samarbejde på tværs af kompetencer og geografi, og vi sigter efter mangfoldighed blandt vores medarbejdere. Det giver os mulighed for at løse en bred vifte af projekter, og vi tror på, at tværfagligt samarbejde fører til kreative og langtidsholdbare løsninger. Derfor er mulighederne hos Rambøll også mange og forskelligartede.

Ansøgning

Ønsker du at vide mere om stilling og arbejdsvilkår, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte projektleder Andreas Bak på mail: AMBAK@ramboll.gl eller telefon +299 32 40 88

Ansøgning samt CV sendes senest 15. november 2026 via knappen "Apply now".

jobs.description:
As a Sr. DevSecOps Engineer I, you’ll play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and efficient software development and deployment pipelines. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security practices seamlessly into the development and operations lifecycle, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, secure, and reliable software solutions.

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

What you’ll do:

• Collaborate with customers and internal teams to design and implement technical solutions across multiple classification environments, working independently or collaboratively to address complex requirements.

• Develop CI/CD pipelines from scratch in GitLab and Jenkins with integrated security scanning and STIG compliance validation, providing expert guidance on pipeline troubleshooting and DevSecOps best practices.

• Create and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates, primarily using CloudFormation, to architect highly available, resilient, and secure DevSecOps tool infrastructure across AWS environments (GovCloud, C2S, TC2S) while ensuring STIG compliance.

• Lead advanced troubleshooting by analyzing system and application logs via Linux command-line tools, conducting root cause analysis, and developing mitigation strategies for service degradation.

• Provide expert guidance to development teams on secure coding practices, STIG compliance, and vulnerability remediation in support of ATO efforts, while mentoring junior engineers through code reviews, IaC best practices, and technical documentation.

• Active TS/SCI with CI Poly security clearance.

• Certification to satisfy DoD 8140/8570 (e.g., Security+, or equivalent).

• 5+ years as a DevSecOps Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or similar.

• Strong hands-on Linux experience.

• Experience with designing, deploying, and managing production-grade Kubernetes (K8s) or OpenShift clusters via automation with Ansible and Terraform and/or CloudFormation in on-prem and cloud environments.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab, or equivalent) and containerization.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
In the time it takes you to read this job description, RapidSOS will have handled ~1,380 emergencies.

At RapidSOS, we are committed to using technology to build a safer, stronger future and working together to save lives. We’re in an exciting phase of growth, welcoming new members from across the globe to our mission-driven, ambitious, and inclusive team. Our work is founded on our values of trust and safety, pioneering, urgency, and purpose over pride, all of which support a company culture where people can innovate, collaborate, grow, and, above all, make an impact.

RapidSOS is the leading public safety AI company that unlocks mission-critical intelligence for emergency response. It harnesses artificial and human intelligence to fuse life-saving data from the world’s largest safety network, which includes over 700M+ connected devices and 200+ global technology companies. This intelligence is delivered to 23,000+ federal, state, and local agencies, serving one million first responders. RapidSOS has supported over one billion emergencies in 16 countries, powering RapidSOS HARMONY, the first purpose-built AI for public safety, designed to save critical time by automatically detecting emergencies, unifying real-time data and video streams, and coordinating a faster, more effective response. Learn more at www.RapidSOS.com.

What this role is about:

RapidSOS is growing fast, and finance has to keep pace. We’re looking for an FP&A Manager who treats financial analysis as a systems problem. You’d rather build the model, workflow, or dashboard that answers a question every month than answer it by hand every month. You’ll own core pillars of our FP&A function. You’ll partner with BI and data teams to move recurring analysis out of spreadsheets and into durable systems. And you’ll put sharp, timely insight in front of the executive team and board. This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy seat on a lean team. You’ll create structure where little exists, make judgment calls without much precedent, and anticipate what the business needs before anyone asks.

What you’ll do:

Own and evolve the company’s core operating models, including the scenario and sensitivity analysis that shapes our planning cycles.Lead budgeting and forecasting, and own forecast accuracy as a measure of your success.Deliver monthly reporting packages for the executive team and board: on time, accurate, and conclusion-first.Build and maintain the KPI dashboards and performance metrics leadership relies on to run the business.Support monthly and quarterly close with variance analysis that surfaces trends, risks, and opportunities early.Act as a strategic thought partner to cross-functional leaders, turning their questions into actionable answers.Partner with BI and data engineering to automate recurring analysis into governed, scalable systems.Use AI tools to accelerate your own work and raise the analytical bar across finance.

What we’re looking for in our ideal candidate:

• 5+ years in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or equity research. SaaS or technology experience is strongly preferred.

• A track record of owning modeling and forecasting end to end with minimal oversight.

• Advanced financial modeling skills, plus experience with planning software (e.g., Abacum, Adaptive Insights, Anaplan) and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

• Fluency with modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) and genuine excitement about how they can change the way finance works.

• Clear, conclusion-first communication, in writing and when presenting to executives and the board.

• A self-directed, scrappy, resilient approach. You move quickly, pivot when priorities shift, and find the gaps before anyone points them out.

• High integrity and a strong sense of urgency and results orientation.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

What we offer:

• The chance to work with a passionate team on solving one of the largest challenges globally

• Competitive salary and benefits and equity participation

• A dynamic, flexible and fun start-up work environment with a highly talented team

If you're curious to learn more about RapidSOS, you can check out https://rapidsos.com/blog/

jobs.title: Director, Global Partnerships & Channels
jobs.description:
Percona is hiring a Director of Channels & Alliances to lead our shift from a direct-led go-to-market model to a partner-amplified one. Partners extend our reach, add delivery capacity, and let us transact in markets we can't serve directly today.



Percona is a fully open source database software and services company. We help organizations run MySQL, PostgreSQL, Valkey/Redis, Maria DB, and MongoDB at scale, on premises and in the cloud.



You will own the full partner portfolio across two of our categories:

Hyperscalers

 - Cloud distribution, easy procurement, On Prem referrals, Hyperscaler sourced and funded deals

 - Marketplace listings, private offers, co-sell, and customers applying committed cloud spend to Percona

VARs

 - Selling where we can't easily transact direct

 - Local paper, local currency, and local relationships in Asia, EMEA, and LATAM



This is a builder role. We measure partner productivity, not partner count. We want fewer, deeper relationships on a shared operating foundation. The role reports to the Chief Revenue Officer.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

Strategy and Portfolio

 - Own the Channels & Alliances strategy and run it as a quarterly plan with targets.

 - Say no to partnerships without clear customer need and a path to economic value

 - Add, tier, and exit partners based on pipeline and bookings contribution

Hyperscalers

 - Lead the team that owns our AWS relationship end to end, across AWS partner and field teams and our own sales and customer success teams

 - Drive Marketplace listings and private offers so customers can buy Percona with committed cloud spend

 - Scale co-sell, including opportunity registration and joint account planning with hyperscaler field teams

 - Secure partner funding, proof-of-concept support, and co-marketing where available

VARs and SIs Regional Expansion

 - Build VARs as our contracting and sales vehicle in Asia, EMEA, and LATAM

 - Pair VARs with regional SIs for delivery and customer access

 - Deliver local enablement, joint marketing, and packaged plays in each region

 - Negotiate partner co-funding of in-region resources where possible

Partner Operating Foundation

 - Build a partner intake and approval process

 - Track and attribute partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and bookings in Salesforce

 - Standardize deal registration

 - Create packaged plays, partner enablement, and a partner marketing toolkit

Cross-Functional Leadership

 - Secure clear commitments from Services, RevOps, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Product and Engineering, and hold each one accountable

 - Get direct sales working with partners, not around them, through clear rules of engagement and deal registration


WHAT YOU HAVE DONE

 - Built or rebuilt a partner program from scratch, including intake, tiering, economics, and deal registration

 - Driven measurable revenue in hyperscalers,SIs, and VARs

 - Hands-on hyperscaler experience with marketplaces, private offers, co-sell, and partner networks

 - Built VAR partnerships in Asia, EMEA, and LATAM, including local contracting and currency

 - Defined partner attribution in Salesforce and reported partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline

 - Understand the open source model and the value it brings to cloud providers and SIs

 - Led programs across Services, Finance, Legal, Product, and Marketing without direct authority

Preferred

 - Database, data infrastructure, and/or open source experience

 - Exposure to AWS, Azure and/or Google Cloud partner ecosystems

 - Partner programs run across multiple regions and time zones


PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

 - Builder. You create structure where none exists and finish what you start.

 - Focused. You say no to partnerships that don't pay off.

 - Analytical. You manage partners on pipeline and bookings, not activity.

 - Global. You are effective across North America, India, Asia, EMEA, and LATAM.

 - Influential. You get commitments from peers without authority and hold them to it.

 - Direct. Partners and internal teams trust you to tell them where things stand.

 - Self-directed. You move fast in ambiguity.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success means partners grow our capacity beyond direct sales. You will grow partner-sourced and partner-influenced bookings and partner-transacted revenue across all four categories, without a matching increase in direct sales and marketing spend. You will also stand up the partner operating foundation that makes that growth repeatable.



<!--WEB-ONLY-->

Why Percona?

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.



Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.



Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. jobs.title: Managing Director of Special Services, CT
jobs.description:
About Achievement First

Achievement First (AF) is a non-profit 501(c)(3) organization that currently supports 41 public charter schools in New York, Connecticut, and Rhode Island. Consistently rated as one of the top charter school networks in the country for almost 25 years, AF is committed to continuous improvement, programmatic evolution for enhanced student outcomes, and sustainable growth. The majority of AF students are Black and Latinx children from low-income families who will be the first in their families to graduate from college. AF currently employs more than 2,200 staff, 61% of whom identify as Black, Indigenous, and Multi-racial, who collectively educate nearly 15,000 students in Brooklyn and Queens, NY; New Haven, Bridgeport, and Hartford, CT; and Providence, RI.

The mission of Achievement First is to deliver on the promise of equal educational opportunity for all of America's children. AF knows that every child, regardless of race, zip code, or economic status, deserves access to great schools. At AF, students realize their potential and develop the skills they need to graduate from high school, succeed in college, thrive in a competitive world, and serve as the next generation of leaders in their communities. At AF, students and staff embark on a shared journey to fulfill their incredible potential.

We are looking for a strategic and knowledgeable Managing Director of Special Services to lead our work in Connecticut.

Your Impact

Team Special Services (TSS) develops people and systems for excellent, inclusive schools. The Managing Director of Special Services, Connecticut leads special services programming and compliance across Achievement First's Connecticut schools in New Haven, Bridgeport, and Hartford. Through the direct management and coaching of a team of 4 to 6 Special Services Directors, you will ensure the growth and success of all learners, especially students with disabilities and multilingual learners. You will build director, school leader, and stakeholder skill, ensure a baseline of effective programming across academy levels, and develop school and network teams through professional development, working group facilitation, and strong coaching practice.

Reporting directly to the Associate Chief of Special Services, your duties include but are not limited to

Developing TSS Directors and School Leaders

• Observe network and school leaders performing tasks related to their priorities

• Support them through modeling and feedback

• Observe classes, facilitate meetings, and lead strategy planning and compliance work alongside leaders

• Support schools and school leaders through tactical compliance support and longer-term leadership development, in concert with the school principal and regional superintendent

• Prepare for and follow through on school visits:

• Schedule visits

• Prepare materials such as exemplars and review prework

• Send a debrief email after each visit

Regional Strategy and Team Management

• Implement the Achievement First vision for Special Services across the Connecticut region (New Haven, Bridgeport, Hartford)

• Execute on yearly Special Services goals and strategy to ensure all AF special services are delivered in alignment with that vision

• Plan proactive and responsive strategy to address Connecticut-specific needs

• Meet with Team Special Services to align on priorities and develop skills and knowledge

Professional Development

• Design and lead PD on special services work for the entire AF network

Candidate Profile

All successful candidates for this position will have:

• A Master's degree in Education with an emphasis on special education

• Connecticut certification, or the ability to obtain it immediately, in both of the following:

• CT #165 Special Education K-12

• CT #092 Intermediate Administration or Supervision

• A proven, multi-year track record of exemplary teaching experience, preferably ensuring the achievement of low-income, minority students. This includes at least four years of highly successful teaching experience with highly effective supports of students with disabilities/IEPs

• At least five years of school or district leadership experience

In addition, the following characteristics are required to be successful on this team:

• Deep knowledge of special education regulations

• Knowledge of effective practice and coaching experience

• Ability to work across lines of difference

• Deep understanding of how our work is equity work, and the ability to lead for racial equity

• Knowing how to motivate and influence across teams

• Strong personal organization when working across multiple schools, regions, and teams

• Strong ethics and ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality

• Confidence in interacting with and influencing individuals at all levels within the organization

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment; flexible, able to work autonomously as well as take direction as needed

• Ability to multitask, with exceptional detail, follow-up, and organizational skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proactive communication style

• Belief in the Achievement First mission and educational model

Compensation

Achievement First sets salaries through a lens of equity, based on the requisite skills, education, and experience relevant to the role. The salary for this position is $150,331.20, with no flexibility. Additionally, Achievement First offers all regular, full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 403(b) retirement benefit package with match, and paid Family Leave.

Achievement First is an equal opportunity employer and an organization that values diversity. People from all diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. Spanish language proficiency is a plus. You can learn more about diversity at Achievement First here: http://achievementfirst.org/about-us/diversity/

jobs.title: Primary Care Clinician (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
The Problem

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

Who We Are

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation that delivers specialty outpatient care for people living with severe mental illness, including schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, bipolar I disorder, and treatment-resistant depression. We design and operate high-acuity, in-person clinics across the United States.

Our model integrates psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community health workers under one roof to deliver coordinated, longitudinal care for a population that has historically been fragmented across systems.

Leading health systems collaborate with Amae to bring this model to their communities, including New York-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit Health.

Why We Are Different

• Integrated care, not a referral network. Psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers work side-by-side and share responsibility for the same patients.

• Practice at the top of your license. Manageable caseloads, meaningful clinical depth, and purpose-built tools designed for this population.

• Continuous learning. Through our collaboration with Mass General Brigham, clinicians receive ongoing training, supervision, and mentorship in evidence-based SMI care.

• Advancing the field. Our clinicians contribute to new outcomes frameworks and research shaping the future of severe mental illness care.

• A model built for sustainability. Team-based care, thoughtful caseloads, and strong infrastructure make this work meaningful—and sustainable over time.

The Role

We are seeking a Primary Care Clinician (FNP, MD, or DO) for a 1099 contract opportunity at our new clinic in Long Beach, California. As part of an interdisciplinary team, you will help deliver personalized, compassionate, high-quality care to individuals with serious mental illness (SMI).

This onsite position requires a commitment of 4–5 hours per week.

In this role, you will provide holistic primary care services to Amae’s patients with severe mental illness. This position will report directly to the Clinical Director and will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, including psychiatrists, therapists, peers, and a health coach, to ensure that our members receive the highest level of care possible. This primary care role is designed to integrate with and support the mental health treatment our members receive at Amae.

What You’ll Work On:

• Conduct thorough assessments, diagnose medical conditions, and manage acute and chronic illnesses while considering their impact on mental health

• Prescribe and manage medications, ensuring safe and effective use, while considering potential interactions with psychiatric medications

• Perform routine physical examinations and preventive health screenings, integrating the findings with mental health care plans

• Educate members on health promotion, disease prevention, and management of chronic conditions, emphasizing the connection between physical and mental well-being

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date medical records and documentation that integrate with mental health care plans

• Participate in ongoing professional development and attend regular team meetings to review and discuss patient care, fostering a collaborative environment

• Uphold Amae Health's commitment to providing compassionate, holistic, and culturally sensitive care

• Adhere to all relevant ethical, legal, and professional standards

What You'll Have:

• NP Degree from an accredited school or a MD or DO degree from an accredited medical school is required

• Current, unrestricted license to practice medicine in California

• Board Certified or Board Eligible in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or related primary care specialty

• For NP PCP candidates, minimum of 5 years RN experience prior to PCP licensure and 1+ year experience as FNP after completion of clinical hours is preferred

• Previous experience working independently as a PCP

• Excellent clinical, communication, and interpersonal skills

• Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team and embrace a whole-person care approach

• Strong commitment to patient-centered care

• Flexibility to adapt to the changing needs of the organization and our members

• Preferred experience in primary care for patients with severe mental illness

• Preferred experience in whole-person, holistic, integrated care

What We're Building

As a clinician at Amae, you are not adjacent to this work. You are essential to it.

• A national care delivery model for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.

• Precision medicine for SMI. Individualized treatment informed by multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data.

• A clinical operating system that puts longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer for care teams.

• Frontier science and measurement: defining and validating the outcomes frameworks that this field has never had. Hospitalizations avoided, days stable, functional improvement, and more.

• A collaboration model with the country's leading health systems that proves coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

Compensation & Benefits

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Hourly compensation for this role will vary by on licensure.

• PCP MD/DO Compensation range: $145-$175/hr

• NP/PA Compensation range: $80-$100/hr
